chapters.title: Chapter 4501: Another Natural Treasure appears
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
This old Venerate Tier could be considered one of Brother Monkey’s internal demons, having suppressed Brother Monkey for several thousand years.
—In his whole life, when had Brother Monkey ever suffered such a loss?

If it was not for the fact that the old Venerate Tier was still apprehensive that the Battle Saint Emperor had not died, and feared that this Saint Emperor would suddenly return, Brother Monkey probably would not have the possibility of revenge either. He would have long since been blasted into smithereens.
This naturally made Brother Monkey furious. However, the old Venerate Tier had long since fled, and after he became a Venerate, he did not know where to look for him.
Brother Monkey had really travelled far and wide to look for him, only to find him easily this tim.

Needless to say, after Ling Xi and Fu Tianxing returned, they must have told him about the old Venerate Tier’s appearance. How could Brother Monkey hold himself back? He tore a rip into space and rushed over at the first instant.

They didn’t take the old Venerate to heart. He was merely at the Pseudo Venerate Tier, so if Ling Han had enough time, he would be able to grind him to death. It wasn’t necessary for him to rely on the Energy Jade.
However, would the Ziwei Imperial Clan send someone over?
Forget it, who cares.
Right now, there was nothing much left to do on the Moonlight Planet. His daughter and son-in-law had already left.
After returning to Celestial Sea Planet, Ling Han continued to guide them in cultivating.
The large black dog and the others were presently rushing over. Even if Ling Han wanted to make his next move, he would first meet up with them.

Ling Han definitely wouldn’t use the Galaxy Network anymore. The Chang Clan was clearly able to control the Galaxy Network, and it wasn’t as transcendent as they made it out to be. Thus, if he logged in on the Galaxy Network, it would be equivalent to telling everyone that he was still alive.
This was a rare opportunity. He had just created a deception of his death, so how could his persona be destroyed so quickly?
A few days later, the large black dog and the others arrived.
They hadn’t been brought here by the Nine Mountains Saint. Did they really think that Saints could be ordered around as they pleased?
Hence, they spent a very long time on their way here.
This time, almost everyone who had come out of the Genesis World had returned. His old friends had all gathered, talking about their experiences over the years. They were all extremely rueful.
“Yi?” Brother Monkey’s eyes involuntarily lit up when he saw the seven babies.
“Brother Monkey, what did you discover?” Ling Han knew that there was something unusual about the seven babies. They didn’t need to cultivate at all, yet their abilities kept increasing.
“Natural Treasure!” Brother Monkey said.
Yi?
‘What are you talking about?’
“Them?” Ling Han pointed at the babies.
Meanwhile, the seven babies cocked their heads and looked at Brother Monkey, not afraid at all.

“That’s right.” Brother Monkey nodded. “Heavenly Dao is truly amazing. Old Sun has always thought that Numinous Treasures were all gourd-like items. I never thought that they would actually take human form.”
Hold on, Brother Monkey, the aspect you are complaining about is not mistaken. These seven babies all popped out of the gourd.
Ling Han’s expression was awkward. The creativity of Heavenly Dao was really limited, for Brother Monkey to guess so accurately.
“Strange, they seem to have suffered some kind of injury, so they turned back into their original form and were nurtured again,” Brother Monkey said.
The seven babies were at a loss, and could only look adorable.

A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head, and he said, “In the past, the Celestial Sea Planet was far larger than it is now, and its level was also higher. In the past, there were Saints stationed here, but this is a weak point that is connected to the Netherworld. In the past, Yin souls appeared in large numbers, leading to the death of Saints.”

“Perhaps, the babies participated in this battle, but in the end, they were severely injured, and had no choice but to transform into their original form, and be nurtured by the heaven and earth again.”
Brother Monkey nodded, “That is indeed very possible.”

He had not thought that the babies would have such origins. Though Ling Han’s deduction was not necessarily accurate, they were actually Natural Treasures, and were of the same level as the pearl in Ling Han’s hand.
No wonder they had all kinds of Mystical Powers the moment they were born.
Yi, their cultivation levels were always the same as his. Could it be that because the babies acknowledged him as their father, so there was a mysterious power taking effect?
In the case of Natural Treasures, the limit was Saint Grade!
Thus, once he became a Saint, his seven children would also become Saints?
This was awesome. Eight Saints had appeared all at once, and putting aside any mention of an Imperial Weapon, this was enough to crush any Imperial Clan.
Thinking about it, they were all very expectant.

Since he had nothing else to do, Ling Han bought a Galaxy Network connection device and put it on those people who had never connected to the Galaxy Network before, asking them to help him find out where any major auctions were held.

He had treasure fluid that could increase one’s life force in his possession. Uh, let’s call it Strengthening Fluid. He planned to sell it to those old Venerate Tiers and Sect Masters whose vitality was waning, in exchange for treasures or Celestial medicines that contained Celestial Qi.
Treasures could be exchanged for things to improve one’s own strength, and that was what it meant to make the most of everything.
There really was one!

Perhaps it was because Ling Han, Yang Yihuan and the others had dealt too great a blow to the Golden Generation, the various Imperial Clans decided to spend even more effort to nurture the Golden Generation. Thus, they would hold a super-large auction, inviting everyone in the universe to participate.
It was announced in the name of the Imperial Clans that this auction would definitely be fair and just, and there would definitely be nothing fishy going on.
Moreover, no matter what kind of criminal you were, as long as you brought treasures to participate, there would definitely be no one who would dare to harm you.
Everything could be discussed after the auction ended.
Looking at the time, it was still early. There was still more than a year.

It wasn’t that the Imperial Clans didn’t want to have it sooner, but rather that the universe was far too large. From the moment they received the news to the moment they rushed over, just how long would they need?

Even if there was the Galaxy Network, which was connected to the entire universe, in the case of Mystery Realms, the Galaxy Network was still cut off. Some would only receive the news after they came out.
Thus, setting a one-year preparation period was already considered very, very short.
Ling Han rubbed his hands in anticipation. He was naturally going to participate in this kind of gathering.

By doing this, it was equivalent to using the full power of the universe to help the Golden Generations increase their cultivation level, so that they could become Saints as soon as possible. Thus, Ling Han naturally had to make the most of his time. Otherwise, when the Golden Generations became Saints, it would still be relatively troublesome.
He discussed with Brother Monkey, and the two of them decided to set out after more than half a year.

“Oh, that’s right!” Ling Han told Brother Monkey about the black chains entwined around his fruit of cultivation. This person was the descendant of the Saint Emperor, and he himself was a Venerate Tier, so he should be very knowledgeable.
However, Brother Monkey was also very confused when he heard this. What the hell was this?
“Old Sun will go in and take a look,” Brother Monkey said, and his figure instantly shrunk. Xiu, he had entered into Ling Han’s mind.
Er, you are going to enter immediately after saying so? Aren’t you going to discuss this with me first?
What if I’m a clean freak?
Ling Han mocked for a while, then sighed. He had been seriously influenced by Jing Haoran.
After a while, Brother Monkey appeared again.
“Brother, this Old Sun doesn’t know either.” Brother Monkey shook his head, then said seriously, “But I’m afraid... it’s not good news.”
“What do you mean?” Ling Han asked.
“There’s a limit to how far these chains can go. However, your fruit of cultivation is constantly growing, so...” Brother Monkey stopped.

However, Ling Han knew that as the fruit of cultivation grew, the chains remained unchanged, so there were only two possibilities. Firstly, the chains would explode, and secondly, the fruit of cultivation would be restricted and unable to grow any further.
But it should be known that these black chains were formed by a heaven’s calamity!

When Ling Han had broken through, the heaven’s calamity had caused such a huge commotion, yet he hadn’t suffered any damage at all. Thus, he refused to believe that the black chains could easily explode.

chapters.title: Chapter 4502: Visitors from Baili Clan
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

However, the problem was that if he wanted to break through to the fourth pinnacle level, he would have to let the fruit of cultivation grow to the extreme, and then turn it into four pillars that supported the sky.
If it continued to be trapped by the black chains, how would the fruit of cultivation evolve into the Fourth Extreme?

Ling Han frowned upon hearing this. He was far too freakish, yet he hadn’t committed any heinous crimes. Thus, the Heavenly Dao had placed a shackle on him, forever trapping him at the level of Sect Master?
This was the restriction of heaven and earth!
Ling Han was only troubled for a moment, before he immediately strengthened his resolve.
“So what if it is the shackles of heaven and earth? I will definitely be able to break them!”
“Furthermore, I have to break through the shackles of heaven and earth to become a Venerate Tier, so I would definitely be countless times stronger than the average Venerate Tier!”
In fact, after he became a Venerate, he would be even more awesome than when he became a Sect Master, and his ability to battle above his cultivation level was even stronger.
Instead, he was filled with anticipation. Fighting with the power of heaven and earth was endlessly enjoyable.

Because most of the Sect Masters of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire had already been killed, this was the moment when their ranks were at its weakest. Faced with such a great opportunity, even if Chen Fengyan did not want to borrow Brother Monkey’s power, it was still not to be missed.
He rose up, leading the Celestial Sea Planet to become independent, and took the chance to take the Moonlight Planet under his banner as well.
Tens of thousands of years ago, the Celestial Sea Planet was subordinate to the Moonlight Planet, and now the situation was reversed, which made Chen Fengyan feel very pleased.
This was their Chen Clan’s long-cherished wish and ambition.

He had taken in a subordinate planet, and there were too many things to do, so Chen Fengyan was so busy that he didn’t even have time to sleep. Naturally, he couldn’t care less about paying his respects to Brother Monkey every few days.
The moon hung high in the sky.

Chen Fengyan was still reviewing the memorials. There were so many things happening on the Moonlight Planet, and they involved the conflicts of interest of many forces, so he had to handle them carefully.
Although he was powerful enough to suppress them, he couldn’t rule a planet by himself. He needed the help of a large number of people. Thus, he had to deal with the balance of power.
This was probably the so-called art of an emperor.
‘Hmm?’
Chen Fengyan suddenly raised his head, and saw that two people had appeared in the palace at some unknown time.
At first, he thought it was Brother Monkey and Ling Han, but looking again, it wasn’t the two of them.
He couldn’t help but grit his teeth. What was going on?

He had just broken through to the level of Sect Master. In the surrounding galaxy, this was the strongest level of strength. He had initially thought that he could reign supreme for a while. He had not thought that there would be Brother Monkey and Ling Han first, and then these two people later.
‘Are you guys here to strike a blow to my pride?’
“Who are you people?” Chen Fengyan asked calmly. He was completely unafraid.

This was both the domineering aura of an emperor, and also because Brother Monkey and Ling Han were both on the Celestial Sea Planet. If anything really happened, rushing over to help would only take an instant.

The two people who had suddenly appeared were both middle-aged men who looked to be in their forties. However, the aura they exuded was extremely terrifying, and neither of them was inferior to Chen Fengyan.
They were all at the level of Sect Master!
The man in the red embroidered robes spoke first, and asked, “So you are Chen Fengyan?”
This was too arrogant!

Chen Fengyan suppressed the flames of rage in his heart. He also made a pressing motion with his hands, signaling for the guards to step back. If they stepped forward, they would only be seeking death.
“It’s me!”
“It’s good that it’s you.” The man in the red embroidered robes nodded, “My name is Baili Chuan, and I come from the Ziwei Imperial Clan.”
Imperial Clan!
Chen Fengyan’s heart involuntarily jolted. To say nothing of him, even the elites of the Holy Land would be moved upon hearing the words “Imperial Clan”.
For a long time, the Imperial Clan represented the authority of heaven and earth, and was publicly acknowledged as the strongest force, transcendent above all else.
The passage of time would weaken any force, and only the Imperial Clan was an exception.
It was as if they did not belong to this realm. They were high and noble, looking down as the rest of the universe prospered and declined.
Although Chen Fengyan was still furious, he suppressed his anger and asked, “Why have the two of you sought me out?”
The other man in green waved at Chen Fengyan and said, “We’re the ones asking you now, so you only need to answer.”
This attitude was too arrogant, and too disdainful!
Chen Fengyan wanted to flip out at this moment, but when he recalled the backgrounds of these two people, he forcefully suppressed the urge.
The Imperial Clan was such a colossal being.
He took a deep breath, and did not speak further.
Meanwhile, Baili Chuan completely did not take Chen Fengyan’s displeasure to heart. When the Imperial Clan did things, what need was there for them to care about the feelings of others?
They were divine dragons above the Nine Heavens, and the rest were mediocre, only worthy of looking up at them.
Now that they were willing to lower themselves, Chen Fengyan should be grateful and honored for the rest of his life.

“Originally, Moonlight Planet was chosen by the Ziwei Imperial Clan. If you take it without asking, that would be a great disrespect!” he said calmly, “However, since what is done is already done, I can’t be bothered to cause any more trouble.”
“How about this? As long as you obey obediently in future, you will still be the emperor. However, you need to guide your citizens to believe in this senior of our clan.”

He took out a portrait and unfolded it in front of Chen Fengyan, saying, “This is a portrait of Venerate Even Sun from our clan. He’s about to break through to the Saint Tier, so he needs your power of belief.”
Chen Fengyan shook his head without any hesitation, and said, “Impossible!”
Although Brother Monkey didn’t make any requests, Chen Fengyan had already made his decision. He wanted the citizens under his rule to worship Brother Monkey and provide him with power of belief.
Even if Brother Monkey didn’t need external power to break through to the Saint Tier, what about after becoming a Saint?
The power of belief could increase the battle prowess of Saints, and at certain times, it could even save their lives. Thus, he definitely had to leave a trump card for Brother Monkey.
Chen Fengyan’s refusal caught Baili Chuan and his companion by surprise. They both faltered upon hearing this.
Yi, shouldn’t it just be a matter of notifying him?
Next, they only needed to give Chen Fengyan some guidance on how to build a sacred temple and how to perform the ceremony of faith.
They had actually been rejected?
“Chen Fengyan, can you repeat yourself?” the man in green asked. There was a look of disbelief on his face.
His name was Baili Yi.
After Chen Fengyan said no, he had already calmed down. Since he had already decided to become hostile, he naturally wouldn’t be so cautious anymore. He said calmly, “You guys can leave now!”
“Chen Fengyan!” Baili Chuan shouted loudly. Did he think they were beggars? That he could chase them away with a wave of his hand?
Chen Fengyan’s expression became stern, and he said, “You’ve barged into my Imperial Palace, and I haven’t even settled scores with you yet. Yet, you’re acting so aggressive?”
“Haha, just a local emperor!” Baili Yi smirked coldly, “Fine, I will kill you, and then establish a new emperor. I don’t believe that every single one would be as stubborn as you!”
He reached over to grab Chen Fengyan.
“Humph! Let’s battle in the sky!” Chen Fengyan didn’t face this attack head-on. Instead, he charged into the sky.
If Sect Masters started a battle, the destructive power would be too great.
Baili Chuan and Baili Yi exchanged a glance before also soaring into the sky.

Chen Fengyan had only just advanced to the level of Sect Master. Meanwhile, one of them was a four-star elite, while the other was a six-star elite. To say nothing of the fact that they had both come from the Imperial Clan, even if they were just ordinary Sect Masters, they would still be able to easily kill Chen Fengyan.
Boom!
They entered into the distance, and Baili Yi moved again, grabbing out at Chen Fengyan.
“A mere One Star Sect Master, I can crush you to death with a single finger!”

If you take it without asking, that would be a great disrespect!” he said calmly, “However, since what is done is already done, I can’t be bothered to cause any more trouble.”
“How about this?
As long as you obey obediently in future, you will still be the emperor.
However, you need to guide your citizens to believe in this senior of our clan.”
He took out a portrait and unfolded it in front of Chen Fengyan, saying, “This is a portrait of Venerate Even Sun from our clan.
He’s about to break through to the Saint Tier, so he needs your power of belief.”
Chen Fengyan shook his head without any hesitation, and said, “Impossible!”
Although Brother Monkey didn’t make any requests, Chen Fengyan had already made his decision.
He wanted the citizens under his rule to worship Brother Monkey and provide him with power of belief.
Even if Brother Monkey didn’t need external power to break through to the Saint Tier, what about after becoming a Saint?
The power of belief could increase the battle prowess of Saints, and at certain times, it could even save their lives.
Thus, he definitely had to leave a trump card for Brother Monkey.
Chen Fengyan’s refusal caught Baili Chuan and his companion by surprise.
They both faltered upon hearing this.
Yi, shouldn’t it just be a matter of notifying him?
Next, they only needed to give Chen Fengyan some guidance on how to build a sacred temple and how to perform the ceremony of faith.
They had actually been rejected?
“Chen Fengyan, can you repeat yourself?” the man in green asked.
There was a look of disbelief on his face.
His name was Baili Yi.
After Chen Fengyan said no, he had already calmed down.
Since he had already decided to become hostile, he naturally wouldn’t be so cautious anymore.
He said calmly, “You guys can leave now!”
“Chen Fengyan!” Baili Chuan shouted loudly.
Did he think they were beggars?
That he could chase them away with a wave of his hand?
Chen Fengyan’s expression became stern, and he said, “You’ve barged into my Imperial Palace, and I haven’t even settled scores with you yet.
Yet, you’re acting so aggressive?”
“Haha, just a local emperor!” Baili Yi smirked coldly, “Fine, I will kill you, and then establish a new emperor.
I don’t believe that every single one would be as stubborn as you!”
He reached over to grab Chen Fengyan.
“Humph!
Let’s battle in the sky!” Chen Fengyan didn’t face this attack head-on.
Instead, he charged into the sky.
If Sect Masters started a battle, the destructive power would be too great.
Baili Chuan and Baili Yi exchanged a glance before also soaring into the sky.
Chen Fengyan had only just advanced to the level of Sect Master.
Meanwhile, one of them was a four-star elite, while the other was a six-star elite.
To say nothing of the fact that they had both come from the Imperial Clan, even if they were just ordinary Sect Masters, they would still be able to easily kill Chen Fengyan.
Boom!
They entered into the distance, and Baili Yi moved again, grabbing out at Chen Fengyan.
“A mere One Star Sect Master, I can crush you to death with a single finger!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4503: Impersonating the name of a dead person
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

Baili Yi was not exaggerating. He was a Four-Star Sect Master, and had also mastered the Imperial Technique. Though he had not cultivated the Imperial Scroll, his battle prowess far surpassed any ordinary Four-Star Sect Master.
Under the control of the Imperial Technique, the Regulations displayed 100% or even 200% of their might.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
In just a few moves, Chen Fengyan was completely at a disadvantage. He didn’t even have the power to parry, and could only dodge and evade.
However, Chen Fengyan wasn’t flustered at all. In fact, he wasn’t nervous at all. This was because he knew that powerful reinforcements would appear at any moment.
“Though your strength is overwhelmingly weak, your composure still makes me feel slight admiration,” Baili Yi said. Though he said it was admiration, there was only a lofty pride on his face.
“Heh, he should be stubborn!” Baili Chuan shook his head, “Hurry up and kill him. We have to find a representative as soon as possible, so Ancestor would not punish us.”
“All right!”
Baili Yi increased the intensity of his attacks. Boom, boom, boom! Fierce attacks rained down one after another, making it difficult for Chen Fengyan to even dodge.
Pu, pu, pu! Blood continued to pour from Chen Fengyan’s body.
His opponent was too strong, and he really could not hold up to him.
As time passed, Chen Fengyan also started to feel uneasy. ‘F*ck! Brother Monkey and Ling Han didn’t run away, did they?’
If he still took it head-on like this, he would really be courting death.
‘Still not appearing? Still not appearing!’
Chen Fengyan started to panic. Was there really no one here?
F***, he decided to run.
“Haha, you only know fear now?” Baili Yi smirked coldly, “It’s too late!”
He stretched out a palm, which turned into a colossal hand, wanting to crush Chen Fengyan to death.
Chen Fengyan was unable to dodge this attack.

Just as Chen Fengyan was about to lose hope, pu! A streak of light shot over, instantly blasting a hole into Baili Yi’s large hand. Although this palm strike had grabbed down, it had still allowed Chen Fengyan to easily escape from the hole that had been created.
“Did you feel like you’re going to die?” Ling Han appeared and asked Chen Fengyan with a smile.
‘Holy f*ck!’
Chen Fengyan was rendered speechless. This was definitely deliberate.
Ling Han must have been nearby all this while, but he only made a move when he was close to his limit.
How could they screw over their junior like this?
“En?” Baili Yi stared at Ling Han, his face filled with surprise. Wasn’t there only one Sect Master in the Dark North Nation? Why had another suddenly appeared?
“Who are you?” he asked.
“Ao, ao, ao, that’s your Grandpa Ling!” The large black dog appeared, his face filled with lofty arrogance. Then, he pointed at himself, “This is Grandpa Dog!”
“Grandpa Dragon is still the best!” The little azure dragon also appeared.
With a “snort”, the perverted pig was also carried over, but only gave a few humphs, showing that he had also made his presence known.
“If you don’t perform well, let’s do it again!” The large black dog and the little azure dragon instantly threw punches and kicks at the perverted pig.

The perverted pig’s face was bruised and battered. Now, the large black dog and the little azure dragon were both Spirit Transformation True Lords. Their abilities were no longer inferior to his, so his thick defenses wouldn’t be of much use.
“Lord Pig is here!” he humphed. What a bunch of b@stards. He had been courting girls, so why did they have to bring him along?
Baili Yi and Baili Chuan were both very confused. You mere Spirit Transformation True Lords act so awesome, but you are still far from being awesome, all right?
They both focused their gazes on Ling Han, feeling that this combination was very familiar.
“Do you need a hint?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“Humph, who cares who you are? To dare ruin the matters of our clan, no one can save you!” Baili Yi declared coldly. He moved directly, and charged towards Ling Han.
This time, he was considerably more cautious. After all, Ling Han had shattered his attack with a single punch. He could not be underestimated.
Ling Han was unconcerned, and casually parried.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

Judging from the situation, Baili Yi was completely on the upper hand, as if victory was in his grasp. However, he knew very well that though Ling Han was only on the defensive, his power was extremely deep. Merely the rebound caused his whole body to tremble violently.
It should be known that after advancing into Sect Master-level, the effects of power had further decreased, and Regulations was the true way to go.
Thus, the rebound caused his entire body to tremble violently. Just how strong was Ling Han’s power? Just how much stronger was he than him?
How could there be such a freakish Minor Advanced Tier?
“Who exactly are you?” Baili Yi shouted loudly.
“Alright, since you want to know so much, I’ll tell you.” Ling Han smiled, “I am Ling Han.”
“Hoho!” Baili Yi merely smirked coldly, not believing it in the slightest.
What a colossal joke.
Who didn’t know that Ling Han had already been smacked to death by the Fire Leaving Saint?

At that time, there had been a considerable number of Saints present, and they had all seen very clearly. With a single strike, Ling Han had not managed to tear a rip into space in time to escape at all, and was directly crushed into dust.
Just ask, which Sect Master would be able to survive the attack of a Saint?
To say nothing of a Sect Master, even Venerate Tier elites would die if it was them.
Thus, Ling Han was definitely already dead, as dead as could be.
“Young man, if you want to become famous, you don’t have to pretend to be a dead person!”
Ling Han faltered upon hearing this. Yi, he had spoken the truth, yet no one believed him?
In that case, what was the point of pretending? He could directly show his true appearance. In any case, others would only think that he was impersonating Ling Han.

Ling Han shook his head, and said, “If you don’t believe me, then forget it. I can’t be bothered to explain. Moreover, you guys are going to become corpses anyway, so there’s no need to waste my breath.”

“Haha, where is your confidence coming from?” Baili Yi laughed loudly. Though he was no match for Ling Han in terms of power, he was not the slightest bit inferior in terms of Regulations! Furthermore, even if he was no match, there was still Baili Chuan, wasn’t there?
He used the Imperial Technique, and increased the intensity of his attacks, wanting to kill Ling Han forcefully.
Ling Han also lost his patience, and began to counterattack.

He did not need to use any secret techniques, and merely moved casually. However, he had already walked out on his own path of cultivation, and every move he made was an amazing move. If it was not for the fact that he was limited by his cultivation level, every move he made could be called Imperial Technique.
How could Baili Yi possibly endure this?
In just two or three moves, he was completely suppressed. That gap was not just a little bit, but rather absolute.
“Let me!” Baili Chuan could no longer sit still. This disadvantage was too obvious.

Meanwhile, Chen Fengyan was feeling rueful. Ling Han’s strength was truly terrifying. Though there was a gap of two stars between their cultivation levels, he knew himself well. Even if he was also a Three Star Sect Master, he would still be defeated by Baili Yi.
Without waiting for Baili Yi to withdraw from the battle, Baili Chuan had already charged over, launching an attack at Ling Han.
Even if it was two against one, who would dare speak badly of the Imperial Clan?
Boom! He unleashed his six-star strength, unleashing eight flashes of Regulations as he did so.
Impressive!
Chen Fengyan exclaimed in his mind. If it were him, he would probably be insta-killed if he faced this attack head-on.
Eight streaks of Regulations!
Ling Han shook his head, “I hate people who don’t abide by the rules the most!” He casually threw a punch at Baili Chuan.
Peng!
With this strike, Baili Chuan’s body instantly exploded.
W-what?
Chen Fengyan and Baili Yi were both transfixed with shock.
Hey, hey, hey, this was too ridiculous, wasn’t it?
That was a Six Star Sect Master, and he more so had an eight-star battle prowess. How had he been insta-killed?

chapters.title: Chapter 4504: Imperial Son is defeated
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Because he was too stunned, Baili Yi even forgot to make a move.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Huh? Why aren’t you fighting anymore? Attack! What are you standing around for?”
Attack your sister!
I am only a Four-Star Sect Master, and my battle prowess is only five stars, which is far inferior to Baili Chuan.
Are you playing around with me?
Though he had been at a disadvantage just now, he felt that the gap was just that little bit. How could it be possible that in Baili Chuan’s case, he had been insta-killed with a single punch?
Baili Yi’s whole body was trembling. Only now did he know that the “corpses” that Ling Han had just mentioned was not an empty boast, but rather that the latter really had such terrifying abilities.
However, he couldn’t figure it out no matter what. Ling Han was too young. Was there such a young and terrifying Sect Master in the world?
“Are you Yang Yihuan, or Myriad Dao?” he guessed repeatedly, “Or He Luo, Origin, Heaven Crushing?”
Ling Han sighed, and said, “I already told you, I am Ling Han! Ling Han!”

Baili Yi’s expression was filled with grief and indignation. He was about to die, yet the other was still toying with him, unwilling to reveal his true identity. It was clear that he wanted him to die without even knowing who his murderer was.
“You’ve gone too far!” he roared.
Ling Han also wore an aggrieved expression. ‘I f*cking told you!’
“I’m about to die from fury!” he humphed, and threw a punch. Peng, Baili Yi was instantly turned into pieces of blood and flesh.
Meanwhile, the large black dog, little azure dragon, and the pervert pig were all roaring with laughter. It was rare to see Ling Han suffer in such a way.
Meanwhile, Chen Fengyan gritted his teeth. He had already overestimated Ling Han. However, he still hadn’t imagined that Ling Han would be so powerful.
He was only a Three Star Sect Master, yet he could insta-kill Baili Chuan, who had an eight-star battle prowess.
Heavens, just how strong was Ling Han’s ultimate battle prowess?
“Little Han, you didn’t expect this, did you?” The large black dog patted Ling Han’s shoulder, “My condolences. Who asked you to put up an act of your own death?”

“That’s right. Even the Saint has confirmed it, and you’re a f dead man. Even if you tell the whole world that you’re not dead, no one would believe you.” The little azure dragon also hit him when he was down.
“Ang, ang.” The pervert pig humphed, and nodded continuously.

Ling Han lamented. Even if he publicly announced that he had not died, the Imperial Clans would definitely step out at the first instant to “clarify” that he was an imposter, in order to maintain the dignity of the Saints. Then, they would mobilize elites to kill him.
Thus, he could only wait until he was powerful enough to be unafraid of being hunted down by Saints. Only then would the whole world believe that Ling Han had really not died.
“You killed members of the Imperial Clan, so I’m sure they won’t let the matter slide,” Chen Fengyan said.
Ling Han nodded in understanding. The Ziwei Clan would most likely send elites over soon, and this time, it would most likely be Venerate Tier elites.
However, he had no choice but to make a move. Could it be that he would have to watch helplessly as Chen Fengyan died?
Who cares? Counter soldiers with arms, and water with an earth weir.
The group returned to the Celestial Sea Planet to cultivate and play around as usual. Since they couldn’t avoid it, they would face it calmly. What was there to worry about?
Sure enough, the deaths of the two Sect Masters enraged the Ziwei Imperial Clan.
How many years had it been? Someone actually dared to provoke the authority of the Imperial Clan?
If it was not for the fact that Ling Han was already dead, they would all suspect that the culprit was Ling Han.
(Ling Han: “...”)
No matter what, they had to find the culprit and bring him to justice, to show the might of the Imperial Clan.
Everyone in the world knew that the Imperial Clan couldn’t be offended. Whoever dared to offend them would die!
Thus, this precedent definitely could not be broken by the Ziwei Imperial Clan.
However, only two Sect Masters had died, so it was naturally impossible that Saints would be mobilized.
Venerate Tier was enough.
Furthermore, who had they sent out?
Imperial Son Tian!
A Golden Generation, even if he was only a Two Star Venerate Tier now, was enough to sweep aside all opposition.
After a few days, Imperial Son Tian arrived.
He arrived above the Celestial Sea Planet, unleashing a terrifying killing intent that enveloped the entire planet.

With his strength, he was completely capable of blasting Celestial Sea Planet into pieces. Furthermore, he was standing in the galaxy, so even if the planet exploded, he would still be able to calmly dodge the shockwave.
However, what the Imperial Clan wanted was the power of belief, so they naturally couldn’t destroy it like this.
Thus, he directly used his killing intent as a probe, so that the culprit would appear.

“Scram!” Who would’ve thought that the scene of the culprit panicking, tearing open the Void and fleeing didn’t appear? Instead, a disdainful and extremely domineering shout traveled over from Celestial Sea Planet.
This voice was imbued with a terrifying power, and traveled over at the speed of light, vibrating majestically in the galaxy.
Imperial Son Tian faltered upon hearing this. They had already sensed his aura, yet he still dared to act so wantonly?

He was a Golden Generation elite, and he was also a Two Star Venerate Tier. It could be said that even ordinary Nine Star Venerate Tier elites wouldn’t be able to suppress him. They could only send out a Saint.
However, just how many Saints were there in the world? Which of them would appear on the Celestial Sea Planet? More importantly, what Saint would not give face to the Imperial Clan?
“Who are you, sir?” Imperial Son Tian asked coldly. He did not act rashly. Though the other had only shouted, it made him understand that this mysterious elite was also a Venerate Tier.
No wonder Baili Chuan and Baili Yi had never returned.

“Humph, I told you to get lost, but you didn’t. Do you insist on having Old Sun make a move?” Shua, a figure streaked out from Celestial Sea Planet. His speed was astonishingly fast, and one could vaguely see that he actually had two flaming wings.
Phoenix Wings Divine Flight!
Brother Monkey held the metal rod in his hand, looking down on Imperial Son Tian, showing the kind of arrogance, as if even if a Great Emperor appeared, he would not be able to bend him to his will.
“It’s you!” Imperial Son Tian involuntarily choked.
How could he not recognize Brother Monkey?

The terrible defeat in a battle of equal cultivation levels was caused by Brother Monkey. At that time, he, Lin Xuan, and Imperial Son Ming had joined forces, yet they were still no match for Brother Monkey, leaving him with a strong psychological trauma.
Now that he had met Brother Monkey again, how could his aura not be greatly weakened?
‘F*ck! Why is Brother Monkey here?’
“Scram!” Brother Monkey was irritable, and without another word, directly brandished his staff in a strike.
This was Brother Monkey’s personality. If he could fight, he would definitely not waste time on nonsense.

Imperial Son Tian parried, but Brother Monkey’s natural talent was not inferior to his. Furthermore, Brother Monkey was a three star Venerate Tier elite. With this additional advantage of one star, it had become an insurmountable gulf.
Moreover, Brother Monkey even had a weapon forged from Saintly Material. How could this be a joke?
Under this series of attacks, Imperial Son Tian was completely unable to fight back.
“Monkey, you killed a member of the Imperial Clan. This matter will not end so easily!” Imperial Son Tian threw down these words, and began to flee.
Brother Monkey’s temper flared, and he immediately set off in pursuit.
He unleashed Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. His speed was even faster than Imperial Son Tian.
They fought and fought all the way, crossing almost half the universe. Thankfully, Imperial Son Tian was only slightly inferior to Brother Monkey. Otherwise, he would definitely have been killed.
In the end, the Imperial Son managed to escape back to the Ziwei Imperial Clan.
However, in this manner, the Ziwei Imperial Clan would definitely send out Saints.
“This time, even if I ask the old man to come out, the Baili Clan probably won’t call a ceasefire,” Ling Han said with a frown.

Though they too had a Saint on their side, the Nine Mountains Saint was only a One Star Saint, after all. Furthermore, the reason why the Imperial Clan was so domineering and forceful was because they possessed the Imperial Weapon.
How were they supposed to resolve this dilemma?

However, he still hadn’t imagined that Ling Han would be so powerful.
He was only a Three Star Sect Master, yet he could insta-kill Baili Chuan, who had an eight-star battle prowess.
Heavens, just how strong was Ling Han’s ultimate battle prowess?
“Little Han, you didn’t expect this, did you?” The large black dog patted Ling Han’s shoulder, “My condolences.
Who asked you to put up an act of your own death?”
“That’s right.
Even the Saint has confirmed it, and you’re a f dead man.
Even if you tell the whole world that you’re not dead, no one would believe you.” The little azure dragon also hit him when he was down.
“Ang, ang.” The pervert pig humphed, and nodded continuously.
Ling Han lamented.

Even if he publicly announced that he had not died, the Imperial Clans would definitely step out at the first instant to “clarify” that he was an imposter, in order to maintain the dignity of the Saints.
Then, they would mobilize elites to kill him.
Thus, he could only wait until he was powerful enough to be unafraid of being hunted down by Saints.
Only then would the whole world believe that Ling Han had really not died.
“You killed members of the Imperial Clan, so I’m sure they won’t let the matter slide,” Chen Fengyan said.
Ling Han nodded in understanding.
The Ziwei Clan would most likely send elites over soon, and this time, it would most likely be Venerate Tier elites.
However, he had no choice but to make a move.
Could it be that he would have to watch helplessly as Chen Fengyan died?
Who cares?
Counter soldiers with arms, and water with an earth weir.
The group returned to the Celestial Sea Planet to cultivate and play around as usual.
Since they couldn’t avoid it, they would face it calmly.
What was there to worry about?
Sure enough, the deaths of the two Sect Masters enraged the Ziwei Imperial Clan.
How many years had it been?
Someone actually dared to provoke the authority of the Imperial Clan?
If it was not for the fact that Ling Han was already dead, they would all suspect that the culprit was Ling Han.
(Ling Han: “...”)
No matter what, they had to find the culprit and bring him to justice, to show the might of the Imperial Clan.
Everyone in the world knew that the Imperial Clan couldn’t be offended.
Whoever dared to offend them would die!
Thus, this precedent definitely could not be broken by the Ziwei Imperial Clan.
However, only two Sect Masters had died, so it was naturally impossible that Saints would be mobilized.
Venerate Tier was enough.
Furthermore, who had they sent out?
Imperial Son Tian!
A Golden Generation, even if he was only a Two Star Venerate Tier now, was enough to sweep aside all opposition.
After a few days, Imperial Son Tian arrived.
He arrived above the Celestial Sea Planet, unleashing a terrifying killing intent that enveloped the entire planet.
With his strength, he was completely capable of blasting Celestial Sea Planet into pieces.
Furthermore, he was standing in the galaxy, so even if the planet exploded, he would still be able to calmly dodge the shockwave.
However, what the Imperial Clan wanted was the power of belief, so they naturally couldn’t destroy it like this.
Thus, he directly used his killing intent as a probe, so that the culprit would appear.
“Scram!” Who would’ve thought that the scene of the culprit panicking, tearing open the Void and fleeing didn’t appear?
Instead, a disdainful and extremely domineering shout traveled over from Celestial Sea Planet.
This voice was imbued with a terrifying power, and traveled over at the speed of light, vibrating majestically in the galaxy.
Imperial Son Tian faltered upon hearing this.
They had already sensed his aura, yet he still dared to act so wantonly?
He was a Golden Generation elite, and he was also a Two Star Venerate Tier.
It could be said that even ordinary Nine Star Venerate Tier elites wouldn’t be able to suppress him.
They could only send out a Saint.
However, just how many Saints were there in the world?
Which of them would appear on the Celestial Sea Planet?
More importantly, what Saint would not give face to the Imperial Clan?
“Who are you, sir?” Imperial Son Tian asked coldly.
He did not act rashly.
Though the other had only shouted, it made him understand that this mysterious elite was also a Venerate Tier.
No wonder Baili Chuan and Baili Yi had never returned.
“Humph, I told you to get lost, but you didn’t.
Do you insist on having Old Sun make a move?” Shua, a figure streaked out from Celestial Sea Planet.
His speed was astonishingly fast, and one could vaguely see that he actually had two flaming wings.
Phoenix Wings Divine Flight!
Brother Monkey held the metal rod in his hand, looking down on Imperial Son Tian, showing the kind of arrogance, as if even if a Great Emperor appeared, he would not be able to bend him to his will.
“It’s you!” Imperial Son Tian involuntarily choked.
How could he not recognize Brother Monkey?
The terrible defeat in a battle of equal cultivation levels was caused by Brother Monkey.
At that time, he, Lin Xuan, and Imperial Son Ming had joined forces, yet they were still no match for Brother Monkey, leaving him with a strong psychological trauma.
Now that he had met Brother Monkey again, how could his aura not be greatly weakened?
‘F*ck!
Why is Brother Monkey here?’
“Scram!” Brother Monkey was irritable, and without another word, directly brandished his staff in a strike.
This was Brother Monkey’s personality.
If he could fight, he would definitely not waste time on nonsense.
Imperial Son Tian parried, but Brother Monkey’s natural talent was not inferior to his.
Furthermore, Brother Monkey was a three star Venerate Tier elite.
With this additional advantage of one star, it had become an insurmountable gulf.
Moreover, Brother Monkey even had a weapon forged from Saintly Material.
How could this be a joke?
Under this series of attacks, Imperial Son Tian was completely unable to fight back.
“Monkey, you killed a member of the Imperial Clan.
This matter will not end so easily!” Imperial Son Tian threw down these words, and began to flee.
Brother Monkey’s temper flared, and he immediately set off in pursuit.
He unleashed Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
His speed was even faster than Imperial Son Tian.
They fought and fought all the way, crossing almost half the universe.
Thankfully, Imperial Son Tian was only slightly inferior to Brother Monkey.
Otherwise, he would definitely have been killed.
In the end, the Imperial Son managed to escape back to the Ziwei Imperial Clan.
However, in this manner, the Ziwei Imperial Clan would definitely send out Saints.
“This time, even if I ask the old man to come out, the Baili Clan probably won’t call a ceasefire,” Ling Han said with a frown.
Though they too had a Saint on their side, the Nine Mountains Saint was only a One Star Saint, after all.
Furthermore, the reason why the Imperial Clan was so domineering and forceful was because they possessed the Imperial Weapon.
How were they supposed to resolve this dilemma?

chapters.title: Chapter 4505: Yahe Planet
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The Imperial Clan, the strongest force in the world, was definitely not just for show.

If Ling Han and Brother Monkey were only by themselves, they would have nothing to fear. If they couldn’t win, they could just run. In future, when they made a comeback, there would be plenty of chances for revenge.
But now, if they still had to drag a Majestic Empire with them, then in a head-on confrontation, how could they possibly be a match for the Imperial Clan?
This was like an egg smashing a rock, shattering at the slightest touch.
Thus, they could only let go of the Celestial Sea Planet.

There was nothing that could be done. Once a colossal being like the Imperial Clan had their eye on a certain planet, unless it was another Imperial Clan, what force would be able to face them head-on?
Retreat.
It was not just Ling Han’s own people. The members of the Chen Clan also had to retreat.

Two Sect Masters of the Baili Clan had died here, and as the owner of this place, Chen Fengyan definitely couldn’t stay out of this. Moreover, with how domineering the Imperial Clan was, if they couldn’t find the culprit, they would definitely kill him.
As a result, Chen Fengyan was forced to pack up his belongings and travel to other regions before he had even warmed up to his position as the ruler of a Majestic Empire.

He was still fine. He knew that as long as Brother Monkey and Ling Han were here, there would eventually come a day when they would make a comeback. He only felt a little regret that he had to leave Celestial Sea Planet which his predecessors had shed blood for, but those Imperial Princes were all extremely displeased.
They were really displeased.

Originally, they had already become second-generation young masters of the Majestic Empire, but now? Not only were they beaten back to their original state, they were even forced to flee to a foreign land. How could they accept this?
Especially when they found out that one of the main culprits behind this was actually Ling Han.
F***, it was this guy again!
However, they now knew that Ling Han was not only Chen Fengyan’s senior, but also a Three Star Sect Master. His cultivation level was higher than even their father’s.
So what they could not tolerate it? They still had to endure it!
At the same time, they were also extremely curious. How exactly did Ling Han cultivate? They were clearly about the same age, but why was there such a huge gulf between their cultivation levels?

Ling Han wouldn’t care about the reactions of these small fry. He set up the formation, and didn’t use the Transfer Formation here to avoid being examined by the Imperial Clan in the future, and subsequently traced down.
The large-scale migration began. Of course, Ling Han, Brother Monkey and Chen Fengyan were the last to leave.
They travelled from galaxy to galaxy, from the North Heavenly Realm to the East Heavenly Realm. Only then did this migration finally come to an end.
Not long after, the terrifying saintly might descended. The Ziwei Imperial Clan’s Saint arrived.

This was an unstoppable force. Ling Han and the others immediately used the Transfer Formation to retreat. If they were slightly later, the Saint would use his great power to restrict space. Even if they wanted to leave, they would not be able to.
As they travelled through the universe, they soon met up with the main troops.
Chen Fengyan had been an emperor for so many years, so he naturally knew what to do. There was no need for Ling Han and Brother Monkey to worry.
Counting the time, there were still eight months until the auction jointly hosted by the Imperial Clans would begin.
“It’s still a little early.”
“But we can go and join in on the excitement first.”
They decided to set off. In order to reduce the size of their target, only Ling Han and Brother Monkey would be going this time.
This disappointed the large black dog and the others. They too wanted to join in on the excitement of such a fun event.
Ling Han didn’t notice that some certain guys were whispering to each other every day. It was unknown what they were planning.
Brother Monkey tore open space and set off with Ling Han.

When the Venerate Tier elite moved, his speed was naturally much faster than the Transfer Formation. Furthermore, in the Void, Brother Monkey could also channel Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to increase his speed.
In a mere nine days, they had already arrived at Yahe Planet.
This was where the auction would be held.

Yahe Planet was a renowned medicinal planet. It was rich in all kinds of Celestial medicines, and in terms of cultivation, Celestial medicines were definitely the most valuable resource. Thus, it was very logical for the auction to be held here.

Though there were still eight months until the auction, there were already a great many people who had come here ahead of time. Furthermore, their cultivation level varied greatly. The weakest were only Foundation Building Tiers, those who had just stepped onto the Celestial Path, and there were stronger Sect Masters, and they were still those veteran Sect Masters that had grey hair and were declining in vitality.

The joint ban of the Imperial Clans had already taken effect. In the two years before or after the auction began, it was strictly forbidden for any kind of battle to take place here. Otherwise, they would become the public enemy of the Imperial Clans.
Precisely because of this, the incident of bullying and tyrannizing people on the Yahe Planet was stopped, which showed just how astonishing the intimidation power of the Imperial Clans was.

Although the auction hadn’t begun yet, there were still countless people who had set up stalls outside. Meanwhile, the old Sect Masters whose vitality was declining were all looking for alchemical pills everywhere, hoping to obtain natural treasures that could extend their lifespan and strengthen their vitality.

Ling Han was in no rush to make a move. The Strengthening Fluid was too valuable, and would definitely be fought over madly by the old Sect Masters, the Venerate Tiers, and even the Saints might make a move.
Hence, this would definitely have to be saved for the time of the auction, so that the value could be maximized.
However, he wasn’t idle either. He roamed around, planning to try his luck and see if he could pick up anything.

However, his present cultivation level was too high, and there were pitifully few Celestial medicines that could be of help to him. Not only did no one know where they grew, even if one was lucky enough to encounter them, the surrounding environment would definitely be extremely dangerous, and extremely difficult to harvest.
Thus, after walking around for a few days, Ling Han didn’t find anything.
Ling Han wasn’t discouraged or angry. He was someone who had obtained the fortune of the True Dragon, so how could his luck be bad?
However, after one month, two months, three months, he still did not encounter any good luck.
Thinking about it, it was normal. For a treasure that was on the level of Sect Master, or even higher level, who would take it out and sell it now?
It would definitely be left until the time of the auction, where everyone would fight over it. Only then would it be able to fetch a satisfactory price.
Right now, if Ling Han wanted to obtain a treasure of this level, he would definitely have to encounter someone that was blind. The chances were too, too slim.
Seeing that the auction was getting closer and closer, he also stopped thinking about picking up scraps.
He had best wait for a while longer.

When there was only a month left until the day of the auction, the number of people who had arrived at Yahe Planet suddenly increased explosively. Furthermore, they all came from extremely powerful backgrounds.

Not only had the younger generation come, but there were also a considerable number of older generations. Some came to support their juniors, while some came for themselves. If they obtained some astonishing natural treasures, allowing their cultivation level to break through, this was something that every cultivator would earnestly seek.
Thus, the most popular thing now was the arrival of this and that famous person.
“The Imperial Son Ming of the Golden Generation has arrived!”
“Hiss, that’s a Venerate Tier elite!”

“My ancestor has been stuck at the peak stage of Nine Star Sect Master for more than 10,000 years without breaking through. It looks like his lifespan is about to dry up, but this guy is only over 100 years old, and has already advanced into Venerate Tier. With this comparison, the gap is really too wide.”
“Heh, he’s the Imperial Son, so who can compare?”
“Yi, Imperial Daughter Xue has arrived.”
“She’s truly beautiful. If she wants to, she’ll have a place in the top ten of the Exquisite Leaderboard.”
“Hiss, how could this person have such great killing intent?”
“Heavens! Wherever he goes, passersby will fall!”
Everyone was stunned. Young prodigies appeared one after another. Some of them were really terrifying, and their aura was too shocking.
