chapters.title: Chapter 4506: Wu Yue
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Yahe Planet, talented people gathered.
Some had come for the auction, while others had come for fame. Now, how many prodigies had gathered here? As long as they could stand out, their names would immediately spread throughout the world.
That’s right. The Imperial Clans had set a rule that prohibited fights, but with so many people here, how could there possibly be no friction or argument?
Did they all have to just bear with it?
No.

There was a arena here that was especially used to settle personal grudges. In this place, battles and even slaughter could be carried out at will. The Imperial Clans would definitely not interfere to stop them.
—If they were afraid of losing or fear death, it was fine if they did not go to the arena. No one could force them.
A great many people that Ling Han had never heard of before all popped up. They were clearly unknown, yet possessed powerful strength, and rose to fame through one duel after another.
However, this kind of prodigy was only limited to prodigies, and was far from being freakish enough to make Ling Han think of them as a rival.

Merely in terms of strength in a battle of equal cultivation levels, there should be no one that could match him in this world. However, looking at history, it was not every generation of Great Emperor that was the strongest in their cultivation level. Take, for example, the Nine Suns Saint. He would frequently be able to defeat the Ancestral King Lingtian, yet the one to have the last laugh was not the Nine Suns Saint.
Thus, whether it was Origin, Myriad Dao, Yang Yihuan or He Luo, they all had the possibility of threatening Ling Han’s chance of becoming Emperor.
However, another few days later, there were more and more powerful prodigies. One of them even moved Ling Han.

For example, there was a young man whose whole body was exuding killing intent. He used a sword, and no matter what opponent he encountered, he would kill the other with a single strike. No one knew how strong his true strength was.
He called himself Wu Yue, but that was all. No one knew his exact origins.
The auction had not begun, but this Wu Yue had already become the person who received the most attention on the Yahe Planet.
He was really too strong. In a consecutive 23 battles, not only had he won all of them, he had killed his enemies with a single strike in every battle, appearing to be at ease.

The last few opponents were the Dao Childs of Holy Lands. Several thousand years ago, they had already cultivated to the peak stage of Nine Stars. However, breaking through to Venerate Tier was too difficult, and required a very long time to stabilize, so they delayed breaking through. However, after so many years, their battle prowess must have been tempered to an incredibly strong extent.
However, they were still insta-killed by Wu Yue.
What was even more shocking was the fact that he was actually only a Five Star Sect Master.
A Five Star Sect Master had insta-killed Nine Stars? Furthermore, Nine Stars that were at the level of Dao Child?
This was really frightening. No wonder when the news spread out, even the Imperial Clans were moved, and sent someone to contact Wu Yue, intending to draw him into the Imperial Clan.
Someone made a prediction; would the current Golden Generation be able to do the same?

The answer was that the Golden Generation Five Star Sect Master could insta-kill a Nine Star Sect Master. However, the opponent could only be an ordinary Sect Master. If the opponent was Dao Child-level, he could be killed, but definitely could not be insta-killed.
This stunned everyone. The Golden Generation had always been synonymous with being the strongest among their peers, yet now, they were forcefully outmatched.
Who exactly was this Wu Yue?
Wu Yue did not agree to any of the invitations from the Imperial Clans. Instead, he stated frankly that he already had a Master, and would never betray them.

Some Imperial Clans were still unwilling to give up, and questioned him closely about which sect he was from. Since they were not able to tempt Wu Yue, they could completely exert pressure on the latter’s sect. They did not believe that there would be any force in this world that could withstand the oppression of the Imperial Clans.
Wu Yue did not hide anything, and told them directly.
The Battle God Palace!
He was actually a seed of the Battle God Palace!
When the news spread out, everyone was shocked.
How was this possible?
A super genius whose battle prowess surpassed Golden Generation was actually a seed of Battle God Palace?
Hiss, what right did the Battle God Palace have?

That’s right. Even the Imperial Clans were unwilling to trifle with this force, not because it was powerful, but because they were wary of the assassination techniques of this force, which could not be guarded against. Furthermore, no one knew where their lair was, so it was impossible to get rid of all of them in one go.
However, the Battle God Palace’s strength was only in its assassination techniques. In a head-on confrontation, to say nothing of the Imperial Clans, even the Holy Lands wouldn’t be afraid.
In a one-on-one head-on confrontation, just see who would win?
Now, however, Wu Yue had appeared. His name was very ordinary, but his natural talent in cultivation had completely suppressed the Golden Generation.
How had the Battle God Palace nurtured him?

This confused everyone, but they didn’t mention recruiting Wu Yue again. If the Battle God Palace bore a grudge, it would be a very troublesome matter. After all, even the Imperial Clans were unwilling to trifle with such an opponent.
Merely looking at how the Battle God Palace had survived the era of various Ancestral Kings, it was clear just how tenacious this force was.

If they were in a different place and at a different time, even if they didn’t kill Wu Yue, they would still chase him away no matter what. Getting along peacefully with an assassin from the Battle God Palace was practically a joke.

But now, since the various Imperial Clans had all declared that no matter how heinous you were, there would be no one targeting you on Yahe Planet, then no matter how displeased they were, they could only swallow their anger.
Moreover, Wu Yue could even insta-kill a Nine Star Sect Master. There were really not many people that could threaten him.
When Ling Han found out, he couldn’t help but feel surprised. He had not thought that Wu Yue was actually a seed of the Battle God Palace.
Should he make a move and kill this person?
He was on the must-kill list of the Battle God Palace. Both sides were already mortal enemies. Either the Battle God Palace would kill him, or he would destroy the Battle God Palace.
This Wu Yue should be the most outstanding successor of the Battle God Palace. If he could kill him, that would definitely be a heavy blow to the Battle God Palace.

However, Wu Yue was really very strong. If Ling Han made a move, putting aside the question of whether he could kill him or not, he would definitely have to use his full strength. Then, his identity would definitely be exposed.
The auction hadn’t even begun, and his public persona had already collapsed?
Ling Han didn’t think that the Imperial Clans would keep their promise, and that they would only make a move after he left Yahe Planet. Instead, they would immediately kill him secretly.
With Purple Calamity Grains, he wasn’t too worried about his life, but in this way, his original intention of participating in the auction was completely ruined.
Forget it. He had to prioritize the overall situation first.

Ling Han thought. Since Wu Yue appeared in a positive manner, it meant that though he came from the Battle God Palace, he disdained from launching sneak attacks and killing people. Then, there should still be chances for them to meet again in future.
There was no rush, no rush.
Ling Han bought Celestial medicines and continued to refine alchemical pills.
Although it wasn’t on the level of Peak Grade, it could still be sold for a high price. Ling Han couldn’t possibly use Strengthening Fluid to trade for whatever good stuff he saw, right?
Time slowly crept by. Finally, the much anticipated auction was about to begin.
The auction this time was extraordinary. It could be claimed to be the highest level auction in the entire universe.

Thus, if one wanted to enter, they would either have to provide proof of astonishing wealth, or have to take out precious natural treasures. Otherwise, there was no need for those who were here simply to watch the excitement, as they would be occupying a spot for no reason.
Ling Han and Brother Monkey entered together. Merely the alchemical pills that Ling Han had concocted gave them the right to enter.

sentences.text: Editor: Henyee Translations
Yahe Planet, talented people gathered.
Some had come for the auction, while others had come for fame.
Now, how many prodigies had gathered here?
As long as they could stand out, their names would immediately spread throughout the world.
That’s right.
The Imperial Clans had set a rule that prohibited fights, but with so many people here, how could there possibly be no friction or argument?
Did they all have to just bear with it?
No.
There was a arena here that was especially used to settle personal grudges.
In this place, battles and even slaughter could be carried out at will.
The Imperial Clans would definitely not interfere to stop them.
—If they were afraid of losing or fear death, it was fine if they did not go to the arena.
No one could force them.
A great many people that Ling Han had never heard of before all popped up.
They were clearly unknown, yet possessed powerful strength, and rose to fame through one duel after another.
However, this kind of prodigy was only limited to prodigies, and was far from being freakish enough to make Ling Han think of them as a rival.
Merely in terms of strength in a battle of equal cultivation levels, there should be no one that could match him in this world.
However, looking at history, it was not every generation of Great Emperor that was the strongest in their cultivation level.
Take, for example, the Nine Suns Saint.
He would frequently be able to defeat the Ancestral King Lingtian, yet the one to have the last laugh was not the Nine Suns Saint.
Thus, whether it was Origin, Myriad Dao, Yang Yihuan or He Luo, they all had the possibility of threatening Ling Han’s chance of becoming Emperor.
However, another few days later, there were more and more powerful prodigies.
One of them even moved Ling Han.
For example, there was a young man whose whole body was exuding killing intent.
He used a sword, and no matter what opponent he encountered, he would kill the other with a single strike.
No one knew how strong his true strength was.
He called himself Wu Yue, but that was all.
No one knew his exact origins.
The auction had not begun, but this Wu Yue had already become the person who received the most attention on the Yahe Planet.
He was really too strong.
In a consecutive 23 battles, not only had he won all of them, he had killed his enemies with a single strike in every battle, appearing to be at ease.
The last few opponents were the Dao Childs of Holy Lands.
Several thousand years ago, they had already cultivated to the peak stage of Nine Stars.
However, breaking through to Venerate Tier was too difficult, and required a very long time to stabilize, so they delayed breaking through.
However, after so many years, their battle prowess must have been tempered to an incredibly strong extent.
However, they were still insta-killed by Wu Yue.
What was even more shocking was the fact that he was actually only a Five Star Sect Master.
A Five Star Sect Master had insta-killed Nine Stars?
Furthermore, Nine Stars that were at the level of Dao Child?
This was really frightening.
No wonder when the news spread out, even the Imperial Clans were moved, and sent someone to contact Wu Yue, intending to draw him into the Imperial Clan.
Someone made a prediction; would the current Golden Generation be able to do the same?
The answer was that the Golden Generation Five Star Sect Master could insta-kill a Nine Star Sect Master.
However, the opponent could only be an ordinary Sect Master.
If the opponent was Dao Child-level, he could be killed, but definitely could not be insta-killed.
This stunned everyone.
The Golden Generation had always been synonymous with being the strongest among their peers, yet now, they were forcefully outmatched.
Who exactly was this Wu Yue?
Wu Yue did not agree to any of the invitations from the Imperial Clans.
Instead, he stated frankly that he already had a Master, and would never betray them.
Some Imperial Clans were still unwilling to give up, and questioned him closely about which sect he was from.
Since they were not able to tempt Wu Yue, they could completely exert pressure on the latter’s sect.
They did not believe that there would be any force in this world that could withstand the oppression of the Imperial Clans.
Wu Yue did not hide anything, and told them directly.
The Battle God Palace!
He was actually a seed of the Battle God Palace!
When the news spread out, everyone was shocked.
How was this possible?
A super genius whose battle prowess surpassed Golden Generation was actually a seed of Battle God Palace?
Hiss, what right did the Battle God Palace have?
That’s right.

Even the Imperial Clans were unwilling to trifle with this force, not because it was powerful, but because they were wary of the assassination techniques of this force, which could not be guarded against.
Furthermore, no one knew where their lair was, so it was impossible to get rid of all of them in one go.
However, the Battle God Palace’s strength was only in its assassination techniques.
In a head-on confrontation, to say nothing of the Imperial Clans, even the Holy Lands wouldn’t be afraid.
In a one-on-one head-on confrontation, just see who would win?
Now, however, Wu Yue had appeared.
His name was very ordinary, but his natural talent in cultivation had completely suppressed the Golden Generation.
How had the Battle God Palace nurtured him?
This confused everyone, but they didn’t mention recruiting Wu Yue again.
If the Battle God Palace bore a grudge, it would be a very troublesome matter.
After all, even the Imperial Clans were unwilling to trifle with such an opponent.
Merely looking at how the Battle God Palace had survived the era of various Ancestral Kings, it was clear just how tenacious this force was.
If they were in a different place and at a different time, even if they didn’t kill Wu Yue, they would still chase him away no matter what.
Getting along peacefully with an assassin from the Battle God Palace was practically a joke.

But now, since the various Imperial Clans had all declared that no matter how heinous you were, there would be no one targeting you on Yahe Planet, then no matter how displeased they were, they could only swallow their anger.
Moreover, Wu Yue could even insta-kill a Nine Star Sect Master.
There were really not many people that could threaten him.
When Ling Han found out, he couldn’t help but feel surprised.
He had not thought that Wu Yue was actually a seed of the Battle God Palace.
Should he make a move and kill this person?
He was on the must-kill list of the Battle God Palace.
Both sides were already mortal enemies.
Either the Battle God Palace would kill him, or he would destroy the Battle God Palace.
This Wu Yue should be the most outstanding successor of the Battle God Palace.
If he could kill him, that would definitely be a heavy blow to the Battle God Palace.
However, Wu Yue was really very strong.
If Ling Han made a move, putting aside the question of whether he could kill him or not, he would definitely have to use his full strength.
Then, his identity would definitely be exposed.
The auction hadn’t even begun, and his public persona had already collapsed?
Ling Han didn’t think that the Imperial Clans would keep their promise, and that they would only make a move after he left Yahe Planet.
Instead, they would immediately kill him secretly.
With Purple Calamity Grains, he wasn’t too worried about his life, but in this way, his original intention of participating in the auction was completely ruined.
Forget it.
He had to prioritize the overall situation first.
Ling Han thought.
Since Wu Yue appeared in a positive manner, it meant that though he came from the Battle God Palace, he disdained from launching sneak attacks and killing people.
Then, there should still be chances for them to meet again in future.
There was no rush, no rush.
Ling Han bought Celestial medicines and continued to refine alchemical pills.
Although it wasn’t on the level of Peak Grade, it could still be sold for a high price.
Ling Han couldn’t possibly use Strengthening Fluid to trade for whatever good stuff he saw, right?
Time slowly crept by.
Finally, the much anticipated auction was about to begin.
The auction this time was extraordinary.
It could be claimed to be the highest level auction in the entire universe.
Thus, if one wanted to enter, they would either have to provide proof of astonishing wealth, or have to take out precious natural treasures.
Otherwise, there was no need for those who were here simply to watch the excitement, as they would be occupying a spot for no reason.
Ling Han and Brother Monkey entered together.
Merely the alchemical pills that Ling Han had concocted gave them the right to enter.

chapters.title: Chapter 4507: Trading for Celestial Qi
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The auction venue was huge.

This was necessary. Merely in terms of Imperial Clans, there were several dozen, and added with a great many Holy Lands, just how many people did these forces have? And there were even more lone cultivators. They were actually the main sellers. For example, the Imperial Clans would basically be buying items when they held an auction. At most, they would only take out one or two treasures to match the situation.

The auction was very simple. Though there was an auctioneer, he only had the effect of appraising and introducing the auction items. As for what price the auction item would be sold for, that was completely up to the seller of the auction item.
One could accept Dao Stones or trade it for something he wanted the most.
With so many people, it could be imagined that the number of auction items would be incredibly terrifying. It was unknown how long this auction would last.
It may not be impossible for the auction to take a few months, or even one or two years.
Very soon, the auction began.
The sellers took out their own items one after another, and handed them over to the auction venue, where the auctioneer would begin the auction according to their order.
That was because they had done a preliminary selection before entering. The auction items would definitely be valuable, and no one’s time would be wasted.
One after another, items were laid out. The auctioneer appraised them, and made his own judgement. Of course, his words could only be considered as reference, and not absolute.
Some people left in delight after selling their merchandise, while the merchandise of others ended up not being auctioned off.

The reason why they had not been auctioned off was not because there was no competition. Firstly, it was possible that the price was too low, and had not reached a level that would satisfy the seller. Secondly, the seller did not accept Dao Stones, but rather wanted to trade it for other treasures. No one else had provided it, so he could only choose to leave the item unauctioned.
For a few days, neither Ling Han nor Brother Monkey made a move.
Though these things at the beginning had their own value, it was not enough to tempt them.
However, there were really too many people.
All of them were waiting to take out their own treasures for auction. In fact, they might not even be able to do it in ten, or even a hundred years.
The organizer finally knew that this kind of auction was too torturous. Thus, after some discussion, the rules of the auction were changed.

The auction did not proceed like this, but rather was divided into several hundred sub-venues and auctions would be carried out at the same time. Additionally, if you wanted, you could also set up a stall. In any case, the highest bidder would win, and whether to sell or not would depend on the owner of the goods.

In this way, the process was naturally faster. Furthermore, from Spirit Transformation Tier onwards, the martial artists could form spiritual bodies. One could form five to eight, and that was very normal. Moreover, the divine sense for Sect Masters and above was incredibly powerful, enough to cover the entire auction area. It was completely capable of having intel on every auction area.
Thus, this would not cause any effect at all. The treasures that should cause a commotion would still cause a commotion.
The only disadvantage was that the person appraising the treasure would be flustered, and would have to go back and forth to appraise the treasure.
It was fine. The Imperial Clans had already gone to ask for more appraisers. This kind of problem would soon be resolved.
Ling Han also took out a drop of Strengthening Fluid and began the auction.

After the appraisal was made public, Ling Han was instantly surrounded by a large number of old Sect Masters and Venerate Tier elites. All of them had heated gazes, wanting nothing more than to swallow Ling Han whole.
Strengthening one’s physique and strengthening one’s blood and Qi were really too important for people like them who were at the end of their line.

Some people had already glimpsed the threshold of breaking through, but because the life force was seriously lacking, they did not dare to rashly make an attempt. Now that they had seen the Strengthening Fluid, how could they not be wild with joy?
However, there was only one drop, so they could only fight tooth and nail for it.
On the path of cultivation, only few people would benefit while the rest would lose out. After all, there were only so many resources.

“I need treasures that contain Celestial Qi, whether it is Celestial medicine, Celestial pill, or something else. I can accept all of them.” Ling Han stated his request, “I do not accept Dao Stones, no matter how many there are.”
With these words, a great many people were instantly disappointed.

These were treasures that contained Celestial Qi. This was too rare, and belonged to the category that could only be encountered by fortune but not sought. It could only be accumulated over a long period of time.

It was said that the Imperial Clan had a special method to capture Celestial Qi, but it was not something that could be obtained just because one wanted to. It was only a hundred times easier for them than other forces.
A great many people shook their heads and left, but there were still a dozen over people left behind. Clearly, they all possessed Celestial Qi.
“Come on,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“One portion of Celestial Qi, about four stars quality.”
“Two portions, both four stars in quality.”
“One portion, five star quality!”

Everyone began to place bids, and Ling Han was slightly disappointed. Though Celestial Qi could allow the fruit of cultivation to grow, the lower the grade, the less the fruit of cultivation would grow. Furthermore, it could also affect the quality of the fruit of cultivation, causing battle prowess to be inferior to other cultivators of the same level when they were in Venerate Tier.

Thankfully, he had also grasped the pill recipe for the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill, which could elevate the Celestial Qi by another level. However, the higher the original grade of the Celestial Qi, the better.

“Hoho, I am willing to offer an eight-star quality Celestial Qi, but you only have a drop of treasure fluid, which is not enough to trade for it!” Suddenly, an elder spoke up. He was tall and sturdy, and even if two people were tied together, they may not be as wide as he was, but his whole head of hair was already grey, exuding an air of decay.
“Hiss, Crimson Venerate!”
“An old Venerate from the Golden Cauldron Imperial Clan. It’s said that he failed to break through to Saint Tier and severely wounded his life force.”
“No wonder he made a move.”
The people in the surroundings discussed in low voices, their expressions gloomy.
The Imperial Clan was really rich and imposing. The moment they opened their mouths, they immediately offered an eight-star Celestial Qi, which made them completely unqualified to compete.

Meanwhile, the Crimson Venerate wore a proud smile. To the members of the Imperial Clan, obtaining Celestial Qi was far easier than for others. In fact, they could even obtain the highest grade of Nine Stars, but to them, this kind of Celestial Qi was also incredibly rare, and would only be left to be used within their own forces.

The reason why the Golden Generation’s cultivation level progressed so quickly was naturally related to it. Otherwise, the cultivation levels of Sect Master and Venerate Tier could only be slowly accumulated with time.

In the eyes of others, an eight-star Celestial Qi was incredibly valuable, but for the Imperial Clan, they could only obtain one every few hundred years, at most. Only nine-star Celestial Qi would be able to move even the Imperial Clans.
The Golden Cauldron Imperial Clan!
Ling Han subconsciously felt disgust. However, it was now time to earn Celestial Qi, so it didn’t matter.
He thought for a moment, then answered, “Ten drops.”
A thought flashed in Crimson Venerate’s mind. Ling Han actually dared to bargain with him; what did that mean?
The other definitely had more than three drops of treasure fluid!
“Ten drops is still too little.” His expression did not change, and he shook his head.
“It’s about enough. It’s enough to help your blood and Qi reach the peak stage, and allow you to have the qualifications to attempt breaking through to Saint Tier again,” Ling Han said calmly.
Though the treasure fluid in his hand was measured in terms of “bowl”, when it was time to bargain, Ling Han naturally would not be reserved either. This concerned his own interests.
Moreover, why should he be generous to the Imperial Clans?
After a difficult negotiation, the deal was finally settled with twelve drops of treasure fluid.
Hehehe, both sides were very satisfied, and revealed a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 4508: Great Profit
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
In the eyes of Crimson Venerate, this was naturally a great profit for him.

Eight Stars Celestial Qi was indeed precious, but firstly, for the Imperial Clan, it could only be considered a rare item, and could not be considered a supreme treasure. Secondly, Eight Stars Celestial Qi was only Eight Stars Celestial Qi, which was still slightly inferior to top grade Nine Stars Celestial Qi. With this kind of Celestial Qi nurturing the fruit of cultivation, it was definitely not perfect enough.
Since that was the case, he was not afraid that Ling Han would resell this Eight Star Celestial Qi to Origin, Myriad Dao, and so on, to threaten the Golden Generation of their clan.

However, he didn’t know that Ling Han had mastered the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill, which could improve the quality of Celestial Qi. Eight Stars Celestial Qi was actually Nine Stars Celestial Qi!
Otherwise, he definitely wouldn’t be able to laugh now. Instead, he would be crying.

—One day, when Ling Han’s identity was exposed, and also revealed that he had grasped means that could improve the quality of Celestial Qi, the expression of Crimson Venerate would definitely be very amusing.
Ling Han was very pleased. This was the first “nine stars” Celestial Qi that he had obtained, which meant that he could improve the quality of the fruit of cultivation to the optimal level.

He only had to use enough Nine Stars Celestial Qi to complete the forging of his foundations. Then, even if he used a One Star Celestial Qi to nurture it, as long as there was enough, it could still ripen the fruit of cultivation, and its quality was the strongest at that.
Of course, just to be on the safe side, Ling Han still had to get some more Nine Stars Celestial Qi to ensure that the fruit of cultivation would definitely grow to its prime.
“Hohoho.” Crimson Venerate strode off. He was already impatient, and wanted to immediately ingest the treasure fluid to recover his vitality, and once again attempt to break through to Saint Tier.
Becoming a Saint was the greatest thing in his life, because he was already close to the end of his lifespan. If he did not become a Saint, he would only become a dead man.
Ling Han smiled, took out another drop of treasure fluid, and said, “Come, come, come. Those passing by, don’t miss it.”
This caused the other Sect Masters and Venerate Tier elites to grit their teeth. Just how much treasure fluid do you have?

They all wanted to lower the price, but what if the competition wasn’t fierce enough, and others bought the treasure fluid, and Ling Han suddenly ran out of stock? Where would they complain about the injustice?
Thus, even though they knew that Ling Han might still have treasure fluid in his possession, they could only treat it as the last drop.
There definitely wouldn’t be a great amount of such precious treasure fluid. At most, there would only be a dozen or so drops.

However, not too long after, Ling Han had already sold more than 50 drops of treasure fluid, yet he was still shouting, causing those who had previously won the bidding at a high price to cry out at their loss. They were also very shocked. Why did Ling Han have so much treasure fluid in his possession?
After selling over a hundred drops, Ling Han closed his stall.

He couldn’t sell any more. The people now had all become smarter, and none of them were willing to compete at a high price. Instead, they would have Ling Han set a low price, and everyone would buy at this price.
How could Ling Han be willing to do this?
Let’s go, let’s keep these people hanging first.

He directly exited the auction house, and first went to concoct the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill. As for the treasure fluid, he handed it over to Brother Monkey, who would decide whether to continue selling based on the situation.
For Ling Han, concocting the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill was already a walk in the park for him. Thus, after a month, Ling Han had obtained ten cauldrons’ worth of alchemical pills.
Though they were all Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pills, the quality was completely different.

Some Three Stars Celestial Qi had been upgraded to Four Stars, while some Seven Stars Celestial Qi had been upgraded to Eight Stars. The most valuable was still the Eight Stars Celestial Qi that Crimson Venerate had provided. It was now a Nine Stars Celestial Qi!
“Exchanging alchemical pills for Celestial Qi, I will profit more and more!”

Ling Han said with a smile. He could improve the quality of the Celestial Qi, and a difference of one star in quality, even if it didn’t affect the quality of the fruit of cultivation, in terms of growth alone, the difference was at least ten times.
Thus, once he refined, he increased the value of the Celestial Qi by more than ten times.

He would only need to use some supplementary medicines. Though they were Celestial medicines, those Celestial medicines that did not contain Celestial Qi were much cheaper. They could also be bought with Dao Stones, and were completely on a different level from Celestial Qi-level treasures.

Ling Han returned to the auction. This time, he would sell some low-grade Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pills as appropriate, as well as concoct some Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pills for Brother Monkey. Otherwise, how could the Golden Generation have raised their cultivation level, while Brother Monkey was still stagnant?
He found Brother Monkey. In this one month, Brother Monkey had sold seventeen drops of treasure fluid, yet managed to obtain a portion of Eight Stars Celestial Qi for Ling Han!
Ling Han broke into a grin. If he had two portions of Nine Stars Celestial Qi, it should be enough to improve the quality of the fruit of cultivation to the optimal level.
He began to sell the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill, but the sales weren’t very good.
That was because this was equivalent to Celestial Qi. Everyone used it as currency, so why would they still need to buy it?
They were willing to offer Dao Stones, but how could Ling Han be willing to accept it?
However, when Ling Han proposed that seven portions of Celestial Qi could be used to purchase a higher grade Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill, a great many people were tempted.
As mentioned before, an equivalent amount of Celestial Qi of a higher grade would have an effect of at least ten times lower quality Celestial Qi.
‘Aren’t you an idiot?’
When encountering fools, no one would be reserved, and they all made their moves.
And just like that, Ling Han naturally obtained more and more Celestial Qi.
It had only been a day, and aside from the highest grade of Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill, the others had all been sold out.
‘Invigorating! Again!’
Ling Han left the auction house, found a secluded place, and began concocting alchemical pills again. It was still a month’s time, and he had concocted another ten cauldrons.

Furthermore, it was him, the Alchemy Emperor. If it was any other alchemist, the rate of pill completion would definitely drop drastically with the passing of time. It would be awesome enough to concoct two to three cauldrons in a row, so how could he possibly concoct ten cauldrons in a single go?

Old things might not be anything valuable, but a great many people believed that old things were valuable!

Thus, a damaged Spirit Tool was extremely cheap. At most, it could only be bought at a low price for sentimentality’s sake..

Eight Stars Celestial Qi was indeed precious, but firstly, for the Imperial Clan, it could only be considered a rare item, and could not be considered a supreme treasure.
Secondly, Eight Stars Celestial Qi was only Eight Stars Celestial Qi, which was still slightly inferior to top grade Nine Stars Celestial Qi.
With this kind of Celestial Qi nurturing the fruit of cultivation, it was definitely not perfect enough.
Since that was the case, he was not afraid that Ling Han would resell this Eight Star Celestial Qi to Origin, Myriad Dao, and so on, to threaten the Golden Generation of their clan.
However, he didn’t know that Ling Han had mastered the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill, which could improve the quality of Celestial Qi.
Eight Stars Celestial Qi was actually Nine Stars Celestial Qi!
Otherwise, he definitely wouldn’t be able to laugh now.
Instead, he would be crying.

—One day, when Ling Han’s identity was exposed, and also revealed that he had grasped means that could improve the quality of Celestial Qi, the expression of Crimson Venerate would definitely be very amusing.

This was the first “nine stars” Celestial Qi that he had obtained, which meant that he could improve the quality of the fruit of cultivation to the optimal level.
He only had to use enough Nine Stars Celestial Qi to complete the forging of his foundations.

Becoming a Saint was the greatest thing in his life, because he was already close to the end of his lifespan.

chapters.title: Chapter 4509: Broken Sword
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han remained calm and collected as he picked up the broken sword. He then asked the stall keeper, “How much is this?”
The stall keeper was quite cunning, and said, “This is an auction. What item can you offer that would tempt me, or offer a high price?”
Sigh, what a profiteering merchant!
Ling Han sighed internally, then said, “10,000 Dao Stones.”
The stall keeper shook his head, “I do not accept Dao Stones.”
So arrogant.
However, this was normal. If one wanted to increase their strength, the Dao Stone was indeed the most useless.

Ling Han smiled, glanced at the stall keeper, and said, “You’re a Spirit Transformation True Lord. You’re not far from the Sect Master-level. I’ll give you the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill. There’s Celestial Qi in it, and it can help you rapidly increase your cultivation level in the future.”
The stall keeper was instantly moved. Though he had no use for this alchemical pill now, just as Ling Han had said, he did not need too much time.
This was an investment for the future, and the benefits could be seen and felt. It was definitely worth anticipating.
“How many Stars of Celestial Qi?” he asked.
Damn, he was really not easy to deceive!
Ling Han smiled, “Three Stars, I can give you ten.”
The stall keeper looked tempted, but felt that it was somewhat inappropriate to agree to Ling Han’s request so quickly. There... should still be a lot of room for raising the price.
“It’s a little too little.” He gritted his teeth, and suppressed the restlessness in his heart.
“Twenty portions of Three Star Celestial Qi,” a voice said, but it was not Ling Han.
‘F*ck! Someone’s trying to cut me off?1’
Ling Han turned his head, and his eyes narrowed slightly.
Wu Yue!
The person competing with him was actually the most outstanding seed of the Battle God Palace.
‘Very well, I haven’t settled accounts with you yet, yet you’ve already come to my doorstep.’
The stall keeper’s eyes lit up. This was an auction. If there was no one competing, wouldn’t it become an ordinary sale? How boring would that be.
He looked towards Ling Han, and naturally hoped that Ling Han would increase the bid.
Ling Han frowned, but still said, “Thirty portions.”
“Forty!” Wu Yue declared proudly, appearing to be very rich and imposing.
“Two portions of Four Star Celestial Qi.” Ling Han raised the bid again.
“Three portions.” Wu Yue raised his bid unhurriedly, as if he did not take Ling Han seriously at all.
How could the Battle God Palace be so wealthy?
Ling Han continued to increase the bid, and Wu Yue did not back down in the slightest either. It was clear that he was determined to get hold of that broken sword.

This stunned everyone in the area. Was this broken sword really so valuable that it actually needed 20 portions of Four Star Celestial Qi, no, it was already 30 portions of Four Star Celestial Qi to be traded for it?
The happiest person was naturally the stall keeper. He felt as if his heart were about to explode.
He decided that no matter who had bought this broken sword, he would immediately leave Yahe Planet after receiving the Celestial Qi.
Safety first.
When the price had been raised to four portions of Five Star Celestial Qi, Ling Han decisively gave up the bidding.

He did indeed think that this broken sword was worth studying, but such a high price was already very ridiculous. If it was not for the fact that the opposing bidder was a seed of the Battle God Palace, he might have stopped long ago.
As for now? He would just let the other party succeed.

Ling Han thought internally. In any case, there was no way he would spare someone from the Battle God Palace. Sooner or later, he would have to battle Wu Yue, so he would just let the latter keep the broken sword for the moment. This was not Celestial Qi that could be refined.

Wu Yue very happily paid four portions of Five Stars Celestial Qi, and obtained the broken sword. Then, he strode off, his eyes filled with contempt. He did not voice out any mockery as the victor of the bidding at all.
In his eyes, Ling Han wasn’t worth his time at all.
Meanwhile, Ling Han said slowly from behind, “You caused me to waste four portions of Five Star Celestial Qi!”
Yi, the one who had obtained it was clearly Wu Yue, so why did he say that it was a waste of his Celestial Qi?
Everyone was at a loss. Could it be that Ling Han was muddled with anger because he couldn’t compete?
Wu Yue was also taken aback, then came to his senses.
Ling Han was saying that he would die in Ling Han’s hands. Thus, now that he had spent Celestial Qi to buy the broken sword, he was actually squandering Ling Han’s spoils of battle.
This!
Even with Wu Yue’s temperament, he couldn’t help but feel anger rise up in him.
He stopped in his tracks, then asked, “Do you dare battle me?”
However, he didn’t turn around to express his disdain toward Ling Han.
Ling Han merely smiled, “Now is not the time.”
He still had to continue participating in the auction.
Wu Yue humphed and strode off.

The auction was still continuing. Ling Han and Brother Monkey continued to make their bids, turning the alchemical pills and treasures in their hands into more Celestial Qi. This was a positive cycle. Where there was Celestial Qi, more alchemical pills would be produced, and from there, more Celestial Qi would be exchanged.

However, concocting Celestial medicines was really too time-consuming. One cauldron would need three days, and even if Ling Han had to concoct Celestial medicines for a year, that would only be over a hundred cauldrons.
The auction lasted for a total of one year and three months.

Apart from Ling Han, who could maintain a positive cycle, the others left one after another after exchanging for the treasures they needed, leading to fewer and fewer people, and fewer and fewer treasures. In the end, the auction could no longer continue, and it could only be announced that the auction was over.

The elites left one after another. Those who had gained something had to return to cultivate in seclusion to digest their gains, and those who had not had any gains naturally had no need to stay behind. However, because of the declaration from the Imperial Clans, the Yahe Planet was still incredibly peaceful. No one dared to provoke them, and challenge the authority of the Imperial Clans.
However, the elites of the younger generation did not leave. A few Golden Generations joined forces and held a banquet, inviting the young prodigies to attend.
Ling Han didn’t receive an invitation. He didn’t reveal his true appearance, so he naturally didn’t have any reputation at all. How could he have received an invitation?
However, Brother Monkey had received it.
He was the descendant of the Saint Emperor, and he had more so beaten the Golden Generation into fleeing in disarray. Wasn’t it only natural that he had received an invitation?
But precisely because of this, he had clearly humiliated the Golden Generation, so why did they still invite him?
Being qualified was one matter, but inviting Brother Monkey to make Imperial Son Ming and Imperial Son Tian look miserable, what was going on?

“I reckon that Imperial Son Ming and Imperial Son Tian’s abilities have improved, so they want to use this opportunity to defeat Brother Monkey, to show the superiority of the Golden Generation,” Ling Han deduced.
Meanwhile, Brother Monkey brandished the metal rod, his expression completely unconcerned.
In Brother Monkey’s eyes, there was nothing to be afraid of even if his opponent was stronger than him. As the line of the Battle Saint Emperor, he had no reason to be afraid of battle.
“There are still seven days until the banquet... Brother Monkey, wait for me for three days!”
Ling Han began to concoct the Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill.

This was a Venerate Tier-level Celestial Qi, and added with the fact that this was his first time refining it, Ling Han was still very careful. Not only was he afraid of wasting the Celestial Qi, but also because of the issue of time.
He had to succeed in a single attempt. Otherwise, even if he succeeded in refining it, Brother Monkey may not have the time to digest the effects.
Thankfully, he had succeeded in a single attempt.
Ling Han took out the Celestial pill, and handed it to Brother Monkey, telling him to immediately consume it and refine it.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t be stingy toward his own people. What kind of raw materials were used?
Eight Stars Celestial Qi!
Thus, the Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill he concocted was also the highest grade.
Even if this was not enough to boost Brother Monkey’s cultivation level to another level, it would definitely allow Brother Monkey’s strength to improve greatly.
Brother Monkey didn’t stand on ceremony. After receiving these two extremely precious alchemical pills, he immediately began to refine them.
Ling Han didn’t stay idle either. He also started to ingest the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill.

chapters.title: Chapter 4510: Arrogant Wu Yue
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han ingested the highest grade of Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill.
The Celestial Qi surged when one pill was consumed, immediately causing a qualitative change to take place in the fruit of cultivation.
Ling Han shockingly discovered that not only did his fruit of cultivation not grow larger, it was actually shrinking!
This Nine Stars Celestial Qi actually had a side effect?
No.
On the other hand, this was the awesomeness of the Nine Stars Celestial Qi. It expelled the impurities from the fruit of cultivation, making it incredibly pure.
Precisely because the impurities had been removed too much, the fruit of cultivation had become smaller.
Under the influence of the Imperial Scroll, in less than half a day, the medicinal effects of this alchemical pill were completely exhausted.
Again.

Ling Han took another pill. As expected, his fruit of cultivation hadn’t reached perfection yet, and was still shrinking further. What depressed him was the fact that the fruit of cultivation were shrinking, and the black chain was also shrinking. He couldn’t take this opportunity to remove it at all.
One pill after another, Ling Han continued to consume them. Right until the tenth pill, the fruit of cultivation finally stopped shrinking. Instead, it began to swell.
The impurities had been completely removed, and the fruit of cultivation had reached perfection. Thus, it began to grow again.
Calculating the time, there was not much time left until the banquet.
Ling Han stood up, and on the other side, Brother Monkey had also ended his cultivation.
Neither of their cultivation levels had increased, but being tempered by the Nine Star Celestial Qi, their battle prowess had definitely risen to a new height.
“Let’s go!”

They headed to the venue of the banquet. This was a tall mountain, and originally, anyone could set foot on it. However, it was now guarded by the Imperial Clans. Only those who had received invitations could ascend the mountain.
Ling Han didn’t have an invitation, but it didn’t matter. Brother Monkey did. How easy would it be for him to bring someone up?
The mountain was very high, and standing at the summit, the moon and stars were practically close to hand, and could be grabbed with a single hand.
There were a total of four hundred people invited to this banquet. Aside from the Imperial Sons, there were also the Dao Childs and Holy Daughters of the various Holy Lands.

However, it was definitely not just a Dao Child or Holy Daughter that could be invited. Otherwise, there were at least a few thousand Holy Lands in the world, so how could there only be a few hundred people here?
At the very least, only those who had reached the level of Sect Master would be qualified!
After all, almost all of the Imperial Sons had already advanced to this level. If they didn’t ascend this level, how could they be qualified to speak with the Imperial Sons?
Ling Han saw that Origin, Myriad Dao, and the others had also come. Yang Yihuan and He Luo were also here, as well as Chi Menghan. This Imperial Daughter was presently extremely depressed.
She didn’t know that Ling Han was actually still alive, so she was naturally heartbroken.

But for a beauty like her, who was comparable to the Imperial Daughters of the Golden Generation, she was naturally the ideal partner that all men dreamed of. The Imperial Sons approached endlessly, hoping to move her heart.
Moreover, Chi Menghan was currently at a state of great dejection, so seizing this opportunity would be the easiest way to capture her heart.
However, Chi Menghan wasn’t interested at all, and she was cold and indifferent to everyone. This caused everyone to feel as if they had been rebuffed.
“Hehe, what a proud snow lotus, I like her very much!” someone said, as he walked towards Chi Menghan.
This, how arrogant and direct!
Though everyone liked her very much, they were all very reserved, so how could they possibly say it out loud?
“Who is this person?”
When everyone saw him, their eyes narrowed.
Wu Yue, the strongest seed of the Battle God Palace.

Hiss, this guy was too arrogant, wasn’t he? He clearly came from the Battle God Palace, and everyone wanted to beat him up, yet he actually boasted shamelessly, daring to take liberties with the princess of the Donglin Imperial Clan!
Chi Menghan merely glanced coldly at Wu Yue, then withdrew her gaze, not planning to pay any regard to him at all.
Seeing that Wu Yue had been given a cold shoulder, everyone smiled. Now, let’s see how you will end up.

“Celestial maiden Chi, let me help you!” An Imperial Son walked out.
Wasn’t this a good opportunity to curry Chi Menghuan’s favor?
This was naturally a Golden Generation. He was already an eight-star Sect Master. Otherwise, he wouldn’t dare to step out.
Wu Yue was completely unconcerned, and said indifferently, “Get lost, don’t seek your own humiliation!”

The sword light soared into the sky, as if it were splitting open the heaven and earth.

Peng!
He landed on the ground, raising a cloud of dust.
Hiss, an eight-star Sect Master, a Golden Generation, was actually defeated so quickly?

Everyone inhaled sharply. If that was the case, even if a Nine Star Sect Master, a Golden Generation, was to step forward, he would only be able to last a few more moves, at most. He would still be horribly defeated.
Heavens, this guy was only a Five Star Sect Master... Huh, a Six Star Sect Master!
It was clear that he had received great benefits at this auction. His cultivation level had increased by a notch.
Xiu, Wu Yue’s figure landed on the ground, revealing a disdainful expression, “I have warned you long ago!”

That Golden Generation’s expression was filled with humiliation and fury, as well as a sliver of fear. That was because if it was not for the fact that he still had the Substitution Seal on him, he would not have just lost, but would have died.
The gap in strength was too wide. He had nothing to say, and could only swallow this bitter pill.

This made the other Imperial Sons very displeased, but even if they mobilized a Nine Star Sect Master, there was no way he could be a match for Wu Yue, and if it was a Venerate... how could they bring themselves to ask a Venerate to deal with a Sect Master. So what if they won? It only meant that the Golden Generation was incompetent.
Wu Yue smiled faintly, then looked towards Chi Menghan, “Forget that man. In future, you only have to see me howl proudly in the storms!”
This was too arrogant!
“Wu, let me play with you.” Ding Shu walked out.
No matter what, he had once been Ling Han’s lackey, and Chi Menghan clearly had an “illicit relationship” with Ling Han. Thus, logically speaking, he should step out.
“You?” Wu Yue looked disdainful.
“Come battle!” Ding Shu soared into the sky.
Wu Yue brandished his sword in pursuit, and then began a fierce battle with Ding Shu.
They had only exchanged a few blows, and everyone looked stunned, because Ding Shu had actually fought Wu Yue to a tie.
Oh, no, he was slightly inferior, but the problem was that Ding Shu was only a Three Star Sect Master!
There was a gap of three minor levels, yet Ding Shu was only slightly at a disadvantage?
Hiss!
Gasps rang out in the area. This Ding Shu was really too strong, wasn’t he? With such a comparison, the Golden Generation was practically nothing but trash.
Even Wu Yue had not expected this. He was stunned for a moment, then broke into a smile, “I had not thought that you are quite strong. Very good, you are worthy of my full effort!”
His sword technique changed, and instantly, a terrifying offensive surged out.
“What!” Yang Yihuan and He Luo were both moved. “This guy has walked his own path!”
They exchanged a glance, both of them frowning deeply.

chapters.title: Chapter 4511: Sent Flying with a Single Punch
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Although Yang Yihuan and He Luo didn’t know Wu Yue, they could conclude that he was the same as them—an prodigy from ancient times that had been sealed by the Primordial Source Clay until now.
But with similar backgrounds, while they were still earnestly searching for their own path, Wu Yue had already walked out his own path. The gap was very obvious.
They called themselves prodigies, but they could not compare to the rookies now, nor could they compare to the “veterans” of ancient times. How could they endure this?
They knew that there were actually a considerable number of “old prodigies” like them, but they had completely no idea exactly how many there were.
In the skies, Ding Shu laughed loudly, and his offensive increased explosively.
He similarly walked out his own path, every move and style endlessly amazing.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Ding Shu was still slightly inferior, but his fighting spirit was high, and he used various clever moves. Though he was at a disadvantage, he was completely capable of holding on.
He may be outmatched, but it was definitely not a battle that could be decided in a few moves. Instead, it could drag on for a very long time.
The Golden Generation elites all wore solemn expressions.
How many of them had walked their own paths?
Zero!
However, if one wanted to become Emperor, walking out their own path of cultivation was a necessary condition.
—You have walked your own path, and may not be able to become Emperor, but if you do not walk your own path, you would definitely not be able to become Emperor.
Ling Han had died, and there was one less obstacle. However, looking at the situation now, it was not safe at all.

Even if Imperial Son Ming and Imperial Son Tian were already Venerate Tier elites, and had the absolute upper hand in terms of cultivation level, they still hadn’t walked their own path. Even if they reached the level of a Nine-Star Saint, they would only be trapped at this cultivation level forever, and wouldn’t be able to become Pseudo-Emperor.
If one didn’t become a Pseudo-Emperor, how could he become Emperor?
Die! Die! Die!
The Imperial Sons all had killing intent in their eyes. Since they were falling too far behind, they would get rid of these freaks, just like they had done to Ling Han.
If they could get rid of all their powerful competitors, then they could completely compete slowly and advance slowly. In any case, they were very young, so they had plenty of chances.

Ding Shu unleashed his ultimate moves one after another, but it could not be helped. The gap in cultivation level was a little too wide, and his battle prowess was still inferior. This was a shortcoming that could not be compensated no matter what.
After fighting for over 500 moves, Ding Shu decisively retreated from the battle.

Wu Yue didn’t give chase. He knew very well that though he had the advantage in battle prowess, if he wanted to defeat Ding Shu, he might need to fight another three to five hundred moves. Furthermore, he felt that Ding Shu still had a trump card that he had yet to use. Who knows, he may be able to turn the tables.
There was no enmity between them, and they were not fighting over any treasure, so what need was there for them to take the risk?
No one laughed at Ding Shu. Being able to exchange blows with Wu Yue while being three minor levels behind him, this was practically freakish!
“Even if Ling Han revives, can he compare to him?”
“Definitely no match!”
“That’s right. Though Ling Han is freakishly more talented than the Golden Generation Generation, at most, he is only on the same level as Wu Yue. How could he possibly compare to Ding Shu?”
“He’s the greatest freak!”
Everyone was discussing spiritedly, and they all agreed that Ding Shu was truly the strongest freak.
“Is there anyone else who wants to battle?” Wu Yue continued to provoke. He broke into a grin, revealing two rows of snow-white teeth. His eyes swept over everyone’s faces.

Origin, Myriad Dao and the others did not accept the challenge. They were only Three Star Sect Masters, and their abilities were equal to Ding Shu’s. Even if they stepped out to fight, the result would only be the same as Ding Shu’s.
Though this could cause them to become famous, when one had reached a height like they had, would they still care about this kind of empty reputation?
Becoming Emperor was the most important, and only then could one truly obtain a reputation that would last for all eternity.
“Is there no one?” A mocking smile curled up the corners of Wu Yue’s lips, “Too weak, isn’t there anyone that can fight?”
Ling Han shook his head, and strode out.
“Come, I’ll teach you how to call Grandpa.”
“It’s you!” Wu Yue stared at Ling Han, his gaze becoming harsh.
Previously, Ling Han had competed with him over the broken sword, causing him to sacrifice four streaks of Five Star Celestial Qi.
Though this was not all that precious to him, if the four streaks of Celestial Qi were used on him, his cultivation level may be able to rush up to peak stage Six Stars.
“Not bad, not bad. You actually dare to appear in front of me.” Wu Yue’s killing intent circulated, and he took the initiative to rise up, standing in midair.
Yi?

Everyone was surprised. Previously, it was the other person that had risen into the air first, while he was in no hurry. Yet now, he actually took the initiative to step into the air, showing how much killing intent he felt towards Ling Han.
They looked towards Ling Han. Who was this guy, that his ability to attract animosity was so strong?
If they knew that this was Ling Han, they wouldn’t have such doubts — it was normal for this guy to drive others to dying out of fury.
Chi Menghan, meanwhile, showed a strange expression. She looked towards Ling Han, and felt that this man gave her a familiar feeling.
Ling Han slowly rose into the air, walking step by step as if he was taking a stroll.
Too slow, too slow.
Wu Yue’s right hand gripped his sword. Seeing how Ling Han was so slow, he couldn’t help but grip the hilt of his sword tightly, his killing intent even stronger.
This was too despicable. Wasn’t this clearly playing around with him?
“You’ll soon find out what kind of price you’ll have to pay for doing this,” he said calmly. His tone was still very calm, but it couldn’t hide the deep killing intent in his voice.
Ling Han finally reached the same height as Wu Yue. He smiled faintly, and asked, “Have you wasted any of my treasures these past few days?”
‘Motherf*cker!’
Wu Yue looked furious. “You’ll soon become a corpse, and let’s see how you’ll still be able to talk cheeky at that time!”
He raised his sword and pointed it at Ling Han.
“When the sword rises, the winds and clouds rise!” he shouted lightly. Boom, endless Sword Qi spread out, striking towards Ling Han.
There were also Regulations among the Sword Qi, causing every flash of Sword Qi to be filled with destructive power.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and stretched out his right hand. Then, he grabbed out, and instantly, all the Sword Qi shattered one after another, no longer threatening in the slightest.
Yi? En? Ya?
Seeing this scene, everyone was surprised.
‘So powerful!’

Even if Wu Yue didn’t use his full strength, his strength was already publicly acknowledged. He was so strong that even the Golden Generation could only look up to him. Thus, even a casual strike from him should have boundless might, so how could it be so easily dispersed?
Could it be that this guy whose name was unknown was actually a super genius?
Wu Yue was also taken aback. He had not thought that Ling Han would be so strong.
“I’ve really underestimated you!” he said casually, but he naturally didn’t take it to heart. His figure charged out, and his sword swept out.
Ling Han clenched his hand into a fist and punched out, “I, on the other hand, have not!”
Peng!
With a single punch, Wu Yue and his sword were both sent flying.
‘F*ck!’
All of a sudden, everyone’s mouths were agape, completely incapable of believing this.
Fierce, this was too fierce, wasn’t it?
Wu Yue had already proven it with his abilities. Even a Nine Star Sect Master Golden Generation was no match for him. But now? Ling Han had sent him flying with a single punch.
This, this, this, with such a comparison, what was the Golden Generation worth?
They couldn’t even compare to trash!
Heavens, when had such a monster appeared?
If it was not for the fact that Ling Han was as dead as could be, one would suspect that this guy had disguised himself and appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 4512: Fruit of cultivation, Mystical Power
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
In the distance, Wu Yue finally steadied his footing.
He looked at Ling Han, his face filled with shock.

Though Ling Han’s attack was incredibly fierce, he still managed to disperse it, and did not suffer any injury. However, what shocked him was that he was actually no match for a single punch from Ling Han.
How was this possible?

Even if it was the Nine Star Sect Master of the Golden Generation, he was unafraid, and saw him as a weakling. At most, he would only have to use a few more moves, and he would definitely be able to take him down.
However, Ling Han was indeed only at the level of Sect Master.

He inhaled sharply. Firstly, Ling Han had to be a seven, eight, or even nine-star Sect Master. Secondly, the latter’s natural talent should be comparable to Ding Shu. Otherwise, it was definitely impossible for him to have such might.
When he thought of this, a smile actually appeared at the corners of his lips, “Just because your cultivation level is higher than mine, you think you can bully me?”
Humph, he had grasped who knew how many secret techniques!
When Ling Han heard this, his expression became strange.
F***, he was actually being falsely accused like this?
My cultivation level is higher than yours?
‘I, a Three Star Sect Master, have a higher cultivation level than you, a Six Star Sect Master?’

Was there anyone like this? If he couldn’t defeat his opponent, he would say that his opponent’s cultivation level was higher than his. He would not admit at all that it was actually his own strength that was inferior.
Was this narcissistic, or an illness?
Ling Han shook his head. It didn’t matter. What was there to argue about with a dead person?
He charged out, his fighting spirit ignited and solidified.
Seeing that Ling Han didn’t deny it, everyone gave an ‘oh’.

No wonder this guy was so strong that even a freak like Ding Shu was dumbfounded. As it turned out, his cultivation level was much higher than Wu Yue’s. With this conversion, perhaps his aptitude was about the same as Ding Shu, or perhaps even worse.
This was more logical. How could there be so many freaks in this world?
Even so, this was still extremely astonishing. This meant that Ling Han’s talent was definitely above that of the Golden Generation.
When they thought of this, the Golden Generation elites all wore ugly expressions.

Initially, they represented the strongest in the world, but now? Generation after generation of new people appeared, causing them to lose all face. Furthermore, there were also “veterans”. All of them should have long since disappeared in the long passage of history, but now, they had crawled out again.
Becoming Emperor in this generation was so difficult!

Previously, they had said that the Golden Generation was the most likely to shatter the legend that the Imperial Clan could not possibly produce another Emperor, but looking at it now... Sigh, they were all going to fail.
This caused the Imperial Sons to burn with killing intent. Should they take advantage of this opportunity to eliminate all their opponents?
Boom!

The battle between Ling Han and Wu Yue pulled everyone’s thoughts back. Ling Han was still throwing punch after punch. It looked completely random and extremely casual, but its might was world-shaking.
In Wu Yue’s case, he channeled an extremely powerful sword technique. As the sword swept past, the heavens collapsed and the earth was destroyed.
Sect Master-leve already possessed preliminary strength that could destroy the heavens and earth, what more a supreme Sect Master like him.

It could not be helped. Though Wu Yue had walked his own path, he had only taken ten steps, at most. He could deal with Golden Generation, or even Ding Shu, but faced with Ling Han, the gap was too wide.
Hence, his path was still too inexperienced, and was not strong enough to oppose Ling Han. Then, Wu Yue could only borrow the secret technique of his predecessors.
However, this was an Imperial Technique!
“Is there such an Imperial Technique?” The Imperial Sons looked at each other in confusion.

There were only so many Imperial Clans in the world. Though every Imperial Son could not possibly grasp the Imperial Techniques of the other Imperial Clans, no matter what Imperial Technique they had, they still had some understanding of it, and knew the approximate might. This way, when faced with the competition from the other Imperial Sons, they would not be flustered, and have no idea how to deal with it.
However, they had absolutely no recollection of Wu Yue’s sword technique.
The Battle God Palace had actually mastered the Imperial Technique?
How was this possible!
They had never produced a Slaughter Emperor, and if one did not become Emperor, how could they possibly create the Imperial Technique?

Even Ling Han was slightly surprised. He had been to the Battle God Palace’s lair before, and he had also entered the inheritance tower before. However, he had only learnt the Saint Technique after ascending the tower. The most valuable item was the Strange Shadow Steps, but when it came to the Imperial Technique... there was absolutely no such thing.
Could it be that it was Wu Yue who had obtained this opportunity himself?

For example, Ling Han could be considered a disciple of Nine Suns Holy Land. Logically speaking, he couldn’t possibly learn Imperial Techniques, but in truth, not only did he learn Imperial Techniques, he also possessed Imperial Scroll!
Forget about it. Who cares where he had learnt the Imperial Technique? He would just beat him to burst!
Ling Han began to strengthen his offensive. As he threw a punch, sixteen flashes of Regulations appeared faintly.

Wu Yue wasn’t weak. He could unleash fourteen flashes of Regulations with a single strike, which was indeed slightly inferior, but not to the extent that he would be instantly defeated. The problem was, launching fourteen flashes of Regulations with a single strike was the limit of his battle prowess, and no one could maintain at their limit forever.

Thus, most of the time, Wu Yue could only blast out thirteen flashes of Regulations. It could not be helped. The soul could not possibly reach a state of perfection, so there would definitely be ripples.
However, Ling Han was different. He could unleash 16 flashes of Regulations with each strike, which was as steady as could be!
This caused everyone to grit their teeth.
How was this possible?
How could it be that your soul had reached a level of perfection?
That was impossible.

Thus, there was only one possibility, and that was Ling Han’s maximum battle prowess was not limited to sixteen flashes of Regulations. That was why he could maintain this kind of battle prowess all this while.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Without two Regulations, there would be a difference of two stars in strength. In the Sect Master-level, the gap of one star was practically impossible to breach, what more when it was two stars?

If it was another opponent, Wu Yue could still rely on the Imperial Technique, and could still rely on his own outstanding performance to compensate for the gap in battle prowess of these two stars, but against Ling Han?
Sorry.

On his own path of martial arts, Ling Han had already walked too far. Even if Ding Shu, Origin, and the others were added together, they may not be able to compare to him. In terms of battle experience, f***, just how many battles had the Genesis World’s Master experienced in his lifetime?
No matter how much Wu Yue struggled, he was still suppressed by Ling Han. He couldn’t see the slightest possibility of turning the tables.
“Damn it!” Wu Yue gave a humph, his eyes sharp, exuding a strong murderous aura.
He gave a loud shout. Weng, the Dao Fruit Tree manifested from his mind, and swayed above his head. On the fruit of cultivation, six golden veined patterns emitted a terrifying aura.
Yi!
All Sect Masters discovered that his Dao Fruit Tree had uncontrollably manifested out of his mind, and was similarly swaying above his head.
This!
Hiss, what was going on?
“This person should have grasped some kind of Mystical Power that can forcibly extract his opponent’s Dao Fruit Tree!”
“The fruit of cultivation has lost the protection of the physical body. Once it is hit, it’ll definitely be terrible.”
“However, this Mystical Power of his is a double-edged sword, and even his own Dao Fruit Tree has been taken out.”
“No, it should be that his Dao Fruit Tree possesses this kind of Mystical Power, so he can only summon it.”

Even the Imperial Sons exclaimed in shock. This Mystical Power was truly terrifying. If they faced it head-on, it was extremely possible that their fruit of cultivation would be crippled, causing their cultivation level to drop drastically.
So what if they had the Substitution Seal? His cultivation level had fallen back to the Spiritual Transformation Tier, so even if he had a few more lives, they would all be taken by a Sect Master.
“... Just look at his opponent!” One of the Imperial Sons’ eyes widened in shock.
What!

chapters.title: Chapter 4513: Identity Exposed
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Everyone had just been stunned by how terrifying Wu Yue’s Mystical Power was. However, when they turned around, they discovered something even more terrifying.
Ling Han stood there calmly. Above his head... there was no Dao Fruit Tree!
F***, could it be that you are not Sect Master-level?
Otherwise, why hadn’t your Dao Fruit Tree been extracted?
You see, even the Nine Star Sect Master, Golden Generation, was no exception, and couldn’t control it at all, so what allowed you to accomplish the opposite?
This should have nothing to do with abilities, right?
“How is this possible?!” Wu Yue exclaimed in shock. His eyes widened in disbelief.

This was his natural talent and special ability. Even if his opponent’s cultivation level was higher and his abilities were stronger than his, it was useless. He would definitely be able to extract the Dao Fruit Tree.
With this move, he had defeated a great many people whose abilities were superior to his.
But why did it not work when it came to Ling Han?
‘Do you... have any rare treasures on you?’
Ling Han cracked a smile, “What is it? Is it very strange?”
“How could you possibly not be affected by me!” Wu Yue was completely unable to accept this. This was his natural talent and special ability.
Ling Han shrugged, and said, “Since you’re so insistent, I’ll cooperate with you.” He took the initiative to release his Dao Fruit Tree, which swayed above his head.
‘Holy f*ck!’
If Ling Han didn’t release the Dao Fruit Tree, and instead continued to fight with Wu Yue, then even if Wu Yue couldn’t accept it, he wouldn’t have any other negative feelings.
However, things were different now.
Ling Han took the initiative to release the Dao Fruit Tree. This was practically taking pity on him.
Just think of him, Wu Yue, who had been unhindered for so many eras, and had killed who knew how many prodigies. Why was it that in this generation, he would still be pitied by others?
This was a f*cking great humiliation!
Wu Yue was so angry that his face turned livid. With a furious roar, he slashed madly with his long sword.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The two of them once again began an incredibly intense battle.
As the saying goes, those in the know may be confused, but those on the outside can see clearly.
Wu Yue was muddled with anger, but the people around him could see clearly. They all began to inhale sharply, their expressions as if they had seen a ghost.
On Ling Han’s fruit of cultivation, there were only three golden threads, and the third golden thread was clearly still a little light, not as deep as the other two.
What kind of Nine Star Sect Master was this?
Three Stars! Three Stars! Three Stars!
Ling Han actually, actually, was, a Three Star Sect Master!
‘F*ck!’
So what if it was the Golden Generation? They were all gaping in shock.
Just listen to the nonsense that Wu Yue was spouting!
What cultivation level is above yours? Open your damn eyes and take a look. Is this a Nine Star Sect Master?
Do you know how to count?
One, two, three!
Three golden patterns, this was the standard Three Star Sect Maste. Don’t say that you don’t even know how to count one, two, or three!
“Motherf*cker! He’s actually a Three Star Sect Master!”
“I’m about to go crazy!”
“A Three Star Sect Master is actually still so powerful. This is practically a fantasy story!”
“The first in history!”
“One of a kind!”
Everyone expressed their admiration. This was indeed strong to the point that no one could say anything.
Multiple praises spread into Wu Yue’s ears. At first, he didn’t notice it, and he soon forgot about it. In an intense battle, if he was distracted by other things, that would be a suicidal action.
However, as he listened to the discussions of the masses become more and more intense, he couldn’t help but ponder for a moment.
He was shocked.
Wu Yue looked at the top of Ling Han’s head. It was only a simple sweep of his eyes.
Then, he almost fell down from the skies in shock.
Three Stars, this was really a Three Star Sect Master!
Wu Yue’s face instantly flushed red.
Previously, he had confidently said that Ling Han’s cultivation level was definitely above his, but now?
Reality had slapped him right in the face!
It was so heavy that he wanted nothing more than for there to be a crack in the ground for him to crawl into.
No wonder everyone was discussing so intensely. He himself had become a huge joke!

Even if he couldn’t defeat him, that was fine. After all, which cultivator had never been defeated before? To say nothing of ordinary cultivators, even Great Emperors had been defeated when they were young.
However, this kind of mysterious confidence of his... was really too embarrassing.
Wu Yue’s face was completely red, and the killing intent in his eyes became even fiercer.
He turned this kind of humiliation into killing intent. As long as he killed Ling Han, everything would be resolved.
Yes, that would definitely be the case.
However, his battle prowess was inferior to Ling Han’s, and his natural skill had also been declared ineffective. How could he turn the tables?
Just by shouting like this?
Ling Han let out a battle cry, and unleashed his full battle prowess. Every punch was incredibly terrifying.
He hadn’t used the Destructive Energy yet. Otherwise, he would be able to beat Wu Yue to death in a matter of minutes.
However, this was his trump card, and it would easily expose his identity.
—Er, though his current identity was also close to collapsing.
“This person... who is he?”
“I can only think of one person.”
“Me too.”
“Ling Han!”
Everyone said. Aside from Ling Han, who else could be so freakish?
Moreover, how many such freakish prodigies were there in this world? Ding Shu, Origin, Myriad Dao and so on. They were really numbered. How could one of them possibly jump out of nowhere?

They all looked at Ling Han and recalled what Ling Han had said before. Having such a toxic mouth... it must be him. Otherwise, could there be a second person that could be both freakish and infuriating?
Even the Saint had confirmed Ling Han’s death?
The Saint’s vision must have blurred!
Saints did not represent absolute truth, and it was not definite that they would be correct.
Chi Menghan’s beautiful eyes lit up, and her whole person instantly glowed with a strong sense of life.
Ling Han didn’t die, Ling Han didn’t die, Ling Han didn’t die!

Wu Yue was completely at a disadvantage. It should be known that not only did Ling Han have the advantage in Regulations, the quality of his fruit of cultivation had also reached the highest grade under the tempering of Nine Stars Celestial Qi!
Boom! Boom!
Wu Yue was already powerless to continue, and was completely no match for Ling Han.
“I forfeit!” he said through gritted teeth. He was sullen, furious, yet helpless.
“Oh,” Ling Han replied with a nod. However, he continued to attack with his fists.
“You!” Wu Yue was both shocked and furious. Yi, why aren’t you adhering to the rules?
“Trash of the Battle God Palace, I’ll kill anyone of you I see!” Ling Han said coldly.
When the Battle God Palace attempted to assassinate him, had they greeted others and talked about adhering to the rules?
Then why did he have to adhere to the rules when it came to him?
Wu Yue roared in fury, hurriedly turning around to run.
However, someone with a similar cultivation level wanted to throw Ling Han off his tail?
‘Do you think that Phoenix Wings Divine Flight’s reputation as the world’s number one movement technique is undeserved?’
Boom, the fiery wings fluttered in the air. Ling Han intercepted him, and Wu Yue was completely unable to break free.
This time, Ling Han’s identity was undoubtedly confirmed!

Imperial Son Ming immediately opened his mouth in a baleful voice, and said, “Ling Han, battle is forbidden here. This is a joint decision of the various Imperial Clans. You actually dare to disobey, and in order to maintain order, I have no choice but to kill you on the spot!”
As he spoke, he immediately moved as well, grabbing out at Ling Han.
Shua, the shadow of a staff swept past, and it was as if ten thousand stars were crashing towards him at the same time. It was incredibly terrifying.
The Imperial Son Ming didn’t dare to face this attack head-on, so he could only dodge. The attack that he delivered naturally dissipated on its own.
Brother Monkey stood proudly in the air, his metal rod resting on his shoulders. He used one hand to pick at his ear. “You want to bully Old Sun’s brother? Ask the staff in Old Sun’s hand first!”
He looked down on all life, unmatched in his dominance.
