Chi Menghan’s beautiful eyes lit up, and her whole person instantly glowed with a strong sense of life.
Ling Han didn’t die, Ling Han didn’t die, Ling Han didn’t die!
Wu Yue was completely at a disadvantage.

It should be known that not only did Ling Han have the advantage in Regulations, the quality of his fruit of cultivation had also reached the highest grade under the tempering of Nine Stars Celestial Qi!
Boom!
Boom!
Wu Yue was already powerless to continue, and was completely no match for Ling Han.
“I forfeit!” he said through gritted teeth.
He was sullen, furious, yet helpless.
“Oh,” Ling Han replied with a nod.
However, he continued to attack with his fists.
“You!” Wu Yue was both shocked and furious.
Yi, why aren’t you adhering to the rules?
“Trash of the Battle God Palace, I’ll kill anyone of you I see!” Ling Han said coldly.
When the Battle God Palace attempted to assassinate him, had they greeted others and talked about adhering to the rules?
Then why did he have to adhere to the rules when it came to him?
Wu Yue roared in fury, hurriedly turning around to run.
However, someone with a similar cultivation level wanted to throw Ling Han off his tail?
‘Do you think that Phoenix Wings Divine Flight’s reputation as the world’s number one movement technique is undeserved?’
Boom, the fiery wings fluttered in the air.
Ling Han intercepted him, and Wu Yue was completely unable to break free.
This time, Ling Han’s identity was undoubtedly confirmed!
Imperial Son Ming immediately opened his mouth in a baleful voice, and said, “Ling Han, battle is forbidden here.
This is a joint decision of the various Imperial Clans.
You actually dare to disobey, and in order to maintain order, I have no choice but to kill you on the spot!”
As he spoke, he immediately moved as well, grabbing out at Ling Han.
Shua, the shadow of a staff swept past, and it was as if ten thousand stars were crashing towards him at the same time.
It was incredibly terrifying.
The Imperial Son Ming didn’t dare to face this attack head-on, so he could only dodge.
The attack that he delivered naturally dissipated on its own.
Brother Monkey stood proudly in the air, his metal rod resting on his shoulders.
He used one hand to pick at his ear.
“You want to bully Old Sun’s brother?
Ask the staff in Old Sun’s hand first!”
He looked down on all life, unmatched in his dominance.

chapters.title: Chapter 4514: Killing Wu Yue
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The Imperial Son Ming looked coldly at Brother Monkey, his expression baleful.
He was now a three-star Venerate Tier elite, and his cultivation level was not the slightest bit inferior to Brother Monkey. Thus, he was completely unafraid.
“Monkey, you’ve repeatedly protected this brat. Don’t you know that you’re digging your own grave?”
Meanwhile, Brother Monkey crooked a finger at him in an incredibly disdainful manner, “Cut the crap. If you want a fight, bring it on.”
Imperial Son Ming humphed, and charged towards Brother Monkey.
Boom! A palm struck over. He clearly hadn’t used any weapon, but a cold light seemed to be able to split open the heaven and earth.
Brother Monkey was unafraid, and greeted the attack with his staff.
Shadows of the staff flashed, possessing some Saint-level might.

The Imperial Son Ming had no choice but to yield. No matter how awesome he was, he would not be able to withstand an attack from the Saintly Material. That would definitely be enough to shatter his soul.
As soon as the battle began, Imperial Son Ming was at a disadvantage.

Everyone could clearly see that it was not only the weapon in Brother Monkey’s hands that was awesome, but more importantly, Brother Monkey’s use of Regulations was also superior to Imperial Son Ming.

For Imperial Sons like them, they could deliver ten Seven Star Regulations with a single strike, but this was the limit. It could not be the same every time. However, it could be seen very clearly that Brother Monkey had delivered ten Seven Star Regulations more times than Imperial Son Ming.
Thus, inferior in weapons, inferior in Regulations, wasn’t it very normal for Imperial Son Ming to be at a disadvantage?
Imperial Son Ming was unable to accept this.
His cultivation level was clearly the same, so why was he still inferior to Brother Monkey?
This was natural!

Previously, Brother Monkey had ingested the Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill, and used the Nine Stars Celestial Qi to strengthen his cultivation level. And in the case of Imperial Son Ming, even in the Imperial Clan, the Nine Stars Celestial Qi was something that could only be encountered by chance.
He had indeed obtained it before, but he had not yet perfected his foundations.
Thus, this weakness would be magnified when encountering opponents of about the same level.
Hong, hong, hong! Everyone could only see Brother Monkey attacking madly, and Imperial Son Ming could only parry.
“Monkey, why should I be afraid of you?” Imperial Son Ming shouted loudly. With a battle cry, two pillars of light suddenly shot out of his eyes, as if they could even penetrate the Void.
This was his natural talent, the Void Eye. It was not only capable of seeing through beings hidden in the Void, but also had great destructive power.
Brother Monkey scoffed, and with a glare, actually shot out two rays of golden light as well!
Peng!
The pillars of light collided, and the light from Imperial Son Ming’s eyes immediately shattered. Meanwhile, the golden light shot out by Brother Monkey was like a hot knife through butter.
What!
Imperial Son Ming’s mouth moved, and he released a soundless exclamation of shock.
His Mystical Power was actually inferior to Brother Monkey!
“Take another strike from Old Sun’s staff!” Brother Monkey shouted loudly, wielding the metal staff and smashing over with great might.
Peng!
With a single strike, Imperial Son Ming was sent flying, blood spraying from all over his body.
He had no option but to face this strike head-on. He was instantly pummeled by the might of the Saintly Material, so much so that even his mother couldn’t recognize him.
Brother Monkey was just about to follow up on his victory and deal with this opponent, when he saw Imperial Son Tian step out and launch an attack at him.
In this way, Imperial Son Ming finally had a chance to catch his breath. After recovering slightly, he joined forces with Imperial Son Tian to battle Brother Monkey.
The two strongest Imperial Sons had already advanced into Three Stars. Thus, the might of their combined forces had already surpassed Brother Monkey.

However, they couldn’t maintain their strongest state forever, and their battle prowess fluctuated. On the other hand, Brother Monkey could maintain his battle prowess at its peak 70% of the time. In this way, even if Brother Monkey couldn’t win, he wouldn’t be at a disadvantage either.
All the Dao Childs sighed ruefully. Really, the era that belonged to the Imperial Sons and the Golden Generation had already passed.
And now, counting the prodigies, it should be Ling Han, Yang Yihuan, Ding Shu, Brother Monkey and the others.
Brother Monkey was battling against two Venerate Tier elites. On the other side, Ling Han was forcefully suppressing, and Wu Yue was also unable to hold on any longer.

Peng, peng, peng! Ling Han had prepared a powerful move, and shot out 20 flashes of Regulations with a single strike. This had completely exceeded Wu Yue Yue’s tolerance limit. With a single strike, he was torn into pieces.
However, his blood and flesh reformed, and he instantly recovered.
The Substitution Seal!

Ling Han was astonished. Could it be that the Battle God Palace had truly obtained the inheritance of a Great Emperor? Otherwise, it was said that without an Imperial Weapon, it would be impossible to create a Substitution Seal, which involved the Regulations of the highest level.
Wu Yue managed to save his life, and didn’t even dare to say a harsh word. He hurriedly tore a rip into the Void and tried to flee.
However, Ling Han’s Phoenix Wings Divine Flight had already caught up to him. When he threw another punch, Destructive Energy was already boiling on his fist.
Completely different!
Instantly, heaven and earth paled, and the Void trembled.
Even Ling Han himself was shocked. What was going on?
This was the first time he had cast this technique since obtaining the Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy. He had not expected that it would actually cause such a strange phenomenon.

He had just cultivated the complete form of Destructive Energy, when the heaven and earth were alerted, and sent down a punishment of lightning. A layer of shackles was placed on his fruit of cultivation, which could not be removed even now. This also caused him to feel apprehensive, and he no longer used Destructive Energy.
—There was indeed no need to use it.
But now, in order to overlook the Substitution Seal, he subconsciously used the Destructive Energy, which actually caused heaven and earth to pale?
Could it be that it was not recognized by heaven and earth?
Peng!
The Destructive Energy was unleashed, turning into a streak of light that shot towards Wu Yue.
The speed of this light could not be described. It was as if the moment it attacked, it had already reached its target.

Wu Yue had absolutely no time to dodge or parry. Because he had exchanged blows with Ling Han for so long, he was naturally very familiar with Ling Han’s battle prowess. He could not have imagined that Ling Hanji’s attack speed would reach such a high level all of a sudden.
Peng, Destructive Energy surged past, and Wu Yue instantly lost half his body, falling directly from the skies.
The strongest seed of the Battle God Palace had thus died.

This caused the pupils of the Imperial Sons to contract. They were certain that Wu Yue’s Substitution Seal definitely could not be used just once, but in truth, he had indeed been killed with a single strike from Ling Han.
That terrifying energy... did it possess an ability that even the Substitution Seal wouldn’t be effective against?
This was terrifying. This meant that when one faced Ling Han in future, he would not have the chance to start over at all.
“Ling Han, you really didn’t die!” Ding Shu and the others all shook their heads. They both felt relieved and rueful. Even the Saint hadn’t been able to kill him. This guy was really too terrifying.
“Ling Han!” Chi Menghan pounced over. Previously, when Ling Han was fighting, she couldn’t disturb him, but now, her worry, her depression, and surprise all burst forth in an instant.
Ling Han smiled as he pulled Chi Menghan into his arms. This was the first time he had admitted his relationship with Chi Menghan in public.
If anyone could guess what he was thinking, they would definitely go crazy with fury.

That was an Imperial Daughter, and one that was comparable to the Golden Generation. Her being able to take a fancy to you was the good fortune that you had accumulated over eight lifetimes, and you are actually making excuses, putting on airs?
Sigh, they had been fed a public display of affection!
The Imperial Sons, the Dao Childs, and the others all wanted nothing more than to chop Ling Han up. A supreme Celestial Flower had been plucked by Ling Han just like that; this was too despicable!
‘Hmm?’
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s mind, and he sent a message through divine sense to Brother Monkey, “A Saint is about to arrive. We should retreat!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4515: Slightly setting back a Saint
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Brother Monkey nodded, and with a wave of the metal rod, the two Imperial Sons were forced back. Then, he used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and quickly landed beside Ling Han.
He tore a rip into space, and immediately left with Ling Han.
Before entering into the Void , Ling Han smiled at Chi Menghan. They still had a lot of time. Wait for me at the Donglin Imperial Clan.
Chi Menghan also nodded, her gaze resolute.
In the instant that Ling Han and Brother Monkey disappeared, a saintly might spread out. Space was torn apart, and a green-robed old man walked out.
The Ziwei Clan’s Divine Fluid Saint.
He sensed for a while, and did not need anyone to remind him. Immediately, he stretched out his hand towards the location where Brother Monkey had torn a rip into space, “Want to run?”
Boom, his large hand directly shattered space, reaching directly into the Void.
However, after a while, he frowned and retracted the large hand, only to see that half of it was missing.
Hiss!
When everyone saw this, their hearts trembled.
The Saint’s attack had actually been blocked?
The Divine Fluid Saint withdrew his Dao Manifestation, only to see a faint trace of blood on his left hand.
This caused everyone to feel even more apprehensive. The Saint had actually been injured.
Heavens, Ling Han and Brother Monkey actually had the ability to injure Saints, though it was only a slight injury.

They really could not understand. No matter how heaven-defying Brother Monkey was, he was only a Three Star Venerate, after all. He was still a million miles away from Saint Tier, so how could he possibly wound a Saint?
This was practically a dream!

If these people knew that Ling Han had the Energy Jade in his possession, and the attack that exploded was equivalent to the explosion of a great planet, they would not think it to be such a strange thing.

Ling Han knew that the Saint would catch up to him, so he had left behind three Energy Jades in advance. As a result, the Divine Fluid Saint indeed started to pursue him. He immediately detonated the three jades, creating a terrifying explosion in the Void.
This was the explosive might of three great planets, and furthermore, they had all exploded at the same point. Even the Saint would frown at this.
Sure enough, this blocked the Divine Fluid Saint’s advance.

“What, Ling Han actually didn’t die?” The Divine Fluid Saint’s expression instantly became incredibly cold. He couldn’t help but think of Baili Chuan, Baili Yang, and the others of his clan who had been killed.
Brother Monkey’s figure was among them, so the other mysterious Sect Master... must be Ling Han!
Damn it, damn it.
The Divine Fluid Saint flew into a thunderous rage. However, what could he do? Ling Han and Brother Monkey had already disappeared into the distance. Even though he was a Saint, he wasn’t omnipotent.
Furthermore, Ling Han’s death had been confirmed by the Saints, and not just one!
This time, even Saints had also suffered a great humiliation. How humiliating.

However, at the same time, he also found this to be inconceivable. At that time, he had also been present, and he was very sure that when the Fire Leaving Saint had attacked him, Ling Han definitely had not torn a rip into space and fled.
Just how had he managed to survive the attack of a Saint?
The Divine Fluid Saint racked his brains, yet he couldn’t figure it out no matter what.

Ling Han and Brother Monkey continuously traversed through the Void. After reaching the level of Sect Master, Ling Han’s tolerance of the pressure of the Void was naturally countless times stronger. He was unafraid even if he had to traverse continuously for a few months.
It wasn’t long before they returned to their temporary residence.
The empress and the others all approached him. It had been close to a year since they had last seen each other.
Ling Han smiled faintly. He had gained a lot this time, and the amount of Celestial Qi he had obtained was astonishing.
—This was the combined effort of all the Imperial Clans, mobilizing the resources of the entire universe, so it was naturally awesome.
Ling Han was overjoyed, yet at the same time, he was also slightly depressed.
His persona had crumbled too quickly.
You see, he had pretended to be dead very well, but on his first appearance, his disguise had been exposed. This was practically incredible.
Was he really that lacking in acting skills?
Ling Han reflected on his actions, shaking his head and sighing.
He didn’t bother about this first. Since he had obtained so much Celestial Qi, he naturally had to take advantage of the opening to madly increase his cultivation level.
Ling Han continued to concoct alchemical pills, tempering the Celestial Qi that he had obtained again, elevating it to another level.
This took him a whole two years and seven months, but the longer he spent on alchemy, the more it meant that his gains were great.
Then, both he and Brother Monkey began to take alchemical pills to level up.
Four Stars, five Stars, six Stars!

Ling Han increased cultivation by three minor levels in one go, causing even him to grit his teeth. The sudden increase in his cultivation level wasn’t necessarily a good thing either. He had to be careful of having weak foundations. Otherwise, there might come a time when he couldn’t hold up to his cultivation level, or there would be some aftereffects.

Hence, by the time he reached the level of Six Star Sect Master, even though he still had a few Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pills that he had not ingested, Ling Han planned to take his time. He had to stabilize his cultivation level first.
On the other side, Brother Monkey’s improvement was slightly smaller. He had advanced into the Four Star Venerate Tier.

It couldn’t be helped. The higher the cultivation level, the more resources were needed to advance one level. It was already very difficult to advance to the next level, and this was still because Ling Han had spent more resources on Brother Monkey.
“Yi, where’s Old Black and the others?” Ling Han came out of seclusion, and discovered that he did not see the large black dog, the little azure dragon, or the pervert pig.

Previously, when he had returned, he had not seen these three troublemakers either, but he had not taken it to heart. Now that he had concocted alchemical pills and cultivated in seclusion for close to three years, there was still no sign of those three guys, which made him both curious and slightly worried.
“Not long after you went to Yahe Planet, the three of them also ran off. They said that they were also going to attend the auction, and there was no news from them after that,” the empress said.
Yi?
Ling Han faltered upon hearing this. These three idiots had also gone to Yahe Planet? However, he hadn’t seen them!
Furthermore, the auction had long since ended. It had already been three years, so no matter how slow they were, they should have returned by now.
Could it be that something had happened?
However, the universe was vast, so how were they supposed to find a mere three people?
Ling Han decided to wait. If these three guys didn’t return in another year, he would take a trip to Yahe Planet.
He continued to predict his own path of cultivation, and as his cultivation level improved, he took a few more determined steps.
Brother Monkey’s improvement was also gratifying. He had successfully created his own path.
As the bloodline of the Battle Saint Emperor, Dao would be attained through battle. Brother Monkey was also extremely bellicose, so it was very easy for him to walk his own path.

However, Brother Monkey had only touched a sliver of it now, so he began to cultivate in seclusion. He had to stabilize this step. Otherwise, it was very likely that his path of cultivation would collapse.

After a year, Ling Han had more or less stabilized his cultivation level. He consumed the remaining Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pills, but the amount was too little, and it was not enough to support him to advance to the next level.

Inside his body, countless dimensions had been nurtured by the Celestial Qi, and they were all incredibly powerful and full of vitality. There were more than ten times more living beings that had stepped onto the path of cultivation, and elites like Celestial Kings had also increased several times over.
However, the Heavenly Venerable Tier was a barrier that only a rare few could cross, and was practically unchanged.
Ling Han shook his head. He decided to look for the large black dog and the others.
Another year had passed, and there was still no news.
Ling Han set off. This time, he was travelling alone, so his speed was slightly slower. However, he could continuously use Transfer Formation, so his speed was still astonishingly fast.
He arrived at Yahe Planet. After circling around a few times, he still couldn’t find any clues about the large black dog and the others.
Helpless, he could only return.
However, he had just returned, when he received news that the large black dog and the others had actually sent out a call for help!

Ling Han and Brother Monkey continuously traversed through the Void.
After reaching the level of Sect Master, Ling Han’s tolerance of the pressure of the Void was naturally countless times stronger.
He was unafraid even if he had to traverse continuously for a few months.
It wasn’t long before they returned to their temporary residence.
The empress and the others all approached him.
It had been close to a year since they had last seen each other.
Ling Han smiled faintly.
He had gained a lot this time, and the amount of Celestial Qi he had obtained was astonishing.
—This was the combined effort of all the Imperial Clans, mobilizing the resources of the entire universe, so it was naturally awesome.
Ling Han was overjoyed, yet at the same time, he was also slightly depressed.
His persona had crumbled too quickly.
You see, he had pretended to be dead very well, but on his first appearance, his disguise had been exposed.
This was practically incredible.
Was he really that lacking in acting skills?
Ling Han reflected on his actions, shaking his head and sighing.
He didn’t bother about this first.
Since he had obtained so much Celestial Qi, he naturally had to take advantage of the opening to madly increase his cultivation level.
Ling Han continued to concoct alchemical pills, tempering the Celestial Qi that he had obtained again, elevating it to another level.
This took him a whole two years and seven months, but the longer he spent on alchemy, the more it meant that his gains were great.
Then, both he and Brother Monkey began to take alchemical pills to level up.
Four Stars, five Stars, six Stars!
Ling Han increased cultivation by three minor levels in one go, causing even him to grit his teeth.
The sudden increase in his cultivation level wasn’t necessarily a good thing either.
He had to be careful of having weak foundations.
Otherwise, there might come a time when he couldn’t hold up to his cultivation level, or there would be some aftereffects.
Hence, by the time he reached the level of Six Star Sect Master, even though he still had a few Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pills that he had not ingested, Ling Han planned to take his time.
He had to stabilize his cultivation level first.
On the other side, Brother Monkey’s improvement was slightly smaller.
He had advanced into the Four Star Venerate Tier.
It couldn’t be helped.
The higher the cultivation level, the more resources were needed to advance one level.
It was already very difficult to advance to the next level, and this was still because Ling Han had spent more resources on Brother Monkey.
“Yi, where’s Old Black and the others?” Ling Han came out of seclusion, and discovered that he did not see the large black dog, the little azure dragon, or the pervert pig.
Previously, when he had returned, he had not seen these three troublemakers either, but he had not taken it to heart.
Now that he had concocted alchemical pills and cultivated in seclusion for close to three years, there was still no sign of those three guys, which made him both curious and slightly worried.
“Not long after you went to Yahe Planet, the three of them also ran off.
They said that they were also going to attend the auction, and there was no news from them after that,” the empress said.
Yi?
Ling Han faltered upon hearing this.
These three idiots had also gone to Yahe Planet?
However, he hadn’t seen them!
Furthermore, the auction had long since ended.
It had already been three years, so no matter how slow they were, they should have returned by now.
Could it be that something had happened?
However, the universe was vast, so how were they supposed to find a mere three people?
Ling Han decided to wait.
If these three guys didn’t return in another year, he would take a trip to Yahe Planet.
He continued to predict his own path of cultivation, and as his cultivation level improved, he took a few more determined steps.
Brother Monkey’s improvement was also gratifying.
He had successfully created his own path.
As the bloodline of the Battle Saint Emperor, Dao would be attained through battle.
Brother Monkey was also extremely bellicose, so it was very easy for him to walk his own path.
However, Brother Monkey had only touched a sliver of it now, so he began to cultivate in seclusion.
He had to stabilize this step.
Otherwise, it was very likely that his path of cultivation would collapse.
After a year, Ling Han had more or less stabilized his cultivation level.
He consumed the remaining Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pills, but the amount was too little, and it was not enough to support him to advance to the next level.
Inside his body, countless dimensions had been nurtured by the Celestial Qi, and they were all incredibly powerful and full of vitality.
There were more than ten times more living beings that had stepped onto the path of cultivation, and elites like Celestial Kings had also increased several times over.
However, the Heavenly Venerable Tier was a barrier that only a rare few could cross, and was practically unchanged.
Ling Han shook his head.
He decided to look for the large black dog and the others.
Another year had passed, and there was still no news.
Ling Han set off.
This time, he was travelling alone, so his speed was slightly slower.
However, he could continuously use Transfer Formation, so his speed was still astonishingly fast.
He arrived at Yahe Planet.
After circling around a few times, he still couldn’t find any clues about the large black dog and the others.
Helpless, he could only return.
However, he had just returned, when he received news that the large black dog and the others had actually sent out a call for help!

chapters.title: Chapter 4516: Calling for help
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

The large black dog and the others had contacted through the Galaxy Network, but the person they had contacted was naturally not Ling Han — Ling Han had long since stopped using the Galaxy Network. Instead, it was Ji Wuming.

Previously, when Ling Han had returned to the Celestial Sea Planet, he had given some people Galaxy Network connection devices. The large black dog and the others had also added the accounts of these few people to their contact list in case of emergencies.
Now, it was really useful.
Ling Han checked the message that the large black dog and the others had left behind. This was a verbal message, and it was intermittent, showing that the signal there was not good.
“Little Han... we’re trapped... a wolf pack...”
The description was vague, but fortunately, the galactic coordinates could still be recognized.
This was the only message.
Ling Han was astonished. Had the large black dog and the others been surrounded by a wolf pack?
Besieged for three to four years?
He didn’t hesitate and immediately set off, following the galactic coordinates.
After spending two months, he was already close to these coordinates. However, he could not advance any further.
That was because the teleportation to that planet had already been banned.
Why?
Ling Han asked for the reason, and found out that from four years ago, everyone who had been teleported to that planet had disappeared.
If they were alive, there was no sign of them. If they were dead, there was no sign of their corpses.
It was also because of this that the teleportation to that planet was completely closed off.
Yi, it was after the large black dog and the others were teleported here that they suddenly disappeared from the face of the earth?

However, the Cold Sealed Planet in front of him wasn’t a dead planet a land of peril, that no one could set foot on. In reality, it was completely calm there. It was just that the Transfer Formation couldn’t be used. Otherwise, something would definitely happen.
A Venerate Tier had attempted this before. They had attempted to tear a rip into the Void to reach Cold Sealed Planet, but what was the result?
He immediately fled out of the Void, saying that there was an unknown power in the Void. He didn’t dare to advance any further, fearing that something big would happen.
As time passed, Cold Sealed Star Planet became more and more famous. Now, a considerable number of forces had come to investigate, wanting to find out the reason.
Ling Han did not use the Transfer Formation either. Instead, he flew over physically, heading towards Cold Sealed Planet.
Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was unleashed. He stepped on the threads of Regulations in the stars, and his speed was extraordinarily fast.
Merely seven days later, he arrived above Cold Sealed Planet.

Looking down from space, this planet was completely white, as if it was covered with white snow, and that was why it was called the Cold Sealed Planet. However, the Cold Sealed Planet was actually not cold at all. It was just that the majority of the land was covered with white sand, so it looked white.
Ling Han descended, and his divine sense spread out. He immediately began to communicate with the ley lines.
The strength of his divine sense had increased again, and it had reached a state of perfection. Communicating with the ley lines was extremely easy for him.
In just an instant, the ley lines of the Cold Sealed Planet seemed to have become an extension of his body.
Ling Han explored this planet. What elites were there, and what level they were? All kinds of information instantly appeared in his mind.
After a while, he revealed a puzzled expression.
This planet... was really very normal, and also very ordinary.

He went to make some queries, and sure enough, the overall level of cultivation of this planet wasn’t very high. The strongest elite was only Spirit Transformation Tier. Of course, because something strange had happened, recently, Sect Masters, or even Venerate Tiers had arrived, wanting to find out the reason.
However, as long as he didn’t tear open the Void, everything was normal here. It could not be any more ordinary.
Ling Han stayed for a month, yet he couldn’t find anything.
What could he do?
He decided to take a risk and take the initiative to teleport himself. He wanted to see if he would be teleported to the large black dog and the others.
Since the large black dog and the others could still send out a signal, which meant that they were temporarily fine, it should not be a hopeless situation.
He would do as he said.
Ling Han tore a rip into space, then stepped in without hesitation.
Instantly, he felt a powerful pulling force, pulling him towards the left.
If he fled now, Ling Han could still leave, but he had entered into the Void to find the large black dog and the others, so it was naturally impossible for him to go the opposite direction.
He let nature take its course, and allowed this power to guide him, speeding up in the Void, faster and faster.
It was really too fast, so fast that Ling Han couldn’t even see his surroundings clearly.
However, aside from the chaotic flow of energy, there was nothing else in the Void. There was no difference whether one could see clearly or not.
Not long after, Ling Han felt another power surge over, causing him to suddenly fall out of the Void.
Yi, where was this place?
Ling Han looked into the distance. He was presently in space. This seemed to be a vacuum, and he could not see any stars in the distance.
However, this place was not dark, because he was standing on a nebula, and this nebula was presently exuding a gentle light.
Strange, why would the nebula give off such a heavy and solid feeling, as if it was the ground.
There naturally couldn’t be ley lines on the nebula. Ling Han sensed for a while, then shook his head dejectedly.
However, if that was the case, he should be able to leave easily.
What about the large black dog and the others?
Why were they trapped?
Ling Han looked ahead. There were layers of fog in the nebula, which blocked visibility and divine sense, so he could only sense a very small area nearby.
He only hesitated for a moment before heading into the depths of the nebula.
He had come to look for the large black dog and the others, so how could he give up now?

As he walked, Ling Han had already entered deep into the area of fog. It was hard to differentiate which direction was ahead, which direction was behind, which direction was right, and which direction was left.
Even for Ling Han, he soon had no choice but to admit that he had lost his way.
This was too shocking. He was a Sect Master, and he had actually lost his way?
Ling Han wanted to soar into the sky, but after leaping 3000 meters into the air, he fell back down heavily. He was actually unable to fly.
“Many Regulations are missing here, so I can’t fly,” Ling Han murmured.
He didn’t panic. Instead, he continued to advance.
This fog turned ocean-like. After a while, he actually discovered “land”, as if it was a lone island in a sea of fog.
It wasn’t big. The longest point was only about 0.5 km, and the narrowest point was only about thirty meters.
Ling Han stepped onto it, and carefully searched for a while, but did not find anything.
He was just about to leave, when he heard a series of footsteps. Then, he saw three people rush onto the island in a very sorry state.
These three people were an old man, followed by a young man and woman.
They were all injured, and their clothes were also slightly damaged. There were also traces of blood, as if they were being hunted down.
When they saw that there was a person standing here, the three of them were obviously taken aback. However, they immediately ignored Ling Han and hurriedly rushed towards the center of the “island”.
‘Hmm?’
Ling Han looked behind the three of them, and could vaguely see a considerable number of black shadows swaying.
Wolves!
These black shadows quickly revealed their true forms. As it turned out, they were white wolves.
There really were wolves?
Ling Han recalled the message from the large black dog, saying tha they had been trapped and there was a wolf pack. Now, a wolf pack had really appeared.
His eyes swept over them. There were a total of nineteen white wolves, and they were all True Self Tier-level.
Of course, this was no concern to him, but the old man and the others couldn’t be unconcerned. Even the strongest old man was only in the True Self Tier.

chapters.title: Chapter 4517: Digging Three Feet Under the Ground to Search
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The old man and the others didn’t pay attention to Ling Han, and hurriedly ran towards the most central area of the “island”, trying to distance themselves from the wolf pack as much as possible.
The young man glanced at Ling Han and didn’t say anything. On the other hand, when the woman passed by Ling Han, she kindly reminded, “Hide further inside. It’s too dangerous here!”
Ling Han smiled, and followed the three of them.

Xiu, xiu, xiu! Those white wolves only stepped onto the edge of the “island”, as if they had reservations about the land. However, they did not stop here. Instead, they immediately launched an attack, shooting streaks of light over.

Thankfully, though these white wolves were True Self Tier-level, because of the distance, the old man had the chance to calmly parry. Furthermore, when they arrived at the very centre of the “island”, it was as if this place was a natural fortress, and the pillars of light were blocked for no conceivable reason.
Yi?
Ling Han was very curious. What was going on here?
“Brat, hurry up and thank my great-grandfather!” the young man said to Ling Han, his expression filled with arrogance.
Now that they were standing here, he would be considered to have escaped danger, and this also allowed him to recover, so he could bother about other matters.
Ling Han chuckled, and nodded at the old man, “Thank you, old mister.”
The old man looked at Ling Han with slight confusion in his eyes, because he really couldn’t see through Ling Han’s cultivation level.
However, Ling Han was so young. How could it be that his abilities were superior to his?
Er, it should be that this young man had cultivated some kind of strange cultivation technique, and that was why he could not see through his cultivation level. It must be so.
When he thought of this, he naturally showed a hint of pride.
He was in True Self Tier, which was very strong, all right?

The woman, on the other hand, was very kind, and said, “My name is Ning Yufen, and this is my older brother, Ning Haidong, and my great-grandfather, Ning Bian. This Young Master, how should I address you?”
Ling Han pondered for a moment before revealing his true name.
However, Ning Bian and the others didn’t look shocked at all. It was as if they had never heard of Ling Han’s name before.
This was normal. There were really too many people with the same name in this world. They would not link this Ling Han with that Ling Han whose name shook the whole world.
To say the least, with their level, it was very likely that they had no knowledge of Ling Han’s battle merits at all, so there was no reason for them to be shocked.
In their eyes, Ling Han was just an ordinary young man.

“When was Young Master Ling dragged here?” Ning Yufen asked. Then, she took the initiative to relate, “The three of us initially wanted to go to the Highest Heaven Planet. We were just about to teleport two more times, but in the end, we encountered some chaotic turbulence here, and actually ended up here.”
Was this a space vortex?
Ling Han didn’t think so. However, he didn’t say it out loud. Instead, he said, “A few of my friends have disappeared here, so I came to take a look.”
Pu, Ning Haidong immediately spluttered in laughter, shaking his head with a disdainful expression.
Wasn’t it?
He didn’t even have much strength, yet he actually dared to take the initiative to run over?
He had never seen such a stupid person!
Yet a thought flashed in Ning Yufen’s head, “In that case, Young Master Ling has not been in this place for too long?”
“That’s right.” Ling Han nodded.
Ning Yufen instantly looked pleased, “Then, the people outside should already be aware of the strangeness of this place?”
“That’s right.”
“That’s great, then we would be saved!” she exclaimed, clapping her hands.

Ning Haidong’s reaction was much slower. After a long while, he finally smiled and said, “With so many people paying attention, it will definitely attract the attention of elites. At that time, we will be able to break out of this strange land and escape!”
He did not think that this place was all that frightening. It was just that there were some white wolves that he disliked very much.
Ling Han glanced at this young man, and felt that these three people had better luck.
Just think, what cultivation level did the large black dog and the others have?
All of them were Spirit Transformation Tier True Lords!
However, they also mentioned a wolf pack, obviously thinking that the wolf pack was terrifying and a threat to them.
Thus, there must still be a Spirit Transformation Tier, or even Sect Master-level wolf pack here.
“Hey, hey, hey, what’s with that expression?” Ning Haidong’s eyes were sharp. He could sense that Ling Han was smiling, as if he was mocking him.
“Brother, we’re all in the same boat; we should not target each other!” Ning Yufen hurriedly advised.
Ning Haidong was quite obedient towards this younger sister of his. He humphed at Ling Han, and did not speak any further.

Ling Han naturally wouldn’t take such a minor character to heart. He was curious. There were clearly wolves roaming around here, but why were there so many “islands” that one could use to avoid danger?
Were these man-made?
With a thought, he began to dig.
“Hey, what are you doing?” Ning Bian and the others all got a scare, especially Ning Haidong, who directly jumped up and pointed angrily at Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled and said, “If we can figure out why the wolves don’t dare to set foot on this land, perhaps we’ll be able to travel unhindered here.”
When Ning Bian and the others heard this, they were all stunned. ‘Oh, that’s right. This is a very simple logic, so why didn’t they think of it?’
Out of habit, while they searched for a way out here, if they encountered a wolf pack, they would run, and search for “islands” to hide.

However, why didn’t they think about what might be on the “island”? It was this thing that made the wolf pack afraid. Thus, as long as they dug it out, wouldn’t they be able to chase away the wolf pack?
Thus, Ning Haidong immediately began digging as well. If there really was such a treasure, they definitely could not allow it to fall into Ling Han’s hands.
They dug, but after digging for close to three hundred meters, they still found nothing.
Ning Haidong was the first to give up. He sneered, and said, “This place is strange. It’s not as simple as you think!”
If one could obtain treasures by digging into the ground, and scare off the wolf pack, that would be too easy.
Ling Han didn’t pay any heed to this, and he continued to dig.
Once he set his mind on something, he would usually not turn back even if he ran through a wall.
2000 meters, 3000 meters, 4000 meters... Ning Bian and Ning Yufen had already stopped, and only Ling Han was still digging.

After digging another 1500 meters, Ling Han suddenly felt a terrifying aura. It was incredibly sharp, and it shot out from the ground. He managed to dodge in time, but still managed to slice off a corner of his clothes.
Even if there was still a slight distance between them, and it had not sliced into his body, his skin was still burning with pain.
Hiss, what exactly was buried underneath?
Ling Han didn’t dare to dig any further. If this aura exploded completely, he would definitely be in trouble.
As he saw it, it was either a powerful person below, or a terrifying weapon, and that was why even a sliver of aura exuded was incredibly terrifying.
He thought for a moment, then returned to the top.
This could possibly draw a fatal calamity to him, so he naturally could not continue.
Seeing Ling Han return empty-handed, Ning Haidong couldn’t help but sneer.
Humph, what kind of limelight had he been in? Now, it had turned into him being embarrassed, right?
Ling Han looked around, and the wolf pack around him had not dispersed.
He decided not to wait any longer, and instead continue onwards.
—A mere True Self Tier wolf pack, could they stop him?
Ling Han strode forwards.

The woman, on the other hand, was very kind, and said, “My name is Ning Yufen, and this is my older brother, Ning Haidong, and my great-grandfather, Ning Bian.
This Young Master, how should I address you?”
Ling Han pondered for a moment before revealing his true name.
However, Ning Bian and the others didn’t look shocked at all.
It was as if they had never heard of Ling Han’s name before.
This was normal.
There were really too many people with the same name in this world.
They would not link this Ling Han with that Ling Han whose name shook the whole world.
To say the least, with their level, it was very likely that they had no knowledge of Ling Han’s battle merits at all, so there was no reason for them to be shocked.
In their eyes, Ling Han was just an ordinary young man.
“When was Young Master Ling dragged here?” Ning Yufen asked.
Then, she took the initiative to relate, “The three of us initially wanted to go to the Highest Heaven Planet.
We were just about to teleport two more times, but in the end, we encountered some chaotic turbulence here, and actually ended up here.”
Was this a space vortex?
Ling Han didn’t think so.
However, he didn’t say it out loud.
Instead, he said, “A few of my friends have disappeared here, so I came to take a look.”
Pu, Ning Haidong immediately spluttered in laughter, shaking his head with a disdainful expression.
Wasn’t it?
He didn’t even have much strength, yet he actually dared to take the initiative to run over?
He had never seen such a stupid person!
Yet a thought flashed in Ning Yufen’s head, “In that case, Young Master Ling has not been in this place for too long?”
“That’s right.” Ling Han nodded.
Ning Yufen instantly looked pleased, “Then, the people outside should already be aware of the strangeness of this place?”
“That’s right.”
“That’s great, then we would be saved!” she exclaimed, clapping her hands.
Ning Haidong’s reaction was much slower.
After a long while, he finally smiled and said, “With so many people paying attention, it will definitely attract the attention of elites.
At that time, we will be able to break out of this strange land and escape!”
He did not think that this place was all that frightening.
It was just that there were some white wolves that he disliked very much.
Ling Han glanced at this young man, and felt that these three people had better luck.
Just think, what cultivation level did the large black dog and the others have?
All of them were Spirit Transformation Tier True Lords!
However, they also mentioned a wolf pack, obviously thinking that the wolf pack was terrifying and a threat to them.
Thus, there must still be a Spirit Transformation Tier, or even Sect Master-level wolf pack here.
“Hey, hey, hey, what’s with that expression?” Ning Haidong’s eyes were sharp.
He could sense that Ling Han was smiling, as if he was mocking him.
“Brother, we’re all in the same boat; we should not target each other!” Ning Yufen hurriedly advised.
Ning Haidong was quite obedient towards this younger sister of his.
He humphed at Ling Han, and did not speak any further.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t take such a minor character to heart.
He was curious.
There were clearly wolves roaming around here, but why were there so many “islands” that one could use to avoid danger?
Were these man-made?
With a thought, he began to dig.
“Hey, what are you doing?” Ning Bian and the others all got a scare, especially Ning Haidong, who directly jumped up and pointed angrily at Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled and said, “If we can figure out why the wolves don’t dare to set foot on this land, perhaps we’ll be able to travel unhindered here.”
When Ning Bian and the others heard this, they were all stunned.
‘Oh, that’s right.
This is a very simple logic, so why didn’t they think of it?’
Out of habit, while they searched for a way out here, if they encountered a wolf pack, they would run, and search for “islands” to hide.
However, why didn’t they think about what might be on the “island”?
It was this thing that made the wolf pack afraid.
Thus, as long as they dug it out, wouldn’t they be able to chase away the wolf pack?
Thus, Ning Haidong immediately began digging as well.
If there really was such a treasure, they definitely could not allow it to fall into Ling Han’s hands.
They dug, but after digging for close to three hundred meters, they still found nothing.
Ning Haidong was the first to give up.
He sneered, and said, “This place is strange.
It’s not as simple as you think!”
If one could obtain treasures by digging into the ground, and scare off the wolf pack, that would be too easy.
Ling Han didn’t pay any heed to this, and he continued to dig.
Once he set his mind on something, he would usually not turn back even if he ran through a wall.
2000 meters, 3000 meters, 4000 meters...
Ning Bian and Ning Yufen had already stopped, and only Ling Han was still digging.
After digging another 1500 meters, Ling Han suddenly felt a terrifying aura.
It was incredibly sharp, and it shot out from the ground.
He managed to dodge in time, but still managed to slice off a corner of his clothes.
Even if there was still a slight distance between them, and it had not sliced into his body, his skin was still burning with pain.
Hiss, what exactly was buried underneath?
Ling Han didn’t dare to dig any further.
If this aura exploded completely, he would definitely be in trouble.
As he saw it, it was either a powerful person below, or a terrifying weapon, and that was why even a sliver of aura exuded was incredibly terrifying.
He thought for a moment, then returned to the top.
This could possibly draw a fatal calamity to him, so he naturally could not continue.
Seeing Ling Han return empty-handed, Ning Haidong couldn’t help but sneer.
Humph, what kind of limelight had he been in?
Now, it had turned into him being embarrassed, right?
Ling Han looked around, and the wolf pack around him had not dispersed.
He decided not to wait any longer, and instead continue onwards.
—A mere True Self Tier wolf pack, could they stop him?
Ling Han strode forwards.

chapters.title: Chapter 4518: Subdued
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Yi, have you gone mad?
Ning Yufen and the others were all astounded. They had never seen such a person before. Taking the initiative to court death?
Could it be that because he had been mocked by Ning Haidong, it had incited the pride that was typical of youth?
“Young Master Ling, don’t be angry!” Ning Yufen reminded.
Yet Ling Han merely smiled. He had only met these three by chance, and had no obligation to help them tide over their difficulties.
He had his own mission. He had to find the large black dog and the others first, and then consider other matters.
Ning Yufen still wanted to chase after him, yet she saw that the white wolves had already launched an attack. Ning Bian pulled her back.
“Humph, let this kind of ungrateful person fend for himself,” Ning Haidong said coldly.
Before he had even finished speaking, the white wolves’ attacks had already landed on Ling Han.
However, the following scene caused Ning Bian and the others to go numb with shock.
Ling Han was completely unscathed!
How was this possible!
They all gaped, as if they had seen a ghost.
Ling Han strode forwards, and had already reached the edge of the “island”. His eyes swept over them, and he asked calmly, “Are you still not getting lost?”

These white wolves seemed to have sensed Ling Han’s aura, and all of them released low howls of “wuwuwu”. However, there seemed to be a proud and aloof trait in their blood. They clearly knew that Ling Han was not to be trifled with, but they still did not retreat. They merely dug their claws, appearing very irritable.
“I gave you guys the chance, so don’t blame me,” Ling Han said with a shake of his head.
In a situation when there was no animosity between them, he did not mind giving others a chance, even if it was a fierce beast.
However, if they remained stubborn, he wouldn’t be hesitant or soft-hearted either.
Ling Han waved his hand, and the Regulations transformed into Sword Rays. As the sword swept past, the entire wolf pack was instantly annihilated.
‘F*ck!’
Ning Bian and the others were rendered completely speechless. Just what kind of abilities were these?
He was freakishly awesome!
Ling Han didn’t give the three members of the Ning Clan any chance to make up for their mistake. He activated his movement technique and rapidly left.
He didn’t pay them any regard at all.
Ning Bian and the others naturally beat their chests and stamped their feet in regret.
This was a young elite. If they could follow him, they may be able to find the way out.
“Humph, show off!” Ning Haidong muttered softly.
You clearly have such strong abilities, yet still dodged with them. What else could it be but showing off?
Pa, he instantly received a slap on the head. It was Ning Bian who had slapped him. The old man was very angry.

Meanwhile, Ning Yufen said faintly, “Brother, just based on your previous attitude, if it was any other person, they would have long since killed you, right? This Young Master Ling can be considered extremely magnanimous, and you should be grateful.”
Ning Haidong still wanted to argue, but when he thought about how the gap between the two of them was as wide as the gap between heaven and earth, what was the use of verbal attacks?
Ling Han strolled slowly. To say nothing of a True Self Tier-level wolf pack, even if it was a Venerate Tier-level wolf pack... he still had some confidence that he could deal with it.
Why?
He had the Great Emperor Horn, and this was extraordinarily effective against the Wolf Tribe. Even the Imperial Son could not resist it.
Thus, he was confident that he could make even Venerate Tier-level wolves wag their tails and beg for mercy at his feet.
Thinking about this scene, he was still slightly expectant.

After walking for a while, he discovered another “island”, but he still did not have the slightest sense of direction. Even for paths he had already travelled, he was unable to form a map in his mind. It was as if there was an indescribable power affecting him, that he could not resist.
Not long after, the wolf pack came again.
It was still white, but much weaker. It was only Cauldron Forging Tier-level.
Ling Han didn’t make a move at all. Killing a wolf pack of this level couldn’t temper battle prowess.
He directly streaked past. Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was used, and even a Venerate Tier elite wouldn’t be able to catch up to him. At most, they would be evenly matched with him in speed.
Where exactly were the large black dog and the others?
Ling Han walked around, but he had no sense of direction at all. He could only walk around randomly.
Several days later, he actually encountered Ning Bian and the others again.

The three of them were unlucky, and were hunted down by the wolf pack again, and this time, their luck was really too bad. The wolf pack was Spiritual Transformation Tier-level, and they couldn’t even dodge, and would only be insta-killed.
However, they were also very fortunate to have encountered Ling Han at this time.
Ling Han didn’t hesitate. With a wave of his hand, the wolf pack was annihilated.
This allowed Ning Bian and the others to survive a calamity, and they were even more stunned by Ling Han’s strength.
This was too terrifying.
It was only a single move, and in a single move, he had insta-killed a dozen over Spiritual Transformation Tier-level fierce beasts. This strength was illogical.
‘You’re so young, so how did you cultivate?’
“Thank—”
Ning Yufen had just managed to say one word, when Ling Han had already flown away.
This place was far too large, so much so that one would lose all sense of direction. Thus, it would be far too difficult to find the large black dog and the others.
But no matter how difficult it was, so what? How could he not find them?

Old Black and the others didn’t have the Great Emperor Horn. If they encountered a Sect Master-level wolf pack, and didn’t have any “isles” to take refuge on, then it would be hard to say what their situation would be.

The only thing that made Ling Han feel at ease was that these three guys had all cultivated Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and their speed was comparable to cultivators and fierce beasts that were one level higher than them. Thus, this would greatly increase their ability to survive.
They definitely had to hold on until he arrived.
After wandering around aimlessly for a few more days, Ling Han finally encountered the Sect Master-level wolf pack.
There weren’t many, only seven, but it was equivalent to seven Sect Masters acting in unison. This was already terrifying enough.
Ling Han’s interest was piqued, and he raised his fist to greet the incoming attack.
However, he was too disappointed. The seven ferocious wolves were completely not enough for him to fight. In a few punches and kicks, he had eliminated all of them.
So weak?
No, he was too strong!
Ling Han sighed, and continued onwards.
This was a super labyrinth. It was clear that there was no obstruction in any direction, yet no matter how hard he tried, he could not walk out.
Another three days passed, and Ling Han suddenly felt a powerful aura approach.
This was... a Venerate Tier-level great beast!
Ling Han’s heart immediately clenched. He looked to his right, and a shadow appeared in the fog. Then, it slowly became clear, revealing a white wolf that was about nine meters tall.
Venerate Tier elite!

However, Ling Han wasn’t nervous. So what if it was a Venerate Tier-level great beast? As long as he used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, even a Venerate Tier-level great beast would only be able to eat dust behind him.
There was only one, but wasn’t a Venerate Tier-level great beast enough?
This fierce beast stared at Ling Han, and slowly bared its mouth, revealing giant fangs that were like divine blades.
Ling Han smiled, “Doggy, sit!”

The ferocious wolf was furious. Though it was a fierce beast, being able to become a Venerate Tier, it naturally still had some intelligence. It could completely understand Ling Han’s contempt and mockery, which made it feel that its pride had been provoked.
Hence, it immediately waved its claws, and delivered a paw strike at Ling Han.
Ling Han bounced off his feet, and rapidly dodged. Then, he took out the Great Emperor Horn, and blew it strongly.
His Spiritual Power suddenly dropped drastically, but a soundless wave also spread out.
The vicious beast’s claw instantly froze in midair, then withdrew. It pounced quickly to Ling Han’s feet, and rubbed its head against Ling Han’s leg. Boom, Venerate Tier-level power reverberated.
If this was any other Sect Master, he would definitely be directly shattered by this fierce beast acting spoiled. However, just how strong was Ling Han’s physique? He forcefully withstood it.
However, it really hurt a little!
