chapters.title: Chapter 4519: Finding Old Black
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Not bad, he had obtained a Venerate Tier pet.
The Great Emperor Horn was truly heaven-defying.
Ling Han stretched out a hand, and pressed it down on the head of the ferocious wolf.

This ferocious wolf was much taller than Ling Han. Thus, Ling Han couldn’t reach it even if he stretched out his hand. However, the ferocious wolf lowered its head on its own accord, allowing Ling Han to easily touch it.
Ling Han searched the divine sense of the vicious wolf.
Though this fierce wolf was Venerate Tier-level, its memory was incredibly simple.
Ever since it could remember, it had lived in this fog, and to it, this fog was the best tonic, allowing it to endlessly increase its cultivation level.
And that was that.
Ling Han was astonished. A mighty Venerate Tier-level beast had been living in this sea of fog all this while, feeding on the fog and continuously improving its cultivation level?
However, vicious beasts were vicious beasts, after all. Thus, when outsiders invaded, they would instinctively attack.
In the memories of this fierce wolf, it had already killed no less than a few hundred people.
There was one thing that pleasantly surprised Ling Han, and that was the ferocious wolf would not get lost in this sea of fog.
In this way, there was hope that he could find the large black dog and the others. There was no need to search for a needle in a haystack.
“I’ll give you a name.”
Ling Han pondered for a moment before replying, “I’ll call you Mantis Shrimp.”
The fierce wolf didn’t care. Its intelligence was pitifully low, and it didn’t know the difference between a shrimp and a wolf at all.
“Mantis Shrimp, let’s go.”
Ling Han jumped onto the wolf’s back, and had the fierce wolf bring him to find the large black dog and the others.

Though the ferocious wolf did not know where the large black dog and the others were, the advantage was that it would definitely not lose its way. In other words, there was no need for them to take the wrong path.
That was enough.
Ling Han rode the fierce wolf, and searched around in this sea of fog.
After a few days, he had a rough impression.

The width of this sea of fog was about three days’ journey, and its length was about the same. However, if he wanted to search every area, that would not take three or six days’ time, but would take an astonishingly long time.
He hoped that the large black dog and the others wouldn’t run around randomly.
Ling Han thought to himself.
After a whole two months, Ling Han finally found the large black dog and the others.
He had not even seen the large black dog from afar, when he heard the large black dog making a fuss.
“You guys, are you planning to kick me to the curb after I’ve outlived my usefulness?” The large black dog’s arrogant voice rang out.
Ling Han frowned upon seeing this. Had Old Black been bullied?
Riding the fierce wolf, he slowly walked forwards.

There was an “island” ahead of them, and there were a great many wolf corpses lying around the island. Their injuries varied, with saber wounds, sword wounds, and claw marks. Clearly, they had died at the hands of different people.
However, the ferocious wolves were not completely eliminated. There were still about seven roaring on the sidelines.

On the “island”, the large black dog, the little azure dragon and the pervert pig were facing off against 11 cultivators. They were surrounded, and all of them were injured, appearing to be in a very bad situation.
“Hand over the Imperial Technique that you all possess. Otherwise, you can all go and be fed to the wolves!” A cultivator smirked coldly.
Ling Han gave an ‘oh’ in understanding.
These people coveted the Imperial Techniques that the large black dog had on them. Indeed, Imperial Techniques could drive anyone crazy.
However, he hadn’t expected that the biggest threat to the large black dog and the others wasn’t the wolf pack. Instead, it was the cultivators who had been trapped here.
Ling Han’s expression was baleful. Under his control, the fierce wolf beneath him moved quietly, revealing his tall figure in the fog.
Because of the angle, Ling Han, who was seated on it, was not seen by anyone. Thus, everyone could only see the appearance of a massive white wolf, exuding the aura of a Venerate Tier elite.
All of a sudden, everyone felt an immense pressure.

“There’s no need to be afraid. Fierce wolves can’t possibly reach the island!” A martial artist in a long green robe comforted everyone. “Just in time. This is a Venerate Tier-level great beast, and it can easily tear Spirit Transformation True Lords into pieces.”
“If you guys still don’t hand over the Imperial Technique, we’ll chase you guys out!”
“There is no need to leave the island. As long as you leave the central area, you will all be killed by the fierce wolves!”
“So, if you don’t want to die, hand over the Imperial Technique immediately!”

The eyes of these people were burning. The temptation of the Imperial Technique was really too great. Furthermore, this could be considered a natural Mystery Realm. In future, if they killed others to keep them quiet, who would know that they had obtained the Imperial Technique?
The large black dog spat, “Do you think Grandpa Dog doesn’t know that once we hand over the Imperial Technique, you will kill us to keep us quiet!”
“Heng, heng!” The pervert pig nodded continuously.

Meanwhile, the little azure dragon raised its head high, and said, “If worse comes to worst, we’ll just have a battle! Even if we suffer some injuries, and our battle prowess declines, if you guys want to kill us, you’ll have to pay an exorbitant price. I wonder which of you is prepared to die with us.”
These words were very clever. They both expressed their determination to fight to the death, and also incited conflict the relationship between those eleven people.
Those who died... would have died for nothing.
Who would be such a fool?
However, these eleven people seemed to have reached an agreement, and faced with this kind of provocation, not one of them was moved.
The matter was not easy to deal with.
Yi?

The large black dog and the others faltered at the same time. This was because they had received a divine sense transmission. A look of pleasant surprise instantly appeared on their faces, and they immediately retracted their divine sense.
“I’ve decided that even if I die, I won’t let you succeed!” the large black dog suddenly said in a righteous voice.
“Let’s go!” The little azure dragon also charged toward death with a generous expression.
“Heng, heng!” The pervert pig was disdainful. ‘You guys are all actors.’
The large black dog and little azure dragon turned around, then grabbed the perverted pig and headed out of the island.
What was going on?
Everyone was dumbfounded. In their impression, the large black dog and the others were all extremely afraid of death, so why were they suddenly so determined?
“Let them go!” One of them smirked coldly, “Once the fierce wolves attack, let’s see if they won’t flee back in a sorry state, and beg for mercy.”

Everyone nodded in agreement. If there were only seven Spiritual Transformation Tier-level wolves, the large black dog and the others might still have a chance of survival. However, now when there was another Venerate Tier-level wolf?
What a joke. To be able to escape from the eyes of a Venerate Tier-level beast, this was practically a fantasy story, all right?

One step, two steps, three steps, the large black dog and the others had already walked far out of the central area, but all the fierce wolves were just sitting by and watching, and not one of them attacked.
Yi, what was going on here?
The eleven people in the center of the island were all shocked. They could not accept this at all.
Could it be that the three of them were also beasts, so... there was differential treatment?
However, forget about that dog. Shouldn’t wolves eat pigs?
Their temperament had changed drastically. Had they become vegetarian?
When they arrived at the borders, the large black dog stopped, then turned around, “Sons of a b@stard, do you still want Grandpa Dog’s Imperial Technique?”
This?
Everyone gritted their teeth. They could not accept this reality at all.
Someone tried to walk out, but he had just walked out of the safety zone, when he saw a fierce wolf open its mouth, and spit out a silvery light that attacked him.
That person hurriedly retreated, shrinking back into a safe area.
He was completely stupefied!
The wolf pack hadn’t become vegetarian, so what was going on?

sentences.text: Editor: Henyee Translations
Not bad, he had obtained a Venerate Tier pet.
The Great Emperor Horn was truly heaven-defying.
Ling Han stretched out a hand, and pressed it down on the head of the ferocious wolf.
This ferocious wolf was much taller than Ling Han.
Thus, Ling Han couldn’t reach it even if he stretched out his hand.
However, the ferocious wolf lowered its head on its own accord, allowing Ling Han to easily touch it.
Ling Han searched the divine sense of the vicious wolf.
Though this fierce wolf was Venerate Tier-level, its memory was incredibly simple.
Ever since it could remember, it had lived in this fog, and to it, this fog was the best tonic, allowing it to endlessly increase its cultivation level.
And that was that.
Ling Han was astonished.
A mighty Venerate Tier-level beast had been living in this sea of fog all this while, feeding on the fog and continuously improving its cultivation level?
However, vicious beasts were vicious beasts, after all.
Thus, when outsiders invaded, they would instinctively attack.
In the memories of this fierce wolf, it had already killed no less than a few hundred people.
There was one thing that pleasantly surprised Ling Han, and that was the ferocious wolf would not get lost in this sea of fog.
In this way, there was hope that he could find the large black dog and the others.
There was no need to search for a needle in a haystack.
“I’ll give you a name.”
Ling Han pondered for a moment before replying, “I’ll call you Mantis Shrimp.”
The fierce wolf didn’t care.
Its intelligence was pitifully low, and it didn’t know the difference between a shrimp and a wolf at all.
“Mantis Shrimp, let’s go.”
Ling Han jumped onto the wolf’s back, and had the fierce wolf bring him to find the large black dog and the others.
Though the ferocious wolf did not know where the large black dog and the others were, the advantage was that it would definitely not lose its way.
In other words, there was no need for them to take the wrong path.
That was enough.
Ling Han rode the fierce wolf, and searched around in this sea of fog.
After a few days, he had a rough impression.
The width of this sea of fog was about three days’ journey, and its length was about the same.
However, if he wanted to search every area, that would not take three or six days’ time, but would take an astonishingly long time.
He hoped that the large black dog and the others wouldn’t run around randomly.
Ling Han thought to himself.
After a whole two months, Ling Han finally found the large black dog and the others.
He had not even seen the large black dog from afar, when he heard the large black dog making a fuss.
“You guys, are you planning to kick me to the curb after I’ve outlived my usefulness?” The large black dog’s arrogant voice rang out.
Ling Han frowned upon seeing this.
Had Old Black been bullied?
Riding the fierce wolf, he slowly walked forwards.
There was an “island” ahead of them, and there were a great many wolf corpses lying around the island.
Their injuries varied, with saber wounds, sword wounds, and claw marks.
Clearly, they had died at the hands of different people.
However, the ferocious wolves were not completely eliminated.
There were still about seven roaring on the sidelines.
On the “island”, the large black dog, the little azure dragon and the pervert pig were facing off against 11 cultivators.
They were surrounded, and all of them were injured, appearing to be in a very bad situation.
“Hand over the Imperial Technique that you all possess.
Otherwise, you can all go and be fed to the wolves!” A cultivator smirked coldly.
Ling Han gave an ‘oh’ in understanding.
These people coveted the Imperial Techniques that the large black dog had on them.
Indeed, Imperial Techniques could drive anyone crazy.
However, he hadn’t expected that the biggest threat to the large black dog and the others wasn’t the wolf pack.
Instead, it was the cultivators who had been trapped here.
Ling Han’s expression was baleful.
Under his control, the fierce wolf beneath him moved quietly, revealing his tall figure in the fog.
Because of the angle, Ling Han, who was seated on it, was not seen by anyone.
Thus, everyone could only see the appearance of a massive white wolf, exuding the aura of a Venerate Tier elite.
All of a sudden, everyone felt an immense pressure.
“There’s no need to be afraid.
Fierce wolves can’t possibly reach the island!” A martial artist in a long green robe comforted everyone.
“Just in time.
This is a Venerate Tier-level great beast, and it can easily tear Spirit Transformation True Lords into pieces.”
“If you guys still don’t hand over the Imperial Technique, we’ll chase you guys out!”
“There is no need to leave the island.
As long as you leave the central area, you will all be killed by the fierce wolves!”
“So, if you don’t want to die, hand over the Imperial Technique immediately!”
The eyes of these people were burning.
The temptation of the Imperial Technique was really too great.
Furthermore, this could be considered a natural Mystery Realm.
In future, if they killed others to keep them quiet, who would know that they had obtained the Imperial Technique?
The large black dog spat, “Do you think Grandpa Dog doesn’t know that once we hand over the Imperial Technique, you will kill us to keep us quiet!”
“Heng, heng!” The pervert pig nodded continuously.
Meanwhile, the little azure dragon raised its head high, and said, “If worse comes to worst, we’ll just have a battle!
Even if we suffer some injuries, and our battle prowess declines, if you guys want to kill us, you’ll have to pay an exorbitant price.
I wonder which of you is prepared to die with us.”
These words were very clever.
They both expressed their determination to fight to the death, and also incited conflict the relationship between those eleven people.
Those who died... would have died for nothing.
Who would be such a fool?
However, these eleven people seemed to have reached an agreement, and faced with this kind of provocation, not one of them was moved.
The matter was not easy to deal with.
Yi?
The large black dog and the others faltered at the same time.
This was because they had received a divine sense transmission.
A look of pleasant surprise instantly appeared on their faces, and they immediately retracted their divine sense.
“I’ve decided that even if I die, I won’t let you succeed!” the large black dog suddenly said in a righteous voice.
“Let’s go!” The little azure dragon also charged toward death with a generous expression.
“Heng, heng!” The pervert pig was disdainful.
‘You guys are all actors.’
The large black dog and little azure dragon turned around, then grabbed the perverted pig and headed out of the island.
What was going on?
Everyone was dumbfounded.
In their impression, the large black dog and the others were all extremely afraid of death, so why were they suddenly so determined?
“Let them go!” One of them smirked coldly, “Once the fierce wolves attack, let’s see if they won’t flee back in a sorry state, and beg for mercy.”
Everyone nodded in agreement.
If there were only seven Spiritual Transformation Tier-level wolves, the large black dog and the others might still have a chance of survival.
However, now when there was another Venerate Tier-level wolf?
What a joke.
To be able to escape from the eyes of a Venerate Tier-level beast, this was practically a fantasy story, all right?

One step, two steps, three steps, the large black dog and the others had already walked far out of the central area, but all the fierce wolves were just sitting by and watching, and not one of them attacked.
Yi, what was going on here?
The eleven people in the center of the island were all shocked.
They could not accept this at all.
Could it be that the three of them were also beasts, so... there was differential treatment?
However, forget about that dog.
Shouldn’t wolves eat pigs?
Their temperament had changed drastically.
Had they become vegetarian?
When they arrived at the borders, the large black dog stopped, then turned around, “Sons of a b@stard, do you still want Grandpa Dog’s Imperial Technique?”
This?
Everyone gritted their teeth.
They could not accept this reality at all.
Someone tried to walk out, but he had just walked out of the safety zone, when he saw a fierce wolf open its mouth, and spit out a silvery light that attacked him.
That person hurriedly retreated, shrinking back into a safe area.
He was completely stupefied!
The wolf pack hadn’t become vegetarian, so what was going on?

chapters.title: Chapter 4520: Get out
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ɲ”Sons of a b@stard, are you shocked?” The large black dog laughed loudly, “Who is Grandpa Doǥ? Dogs are the leader of the Wolf Tribe. My bloodline is noble, and naturally superior to Wolf Tribe!”
What bullsh*t!
Previously, you had also been hunted down by the wolf pack and fled in a sorry state, all right? Why didn’t I see you act so pretentious at that time?
However, everyone was confused. Why didn’t the wolf pack attack the large black dog and the others now?

“Trash like you actually dare to threaten Grandpa Dragon!” The little azure dragon was not the type to spare others verbally either, and pointed at everyone. “Now, it’s Grandpa Dragon’s turn to flip out!”
“Come, bite these b@stards in front of Grandpa Dragon to death!”
Unfortunately, the wolf pack still only surrounded the “island”, and not one of them obeyed the command to attack.
The little azure dragon couldn’t help but fly into a rage out of humiliation. This was bullying him too much.
“Haha, Four-Legged Snake, you can’t do it!” the large black dog mocked.
“Are you guys done yet!” Among the eleven people, a middle-aged man in a yellow shirt shouted in a deep voice, “What kind of tricks are you playing? Let’s be clear, what’s the point of doing this?”
The large black dog humphed, and said, “Grandpa Dog has never been one to suffer losses. Since you’ve forced us out, I’ll let you suffer the consequences of your own actions!”
“Hahaha!” The eleven people all laughed loudly.

Though they did not know why the wolf pack did not attack the large black dog and the others, when the eleven of them joined forces, their battle prowess was far superior to the large black dog and the others. Otherwise, they would not have dared to force them previously.
“What right do you have to chase us out?” These people asked with a grin.
“Leave it to me,” a voice rang out from the body of the Venerate Tier-level wolf.
Yi?
These people were all shocked. What? A ferocious wolf that had gained intelligence had actually appeared?
Once it developed intelligence, it would no longer be a fierce beast, but a Demonic Beast!

Demonic Beasts and cultivators were no longer hostile. They could actively cultivate, and could use the celestial technique. In fact, after revealing their true form, their defense, attack power, and speed were all considerably superior to cultivators of the same cultivation level.
A Venerate Tier-level great beast, just how terrifying was that!
Next, this fierce wolf slowly lowered its body, as if it was crawling.
This piqued everyone’s curiosity. Could it be that this ferocious wolf was bowing to them?
Use civility before resorting to force?
Er!
This was truly strange and hilarious. A Venerate Tier-level great beast was prostrating in front of them in respect?
However, the following scene shocked them so much that their eyes almost popped out of their heads.
There was actually a person seated on the back of this giant wolf!
Only now did they know that it was not the giant wolf that had gained intelligence, but rather the person on top that had spoken.
But this was even more shocking to them.
That was a Venerate Tier-level fierce beast, and precisely because it was a fierce beast, it could not possibly have any kind of reverence, so how could it possibly be taken as a pet beast?
Inconceivable! Unbelievable!
“Little Han!” The large black dog and the others all rushed over. “Brat, you’ve finally received the message that we sent out!”
What, they knew each other!
Everyone finally understood why the wolf pack didn’t attack the large black dog and the others.
That was because there was someone ruthless, that even a Venerate Tier-level giant wolf was his pet beast.
All of a sudden, they were all trembling.
After offending such a ruthless person, did they still have a way out?
Ling Han nodded, then sneered, “Aren’t you guys very capable? Why did you guys ask me for help?”
“Hehehe.” With how shameless the large black dog and the others were, how could they possibly care? They all showed a shameless smile.
Ling Han was only saying this, so how could he really reprimand them?
However, these eleven people in front of him?
Ling Han opened his mouth, and said, “Are you still not getting out?”

These people were too despicable. They should have been in the same boat, but when they charged into a safe area, they were kicking the large black dog and others to the curb. They were even coveting the Imperial Techniques that the large black dog and the others possessed. This kind of action made Ling Han very angry.
The world was already dark enough, so couldn’t there be a little more light?
The eleven people exchanged looks, and all shook their heads.
What a joke. If they went out now, wouldn’t they be torn into pieces by the fierce wolves?
That would be courting death. They were not idiots.
“Sir, don’t go too far!”
“Your cultivation level definitely won’t surpass ours. It’s just that you have a special method to tame beasts!”
“So, as long as we don’t leave the safe zone, even if you have a Venerate-level beast pet, you won’t be able to threaten us.”
These people whispered among themselves, then spoke to Ling Han, one after another.
Was they still going to resist stubbornly?
Ling Han shook his head, and strode towards the heart of the island.
The 11 people all looked alert. They couldn’t see through Ling Han’s strength at all, so they naturally didn’t dare to be careless.
Ling Han made a tapping motion with his finger. Peng! A person’s head instantly exploded into a cloud of blood.
‘F*ck!’
Seeing this scene, the remaining ten all felt a chill run down their spines.
Heavens, this was a Sect Master elite.
Though there were ten of them, against Sect Master-level?
Sorry, they would definitely be insta-killed.
Seeing Ling Han raise his hand again, the ten people were instantly scared out of their wits, and they all rushed out of the island.
They fled very separately. In this way, even if they were pursued, there would definitely be a few that could escape alive.
As for who would be able to escape, that would have to depend on luck.
However, they had forgotten that there was also a Venerate Tier great beast here!
The giant wolf pounced on them one by one. With only ten jumps, it had bitten all ten of them to death.
When a Venerate Tier elite made a move, there was naturally no doubt about the end result.

“This is really venting my anger!” the large black dog said hatefully. Previously, they had been fighting side by side with these people, yet in the end, they had been bitten in the back. Anyone would explode in anger at this, what more when it was the large black dog.
“Let’s go. Let’s think of a way to leave this place.” Ling Han beckoned with his hand, signaling the large black dog and the others to sit on the back of the wolf.
“Hehe, thank you for your hard work!” The large black dog even greeted the giant wolf.
The giant wolf withdrew its Venerate Tier-level intimidation, and the seven ferocious wolves immediately turned around and fled.

The Wolf Tribe had a strict hierarchy. A Venerate Tier-level wolf was completely capable of making a low-level wolf commit suicide. Thus, the seven wolves naturally fled as if they had been granted amnesty.
Ling Han also commanded the giant wolf to charge forward.

He didn’t need to know the direction. It was fine as long as this giant wolf didn’t get lost. They would definitely be able to walk out of the sea of fog as they headed forwards. At that time, they would be able to leave safely.
The giant wolf streaked through the air. Its speed was incredible, and it was as if it were a beam of light.
After all, this was a Venerate Tier.
The Venerate Tier-level wolf cleared the path for them, so they naturally advanced smoothly. After walking for two days, the giant wolf suddenly stopped.
Yi?
Ling Han looked ahead, and a figure could vaguely be seen.
He was curious, because he had not commanded the giant wolf to stop.
Could it be that the person in front of them was so powerful that even the giant wolf felt apprehensive?
A Venerate Tier elite?
Or even a Saint?
At this time, the figure in front of him was approaching, and very soon, a young man appeared in front of Ling Han.
Because of his position, he was looking up at Ling Han, but there was an incredibly confident expression on his face. He did not feel insignificant because of this at all.
“Who are you?”
“Who are you?”
The two of them asked each other at practically the same time.

chapters.title: Chapter 4521: Di Wuji
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The young man revealed a smile, and said, “As the owner of this place, I think I should be qualified to ask about your origins, right?”
What, he was the owner of this place?
Ling Han was internally stunned. Just how inconceivable was this?
However, he actually believed his words more than he disbelieved it.
Why?
Because of the giant wolf’s reaction.

This young man was a Sect Master. He was 100% sure of this. Thus, the fact that the giant wolf had taken the initiative to stop was definitely not because of the young man’s strength, but because this giant wolf recognized him.
The problem was that he didn’t find any information about this young man in the giant wolf’s memories. It seemed like it was purely instinctive for this giant wolf to feel reverence.
Interesting.

A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. Previously, there had already appeared such rulers of lands of peril like the sea of blood and the Yin River. Could it be that one of them would also appear here?
“My name is Ling Han.” He smiled slightly.
“Ling Han?” The young man revealed an astounded expression, then smiled as well. “I’ve heard of you, but according to rumors, you’re already dead.”
Ling Han laughed loudly, “The rumors also say that I’m shameless!”
The large black dog, little azure dragon, and pervert pig all rolled their eyes. ‘You are really very shameless. That has absolutely nothing to do with the rumors!’
The young man opposite him nodded, and said, “I am Di Wuji.”
Di?
There was only one surname of ‘Di’, and that was the Wolf Tribe Demon Emperor!
Yi, this place was filled with wolves, and there were even Venerate Tier-level great beasts... could it be? This was the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan?
“Dare I ask, Brother Di, what is this place?” Ling Han asked calmly.

Di Wuji smiled faintly, “Brother Ling should have guessed a little. However, this place is not the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan, but rather another related place. I would like to know, why is Brother Ling actually able to control the Wolf Tribe?”
He naturally knew how ferocious his wolf pack was. Aside from his own bloodline that could suppress them, there was no way anyone else could control them.
Ling Han’s mind whirred. This wasn’t the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan?
However, there were countless wolves here, and even he had lost his sense of direction. Could it be that it was not because of a Great Emperor-level formation?
Aside from the Imperial Clan, where else would there be Emperor-level formations?
Moreover, he dug three feet into the ground, and a terrifying aura seeped out from the ground, easily injuring him.
So, this place was actually not the Imperial Clan of the Demon Wolf Race?
Obviously, Di Wuji could not possibly tell him the full truth. Otherwise, the latter would not have avoided this topic.
Ling Han smiled, and opened his mouth to say, “Oh, I have a natural special ability, and am skilled in controlling all beasts.”
He deliberately swept an eye over the large black dog, the little azure dragon, and the perverted pig. How could these three guys not understand? Immediately, they all put on respectful expressions.
“Woof!”
“Ang!”
“Gu!”
The barking of a dog, the roar of a dragon, and the squealing of a pig seemed to be expressing their submission to Ling Han.
Di Wuji: “...”
He suddenly felt like he was about to go crazy.
‘You’re not playing by the rules, are you?’ Although these three guys were all in the form of beasts, it was clear with a single glance that they were Demonic Beasts and not ferocious beasts.
The so-called Beast Control Proficiency was practically non-existent!
“Hehe, the rumors are not false. You are indeed very shameless!” Di Wuji sighed.
Ling Han put on a serious expression, and rebuked righteously, “Who said that? Who said that? I want to reason with him. How can he insult me behind my back like this!”
The large black dog and the others all chuckled. If you weren’t shameless, there wouldn’t be anyone shameless in this world.
Di Wuji shook his head, and did not linger on this topic. Instead, he asked, “Brother Ling should have a horn on you, right?”
‘Hmm?’
Ling Han tensed. No outsider knew that he possessed a horn.
In fact, even after he had used the horn to control Di Luo, the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan was still completely baffled, and did not know what was going on.
But when it came to Di Wuji, why had he immediately guessed it correctly?

He had long since suspected that the Great Emperor Horn was most likely forged from the bones of the Wolf Emperor, and that was why it could overlook the precious tool of the Wolf Tribe and be effective even on the Imperial Son.

However, the strange thing was that the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan didn’t seem to know about the Great Emperor Horn at all. Instead, in the case of Demon Race, he revealed the secret of the Great Emperor Horn with a single word.
F***, could it be that this Di Wuji had come from the ancient era, so he knew a great many secret techniques of the Wolf Tribe that would not be passed on to others?
“Of course not!” Ling Han’s mind whirred, but his answer was without hesitation. “What’s the use of this horn? It can actually control the Wolf Tribe?”
Di Wuji chuckled, “This horn was refined from a bone that my father extracted from himself. It has a natural suppressive effect on the Wolf Tribe.”
My father!

Heavens!

This was an existence similar to the little azure dragon and the little red bird. Moreover, he seemed to have been developing secretly all this while, hidden in this Mystery Realm. There was no shortage of cultivation resources, unlike the little azure dragon, who had lost his father before he was even born.

The problem was, being able to elevate the quality of the Celestial Qi was Ling Han’s ability. Then, seven portions of Eight Star Celestial Qi would have to be traded for a treasure that had been personally refined by a Great Emperor?
Ling Han was definitely at a disadvantage, and a huge disadvantage at that.

Yi, this turn of events is really too sudden, isn’t it?

That was right.

Brother?

chapters.title: Chapter 4522: Attack
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The large black dog’s expression was filled with sincerity, as if he really considered Di Wuji as one of his brothers.
Best scenario was for Di Wuji to also return to his wolf form. They could rub their noses, and wag their tails. They would be truly in harmony.
Di Wuji’s expression was ugly.

His shrewdness could be considered extremely deep. After all, he was the son of a Great Emperor, so how could his self-restraint be weak? Moreover, he had experienced one era after another, so how could that kind of accumulation be something that ordinary Imperial Sons could compare to?
However, at this moment, he felt like he was about to go crazy.
Ling Han and the large black dog were both f*cking unpredictable. He had lived for so long, but he had never seen this kind of character.
He took a deep breath, and said, “Ten portions of Eight Star Celestial Qi.”

Ling Han immediately looked displeased. With a wave of his hand, he said, “Brother Di, you are really too unfilial towards your father, Lord Wolf Emperor! I hate unfilial people the most!” He turned around and glanced at the large black dog and the others, “Let’s go.”
Di Wuji finally couldn’t bear it any longer, and his expression changed drastically, as he exclaimed, “Brother Ling, don’t forget, that was originally belonging to our Di Clan!”

“Brother Di, you’re wrong to say that,” Ling Han said with a serious expression. “The surname of the Emperor isn’t written on that horn. Moreover, I didn’t steal or snatch it. I obtained it with my own abilities, so it naturally belongs to me.”
“Going by Brother Di’s logic, as long as it is something that belongs to me, I can get it back. Then, I will sell something to you, then take it back, then sell it to you, and then take it back...”
In a single breath, he said ‘sell it to you, then take back’ many times. Then, he paused, and looked towards the large black dog, “How much does he owe me now?”
The large black dog put on an act, counting them off one by one with his toes. Then, he said, “There would have to be over a hundred thousand portions of Celestial Qi.”
Ling Han nodded and said, “Then let’s give him a discount. Rounding off the number, let’s charge him a hundred thousand.”
Di Wuji was finally enraged. A vein was popping on his forehead. Boom, a frightening aura surged out, and the images of seven stars actually appeared behind him, exuding a frightening pressure.
This Imperial Son was no pushover!

Ling Han’s heart immediately clenched. This guy was definitely on the same level as Yang Yihuan, Feng Miaoling, and so on. In fact, he was even stronger than them. He was comparable to Ding Shu, Myriad Dao, and others at the same cultivation level.
However, Ling Han was completely unafraid. By now, he was already a six-star Sect Master. To say nothing of being invincible against all Sect Masters, er, in truth, he was not too far off either.
“Ling Han, this is your final warning. Don’t force me!” Di Wuji was obviously suppressing his anger before saying this.

“Brother, what’s wrong with you? Why are you so furious? Sigh, if you have a problem, just say it. On the basis that we share the same blood, Grandpa Dog will definitely help you! But you have to say it. If you don’t say it, how would Grandpa Dog know?”
“Although you keep looking at Grandpa Dog with such urgency, you really have to say it out loud.”
“If you don’t say it, Grandpa Dog won’t be able to read your mind. How can I know?”
“So, are you going to say it or not?”
The large black dog’s mouth was full of nonsense, and very tongue-twisting.
Di Wuji’s face was red, green and black, changing continuously.
Now, he really wanted to kill someone, oh no, kill a dog!
“Humph, you guys are courting death!” he shouted lightly, and the aura of his bloodline surged, affecting that Venerate Tier-level giant wolf.
His bloodline could suppress any member of the Wolf Tribe by nature. This was the ability of the son of the Great Emperor.
However, that giant wolf was also being controlled by the Great Emperor Horn. This was similarly supreme control.
Unless the Wolf Emperor came back to life, it would be hard to decide who was stronger between these two types of control.
Thus, the giant wolf was in a difficult position.
Who should he listen to?
Unfortunately, though it was Venerate Tier-level, its intelligence was only on the level of a five-year-old child. This really made things difficult for it!
When Di Wuji saw this, he couldn’t help but frown.
He had indeed thought of this possibility, but before witnessing it with his own eyes, he always wanted to give it a try.
Though this move was ineffective, it was fine. His strength could crush everything. Worse come to worst, he would just have to deal with it himself.
He stretched out a hand, and grabbed out at Ling Han.
Weng, weng, weng! One after another, Regulations manifested, and there were a total of... eighteen of them!
Impressive!
Even if this guy was a nine-star Sect Master, his natural talent in cultivation was still inconceivably high. He really could match Ding Shu and the others.
Merely in terms of battle prowess, this was the strongest Sect Master that Ling Han had seen so far — that kind of Venerate Tier suppressing Sect Master didn’t count.
Unfortunately, his opponent was Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled faintly and replied with a punch of his own.
Boom, with a punch, nineteen Regulations formed!
What!
Di Wuji’s eyes instantly widened in shock.
How was this possible?
Nineteen six-star Regulations? This was practically unbelievable!
He was a nine-star Sect Master, so even if Ling Han’s cultivation level was the same as his, he still had one more Regulation than he did.
In other words, Ling Han’s natural talent in cultivation was higher than his.
He could not believe it.
Who was he?
He was the son of the Wolf Emperor, and he had received special attention from the Great Emperor since a young age. In fact, he had even changed his fate!
Thus, in a battle of equal cultivation levels, he should be invincible.
And now, there was actually someone that was even slightly more freakish than him. Though there was only a gap of a single star, inferiority was inferiority, and there was no excuse for it.
Instantly, his killing intent blazed madly.
He definitely had to kill Ling Han.

In terms of Regulations, he was indeed slightly inferior to Ling Han, but battle prowess wasn’t completely determined by the number of Regulations. Just like how power was the most important attribute of a cultivator, but it wasn’t absolute.
“Demonic Wolf Devours the Moon!” Di Wuji shouted loudly, his figure rapidly enlarging. Then, he opened his massive mouth, and was about to swallow Ling Han.
Ling Han humphed upon hearing this. ‘Who cares about your cultivation technique? My fist is invincible, and it can shatter everything!’
Boom!
He had already walked out his own path. Every punch and kick was comparable to the Imperial Technique.
The terrifying power of the punch swept over, and the Regulations turned into an endless number of God Tools, forcibly shattering that massive mouth.
Di Wuji returned to his original form, and there was some blood at the corner of his lips.
His ultimate move had been shattered with a single punch from Ling Han, so it naturally backfired on him. However, he was strong enough, so this only caused him slight injury.
This stunned him.

The Demon Wolf Devouring Moon was an Imperial Technique. As long as he swallowed his target, a large amount of blood essence would be deprived from his body, causing his battle prowess to drop drastically. He only had to do it a few times, and he would definitely be done for.
This move could be said to have been tested time and time again. It had killed who knew how many powerful opponents.
However, faced with Ling Han, this Imperial Technique was actually easily resolved.
“I have underestimated you.” Di Wuji nodded. Looks like he could not defeat Ling Han with such a simple move.
He humphed, and once again charged towards Ling Han. The seven stars behind him solidified, as if they were the reflection of the heavens, infinitely boosting his power.
Peng!
Ling Han exchanged a blow with Di Wuji, and a frightening power assailed him, instantly sending him flying.
Hiss, what strong power!
Ling Han steadied his footing, and felt a boiling sensation in his chest. He almost threw up blood.

He was astonished. Even if his cultivation level was inferior to Di Wuji’s, there was only a gap of three minor levels, at most. However, in terms of the power gap of this attack, it was at least 10 stars and above.

chapters.title: Chapter 4523: Power of Seven Stars
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

When one had reached the Spirit Transformation Tier, especially Sect Master-level or above, the importance of power would have to give way to Regulations. It would definitely be Regulations that would decide the battle prowess of a cultivator.
Though that was the case, if the Regulations were of the same level, but the power gap was equivalent to the gap between Venerate Tier and Sect Master?
This was definitely a crushing defeat!
Ling Han could feel that Di Wuji’s power had surpassed him by at least 10 stars, just like how a Venerate Tier was attacking him.
However, how could a Sect Master possess such powerful strength?
Ling Han looked at the seven starsbehind Di Wuji. They had already completely solidified, and were exuding a terrifying aura.
The problem must lie here.

When he saw how Ling Han was staring fixedly at the stars behind him, Di Wuji smiled proudly, “This is my father using his supreme might, forcibly refining the seven great stars and placing them into my body. They can endlessly provide me with power.”
The large black dog, little azure dragon, and pervert pig all paled at the same time. This was too freakish.
It should be known that if a star exploded, even Venerate Tier elites would be forcefully shattered.
From this, it could be seen just how much terrifying power a star contained.

Of course, this wasn’t an explosion. Instead, it was a continuous flow of power, so it was definitely much weaker. However, there were a total of seven stars, so the power supply together was naturally extremely terrifying.

He believed that this was still because Di Wuji was only a Sect Master, and could only sustain a limited amount of power. Otherwise, if he advanced into Venerate Tier, he would definitely be able to sustain even more power, and the power that he blasted out would be even more terrifying.
—So what if my Regulations are slightly inferior to you? My power is definitely overwhelming!

Ling Han revealed a blazing fighting spirit. In a battle of equals, he had always been invincible. Even if Yang Yihuan, Feng Miaoling, and the other ancient prodigies appeared, and there was also the competition with Origin, Ding Shu, and the others who were similarly Genesis World’s rulers, he was still invincible among his peers.
Even if Ding Shu and the others wanted to battle him, without the advantage of three or four minor levels, there was no way they could exchange blows with him.
Now, however, Di Wuji possessed overwhelming power. He was completely outmatched, and this instead stimulated his intense fighting spirit.
‘Come!’
Ling Han released a battle cry, and the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was used. His speed was extremely fast, and he circled around Di Wuji. Then, he shot out punch after punch.

He used his strengths and avoided his weaknesses, and did not confront Di Wuji head-on. Instead, he used his advantage in speed, and blasted out Regulations, which turned into divine light to attack this powerful opponent.
Di Wuji was astounded, “True Phoenix’s movement technique? You are quite lucky, to actually have obtained True Phoenix’s inheritance!”
This was a precious technique that even his father very much wanted to see. Unfortunately, he still lacked a sliver of fate to witness it.
“However, you want to defeat me just like that?” He smiled faintly, and his eyes suddenly widened. He shouted loudly, “Freeze!”
Weng! The seven stars lit up at the same time, unleashing a devastating power.
Instantly, the air around them became incredibly heavy. Boundless power had even solidified.
Ling Han’s speed rapidly decreased. Seven stars took effect at the same time, causing the space around him to become incredibly frozen. Even Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was greatly affected.

There was nothing else that could be done. Di Wuji’s power had definitely advanced into the level of Venerate Tier, and now, with his overwhelming power that was superior to Ling Han’s cultivation level by a major tier, he was naturally capable of affecting Ling Han.
“Hahaha!” Di Wuji laughed loudly, and delivered a palm strike towards Ling Han.
Boom, endless power reverberated, compressing layer by layer. It had even solidified, and could be seen clearly with the naked eye.
Because Ling Han’s speed was limited, he did not manage to completely dodge this blow. After being swept by it, his whole person was instantly sent flying.
Terrifying!
Ling Han fell onto the ground, and with a ‘wah’, he threw up blood madly.
The large black dog, the little dragon, and the pervert pig all looked anxious. They believed that in a battle of equal cultivation levels, Ling Han would definitely be able to crush Di Wuji.
But who asked him to be the son of a Great Emperor? Seven stars had actually been refined into his body!

In truth, if Di Wuji had advanced into Saint Tier, then this kind of advantage in power would completely disappear, because a single strike from a Saint would be able to easily destroy a star. This gap was too wide, so the power of seven stars was naturally meaningless.
However, at the Sect Master-level, or even Venerate Tier-level, these seven stars could greatly increase Di Wuji’s power, and cause a crushing blow to his opponent.

Ling Han was only able to vomit blood and not be insta-killed with a single strike. That was because he had cultivated the Heavenly Dragon Emperor’s Scroll, and could disperse another portion of the power of the attack.
If it was any other Sect Master? They would have been insta-killed long ago, all right?
This could not be considered Di Wuji’s own battle prowess, but who asked him to have a Great Emperor as his father?
“Four-Legged Snake, why are you so weak?” the large black dog asked the little azure dragon.
The little azure dragon was rendered speechless. His father died before he was even born, and it’s my fault?
“Ling Han, your natural talent is indeed amazing. However, in front of the accumulated power of a Great Emperor, what are you worth?” Di Wuji’s expression was filled with pride.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “This isn’t your strength. Besides, I haven’t lost yet!”
He stepped out, and threw another punch.
This time, he used the Seven Star Regulations, though there were only two slivers.
Di Wuji smirked coldly. This was really too foolish. He clearly knew that his power was overwhelming, and still wanted to confront him head-on?
‘You were killed by your own stupidity.’
He delivered a palm strike, extremely casual, but with the boost of terrifying power, the might of this strike was boundlessly strong.
Ling Han did not dodge or retreat, and shot out this punch grandly, turning into a giant golden fist that blasted towards Di Wuji at an extraordinarily fast speed.
Peng!
The golden fist landed on the palm strike, and was instantly shattered by the vigorous power.
Even if you had one more Regulation, so what? If the power gap was too wide, you would still be overwhelmed.
However, after the colossal fist crumbled, a streak of shattered light continued to blast towards Di Wuji.
What!
Di Wuji was taken aback, his eyes almost popping out in shock.
How was this possible?
Ling Han’s power clearly hadn’t changed, and the number of Regulations was still nineteen. So, why was the power of his punch soaring? Why was it able to pierce through his attack?
Xiu, this punch had already arrived.
He was completely unprepared, and was too confident. Thus, he did not manage to dodge in time, and was hit head-on.

“Wu!” He instantly gave a muffled humph, opened his mouth, and spat out a mouthful of blood. A bloody hole shockingly appeared in his abdomen. It had been created by the shattered power of Ling Han’s fist.
Looking again at Ling Han, he was also sent flying by the vigorous power, and similarly spat out a mouthful of blood.
This blow could be considered to have wounded both sides.
“Good job!” The large black dog, the little azure dragon, and the pervert pig all cheered loudly, instantly becoming excited.
—You, Di Wuji, are depending on the power of the Great Emperor, but Ling Han is truly capable.
With such a comparison, it was clear who was superior.
Di Wuji’s eyes shone brightly. He lowered his head to look at the wound, then said darkly, “So, it turns out that you have actually grasped a sliver of the Seven Star Regulations!”
It was precisely because the level of Regulations was too high, so even if there was only a sliver, it still managed to break through his attack, and cause damage to him.
Freak, how could there be such a freak?

chapters.title: Chapter 4524: The Saint Corpse appears
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Di Wuji’s killing intent blazed even brighter.
This kind of opponent was unimaginable to him. Could even the Great Emperors of the past compare to Ling Han?
Thus, Ling Han definitely had to die. Otherwise, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to become Emperor would appear in this era, and it was also very likely that it would be snatched away by Ling Han.
Becoming Emperor was the ultimate dream for these supreme prodigies, and they were willing to risk their lives for it.
“Die!”
Di Wuji aggressively charged over. Even if Ling Han had grasped a little bit of the Seven Star Regulations, so what? His power had an absolute advantage, and he could crush him.
Ling Han released a battle cry, and exchanged blows with Di Wuji.
His attack was very simple, and that was to use his own path of martial arts, as well as the Seven Star Regulations, to clash head-on with Di Wuji.

In terms of power, it was naturally Di Wuji who had won, and in terms of piercing ability, it was Ling Han who had gained an absolute advantage. This was the Seven Star Regulations, and against a Sect Master, he similarly had a crushing advantage.
Thus, neither of them dodged or evaded, exchanging blows head-on, which naturally caused great injury to both of them.

The shockwaves of the terrifying power blasted out, and the Seven Star Regulations turned into a blade that possessed boundless destructive power. The large black dog and the others had no choice but to retreat, not daring to face its might at all.
It couldn’t be helped. Though the little azure dragon was also the son of a Great Emperor, and had astonishing natural talent in cultivation, he was only a Spirit Transformation Tier, after all.
His cultivation level was far too inferior, so much so that he couldn’t withstand these attacks at all.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
With every exchange of blows, Ling Han and Di Wuji were both throwing up blood continuously, their injuries extremely severe.

In terms of attack power, the two of them could be considered evenly matched. They were both extremely strong, and in terms of defense, Ling Han was actually stronger, but it was just enough to compensate for his inferiority in attack power.
Thus, if they traded injuries for injuries like this, the final result would be both sides suffering heavy losses, or even perishing together.
At this time, it was up to the recovery ability.
Ling Han channeled the Ten Cultivation Technique, and his injuries were immediately under control. Combined with his powerful physique, he could completely become an undying cockroach.

Though Di Wuji also had healing techniques, every Great Emperor had their forte. For example, in the case of the Wolf Emperor, he preferred to attack. Thus, the Imperial Technique that he had created was more inclined towards attack.

In any case, the Great Emperors were all invincible in the universe. Whether their attack was stronger or weaker, or how powerful their recovery abilities were, it didn’t matter. This was completely dependent on the personality of the Great Emperor.
The gap between Imperial Techniques was relatively small, but after fighting for a long time, this gap was apparent.
Di Wuji was so stunned that he discovered that if this continued, he would lose!
‘F*ck! He would actually lose?’
He frowned deeply. This kind of conclusion had really disappointed him too much, and also dealt too much of a blow.
This was equivalent to having a Great Emperor help him cheat, yet he was still inferior to a cultivator at the same cultivation level. How could he accept this?
He gritted his teeth, and the seven great stars lit up brightly at the same time, emitting a blinding light.
Then, boom, a ray of light shot out, turning into a supreme divine light that slashed towards Ling Han.
This speed was too fast, and there was no way to dodge at all!

Ling Han didn’t dare to be careless, because when he faced these seven great stars, it couldn’t be considered a battle at the same cultivation level at all. Instead, he was fighting against a Venerate Tier, or at least a Pseudo Venerate Tier.
Thus, with a single thought, Purple Calamity Grains immediately formed a defense.
Peng!
The attack landed on Ling Han’s body, and a blinding light flashed.
A smile instantly appeared on Di Wuji’s face. Though this attack had not improved on the level of Regulations, in terms of power, it was equivalent to a Three Star Venerate Tier.
Ling Han was definitely going to die if he faced this attack head-on.
However, in an instant, a figure charged out of the light.
Who else could it be but Ling Han?
Di Wuji had not thought of this at all. This was completely impossible.
Peng, Ling Han’s punch had already arrived. Even if he leaped out of the way to dodge, and dodged the front of the fist, the terrifying power and Regulations still landed on him.
Di Wuji gave a muffled humph, and was instantly sent flying.
He was throwing up blood madly, his eyes filled with both shock and confusion.
Why had Ling Han not died?
This was illogical!
Ling Han smiled calmly, “You have the means of a Great Emperor, so how could I not have a trump card?”
Aside from Purple Calamity Grains, he also had a Pseudo Imperial Weapon, Destructive Energy, and so on.
Di Wuji glared at Ling Han. At this moment, he really did not know what to say.

As the son of the Great Emperor, his battle prowess was already incredibly powerful. Add to that the techniques of the Great Emperor, to say nothing of being invincible among his peers, even if his opponent’s cultivation level actually surpassed him by a major tier, he still had the ability to save his life.
But now, faced with Ling Han, he did not have the slightest bit of confidence.
In fact, this opponent had even more tricks up his sleeve than he did.
He took a deep breath, and suddenly cut open his finger, squeezing out a drop of silver blood.
“F*ck! Idiot!” the large black dog immediately exclaimed. “You’ve clearly bled so much, so why are you still cutting your finger and squeezing out blood?”
When Di Wuji heard this, he almost couldn’t help but throw up blood.

However, he was also a little confused. That’s right. He had already bled so much, so why did he still deliberately cut his finger? Could it be that he was too used to it, that he did not think too much about it at all?
He flew into a humiliated rage, and shouted, “That’s not important. What’s important is that you all have to die!”
He seemed to have activated some kind of special ceremony, and was muttering under his breath. Then, a terrifying aura suddenly spread out from not too far away.
Boom, the sound of something shattering rang out. Then, not too far away, a figure suddenly appeared, supporting both heaven and earth.
This was... Ling Han was astonished.
He knew that there was an “island” not far away, and he was certain that the sound just now should be the ground shattering, and that figure crawling out from underneath.
Previously, he had already excavated the island, but he had not dug to the bottom. He was shocked by a powerful aura, and did not dare to continue digging.
He suspected that there was an elite buried underneath, or perhaps it was a deadly weapon. By the looks of it now, it should be the former.
Boom!
Right at this moment, that figure had already walked over. With a single step, the ground trembled violently.
It was only one step, and that figure was already close enough, revealing its true appearance.

This was a giant ape that was as tall as three hundred meters. There were bone chains around its neck, and it was wrapped in a layer of armor. It held a spiked club in its hand. Upon a closer look, this staff was forged from white bone.
However, there was a wound on his chest that had directly pierced through his heart.
Saintly might!
Ling Han was immediately certain that this definitely wasn’t a Venerate Tier. Venerate Tiers weren’t that powerful.
However, this Saint Ape was already dead. It was a walking corpse.
But a starving camel was still bigger than a horse. So what if he had died? He could still unleash his saintly might, and it was no issue for him to insta-kill Ling Han.
F***, Di Wuji was actually capable of summoning a dead Saint?

Ling Han’s heart jolted. This place was indeed no different from the sea of blood and the Yin River. Then, there should be Saint corpses buried beneath those “islands”, right? That was why the wolves were afraid, and dared not set foot here.
Hiss!
Without the slightest hesitation, he grabbed the large black dog and the others. Then, he used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to rapidly flee.
Fight my a*s, even a Saintly corpse had appeared.
The corpse of the Saint Ape was a little dumb. This was understandable. After all, it had already died.
He was under the control of Di Wuji, and only then did he raise a giant hand, which struck out at Ling Han.
His arm was only a few hundred meters long, but just how terrifying wasSaint-level battle prowess?
The force and Regulations intertwined, turning into a monstrous demonic hand that set off in pursuit of Ling Han.

Fight my a*s, even a Saintly corpse had appeared.
The corpse of the Saint Ape was a little dumb.
This was understandable.
After all, it had already died.
He was under the control of Di Wuji, and only then did he raise a giant hand, which struck out at Ling Han.
His arm was only a few hundred meters long, but just how terrifying wasSaint-level battle prowess?
The force and Regulations intertwined, turning into a monstrous demonic hand that set off in pursuit of Ling Han.

chapters.title: Chapter 4525: Another ocean of Saint corpses
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han’s speed was very fast. Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was the fastest movement technique in the world.
However, it was a Saint that was attacking him.
Even if he had long since died, and was a corpse, he was still faster than him. The attack had already reached him.
Ling Han did not hesitate in the slightest, and immediately threw out a few Energy Jades. Then, he channelled Purple Calamity Grains to take this blow from the Saint head-on.
His heart ached. If he was attacked by a Saint, the Purple Calamity Grains would not be able to take effect after a few times.
However, if he was about to lose his life, what was the point of discussing anything else?
Boom!
That demonic hand very quickly crashed into the Energy Jades, and immediately detonated the jades. A terrifying wave of energy surged out, surging in all directions.
So what if this was a sea of fog? At present, it was equivalent to two Saints exchanging blows, so how terrifying would the shockwave created be?
Ling Han only felt his body tremble, and was instantly sent flying by a massive force.
This speed was too fast, and the distance of 5,000 km had passed in an instant.
Thankfully, he channelled the Purple Calamity Grains. This could block the attack of a Five Star Saint, and was enough to ensure his safety.
He discovered that the four of them had been directly sent flying out of the area of the sea of fog, and were standing all alone in space.
Run!
Ling Han did not hesitate in the slightest, and turned to leave.
He didn’t dare to tear open space. If he entered the Void, he might be forcefully sucked into the sea of mist again.
Yi?
He saw a terrifying aura attack from the sidelines, instantly approaching above the sea of fog.
A Saint!
F***, there was an ambush outside as well?
That’s not right.

Ling Han immediately discovered that this Saint was alive. He had manifested his Dao Manifestation, which was even larger than a planet. With a single step, he could cover millions and millions of km, and that was why he could arrive in an instant.

It was not targeted at him, but rather because he was interested in the matter of those that had teleported to the Cold Sealed Planet going missing. It was because of this that he had deliberately come to investigate.
Ling Han immediately covered himself, the large black dog, and the others with the hide of the Void Beast. He naturally didn’t want to be discovered by the Saint and captured for questioning.
This was a Saint that was dressed in white robes. His hair was also silvery white, and it hung down to his waist, making him appear sage-like.
“Humph, so it is this sea of fog that is causing trouble!” the Saint said to himself. He stretched out a palm, and shot out towards the sea of fog.
However, before his attack had even reached its target, a demonic hand suddenly shot out from the sea of mist. This hand was as large as a planet, and it was about to strike the Saint.
Boom!
The two of them exchanged a blow, creating a terrifying shockwave.

Ling Han and the others were instantly sent flying into the depths of the universe by the shockwave. Thankfully, they were still very far away. Thus, though the aftermath was strong, Ling Han was completely capable of dispersing it.
In the distance, the sea of mist was rapidly shrinking in size. However, the Saint was still standing tall and upright. He was incredibly huge, and could be seen clearly.

The silver-haired Saint unleashed another barrage of attacks. However, multiple Saint corpses that were riddled with fatal wounds leaped out of the sea of mist, one after another. They instantly surrounded the silver-haired Saint, ganging up on him.

Boom, a terrifying aura surged over in wave after wave. Ling Han did not linger around, and after being pushed far enough away, he immediately tore a rip into space, and fled with the large black dog and the others.
It was very likely that the silver-haired Saint was in a perilous situation.
Ling Han sighed internally. He could see that there were several dozen Saint corpses that had jumped out. Merely with their numbers, they could overwhelm him.
Previously, the Saint corpses in the sea of blood were clear proof of this. Even if a great number of Saints brought the Imperial Weapons with them, they would not be able to withstand it.
Ling Han appeared on the nearest planet. He brought the large black dog and the others, and continuously used Transfer Formation to travel back to the main base.
And now, another danger zone had appeared, where a great number of Saint corpses were buried.
And this time, it was actually related to the Wolf Emperor!
This was set up by the Wolf Emperor when he was alive?
What on earth was he trying to do?
Ling Han returned. Coincidentally, Brother Monkey had also come out of seclusion. He hurriedly told Brother Monkey about the matter.
When Brother Monkey heard this, he pondered for a moment, then said, “When Old Sun has advanced into Saint Tier, I will sweep aside all opposition.”
Er, Brother Monkey, I know you’re very domineering, but don’t be so brainless, all right?

However, upon further thought, this kind of thing was not something that could be solved through discussion. There were too many secrets in this world, so they could only wait quietly for the truth to surface on its own, and what they could do was to increase their cultivation level as much as possible.
“Buddha Doga must know,” Ling Han murmured.
Unfortunately, if Buddha Doga wanted to tell him, would he have waited until now?
‘Forget it, I’ll cultivate!’
Ling Han had Ji Wuming help him out, and spread the news on the Galaxy Network, that he wanted to sell some Strengthening Fluid in exchange for high-level Celestial Qi.

—In the previous auction, Ling Han had indeed used a portion of the Strengthening Fluid to trade for the Celestial Qi. However, the majority of it was obtained with low-level Celestial Qi after refining the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill, using money to make money.
Now that he had finished eating the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pills, he naturally had to think of another way.
At the same time, he took out the broken sword.
Previously, it was precisely because of this broken sword that he had first become enemies with Wu Yue. Afterwards, after he had killed Wu Yue, this broken sword naturally became his spoil of battle.
Previously, he had not had the time to study it, and only now did he remember.
However, after studying it for a long time, he did not discover anything.
He could only sense a very obscure yet very powerful fluctuation in the broken sword.
“If there’s a chance in the future, let the old man take a look.”
Ling Han put away the broken sword and turned his attention to cultivation.
After Ji Wuming released the news, it wasn’t long before someone replied, saying that they were interested in the Strengthening Fluid.
After a round of bargaining, the two sides reached an agreement.
Ling Han brought Ji Wuming with him and traversed a considerable number of galaxies, arriving at a great planet. Then, they began the transaction.
Of course, he couldn’t arrange it on his own planet. He had to be careful.
After consecutively completing a few business deals, Ling Han and Ji Wuming finally left. Then, he began to concoct alchemical pills.

He left behind a few alchemical pills, and used them to continue trading for Celestial Qi. That was because he did not have much Strengthening Fluid left, and could not redeem much Celestial Qi. However, if he had the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill, it could allow him to maintain a positive cycle.

Unfortunately, there was pitifully little Celestial Qi that could be traded for now. He finished the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pills, but he was still some distance away from the peak stage of Six Star Sect Master.

He continued to search for buyers on the Galaxy Network. Whether it was the Strengthening Fluid or the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pills, he would be happy to sell them as long as there was someone willing to use Celestial Qi to trade for them.
A few days later, he successfully concluded a deal, and hurriedly set out with Ji Wuming.
This rendered Ji Wuming speechless. He still had to cultivate, so why was Ling Han always looking for him?
Ling Han chose a new planet. He had just completed his transaction, and was just about to leave, when he suddenly felt an eerie aura assault him.

He had been to many dangerous places, and there were indeed some places that were incredibly cold. It would not be strange even if a Spirit Transformation Tier or even Sect Master were to freeze to death.
However, he was certain that this eerie feeling was completely different.
In fact, he was actually quite familiar with it.
The Netherworld’s aura!
He immediately tensed up, and did not come to his senses at the first instant. That was because he felt that this was inconceivable, and his brain had ruled out this possibility.
What was going on? Why did the aura of the Netherworld appear here?
He activated the ley lines, and when he checked, he couldn’t help but reveal a shocked expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 4526: Second Yin soul invasion
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
In this world, there was the Living Realm and the Netherworld.
The Living Realm was resided by living people, while the Netherworld was resided Yin souls—the two sides didn’t offend each other.
However, perhaps it had been too long, or perhaps it was for some other reason. In short, the Netherworld and Living Realm were actually showing signs of merging.

In the Living Realm, there were many weak points. In these weak points, the Living Realm and the Netherworld were only separated by layers of thin barriers, and elites could easily break through these barriers.
The Celestial Sea Planet of the past was a tragic example. A great number of Yin souls invaded, and even caused a Saint to die because of it.
What had Ling Han seen?
At the connecting point to the Netherworld, a large amount of Yin Qi was seeping out, and correspondingly, countless Yin souls were flying out!

They were extremely fragile under the sunlight, and would be turned into dust with a single beam of light. However, the surging Yin Qi was also transforming the environment. Yin Qi covered the sky, blocking the sunlight.
Although the yin souls would still be restricted in the Living Realm, without the direct sunlight, the Yin souls’ survival ability and mobility would also be greatly improved.
One after another, mortals were possessed by Yin souls, turning into walking corpses.
In just an instant, the number of deaths numbered in the millions and millions.
Was this a unique phenomenon, or... had the Netherworld beings’ invasion begun again?
Ling Han did not hesitate. Immediately, with Star Steps, he appeared at that most initial connecting point.
By now, the surrounding area had already been completely transformed by the Netherworld. Ling Han discovered that his control over the Regulations was rapidly decreasing.
If he couldn’t use the Regulations, his battle prowess would naturally decline correspondingly.
Seeing the appearance of living beings, the Yin souls that came out of the connecting point immediately whistled towards Ling Han.
Ling Han humphed and threw a punch.
Peng!
Instantly, large amounts of Yin souls instantly disintegrated in midair.
He was a six-star Sect Master now, so just how terrifying was the power of his punch?
However, the endless Yin souls continued to charge forward, not taking death to heart at all. They had not developed intelligence, and merely instinctively wanted to seize a physical body.
“Come!” Ling Han beckoned with his hand, and instantly, streaks of Earth Qi surged out, turning into Earth Dragons that blocked the connecting point.
Just how powerful was the power of a planet? However, the planet itself would not show its might, and had to be activated either by a Formation Master or formations.
Now that the Earth Qi had transformed into dragons, it had become a killing ground, and any Yin soul would shatter at the slightest touch.
At this time, the elites on this planet also flew over.

Some people were completely unaware of the Netherworld and Yin souls, and were completely confused about the situation. When they saw that Ling Han was standing there alone, they thought that it was his doing, and immediately rebuked him.
Additionally, there was no shortage of experienced people here. They immediately stopped them and explained.
“What, this is the connecting point of the Netherworld?”
“Then what do we do?”

Everyone could clearly see that the Yin souls that wreaked havoc everywhere possessed the unique trait of ignoring power attacks. Only high-level energy could injure them, and once they possessed someone, that person would be a dead man.
Boom!
Right at this moment, the Earth Dragons that had sealed off the connecting point were actually shattered in unison. Yin souls as tall as nine meters walked out, exuding a powerful aura.
Sect Master-level!
Not just one, but seven.

The overall level of cultivation of this planet was not very high, and the strongest was only Sect Master-level. Seeing seven Sect Master-level Yin souls appear all at once, it naturally caused everyone’s expression to change.
The invasion of the Yin souls was not something that they could withstand at all. They had best flee.
So what if the sky collapsed? There would always be someone taller to hold it up.
Ling Han humphed, and immediately charged out. As he brandished his fists, peng, peng, peng! One punch was enough to kill one, and the seven great yin souls were immediately destroyed.
With another wave of his hand, the Earth Dragons appeared once more.
F***, this was too powerful, wasn’t it?
Everyone’s eyes widened in disbelief.
Ling Han’s move naturally allowed everyone to see clearly that he was also a Sect Master.
However, as a fellow Sect Master, his strength was too inconceivable.
“He must be the Dao Child!”
“That’s right, only a Dao Child would have such strong battle prowess!”
Quite a number of people said conceitedly, using the worldview that they had knowledge of to explain Ling Han’s strength.
Ling Han said darkly, “I need Xuanlong Iron, Cloud Smoothstone, Heavenly Square Metal...” He recited a long list of ingredients.
Everyone exchanged looks. ‘What do you mean?’
Was he trying to extort them?
Hiss, you can’t play around like this. Taking advantage of a crisis to make a demand, this was really too despicable.
Ling Han frowned, and said, “What nonsense are you thinking? I want to set up a formation and lock this connection point!”
Only now did everyone know that they had misunderstood Ling Han. They all felt apologetic.
The survival of the planet concerned the interests of every single one of them. Thus, they immediately moved, delivering the materials that Ling Han needed.
Ling Han immediately began to create formation foundations.

With him here, he naturally could guard this connecting point. However, he could not possibly stand guard here forever, and the moment he left, the Earth Dragons would lose his support, and very soon, they would completely exhaust their Earth Qi and disappear.
Thus, he needed to set up a formation, extract the power of heaven and earth to lock this connecting point.

With the strength of his Spiritual Power, he was actually already capable of setting up a Venerate Tier-level formation, but firstly, there was a shortage of time and insufficient materials, and secondly, he had not grasped the corresponding formation, so he had only set up a Sect Master-level formation.
If the Yin souls that rushed out were only Sect Master-level at most, then this formation would be enough.
Firstly, the Yin soul’s battle prowess was inferior to cultivators of the same cultivation level in the first place, and secondly, this was the Living Realm, after all!
When the Yin soul came to the Living Realm, its battle prowess would definitely be affected, and drop by more than one or two levels.
Not long after, the formation foundations were completed.

After Ling Han had planted the formation foundations, he used his powerful Spiritual Power to stimulate the ley lines. Boom, instantly, every formation foundation emitted light, intertwining to form a super great formation.

Previously, when the Earth Dragons had sealed off the area, there were still a few scattered Yin souls that could rush out, but once the great formation was activated, there would definitely be none that could escape.
Though there were still Yin souls here, without the subsequent replenishment, every time they killed one, there would be one less, so there was no need to worry.
After doing all this, Ling Han hurriedly returned with Ji Wuming. He didn’t want a fire to start in his own backyard.
Thankfully, the planet they were on was unscathed, and had not been invaded by the Yin souls.
However, if one were to take a look through the Galaxy Network, they would discover that the invasion of the Yin souls was not an isolated event, but rather a frequent occurrence.

News of Yin souls invading was revealed from various places in the universe, and in the case of the Mountain Sea Heaven, it was even worse. The doors to the Netherworld had opened once more, and countless Yin souls rushed out, attacking cities and plundering lands.
Wherever they occupied, the air would be dense and baleful. The environment was changing drastically, developing to become more like the Netherworld.

This was a serious threat to all living beings. With the Imperial Clans as the leader, they once again joined forces with the Holy Lands of the universe, forming an alliance to fight against the Yin souls.

However, the Living Realm was like a sack that was riddled with holes. Previously, it would have been fine as long as it was not filled with water. It looked like the universe was peaceful, but now? It seemed like Yin souls would run out from every place, causing great chaos in the world.
