However, he could not possibly stand guard here forever, and the moment he left, the Earth Dragons would lose his support, and very soon, they would completely exhaust their Earth Qi and disappear.
Thus, he needed to set up a formation, extract the power of heaven and earth to lock this connecting point.

With the strength of his Spiritual Power, he was actually already capable of setting up a Venerate Tier-level formation, but firstly, there was a shortage of time and insufficient materials, and secondly, he had not grasped the corresponding formation, so he had only set up a Sect Master-level formation.
If the Yin souls that rushed out were only Sect Master-level at most, then this formation would be enough.
Firstly, the Yin soul’s battle prowess was inferior to cultivators of the same cultivation level in the first place, and secondly, this was the Living Realm, after all!
When the Yin soul came to the Living Realm, its battle prowess would definitely be affected, and drop by more than one or two levels.
Not long after, the formation foundations were completed.
After Ling Han had planted the formation foundations, he used his powerful Spiritual Power to stimulate the ley lines.
Boom, instantly, every formation foundation emitted light, intertwining to form a super great formation.

Previously, when the Earth Dragons had sealed off the area, there were still a few scattered Yin souls that could rush out, but once the great formation was activated, there would definitely be none that could escape.
Though there were still Yin souls here, without the subsequent replenishment, every time they killed one, there would be one less, so there was no need to worry.
After doing all this, Ling Han hurriedly returned with Ji Wuming.
He didn’t want a fire to start in his own backyard.
Thankfully, the planet they were on was unscathed, and had not been invaded by the Yin souls.
However, if one were to take a look through the Galaxy Network, they would discover that the invasion of the Yin souls was not an isolated event, but rather a frequent occurrence.
News of Yin souls invading was revealed from various places in the universe, and in the case of the Mountain Sea Heaven, it was even worse.
The doors to the Netherworld had opened once more, and countless Yin souls rushed out, attacking cities and plundering lands.
Wherever they occupied, the air would be dense and baleful.
The environment was changing drastically, developing to become more like the Netherworld.
This was a serious threat to all living beings.
With the Imperial Clans as the leader, they once again joined forces with the Holy Lands of the universe, forming an alliance to fight against the Yin souls.
However, the Living Realm was like a sack that was riddled with holes.
Previously, it would have been fine as long as it was not filled with water.
It looked like the universe was peaceful, but now?
It seemed like Yin souls would run out from every place, causing great chaos in the world.

chapters.title: Chapter 4527: Arriving at Mountain Sea Heaven again
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The Netherworld’s second large-scale invasion began, and the universe descended into chaos.
Thankfully, this kind of experience had happened a few dozen years ago. Thus, under the leadership of the Imperial Clans, the various forces in the universe began to resist in an orderly manner.

The Lord of the Blood Sea and the other supreme elites didn’t appear. Correspondingly, Buddha Doga also didn’t appear. It was as if they had reached a tacit agreement—neither side would send any top-notch elites.
Not only did Pseudo-Emperor-level elites not appear, but even Saint-level elites didn’t appear.
Thus, though this was a super large-scale invasion, and it was not just limited to the Mountain Sea Heaven, in terms of danger level, it was actually not as dangerous as the first time.
It was as if the Netherworld wasn’t worried at all, and they were planning to advance slowly and steadily.
Ling Han was extremely worried.
The first time the Yin souls invaded, a Yin Saint had said that they were all chess pieces on the chessboard, and were only at the mercy of others.
Using a Saint as a chess piece, and in fact, using the Netherworld and Living Realm as a chessboard, what kind of huge game was this?
These were truly troubled times.
Ling Han sighed. The peace of the two realms that Buddha Doga had fought so hard for was now in shambles again.

Now, there were cries of anxiety from all over the universe. Though the battle prowess of Yin souls had been weakened in the Living Realm there were really too many of them, so the pressure was really great.
The Saints didn’t dare to step out.

If the Living Realm sent out a Saint, then the Netherworld would also send out the Yin Saints accordingly. Furthermore, all of them were unafraid of death. If they were no match, a good few of them would rush forwards to self-destruct by burning the holy flame. So what if they were Saints? They would still be dragged down with them!
Thus, at present, only those with battle prowess on the level of Venerate Tier were rampaging unhindered in the Two Realm Battlefield. This seemed to be a state of tacit agreement from both sides.

The Living Realm was waiting for the birth of a new Emperor. As long as a new Emperor appeared, they would naturally be able to suppress the chaos of the universe. The Netherworld and Yin souls would be no problem at all.
As for what the Netherworld beings were waiting for... only the mighty figures of the Netherworld would know.
In short, a rare peaceful situation had appeared in the Living Realm. All the races and forces had set aside their old grudges and grievances, and joined hands to fight against the Yin souls.
The most important battlefield was still the Mountain Sea Heaven.

The other battlefields were only small skirmishes, and the connecting point between the two Realms jhere was too small. The powerful Yin souls couldn’t come out at all. As long as they set up a formation and sent someone to stand guard, they would basically be fine.

But the Mountain Sea Heaven was different. There was a massive hole torn in this place. To say nothing of Saints, even a Great Emperor would probably be able to pass through — otherwise, with how strong a Great Emperorwas, a sliver of his aura would be able to shatter the passageway.
Thus, the number of Yin souls that came out of the Mountain Sea Heaven was naturally the highest, and the number of Venerate Tier-level Yin souls was chillingly high.
The Imperial Clan Alliance issued a notice, calling on all those who had ambitions to head to the Mountain Sea Heaven to resist the Yin souls.

This was not for nothing. Killing Yin souls itself would be rewarded by heaven and earth. Of course, the number of kills definitely had to be large. If one only killed a few dozen or a few hundred, heaven and earth would not be moved.
Additionally, the Imperial Clan Alliance would also tally everyone’s battle merits, and based on their battle merits, they could redeem items from the Imperial Clan Alliance.

The range of things that could redeemed was wide. There were cultivation techniques, celestial techniques, Celestial medicines, formation techniques, pill recipes, and so on. As long as you had enough battle merits, you could basically redeem anything.
—Except for the Imperial Scroll and the Imperial Technique. This was definitely a secret that would not be passed on. There was no way that the Imperial Clans would be so generous.

At present, all the elites in the world were heading towards the Mountain Sea Heaven. Killing the Yin souls itself would be rewarded by the heaven and earth, and they would also be rewarded by the Imperial Clans, so why not?
The large black dog and the others were also restless, urging Ling Han and the others to set off.
Ling Han didn’t waste any time. He continued to run around, setting up formations everywhere and sealing off the connecting points of the two realms. He still hadn’t caught his breath yet.
“All right, there is one last place. After we have set up the formation, we will set out to the Mountain Sea Heaven,” Ling Han said.
This caused the large black dog and the others to cheer.
A few days later, Ling Han had also dealt with the last place.
He didn’t shoulder the safety of the world, and he was only a six-star Sect Master. He didn’t have that much power yet, but within the range of his abilities, Ling Han still wanted to do his best.
“We can’t go to the Mountain Sea Heaven like this,” Ling Han said.
The large black dog nodded, “Little Han has made too many enemies. If we run over like this, we would definitely be killed by the Imperial Clans!”
To hope that the Imperial Clans would prioritize the bigger picture, and repay evil with good, and fully nurture Ling Han to become Emperor?
What a joke. Even if they were afraid of the words of the public, they would still secretly kill Ling Han.
The little azure dragon immediately sneered, “Old Black, you speak as if you don’t have many enemies!”
The large black dog had a toxic tongue, and his enemies were no less than Ling Han’s.
“Heng, heng!” The perverted pig rolled his eyes, meaning that , ‘Four-Legged Snake with a cheap mouth like you is not much better, b@stard.’
All of a sudden, the four of them fell silent.

They should not accuse each other of things they themselves were guilty of; the four of them were the type to attract animosity. Even if there weren’t 10,000, there would be 8,000 that wanted to kill them.
“Disguise!”
“Definitely!”
“Let’s go.” Brother Monkey walked over with his staff. His expression was filled with indifference.
Everyone set out.

Resisting the Yin souls this time not only concerned everyone, but killing the Yin souls would also reap tangible benefits. Thus, as long as one’s cultivation level was on the Celestial Path, they would all be mobilized.
There were too many people, so Brother Monkey couldn’t transport them with him.
Thus, most people still used Transfer Formation, and everyone would meet up outside of Mountain Sea Heaven.
A dozen over days later, Brother Monkey brought Ling Han, the large black dog and a few others to the Purple Gauze Planet outside the Mountain Sea Heaven.

From here, there would be occasional flashes of light in the universe, which was incredibly dazzling, and the area that the Mountain Sea Heaven was originally in had become a mass of black, and was still spreading out in all directions.

The Purple Gauze Planet was a bridgehead at the front lines. Here, there were official troops established by the Imperial Clan Alliance, as well as freedom fighters who were unwilling to be restrained, and were only willing to keep to themselves.
But it was all right. As long as they were there to kill Yin souls, they could ride the warship into the universe every day, and battle with the Yin souls there.

If one wanted to obtain battle merits and redeem treasures from the Imperial Clans, they could obtain a small item for free. After wearing it, one could absorb a portion of the power of the Yin soul when the wearer killed the Yin soul.
This item would automatically calculate the Yin soul’s power based on the strength of the Yin soul’s power, and from there, calculate the battle merits.

Of course, because he had absorbed a portion of the power of Yin soul, the heaven and earth reward that he could receive from wearing it would also be slightly lesser, but it was really lesser by a very small amount, and could be ignored.
Ling Han and the others all went to collect a small item like this. They decided to enter the universe by ship on the second day, and battle with the Yin souls.
A day passed very quickly. Ling Han, Brother Monkey, and the others all queued up and boarded the warship.
—They had disguised themselves, and planned to hide their identities. Of course, they would keep a low profile as much as possible.
Of course, Ling Han believed that with Brother Monkey’s temper, he would definitely be exposed in less than three minutes in a fight.
Thus, Brother Monkey, Ling Han, and the others were not on the same warship, to avoid dragging Ling Han and the others down with him.

chapters.title: Chapter 4528: Battlefield
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

In any case, Brother Monkey was a Venerate Tier elite. Furthermore, it was unknown whether the Battle Saint Emperor was still alive or dead. No one knew whether this old Saint Emperor would suddenly charge back from the edge of the universe one day.
Thus, as long as Brother Monkey did not commit any heinous crimes, then no matter how displeased the Imperial Clans were, they would only have to swallow their anger.
He was strong enough to do as he liked, and did not need to have too many reservations.
If Ling Han and the others separated from Brother Monkey, Brother Monkey would be able to do as he liked.
After bidding farewell to Brother Monkey, Ling Han and the others boarded the warship and flew into the universe.

Their journey was very simple. There was only Ling Han, the large black dog, the little azure dragon, and the perverted pig. They were either Sect Master-level, or Spirit Transformation True Lord. It could be said that they represented the strongest battle prowess on Ling Han’s side.
Ling Han had sent the seven babies to protect the empress and the others. These people would come via Transfer Formation, so they naturally would be slightly slower.
The warship soon entered into the universe, and seeing that the battlefield ahead was getting closer and closer, the atmosphere on the ship also became tense all of a sudden.
“Haha, a bunch of new recruits!” someone mocked. “It’s not that I want to say this, but if you guys are so nervous, you’ll definitely die in less than ten minutes on the battlefield.”
This made everyone even more nervous. This involved their own life and death, so who wouldn’t be nervous?
“This big brother, do you have any experience to impart?” Someone who was thick-skinned immediately asked.

The person from before put on a laidback expression, and said with a smile, “How could there be any experience? It’s just a chaotic battle. Most of the time, you don’t even know where the attacks are coming from. Therefore, you have to find a small team first, and cooperate well.”
Everyone nodded, and went off to find their teammates.
Meanwhile, the veteran soldier shook his head. This was a last-minute effort, so how could they cooperate?
With the assault of the Yin soul army, these people would definitely flee for their lives.

However, those who managed to survive would be useful. They could be recruited into the official troops, firstly, to familiarize themselves with the terrible battle, and secondly, to know that only by gathering together for warmth would they be able to survive, and only then would they truly obey commands.
He was one of the eyes and ears, discovering valuable freedom warriors.
His eyes swept over them, and he faltered slightly.

He saw four people who were different from the others. Not only did they not converse with the others to form a team, but there was not the slightest bit of nervousness on their faces, as if they were not going to battle the Yin souls, but rather going for a picnic.
You guys are really too relaxed, aren’t you?
He nodded internally. These four people either had astonishing abilities, or had too high an opinion of themselves, and did not realize at all how terrifying Yin souls could be.
However, he did not speak out of turn, because he was only an observer.
It wasn’t long before they neared the edge of the battlefield.
The warship stopped, and did not go too deep. If they went any further, the warship would be attacked. This was only a transport ship, and did not have too strong a defense.
“Everyone, leave the ship!” one of the sailors shouted.
Some people immediately jumped out of the ship’s deck and rushed into the battlefield, but there were also some people who looked afraid.
It was possible that they had come with hot blood in their hearts, and had lofty aspirations, wanting to establish an outstanding meritorious service.
However, after they really came here, they surveyed the surroundings and realized that this was practically a living hell!

The entire battlefield was covered with corpses. Some were complete, and some were incomplete. Severed arms, legs, and heads covered this area, causing one to feel apprehensive just by looking at them. Those with weaker mental endurance were about to throw up.
As a result, a few women on the ship had already begun to vomit. Even two men couldn’t hold themselves back.
Ling Han nodded at the large black dog and the others. The four of them leaped out at the same time, heading towards the battlefield.
“Let’s move separately.”
The four of them were too strong. If they gathered together, they would be too eye-catching.
Ling Han charged into the battlefield, and instantly, four Yin souls charged towards him.
They were merely Cauldron Forging Tier-level, so they weren’t even qualified to have him attack them..
Ling Han strode forwards, and the four Yin souls rushed over, immediately shattering into pieces.

He was slightly disappointed. Although there were many Yin souls here, there were none that could reach Sect Master-level. Furthermore, there was a mixture of cultivators fighting.. There were Yin souls, as well as living beings. When he attacked, he would definitely have reservations, and could not kill all of them together.
This place was clearly not suitable for him. He had to go ahead.
As he passed, Ling Han didn’t hold back either, killing all the Yin souls in his way.
He advanced forwards, and the level of Yin soul gradually increased. True Self Tier, or even Spirit Transformation Tier, appeared.
This was still not what Ling Han wanted.
He advanced further. In this area, whether it was the living cultivators or the Yin souls, their numbers were considerably lesser. They were all Sect Master-level.
Ling Han looked ahead. There were still Venerate Tier-level battles there.

The Imperial Clan Alliance adopted a strategy of setting up layers of defenses, sparing the weak and concentrating on the strong. The Venerate Tier elites stood at the front lines, followed by the Sect Masters, the Spirit Transformation Tier, and so on. With this kind of selection, the Yin souls were also separated.
The strongest elite had been blocked at the first line, and then the Sect Master was at the second line. Coincidentally, they both had their own opponents.

Although there were many Sect Masters in the Living Realm, living beings needed to rest, so they couldn’t battle all the time. Thus, the Sect Masters had to be divided into several groups. One group would attack, and the others would rest.

Then, they still had to leave behind a portion of people for mobility. This group would have to go wherever they needed reinforcements, and also to prevent the Yin souls from suddenly increasing the intensity of their offensive.

On the other hand, the Yin souls didn’t need to rest, and they wouldn’t be injured either. They could battle continuously, and added with their absolute advantage in numbers, in this kind of war, even the Sect Masters of the Living Realm would have to match at least two Yin souls at the same time.

Thankfully, the Yin souls’ own battle prowess was slightly inferior, and added with the fact that this was the Living Realm, which had weakened a portion of their abilities, the Sect Masters of the Living Realm would still be able to hold on if it was one against two.
However, the battles were still as intense as before. Occasionally, there would be people who were severely wounded, or even killed.
After all, Yin souls were not idiots either. Why do I have to fight two against one evenly? Can’t I fight four against one, or ten against one?
Both sides suffered heavy casualties, but the Yin soul army was unafraid of death, while the Living Realm army couldn’t be so unafraid of death. Thus, their morale was far inferior.
At this rate, how many days could the Living Realm last?
Thankfully, the Imperial Sons also joined the battle, especially the Golden Generation. Similarly Sect Masters, they were too strong, and it was not impossible for them to fight a hundred alone.
They moved unhindered, invincible.
Ling Han also charged out. In his eyes, these Yin souls represented treasures that could increase his cultivation level.
He was very reserved, and did not use his full strength, but he was too strong. He could still kill a Yin soul with a few punches and kicks, as easily as could be.

After killing several thousand Yin souls, he finally received a reward from heaven and earth. An incredibly pure energy surged into his body, causing the sixth golden thread on his fruits of cultivation to become slightly deeper.
Invigorating!
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. Going by the rate of killing Yin souls, he would only need about ten days to advance to seven stars.
However, after fighting for only four days, the Yin soul army suddenly withdrew.
Ling Han had no choice but to retreat back onto the warship.

The entire battlefield was covered with corpses.
Some were complete, and some were incomplete.
Severed arms, legs, and heads covered this area, causing one to feel apprehensive just by looking at them.
Those with weaker mental endurance were about to throw up.
As a result, a few women on the ship had already begun to vomit.
Even two men couldn’t hold themselves back.
Ling Han nodded at the large black dog and the others.
The four of them leaped out at the same time, heading towards the battlefield.
“Let’s move separately.”
The four of them were too strong.
If they gathered together, they would be too eye-catching.
Ling Han charged into the battlefield, and instantly, four Yin souls charged towards him.
They were merely Cauldron Forging Tier-level, so they weren’t even qualified to have him attack them..
Ling Han strode forwards, and the four Yin souls rushed over, immediately shattering into pieces.
He was slightly disappointed.
Although there were many Yin souls here, there were none that could reach Sect Master-level.
Furthermore, there was a mixture of cultivators fighting..
There were Yin souls, as well as living beings.
When he attacked, he would definitely have reservations, and could not kill all of them together.
This place was clearly not suitable for him.
He had to go ahead.
As he passed, Ling Han didn’t hold back either, killing all the Yin souls in his way.
He advanced forwards, and the level of Yin soul gradually increased.
True Self Tier, or even Spirit Transformation Tier, appeared.
This was still not what Ling Han wanted.
He advanced further.
In this area, whether it was the living cultivators or the Yin souls, their numbers were considerably lesser.
They were all Sect Master-level.
Ling Han looked ahead.
There were still Venerate Tier-level battles there.
The Imperial Clan Alliance adopted a strategy of setting up layers of defenses, sparing the weak and concentrating on the strong.
The Venerate Tier elites stood at the front lines, followed by the Sect Masters, the Spirit Transformation Tier, and so on.
With this kind of selection, the Yin souls were also separated.
The strongest elite had been blocked at the first line, and then the Sect Master was at the second line.
Coincidentally, they both had their own opponents.
Although there were many Sect Masters in the Living Realm, living beings needed to rest, so they couldn’t battle all the time.
Thus, the Sect Masters had to be divided into several groups.
One group would attack, and the others would rest.
Then, they still had to leave behind a portion of people for mobility.
This group would have to go wherever they needed reinforcements, and also to prevent the Yin souls from suddenly increasing the intensity of their offensive.
On the other hand, the Yin souls didn’t need to rest, and they wouldn’t be injured either.

They could battle continuously, and added with their absolute advantage in numbers, in this kind of war, even the Sect Masters of the Living Realm would have to match at least two Yin souls at the same time.

Thankfully, the Yin souls’ own battle prowess was slightly inferior, and added with the fact that this was the Living Realm, which had weakened a portion of their abilities, the Sect Masters of the Living Realm would still be able to hold on if it was one against two.
However, the battles were still as intense as before.
Occasionally, there would be people who were severely wounded, or even killed.
After all, Yin souls were not idiots either.
Why do I have to fight two against one evenly?
Can’t I fight four against one, or ten against one?
Both sides suffered heavy casualties, but the Yin soul army was unafraid of death, while the Living Realm army couldn’t be so unafraid of death.
Thus, their morale was far inferior.
At this rate, how many days could the Living Realm last?
Thankfully, the Imperial Sons also joined the battle, especially the Golden Generation.
Similarly Sect Masters, they were too strong, and it was not impossible for them to fight a hundred alone.
They moved unhindered, invincible.
Ling Han also charged out.
In his eyes, these Yin souls represented treasures that could increase his cultivation level.
He was very reserved, and did not use his full strength, but he was too strong.
He could still kill a Yin soul with a few punches and kicks, as easily as could be.
After killing several thousand Yin souls, he finally received a reward from heaven and earth.
An incredibly pure energy surged into his body, causing the sixth golden thread on his fruits of cultivation to become slightly deeper.
Invigorating!
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face.
Going by the rate of killing Yin souls, he would only need about ten days to advance to seven stars.
However, after fighting for only four days, the Yin soul army suddenly withdrew.
Ling Han had no choice but to retreat back onto the warship.

chapters.title: Chapter 4529: Into the depths
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The warship was almost empty.
In the past, there had been a ship full of people, but now, there was only one third of them!

Furthermore, this was also the total number of people that this warship had transported from the Four Heavenly Realms. In other words, out of the people from the four Heavenly Realms, only one third was left.
Just how high was the casualty rate?
It could not be helped. This warship was carrying new recruits, and they had completely not been baptized by war, so how could they not suffer heavy casualties?
However, those who survived would rapidly grow. If they did not die after a few great battles, they would be able to become elites.
On the ship, everyone was silent. Some were numb, some were excited, and some were terrified. These were all normal reactions.
That veteran soldier was still observing, and had memorized the appearances of these survivors.
The warship returned to the Purple Gauze Planet.
Everyone went to rest and reorganize. The Yin souls would make a comeback soon, and by then, they had to face it in their best condition.
After disembarking from the warship, the sun was shining brightly.
Everyone was filled with the feeling of having survived a calamity. Bathing in the sunlight, feeling that they were still alive, a great many people cried out.
“Haha, I’ve advanced by a minor level!”
“Though I have sustained a considerable injury, the internal injuries that I have sustained in the past have disappeared!”
“My martial arts foundations have become even more solid!”
Multiple voices rang out, filled with excitement.
As long as they didn’t die in battle, they would definitely be able to obtain benefits.
Ling Han, the large black dog, and the others also left. They found a place to rest and reorganize.
If they battled against Yin souls, the stronger they were, the greater their gains would definitely be. Thus, the large black dog and the others were all overjoyed.
In the face of such pressure, even the pervert pig had no choice but to stay alert and fight seriously, because he did not want to die.
One day, two days, five days, and very soon, ten days had passed, but the Yin souls actually did not launch a new wave of attacks.
No one breathed a sigh of relief. Instead, they all became even more nervous.

The longer they accumulated power, the more terrifying the explosion of the Yin soul invasion would be in the next wave of attacks. Thus, there was a large rock weighing down on everyone’s chest, and it was getting heavier and heavier.
On the seventeenth day, masses of Yin souls suddenly rushed out of Mountain Sea Heaven.
It had begun!

On the Living Realm’s side, the Venerate Tiers, the Sect Masters and the Spirit Transformation Tier True Lords all rushed into space at the first instant. They didn’t need to take a warship; that would only delay their progress.

The others couldn’t. They had to use the warship as a means of transportation. After all, the minimum requirement for flying physically was Core Formation Tier, but this kind of speed was too slow. By the time they flew into the depths of space and faced off against the Yin souls, the battle might be almost over.
This time, Ling Han didn’t waste any time and immediately shot into the air.
It was not only Purple Gauze Planet. From the seventeen planets surrounding the Mountain Sea Heaven, elites flew out to meet the Yin souls.
Ling Han hadn’t used the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. This was far too eye-catching. If it wasn’t a life-and-death situation, he definitely would not use such an ultimate technique.
He was using the Imminent Skyline. Although it was a Saint Technique, its speed couldn’t be considered slow either.
But in this way, he was inferior to those Imperial Sons. They all rushed in front of him, and were the first to face the yin souls.
Ling Han frowned. He was always suppressing his abilities, so how could he compare to the Imperial Sons?
Since one had entered into battle later, and the efficiency of his slaughter was low, he would definitely kill a great many fewer Yin souls.
Now, the top prodigies were all fighting with all their might, striving to be at the forefront. In that way, the possibility of becoming Emperor was naturally higher.
They had no choice but to compete, because there were really too many prodigies of this generation, such as Ding Shu and Origin. Which one of them did not have the aptitude to become Emperor?
Thus, once Ling Han fell too far behind, then even if he was more freakish, he could only sit by and watch another become Emperor.
“This won’t work.”
Ling Han shook his head, but what could he do?
He couldn’t help but turn his gaze even further away.
What if he intercepted them there?
He was indeed at the level of Sect Master. Theoretically speaking, he couldn’t possibly be a match for Venerate Tier.
However, against a Yin soul, he had a crushing advantage.
Destructive Energy!
Thus, even if he encountered a Venerate Tier Yin soul, he would not be afraid. In fact, he could even kill it.

“All right, I’ll go there!” Ling Han was filled with confidence, because even if he was besieged by Venerate Tier Yin souls, or even encountered the Yin Saint, didn’t he still have the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and the Purple Calamity Grains?
This gave him great confidence.
He would do as he said.
After venturing deep into the battlefield, he didn’t linger in battle at all. When he arrived at the Sect Master-level battle area, he immediately used the Strange Shadow Steps and continued forward.
Very soon, he had passed through the Sect Master-level battlefield, and arrived at the area where the Venerate Tiers were battling.
He saw Brother Monkey, who was wielding a metal rod that was radiating with golden light. He was invincible.
Very good, Brother Monkey should have gained a lot. His abilities improved rapidly.
Ling Han smiled knowingly, and continued onwards.
Very soon, he had also passed through the Venerate Tier-level battlefield. There were many Yin souls here, and their abilities varied greatly, from Foundation Building Tier to Venerate Tier-level.
Ling Han appeared. This time, he had no scruples.
This is my battlefield, my world!
Boom, he threw a punch, and nineteen streaks of Regulations shone. Instantly, a massive vacuum appeared ahead of him.
All the Yin souls that were in the path of his attack were all turned into ashes.
When they saw a living being, they didn’t need anyone to command them, and the nearby Yin souls all charged over with a whistle.
Ling Han humphed as he unleashed his murderous aura. Pa, pa, pa! The Yin souls in the surrounding area were instantly annihilated.
The efficiency of this massacre was too high.
However, those that he had insta-killed naturally could not possibly have Yin souls that were too strong. Thus, Ling Han had temporarily not received any reward from the heaven and earth either.
Yin souls completely had no concept of death, and pounced one after another.
After battling for a while, Ling Han felt a powerful aura approach.
This was a Yin soul of the level of Sect Master.
It bared its fangs and brandished its claws, appearing incredibly fierce.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and with a punch, this Yin soul died.
Ling Han, who had reached the level of a six-star Sect Master, found it truly hard to find a match for himself among Sect Masters. Most opponents would only be insta-killed by him.
Someone like Di Wuji was really too rare. Furthermore, it was not that his own strength that was really strong enough to stand against Ling Han.
Die! Die! Die!

In just over ten minutes, Ling Han began to receive rewards from heaven and earth. His cultivation level began to increase, and the golden patterns on the fruit of cultivation became deeper and deeper.
“Going by that logic, I would be able to reach peak stage Six Stars in two days, at most!”
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. Fighting like this was more fun.
‘Hmm?’
A solemn expression appeared on his face. This was because he could sense an incredibly powerful aura that far surpassed his own.
Venerate Tier!
He looked into the distance, and saw a Yin soul that was as tall as three hundred meters was rapidly approaching. It had the body of a goat, its horns golden, and actually had a sacred air about it.
When the Venerate Tier arrived, how would a Sect Master be able to block him?
Ling Han gave a loud shout, and made the first move. He shot out a punch, and Destructive Energy boiled.

Faced with a Venerate Tier-level existence, his two slivers of Seven Star Regulations were not enough at all. Thus, he completely abandoned them and used all his Spiritual Power to stimulate the Destructive Energy.

chapters.title: Chapter 4530: Seven Star Sect Master
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Boom!
The Destructive Energy was unleashed, turning into a ball of light that was even darker than darkness itself. At an incredibly fast speed, it blasted towards the Venerate Tier Yin soul.

The Venerate Tier Yin soul had never imagined that Ling Han’s attack could be so fast. At this moment, it was already impossible for it to dodge. It could only clasp its front hooves in front of its chest.
It didn’t matter. It could easily block the attack of a mere Sect Master.
However, when the force of the punch arrived, this Yin soul finally realized that the situation was not good.
Its defense was completely useless in front of this energy.
Peng!
The Destructive Energy surged past, and that Venerate Tier-level Yin soul was instantly destroyed.
If others saw this, their eyes would definitely pop out in shock.
That was because though the Yin soul’s battle prowess was not strong, its defense was very high.

This was not reflected in the strength of their physique, but rather that they could immediately heal after being injured. Of course, their battle prowess would also decrease accordingly, and had to be compensated by devouring other Yin souls.
Hence, killing Yin souls was very troublesome, and they needed to be shattered bit by bit.
But in front of Ling Han, this Yin soul was killed with a single punch, and directly turned into ashes.
Yet Ling Han was completely unconcerned. He squinted his eyes, feeling the arrival of the rewards from heaven and earth, circulating in his body, making him feel incredibly pleased.
‘Come, again!’
He released a battle cry, and the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was used, traversing among the Yin souls.
There was no need for him to make a move at all. He only had to channel the Destructive Energy onto the phoenix wings, and wherever he passed, an absolute vacuum would appear in the Yin soul masses.
This destructive power was really strong enough to destroy the heavens and earth.
The Yin souls naturally could not possibly sit by and watch him slaughter like this. Very soon, another Venerate Tier Yin soul arrived, and launched an attack at him.
Even if the Yin soul’s attack was weaker, it was still Venerate Tier-level after all!
Ling Han didn’t dare to face it head-on, and simply used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. ‘In any case, you can’t catch up to me.’
However, wherever he passed, it was still a feast of slaughter.

Taking advantage of being unexpected, he would still blast out Destructive Energy towards the Venerate Tier-level Yin soul, but after suffering a loss once, the Yin soul would naturally be on guard, and dodge at the first instant, causing Ling Han to be unsuccessful.
It was fine.
Ling Han chuckled. He couldn’t trick elites of Venerate Tier, but Sect Master-level Yin souls would not be able to escape even if they wanted to.
He killed to his heart’s content. No one, no, no soul could stop him.
And in the distance, the elites at the Venerate Tier and Sect Master battlefield all discovered that the pressure on them was becoming lighter.
Yi?
Yin souls were clearly still surging over like floodwaters, but strangely, the number of Sect Masters and Venerate Tiers among them had decreased considerably, greatly reducing their pressure.
What was going on?
The battle had only progressed for a day, and the Yin soul troops were about to retreat?
That’s not right.
This time, they had held back for more than half a month. That should have been a very powerful wave. Why were there signs that the battle would end after a day?

They had never imagined that someone was standing in front of them, attracting the pursuit of a great many Venerate Tier-level Yin souls, and in the case of Sect Masters, those in this direction were more or less dead.
Ling Han wasn’t nailed to a single spot. He continued to move around, circling around the Mountain Sea Heaven, trying to attract as much aggro as possible.

He was also very careful. In front of a Venerate Tier Yin soul, he could still come and go as he pleased, and even had the ability to counterattack. However, once a Yin Saint made a move, he would definitely be in trouble.
Thus, he was always prepared to face a powerful enemy with the Purple Calamity Grains.

What surprised him was that the Yin souls seemed to really be very well-behaved. No matter how many Sect Masters he had killed, and even three Venerate Tiers had been killed, no Yin Saint appeared to stop him.
After battling for three days, Ling Han received enough rewards from heaven and earth, advancing his cultivation level to peak stage six stars.
At this time, there was no way for him to retreat.
This was because he had already revealed himself. If he ran back with a large group of Yin souls, who wouldn’t recognize him?
The good days had just begun, and there was absolutely no way that Ling Han would want to destroy his disguise so quickly.
He definitely had to maintain his composure!

It didn’t matter. His cultivation level could no longer increase, but the rewards from the heaven and earth were in all aspects. Spiritual power, physique, life force, and so on could all continue to improve.
This battle lasted for a whole nine days.
The Yin souls finally announced the withdrawal of troops, and the remaining Yin souls immediately retreated back to the Mountain Sea Heaven.
Ling Han breathed a sigh of relief, and also went back.
He used the Strange Shadow Steps to hide himself. With his present strength, even Venerate Tiers might not be able to discover him.
—As the number one assassin organization, the Battle God Palace was indeed quite capable.
Ling Han did not return directly to the Purple Gauze Planet. Instead, he boarded a warship.
He wanted to break through on the warship.
Coincidentally, this was the warship that he had boarded for the first time.
The veteran soldier was slightly surprised to see Ling Han.
That was because he had not seen Ling Han board the ship.
“He should have boarded another warship,” he said to himself, and came up with an answer himself.
However, as a freelance soldier, being able to survive two battles, this ability and survivability was very good.
He walked over, sat beside Ling Han, and asked, “How should I address you, brother?”
Ling Han glanced at him, “Ji Wuming.”
This sounded like a fake name. Who would be called “Wuming”1?
However, the veteran soldier didn’t care. It didn’t matter what Ling Han’s name was. He only wanted to strike up a conversation.
“Brother Ji, to be able to survive two great battles, your survivability is truly amazing,” he complimented.
Ling Han smiled and said, “It’s nothing. As long as you hide in the back during battle, you can do the same.”
‘Holy f*ck!’
The veteran soldier instantly lost his cool, feeling incredibly awkward.
What difference was there between you and a f deserter?
And he was still so self-righteous? Was that very honourable?
The veteran soldier was rendered speechless. If this kind of person joined the official army, wouldn’t he be bringing disaster to others?
He stood up and left.
Ling Han smiled, and began to prepare to break through to the Seven Star Sect Master-level.

He had been engaged in bloody battles these past few days. Moreover, the advancement of his cultivation level had come from the rewards of heaven and earth, so it was only natural that he hadn’t suffered any side effects. After accumulating his cultivation for half a day, he was already confident that he could achieve victory.
Breaking through to seven stars!
The warship had already returned to port, and everyone disembarked one after another. However, Ling Han was still in seclusion, so he naturally did not move.

No one paid attention to him, because they had already heard from the veteran soldier that Ling Han was a coward. After entering the battlefield, he would hide at the back and take advantage of the situation.
This kind of person... who would pay attention to him?
No wonder no one had seen him during the battle.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t care. His mind was completely focused on breaking through.
Two days later, Ling Han suddenly opened his eyes.
The Dao Fruit Tree had grown by a significant amount again, and a seventh golden thread had also appeared on the fruit of cultivation.
Seven stars.
Ling Han strode forwards. He had not even disembarked from the ship, when he saw a large number of cultivators rush over, and board the ship, one after another.
Needless to say, it was definitely the Yin souls that had launched another attack.
Alright, there was no need for him to disembark. He could directly head into space.
Ling Han stood with his hands clasped behind his back, looking towards space. With his present vision, he could vaguely see the boundless number of Yin souls in space.
Just how long was this war going to continue?
Seeing his solemn expression, the people on the ship all scoffed.
‘F*ck! You’re an army deserter, so why are you pretending to be so compassionate?’

Yet Ling Han was completely unconcerned.
He squinted his eyes, feeling the arrival of the rewards from heaven and earth, circulating in his body, making him feel incredibly pleased.
‘Come, again!’
He released a battle cry, and the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was used, traversing among the Yin souls.
There was no need for him to make a move at all.
He only had to channel the Destructive Energy onto the phoenix wings, and wherever he passed, an absolute vacuum would appear in the Yin soul masses.
This destructive power was really strong enough to destroy the heavens and earth.
The Yin souls naturally could not possibly sit by and watch him slaughter like this.
Very soon, another Venerate Tier Yin soul arrived, and launched an attack at him.
Even if the Yin soul’s attack was weaker, it was still Venerate Tier-level after all!
Ling Han didn’t dare to face it head-on, and simply used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
‘In any case, you can’t catch up to me.’
However, wherever he passed, it was still a feast of slaughter.

Taking advantage of being unexpected, he would still blast out Destructive Energy towards the Venerate Tier-level Yin soul, but after suffering a loss once, the Yin soul would naturally be on guard, and dodge at the first instant, causing Ling Han to be unsuccessful.
It was fine.
Ling Han chuckled.
He couldn’t trick elites of Venerate Tier, but Sect Master-level Yin souls would not be able to escape even if they wanted to.
He killed to his heart’s content.
No one, no, no soul could stop him.
And in the distance, the elites at the Venerate Tier and Sect Master battlefield all discovered that the pressure on them was becoming lighter.
Yi?
Yin souls were clearly still surging over like floodwaters, but strangely, the number of Sect Masters and Venerate Tiers among them had decreased considerably, greatly reducing their pressure.
What was going on?
The battle had only progressed for a day, and the Yin soul troops were about to retreat?
That’s not right.
This time, they had held back for more than half a month.
That should have been a very powerful wave.
Why were there signs that the battle would end after a day?

They had never imagined that someone was standing in front of them, attracting the pursuit of a great many Venerate Tier-level Yin souls, and in the case of Sect Masters, those in this direction were more or less dead.
Ling Han wasn’t nailed to a single spot.
He continued to move around, circling around the Mountain Sea Heaven, trying to attract as much aggro as possible.
He was also very careful.
In front of a Venerate Tier Yin soul, he could still come and go as he pleased, and even had the ability to counterattack.
However, once a Yin Saint made a move, he would definitely be in trouble.
Thus, he was always prepared to face a powerful enemy with the Purple Calamity Grains.
What surprised him was that the Yin souls seemed to really be very well-behaved.
No matter how many Sect Masters he had killed, and even three Venerate Tiers had been killed, no Yin Saint appeared to stop him.
After battling for three days, Ling Han received enough rewards from heaven and earth, advancing his cultivation level to peak stage six stars.
At this time, there was no way for him to retreat.
This was because he had already revealed himself.
If he ran back with a large group of Yin souls, who wouldn’t recognize him?
The good days had just begun, and there was absolutely no way that Ling Han would want to destroy his disguise so quickly.
He definitely had to maintain his composure!
It didn’t matter.
His cultivation level could no longer increase, but the rewards from the heaven and earth were in all aspects.
Spiritual power, physique, life force, and so on could all continue to improve.
This battle lasted for a whole nine days.
The Yin souls finally announced the withdrawal of troops, and the remaining Yin souls immediately retreated back to the Mountain Sea Heaven.
Ling Han breathed a sigh of relief, and also went back.
He used the Strange Shadow Steps to hide himself.
With his present strength, even Venerate Tiers might not be able to discover him.
—As the number one assassin organization, the Battle God Palace was indeed quite capable.
Ling Han did not return directly to the Purple Gauze Planet.
Instead, he boarded a warship.
He wanted to break through on the warship.
Coincidentally, this was the warship that he had boarded for the first time.
The veteran soldier was slightly surprised to see Ling Han.
That was because he had not seen Ling Han board the ship.
“He should have boarded another warship,” he said to himself, and came up with an answer himself.
However, as a freelance soldier, being able to survive two battles, this ability and survivability was very good.
He walked over, sat beside Ling Han, and asked, “How should I address you, brother?”
Ling Han glanced at him, “Ji Wuming.”
This sounded like a fake name.
Who would be called “Wuming”1?
However, the veteran soldier didn’t care.
It didn’t matter what Ling Han’s name was.
He only wanted to strike up a conversation.
“Brother Ji, to be able to survive two great battles, your survivability is truly amazing,” he complimented.
Ling Han smiled and said, “It’s nothing.
As long as you hide in the back during battle, you can do the same.”
‘Holy f*ck!’
The veteran soldier instantly lost his cool, feeling incredibly awkward.
What difference was there between you and a f deserter?
And he was still so self-righteous?
Was that very honourable?
The veteran soldier was rendered speechless.
If this kind of person joined the official army, wouldn’t he be bringing disaster to others?
He stood up and left.
Ling Han smiled, and began to prepare to break through to the Seven Star Sect Master-level.
He had been engaged in bloody battles these past few days.
Moreover, the advancement of his cultivation level had come from the rewards of heaven and earth, so it was only natural that he hadn’t suffered any side effects.
After accumulating his cultivation for half a day, he was already confident that he could achieve victory.
Breaking through to seven stars!
The warship had already returned to port, and everyone disembarked one after another.
However, Ling Han was still in seclusion, so he naturally did not move.
No one paid attention to him, because they had already heard from the veteran soldier that Ling Han was a coward.
After entering the battlefield, he would hide at the back and take advantage of the situation.
This kind of person... who would pay attention to him?
No wonder no one had seen him during the battle.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t care.
His mind was completely focused on breaking through.
Two days later, Ling Han suddenly opened his eyes.
The Dao Fruit Tree had grown by a significant amount again, and a seventh golden thread had also appeared on the fruit of cultivation.
Seven stars.
Ling Han strode forwards.
He had not even disembarked from the ship, when he saw a large number of cultivators rush over, and board the ship, one after another.
Needless to say, it was definitely the Yin souls that had launched another attack.
Alright, there was no need for him to disembark.
He could directly head into space.
Ling Han stood with his hands clasped behind his back, looking towards space.
With his present vision, he could vaguely see the boundless number of Yin souls in space.
Just how long was this war going to continue?
Seeing his solemn expression, the people on the ship all scoffed.
‘F*ck!
You’re an army deserter, so why are you pretending to be so compassionate?’

chapters.title: Chapter 4531: Robbery
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The warship arrived; charge!
Ling Han strolled slowly. After reaching seven stars, he could fire out 20 flashes of Regulations with a single strike.
What kind of concept was this?

In the past, on the Imperial Path, the greatest test for a Sect Master was only to deliver twenty flashes of Regulations with a single strike, and this was still the result of a Venerate Tier suppressing his cultivation level.

Judging by the situation that Ling Han had seen, to say nothing of Golden Generation, even such ancient prodigies like Yang Yihuan and Di Wuji could only fire eighteen Regulations with a single strike, at most.
Yet when Ling Han was now a Seven Star Sect Master, he had already reached the limit of twenty flashes of Regulations.
Obviously, he would definitely be able to break this limit.
Among those on the level of Sect Master, there was really no one that was his match.
He still charged to the front lines, harvesting Yin souls, and obtaining the rewards of heaven and earth, rapidly increasing his cultivation level.
This time, he again attracted the pursuit of a great many Venerate Tier elites.

However, even if he had increased his cultivation level by a minor level, there was no qualitative change in his battle prowess. It was impossible for him to directly possess strength that could match Venerate Tier-level. Thus, he could only focus on roaming around and fighting, finding opportunities to kill enemies.
This battle lasted for a whole ten days.
Ling Han could pat his chest with certainty and guarantee that there was definitely no one who had gained more than he had.
Whether it was the number or quality of Yin souls he had killed, he was definitely the undisputed number one.
It could not be helped. He had Destructive Energy, which was a super weapon against Yin souls.
As for Ding Shu and the others?

Indeed, they also possessed Destructive Energy, but firstly, it wasn’t complete, and secondly, they didn’t have a life-saving trump card like Ling Han, who dared to venture deep into this area to battle.
Thus, it was definitely Ling Han who was the most awesome.
He had no intention of publicizing it at all, and was silently making a fortune.
The battle ended, and Ling Han returned to the warship, sitting quietly.

He hadn’t contacted the large black dog and the others for so many days, and he was sure that the empress and the others had already arrived. Ling Han wasn’t in a hurry. As long as these people weren’t aggressive, they could completely handle the battle with ease.
It should be known that the seven babies had been sent by him to protect the empress, Hu Niu, Ling Xi, and the others, so how could anything possibly happen?
Seeing Ling Han come back alive again, the people on the ship all thought him shameless.
After wave after wave of battle, the “veterans” were further reduced in number. With every battle, a large number of people would die in battle, so how could the people on this ship be an exception?
Precisely because of this, they looked down even more on Ling Han.
Everyone else was fighting and bathing in blood, but what about Ling Han?
He hid at the back and was a shameful deserter.

If it was not for the fact that everyone was completely exhausted after the battle, and only wanted to have a good rest, it was probable that some impatient and hot-tempered people would throw Ling Han off the ship.

Half a day later, the warship returned to the Purple Gauze Planet. Everyone disembarked one after another, looking for a place to rest. Additionally, some people had also accumulated enough battle merits, and could redeem treasures from the Imperial Clans.
Ling Han took a look. His merit points had reached 20 million.
He didn’t know how many merits others had, but based on the number of Yin souls he had killed and their high level, this number should be extremely shocking.
Let’s go and take a look at the Imperial Clans and see if I can redeem a few portions of Celestial Qi.
Though his advancement was fast enough, he did not mind at all if it could be faster. Furthermore, if he had no use for it, couldn’t he give it to the empress and the others?
“Hey, stop right there!” Ling Han had not taken a few steps, when he was stopped.
He looked over, and there were a total of three people blocking his way. All of them had their chests bared, looking like hooligans.
Yi, there were actually ruffians here?
Seeing that Ling Han had stopped, one of them said, “Hand over the scoring device.”

The so-called scoring device was a small item used to tally battle merits. The Imperial Clans did not give it this name. It was unknown who had called it that first, and when it spread out, it became publicly acknowledged.
Realization dawned on Ling Han. This scoring device was not tied to the identity of the wearer. Thus, others could completely take it, and use the battle merits inside to redeem treasures.
Hehe, you guys have also progressed with the times, huh? The transition is quite fast.
Ling Han smiled, and said, “All right.”
He was extremely cooperative, and handed over the scoring device.
The three of them faltered upon hearing this. So smoothly?
“This guy is a deserter, so it’s normal for him to be afraid.”
“Moreover, he definitely doesn’t have many battle merits, so he doesn’t care.”
“Pei, how unlucky.”

The three of them shook their heads. However, Ling Han had already handed over the scoring device, so they were no longer interested in making things difficult for Ling Han. They turned around and left.
Ling Han didn’t stop them, and he simply counted in his mind. One, two, three, four...
In the distance.
“Let’s see how many points that brat has,” one of them said. They had snatched something, so they should at least see how much it was worth.
The person holding the scoring device nodded. No matter how small the ant’s leg was, it was still meat.
Let’s take a look.
He picked up the scoring device and looked at it. Involuntarily, he couldn’t help but gape, “F*ck, my eyes must have blurred.”
He kneaded it a little, then looked again.
Nothing had changed.
Twenty, over twenty million!
“Hey, what nonsense are you spouting?” the person beside him asked. Then, he snatched the scoring device over, and his eyes swept over it. “F***!”
The third person wore a dumbfounded expression. ‘What’s wrong with you people?’
It was just a scoring device; was there any need for you guys to make such a big fuss?
“What are you two playing at? I’m warning you, don’t team up to trick me.” He also grabbed the scoring device. With a look, the corners of his mouth instantly twitched madly.
“We—”
“We’re rich!”
In an instant, the three of them exclaimed at the same time, stomping their feet in excitement.
More than 20 million battle merit points, this was a huge sum that drove them crazy.
F***, in future, I’ll buy two alchemical pills at a time, eat one, and throw the other one away!
The same was true for Spirit Tools. He could hold one in his hand, and another at his waist.
For no other reason than the fact that he was rich!
After a moment of excitement, one of them suddenly shivered, “No, we have to return the scoring device.”
“Are you crazy?” the other two shouted at the same time, looking at him like he was an idiot.
Over 20 million battle merit points!
That person forcefully suppressed his greed, and analyzed, “Just think, what kind of strength would be needed to be able to obtain more than 20 million points?”
This... the remaining two immediately fell silent, and then looked terrified.
That’s right. It was not that they had not been on the battlefield before, but after three battles, the battle merits that each person had obtained was only slightly over a hundred points.
From this, it could be seen just how many Yin souls had to be killed to achieve a battle merit of more than 20 million, and just how strong a Yin soul would have to be to be able to accomplish that?
This kind of person... must be a supreme elite, whose abilities far surpassed them.
“Had he just found this?” one of them whispered. “If he really was that powerful, why did he give us the scoring device?”
“How could it have been picked up?” The first person shook his head, “For such an elite, how could he lose something?”
True.
“It should be that guy that is deliberately testing us. If we are greedy...”
The three of them stopped talking, their eyes filled with fear.
“Let’s go back.”
“M-hm.”
The three of them obediently returned, and saw that Ling Han was still standing where he had been, a faint smile on his face.

This caused their hearts to clench, and they increasingly felt that they had done the right thing. Otherwise, if they fled with the scoring device, they would probably not be far from becoming corpses.

chapters.title: Chapter 4532: Storm of Redemption
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Please, please spare us, Lord.” The three people respectfully returned the scoring device to Ling Han.
Ling Han caught it, and smiled faintly, “What is it? Have you suddenly turned over a new leaf?”
He wasn’t afraid of these three people fleeing at all. With how powerful his divine sense was, where could these three people run to? Moreover, didn’t he still have control of the ley lines?
“It’s all because of your brilliance, Milord!” A large man said with slight excitement, “Under Milord’s brilliance, we finally repented, and thought that our actions were too inappropriate!”
‘F*ck! You’re far too shameless!’
His two companions gritted their teeth. They had not thought that the other would say such mushy words. This made them want to throw up.
Ling Han smiled brightly, and said, “Flattery will never be denied. Come, flatter me more. Who knows, if I’m in a good mood, I won’t call you guys to account.”
“Lord, you are like the red sun in the skies, shining wherever you are!”
“Your divine might is invincible, and wherever you go, Yin souls will all be turned into ashes!”
“With your participation, this battle will definitely be recorded in history, and shine for all eternity!”

The three of them hurriedly began to curry favor. In any case, they would do whatever was mushy. If they spoke too much, they would naturally have immunity, and would not keep thinking of throwing up.
Ling Han smiled sheepishly, and interrupted them, asking, “What are your names?”
“Liu Xing.”
“Feng Xingwang.”
“Gu Taihua.”

The three of them hurriedly announced their names, and at the same time, there was also some hope in their eyes. If they could get Ling Han’s support, would they be able to do as they liked in the future?
“The next time the Yin souls invade, come find me at the warship number 754,” Ling Han said, then strode off.
“Thank you, Lord!” Liu Xing and the others were overjoyed. They had really gotten a powerful backer.
Ling Han walked all the way, and soon arrived at the treasure exchange office set up by the Imperial Clan Alliance.

For the convenience of the cultivators at Purple Gauze Planet, there were many such exchange places. However, for first-timers, they could only choose what they wanted to trade for first. Then, the staff here would deduct your battle merits, and make you wait for a few days. Then, they would bring the redemption items from the headquarters, and hand them over to you.
Thus, this redemption office was not very big. In fact, there were only two staff members, one old and one young, and they were both men.
Seeing that the young man was busy, Ling Han found the old man. From the looks of it, this old man should be the person-in-charge of this place, and the young man was only his subordinate.

“If you want to redeem something, make your choice first. Once you’ve made your decision, hand the scoring device over to me.” Without waiting for Ling Han to speak, the old geezer directly handed over a small ball, appearing to have no patience.

Ling Han picked up the small ball and probed it with his divine sense. Instantly, images spread out in his mind. They were all introductions to various natural treasures, God Tools, alchemical pills, and so on. At the bottom was the merit points that were needed to redeem them.
He was only interested in Celestial Qi, and kept searching. Not long after, he discovered a page of Celestial Qi.
From One Star to Eight Stars, but One Star Celestial Qi only needed a million battle merits, while Eight Star Celestial Qi needed as much as fifteen million.

Theoretically speaking, if Celestial Qi was one level higher in quality, its value was more than ten times higher. Thus, if One Star Celestial Qi could be redeemed with a million battle merits, then in conversion, the redemption value of Eight Star Celestial Qi would be overwhelmingly high.
This was clearly unsuitable.

No matter how precious Eight Star Celestial Qi was, it should still be something that could be touched, right? However, one couldn’t reduce the value of One Star Celestial Qi to a level that everyone could redeem according to the ratio. In that case, even the Imperial Clans would become poor.
Thus, they could only set a high price.

1,000,000 merit points was something that most people could only see but not reach. Only a very small number of elites could achieve this, and 10,000,000 merit points and above was enough to drive anyone to despair.
Aside from Imperial Sons, Origin, Ding Shu, and the others, how many other people could reach this level?
If it was them, wasn’t this what they should deserve in the first place?
Thus, the Imperial Clans were actually very thorough in their considerations. It seemed fair, but in truth, it was not fair at all.
However, they had overlooked Ling Han.
Ling Han found this strange. Why didn’t he see Yang Yihuan, Feng Miaoling, or He Luo?
With their strength, they could not only kill Yin souls to increase their cultivation level, they could also earn some merit points to redeem treasures, so why didn’t they?
He thought to himself, but did not hesitate. Instead, he placed the ball and the scoring device on the table, and said, “I have decided. I will choose Eight Star Celestial Qi!”
Pu!
The old man spluttered, his face filled with shock.
You’ve probably lost your mind, haven’t you?
Eight Stars Celestial Qi! How many battle merits did it need to be redeemed?
15 million!

Even if you had been killing Yin souls since birth, and continued to do so until you died, being able to accumulate a million battle merits was already very impressive, and you actually dared to ask to redeem Eight Stars Celestial Qi that was worth 15 million merit points?
Hehe, was he an idiot?
“Shoo, shoo, shoo!” The old man waved his hand, his expression extremely unfriendly. He thought that Ling Han had either gone mad, or was deliberately toying with him.

Ling Han frowned, and said, “According to the rules, I’ll choose the items to redeem, and you’ll be responsible for deducting the battle merits. Also, to tell me when I’ll come and retrieve the items. Why don’t you follow the procedure?”

“Hahaha!” The old man couldn’t help but laugh loudly, but there was no hint of a smile on his face, “Brat, are you really going to make a big fuss out of this? Then I might as well tell you. To dare to play around with a member of the Imperial Clan, that is a crime punishable by death!”
There were still some other cultivators at this redemption point. When they saw the two of them suddenly start arguing, they all cast their gazes over.
The old man gave a simple explanation, which immediately caused everyone to laugh loudly.
Who didn’t know the price of Eight Star Celestial Qi?
Those were some of the most expensive items among the redeemable items, and could instill fear in others just by looking at them.
If it was a Venerate Tier elite, or a Golden Generation elite that had come to redeem it, then everyone could still accept it, but you, an average-looking brat, hoho, this was practically a joke.
“Have you gone mad?”
“Dreaming about being a peerless elite for too long, he even deceived himself!”
“Brat, your mother told you to come out to help. After the fight, you should go home.”
A considerable number of people began to mock him, feeling that an extreme character like Ling Han was really rare.
Ling Han also smiled, and said, “Hurry up, deduct the battle merits. I’m still busy!”
Pu, this naturally drew ridicule from the masses again. Tsk, tsk, tsk. This guy actually made a joke sound so serious; it was indescribably funny.
“All right, I would really like to see what kind of ‘shocking’ battle merits you have obtained.” The old man humphed, and picked up the scoring device from the table.
He emphasized the word “shocking”, which naturally caused a great many people to roar with laughter.
Some people looked at Ling Han with eyes filled with pity. Sigh, what was the point? Running in front of so many people and embarrassing yourself; does your mother know about this?
“F***!” The old man picked up the scoring device, and with a sweep of his divine sense, he couldn’t help but curse. His face was filled with shock.
‘Holy f*ck!’

Ling Han caught it, and smiled faintly, “What is it?
Have you suddenly turned over a new leaf?”
He wasn’t afraid of these three people fleeing at all.
With how powerful his divine sense was, where could these three people run to?
Moreover, didn’t he still have control of the ley lines?
“It’s all because of your brilliance, Milord!” A large man said with slight excitement, “Under Milord’s brilliance, we finally repented, and thought that our actions were too inappropriate!”
‘F*ck!
You’re far too shameless!’
His two companions gritted their teeth.
They had not thought that the other would say such mushy words.
This made them want to throw up.
Ling Han smiled brightly, and said, “Flattery will never be denied.
Come, flatter me more.
Who knows, if I’m in a good mood, I won’t call you guys to account.”
“Lord, you are like the red sun in the skies, shining wherever you are!”
“Your divine might is invincible, and wherever you go, Yin souls will all be turned into ashes!”
“With your participation, this battle will definitely be recorded in history, and shine for all eternity!”
The three of them hurriedly began to curry favor.
In any case, they would do whatever was mushy.
If they spoke too much, they would naturally have immunity, and would not keep thinking of throwing up.
Ling Han smiled sheepishly, and interrupted them, asking, “What are your names?”
“Liu Xing.”
“Feng Xingwang.”
“Gu Taihua.”
The three of them hurriedly announced their names, and at the same time, there was also some hope in their eyes.
If they could get Ling Han’s support, would they be able to do as they liked in the future?
“The next time the Yin souls invade, come find me at the warship number 754,” Ling Han said, then strode off.
“Thank you, Lord!” Liu Xing and the others were overjoyed.
They had really gotten a powerful backer.
Ling Han walked all the way, and soon arrived at the treasure exchange office set up by the Imperial Clan Alliance.
For the convenience of the cultivators at Purple Gauze Planet, there were many such exchange places.
However, for first-timers, they could only choose what they wanted to trade for first.
Then, the staff here would deduct your battle merits, and make you wait for a few days.
Then, they would bring the redemption items from the headquarters, and hand them over to you.
Thus, this redemption office was not very big.
In fact, there were only two staff members, one old and one young, and they were both men.
Seeing that the young man was busy, Ling Han found the old man.
From the looks of it, this old man should be the person-in-charge of this place, and the young man was only his subordinate.
“If you want to redeem something, make your choice first.
Once you’ve made your decision, hand the scoring device over to me.” Without waiting for Ling Han to speak, the old geezer directly handed over a small ball, appearing to have no patience.
Ling Han picked up the small ball and probed it with his divine sense.
Instantly, images spread out in his mind.
They were all introductions to various natural treasures, God Tools, alchemical pills, and so on.
At the bottom was the merit points that were needed to redeem them.
He was only interested in Celestial Qi, and kept searching.
Not long after, he discovered a page of Celestial Qi.
From One Star to Eight Stars, but One Star Celestial Qi only needed a million battle merits, while Eight Star Celestial Qi needed as much as fifteen million.
Theoretically speaking, if Celestial Qi was one level higher in quality, its value was more than ten times higher.
Thus, if One Star Celestial Qi could be redeemed with a million battle merits, then in conversion, the redemption value of Eight Star Celestial Qi would be overwhelmingly high.
This was clearly unsuitable.
No matter how precious Eight Star Celestial Qi was, it should still be something that could be touched, right?
However, one couldn’t reduce the value of One Star Celestial Qi to a level that everyone could redeem according to the ratio.
In that case, even the Imperial Clans would become poor.
Thus, they could only set a high price.
1,000,000 merit points was something that most people could only see but not reach.
Only a very small number of elites could achieve this, and 10,000,000 merit points and above was enough to drive anyone to despair.
Aside from Imperial Sons, Origin, Ding Shu, and the others, how many other people could reach this level?
If it was them, wasn’t this what they should deserve in the first place?
Thus, the Imperial Clans were actually very thorough in their considerations.
It seemed fair, but in truth, it was not fair at all.
However, they had overlooked Ling Han.
Ling Han found this strange.
Why didn’t he see Yang Yihuan, Feng Miaoling, or He Luo?
With their strength, they could not only kill Yin souls to increase their cultivation level, they could also earn some merit points to redeem treasures, so why didn’t they?
He thought to himself, but did not hesitate.
Instead, he placed the ball and the scoring device on the table, and said, “I have decided.
I will choose Eight Star Celestial Qi!”
Pu!
The old man spluttered, his face filled with shock.
You’ve probably lost your mind, haven’t you?
Eight Stars Celestial Qi!
How many battle merits did it need to be redeemed?
15 million!

Even if you had been killing Yin souls since birth, and continued to do so until you died, being able to accumulate a million battle merits was already very impressive, and you actually dared to ask to redeem Eight Stars Celestial Qi that was worth 15 million merit points?
Hehe, was he an idiot?
“Shoo, shoo, shoo!” The old man waved his hand, his expression extremely unfriendly.
He thought that Ling Han had either gone mad, or was deliberately toying with him.
Ling Han frowned, and said, “According to the rules, I’ll choose the items to redeem, and you’ll be responsible for deducting the battle merits.
Also, to tell me when I’ll come and retrieve the items.
Why don’t you follow the procedure?”
“Hahaha!” The old man couldn’t help but laugh loudly, but there was no hint of a smile on his face, “Brat, are you really going to make a big fuss out of this?
Then I might as well tell you.
To dare to play around with a member of the Imperial Clan, that is a crime punishable by death!”
There were still some other cultivators at this redemption point.
When they saw the two of them suddenly start arguing, they all cast their gazes over.
The old man gave a simple explanation, which immediately caused everyone to laugh loudly.
Who didn’t know the price of Eight Star Celestial Qi?
Those were some of the most expensive items among the redeemable items, and could instill fear in others just by looking at them.
If it was a Venerate Tier elite, or a Golden Generation elite that had come to redeem it, then everyone could still accept it, but you, an average-looking brat, hoho, this was practically a joke.
“Have you gone mad?”
“Dreaming about being a peerless elite for too long, he even deceived himself!”
“Brat, your mother told you to come out to help.
After the fight, you should go home.”
A considerable number of people began to mock him, feeling that an extreme character like Ling Han was really rare.

Some people looked at Ling Han with eyes filled with pity.

Running in front of so many people and embarrassing yourself; does your mother know about this?

His face was filled with shock.
