chapters.title: Chapter 4533: Beat Him to Death
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
More than twenty million battle merit points?
F***, who could believe this!
The old man was immediately dumbfounded, and the expression on his face seemed to have frozen.
Yi, what was going on here?
Everyone was curious. You only took a look at the scoring device; how did you become like this?
Could it be that it was poisonous?
Otherwise, no matter how low his battle merits were, there was no need for him to have such an expression, right?
Er, heaven-defyingly high battle merits?
Hey, hey, hey, don’t live in a dream. How could there be such a possibility?
“What are you standing around for?” Ling Han knocked on the table, his expression impatient.
Only now did the old man come back to his senses, and looked at Ling Han with a confused and uncertain gaze.
More than 20 million battle merit points, how did this guy get it?
He was certain that even if it was the Golden Generation, their current battle merit value would only be over a million, at most. Compared to Ling Han, this was only a fraction.
Thus, how could he believe that a nameless nobody had actually defeated the Golden Generation? Moreover, it was a crushing defeat!
However, this was indeed a scoring device issued by the Imperial Clan Alliance.
What method had this brat used to change his score?
Or could it be that this brat’s luck was heaven-defying, and he had picked up the scoring device that had been left behind by a supreme elite?
As for how the latter could have happened, he did not know, nor did he care. It was enough for him to know that there was just a sliver of a chance.
In short, these 20 million battle merits definitely couldn’t have been earned by Ling Han.
He was absolutely certain of this.
A smile appeared on his face. It was time for him to make a fortune!

This smile was immediately withdrawn. The old man’s expression immediately became stern, and he shouted loudly, “Good one, brat, you actually dare to steal someone else’s scoring device. Do you know that this is a serious crime!”
‘What? Stolen?’
Everyone exchanged looks, and came to a sudden realization.
The score on the scoring device was definitely very high, and did not match Ling Han’s strength at all. That was why the old man was first stunned.
Ling Han was well aware of this, and he said calmly, “Next, are you going to detain my scoring device, and spare me this once on account of my first offense?”
“Spare you? Hehe, in your dreams!” the old man balefully said.

His name was Pei Kuo, and he belonged to the Crimson Rainbow Imperial Clan. Of course, he was only a peripheral character in the clan. Otherwise, he would not have fallen to the level of guarding the exchange point.
However, if he took advantage of others, who would dare to say anything against him?
More than 20 million battle merit points could be exchanged for a lot of treasures for him.
Ling Han couldn’t help but chuckle, saying, “You’re even more black-hearted than I expected.”
Not only did he want to snatch his battle merits, he even wanted to punish him.
Hehe, did he think he was an easy target to bully?

“Guards! Guards!” Pei Kuo shouted loudly. Though he was also a True Self Tier, as a dignified member of the Imperial Clan, how could he possibly make a move personally? This would be too demeaning of his status.
Very quickly, two guards came in. They were both in the Core Formation Tier.
“Capture this evil criminal and send him to the Public Order Office!” Pei Kuo pointed at Ling Han.
The two guards immediately raised the spears in their hands and aimed them at Ling Han.

As guards, they were treated fairly well. These two spears were both Spirit Tools, and under their control, the tip of the spears glowed. If Ling Han showed the slightest sign of resistance, they would attack him without mercy.
Ling Han shook his head, and asked with a smile, “Why am I not the slightest bit surprised?”
“Obediently follow us, so you won’t suffer. In fact, you might even lose your life,” a guard said.
Ling Han moved, grabbing out at that guard.
“How dare you!” The two guards activated their Spirit Tool without hesitation. Xiu, xiu, two streaks of green light immediately shot towards Ling Han.

However, when the green light reached Ling Han, it automatically crumbled, and Ling Han had already grabbed one of the guards. With a toss, he threw that person out. He did the same thing, and threw out the other guard.
—These two guards were lying outside just like that, unable to get up again.
Hiss!

Everyone was stunned. At first, they had thought that Ling Han, who was average-looking, should be a nameless nobody. No one had thought that his strength would actually be so strong, capable of toying with Core Formation Tiers in the palm of his hand.
Was this a high-level Core Formation Tier, or... a True Self Tier?
If he were a True Self Tier, he would already be qualified to be called an elite.
Pei Kuo was also slightly surprised. He had not thought that Ling Han’s strength was far beyond his expectations.
A thought flashed through his mind. Could it be that this battle merit was really obtained by Ling Han?
However, it was only an instant, and he immediately shook his head.
Impossible!
Even the Golden Generation had only obtained over a million battle merits. What right did Ling Han have to surpass the Golden Generation?
Was there any law? Was there any logic?
“Humph, no wonder he dared to be so arrogant. As it turned out, he still has some abilities!” Pei Kuo sneered, and stretched out a hand to grab Ling Han.
He was slightly irritated. He was a member of the Imperial Clan, and to have him lower himself to personally make a move on him was practically demeaning him!
Pa!
A crisp sound rang out, and Pei Kuo’s face had already sustained a solid slap.
Yi, what was going on?
Everyone was a little stunned. When had Ling Han made his move?
Who had seen it?
Pei Kuo himself was also very confused. He looked at Ling Han, then flew into a humiliated rage, and once again launched an attack.
Pa, another slap, crisp and loud.
F***, another slap?

Everyone turned to look at Pei Kuo, and saw that both his cheeks were very swollen. There was a hint of purple in the green, and a hint of black in the purple. It was as if they were filled with congested blood, and could spurt out at any moment.
When they looked at Ling Han again, their gazes were different.
Two consecutive slaps meant that Ling Han’s strength was far superior to Pei Kuo’s.
But it should be known that Pei Kuo was a True Self Tier!
To be able to toy with the True Self Tier in the palm of his hand, what kind of cultivation level would that have to be?
“You, how dare you!” Pei Kuo was about to cry. He was a member of the Imperial Clan, and he was already so old, yet he had been slapped in public. How could he accept this?

“Heh, you know how to feel wronged?” Ling Han said with a cold chuckle. Pa, pa, pa! He continued to slap, saying, “Then why didn’t you consider the consequences when you tried to swindle me and even send me to prison?”
“Only you can harm others, and others are not allowed to resist?”
“What kind of logic is that?”
Pa, pa, pa! Ling Han’s hands didn’t stop, and they continued to deliver slaps.

Pei Kuo was slapped so hard that blood was spurting from his mouth and nose. Soon, his teeth were also sent flying, and his whole face was even smashed, revealing ghastly white eyes, his two eyeballs practically popping out.
How tragic!
Yet Ling Han did not feel the slightest bit of sympathy. F***, if it was not for the fact that he was very strong, wouldn’t he really have been scammed, and suffer injustice for nothing?
Who would pity him?
He had brought this upon himself!
“Since you’re so shameless and want no face, I’ll help you slap it off!”
Everyone inhaled sharply. Things had progressed to this point, so how could they not understand?

—Pei Kuo probably saw that Ling Han’s merit points were high, and misunderstood that he did not have much strength or background, so he wanted to rob him of his merit points. In the end, he just had to kick an iron plate.
Thinking of this, everyone felt like they had a common enemy, because this kind of thing could possibly happen to them as well.
“Beat him to death!” It was unknown who called out. This drew the resonance of a great many people, and they all called out.
C

chapters.title: Chapter 4534: Take them all down
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Right at this moment, someone from the Imperial Clan arrived.
When a member of the Pei Clan had met with an accident, it was naturally the Crimson Rainbow Imperial Clan that had come.
“Stop!” The visitor was a middle-aged man, but his abilities were much, much stronger than Pei Kuo’s.
He was a Spiritual Transformation Tier.
That was enough.
Yet Ling Han acted as if he had not heard anything, and continued to thrash him madly.
“I told you to stop!” The middle-aged man felt slightly embarrassed.
He was a Spirit Transformation True Lord. Furthermore, he came from the Imperial Clan, which had a natural glory. Even if he went to the Holy Land, who wouldn’t treat him as an esteemed guest?
Now, he had already spoken, but there was actually someone who would not listen?
Ling Han still ignored him, and continued to slap him.
The middle-aged man couldn’t hold himself back any longer. He immediately lashed out, grabbing at Ling Han.
Pa, a crisp sound rang out. It was obviously that familiar sound of a slap to the face.
However, this time, Ling Han did not slap Pei Kuo, but rather the middle-aged man.
What was going on?

Everyone was dumbfounded. If it was Pei Kuo, he was ultimately only a True Self Tier. Though he could be called an elite, above the True Self Tier, there were still a considerable number of cultivation levels.
However, a Spirit Transformation True Lord was also sent flying by a slap from Ling Han?
This!

There were indeed three levels above the Spirit Transformation Tier—Sect Master, Venerate Tier, and Saint Tier—and there was no need to count the Great Emperor Tier. Only one would appear in a single era, so there was no point to keep track of it.
So, did Ling Han belong to the cultivation level of Sect Master, Venerate or Saint?
How was this possible!
He was too young, and furthermore, his appearance was average. How could there be such a prodigy?
However, facts speak louder than words. Ling Han was now working left and right, using his left hand to slap Pei Kuo, while his right hand was slapping the middle-aged man, both without delay.
This time, the Pei Clan was completely humiliated.
After another while, someone from the Pei Clan finally came.
This time, it was naturally a Sect Master. He was a middle-aged man who looked to be in his fifties. He was wearing a white robe, and every single hair on his head was combed neatly.
“Pei Guangchen!” someone said in a low voice, revealing the identity of this person.
“Hiss, more than ten thousand years ago, that Pei Guangchen that stirred up the winds and clouds?”

“I remember that there was a person called Pei Guangchen who challenged the Dao Child of the various great Holy Lands in a row, and never lost. Afterwards, he was hunted down by the Venerates of the seven Holy Lands, and only then did his identity as an Imperial Clan elite was finally exposed.”
“The Imperial Son of the previous generation of the Pei Clan!”
Everyone whispered among themselves, all of them looking fearful.
The Imperial Clan was already frightening enough, what more when it was the Imperial Son!
Meanwhile, Ling Han was astonished. An Imperial Son, who was already so old, was only at the level of the Sect Master?
He immediately laughed in spite of himself. If every Imperial Son could charge up to Venerate Tier or even Saint Tier, then the strength of the Imperial Clan would really be too exaggerated.
In truth, it was also very difficult for the Imperial Son to reach Saint Tier. This would need power that was accumulated for a great many generations.

Otherwise, since Saints could live for millions of years, and generation after generation of Imperial Sons continued to become Saints, just how astonishing would the number of Saints in every Imperial Clan be?
Sect Maste-level was indeed a little weak, but it was acceptable.
Pei Guangchen looked coldly at Ling Han, his eyes filled with killing intent.
To humiliate the Imperial Clan like this, no matter what, Ling Han’s only fate was death.
Furthermore, the image of the Imperial Clan could not be tarnished, what more when if this matter spread out, it would affect the image of the whole Imperial Clan Alliance.
Who else would fight with all their might?
You see, not only would his battle merits be coveted by others, he himself would also be beaten and killed.
Thus, he definitely had to push all the blame onto Ling Han, insisting that he was a petty thief.

“Kneel,” Pei Guangchen said coldly. As the previous Imperial Son, he was naturally extraordinary. He had long since cultivated to the level of nine stars, and his battle prowess far surpassed the level of Dao Child.
He was filled with confidence. If he made a move, Ling Han would definitely have to bow down to him.

Ling Han smiled calmly, “Is this the attitude of your Pei Clan, or the Imperial Clan Alliance? Your people want to steal my battle merits, and when they did not succeed, you all jump out in waves to help him?”
“Haha, this kind of behavior is really shameless!”
“If you can’t bear to part with the treasures, then don’t hypocritically come up with some scoring device!”
“How embarrassing!”
When these words fell, a great many people nodded. At first, they had not known the truth, but now, they were all on Ling Han’s side.
They felt as if they were experiencing it themselves!
Some people didn’t mind making things worse, and turned on the connection device, broadcasting live on Galaxy Network.
All of a sudden, the number of people paying attention skyrocketed.
A great many people were protesting online, expressing their support for Ling Han.
Who wouldn’t be furious if this happened to them?
Of course, there were also some people who were curious about Ling Han’s identity. Who was this guy? He clearly looked ordinary, but his abilities were quite strong.
“No matter how strong he is, there is no way he could match Imperial Son.”

“Though Pei Guangchen’s talent is inferior to those Imperial Sons of the present generation, he must have cultivated to nine stars long ago. Dao Child of the same cultivation level is far from being his match, so how is that person supposed to block him?”
“Using his life?”
Everyone thought that Ling Han’s path of resistance would end here.
The higher-ups of the Imperial Clans were also paying attention to this matter. They were very angry. Their subordinate had actually done such an unreliable thing!
But now that things had come to this, what else could they do?

“Guangchen, execute that person immediately. Don’t let him make any more comments. At present, the entire Galaxy Network is paying attention to this matter!” A mighty figure communicated a command to Pei Guangchen through divine sense.
Pei Guangchen nodded, and showed a cold smirk, “Making an enemy of the Imperial Clan, I really don’t know where you get your courage from?”
He moved, launching an attack at Ling Han.
Pa!
It was only a single punch, and Pei Guangchen immediately sprawled out on the ground, his limbs twitching continuously.
“If you’re strong, you’re naturally courageous,” Ling Han said calmly. His voice was filled with arrogance.
However, he had displayed absolute strength, so who would care if he was showing off or not?
There was only endless admiration.
Heavens, even the Imperial Son of the previous era had been knocked down with a single punch. These abilities were nature-defying!
Ling Han stretched out a foot and placed it on Pei Guangchen’s head. He asked calmly, “Who are you going to send next? Venerate Tier?”
No one responded.
Now, the matter was getting bigger and bigger, and the whole universe was paying attention. If they still sent out a Venerate Tier, then the whole world would really be in chaos.

If Pei Guangchen could kill Ling Han, then Ling Han’s strength would only be so-so. How could he possibly obtain a battle merit that would make others dumbfounded? However, even Pei Guangchen was easily defeated, and Ling Han’s strength had been completely proven.
This kind of strength was still not worthy of such a high battle merit?
You Imperial Clans are really too much of a bully, isn’t it?

At present, everyone in the world was on his side, and the Imperial Clans would also have to be wary of the mouths of the masses.
After all, Saints needed the power of belief. If they broke their word, who would still believe in the Imperial Clans?
The Venerate Tier from the Pei Clan had also brought over a portion of Eight Star Celestial Qi, which he personally handed over to Ling Han. He didn’t need to wait for a few more days.
When he came into contact with Ling Han, he also used his divine sense to scan Ling Han.

chapters.title: Chapter 4535: Defense
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han was far too powerful, far too powerful.
Thus, the Venerate of the Pei Clan was naturally suspicious of his identity, and thought that it was possible that it was Ling Han in disguise.
If they confirmed that it was Ling Han, they would move quietly, kidnap Ling Han, and search for all the secrets on him before killing him to prevent him from leaking the secret.
However, with the help of the Soul Forming Technique, the Venerate couldn’t see anything off at all.
Ling Han took the Celestial Qi and immediately left.
In the meantime, he changed his appearance three times, moving with Strange Shadow Steps and Star Steps, and finally, he even used the Void Beast hide to conceal himself.
In this way, if he would still be targeted by others, then he would have no choice but to accept it.

—In public, it was impossible for anything to happen to him, because if anything happened, it would naturally be blamed on the Imperial Clans. For the present war situation, this would be too great a blow to their morale.
“Here’s another Nine Stars Celestial Qi.” Ling Han smiled. This should be able to help Brother Monkey create the strongest pillars of Fourth Extreme.
Of course, to concoct the Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill was naturally no big deal for him.
Now, a great many people were discussing him.
Who exactly was he? And what cultivation level was he in?
“I’m guessing that it’s highly possible that he’s a Venerate.”
“En, otherwise, how could he have subdued Pei Guangchen with a single move?”
“He had initially wanted to keep a low profile, but he never thought that he would be bullied by a minor character.”
“Haha, let everyone know about this. Don’t underestimate minor characters. Who knows, they might be just wanting to show off.”
For the moment, no one suspected that it was Ling Han in disguise.

This matter naturally made Ling Han even more displeased with the Imperial Clans, but he immediately set it aside. He first concocted the Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill, and then handed it over to Brother Monkey, helping him cultivate his cultivation level to perfection.
After waiting for a few days, the Yin souls attacked again.
Ling Han arrived at the warship that he usually boarded. Then, he saw Liu Xing, Feng Xingwang, and Gu Taihua.
“Lord Ling!” When they saw Ling Han, they paid their respects.
Ling Han nodded and boarded the ship first. Liu Xing and the others hurriedly followed behind him, automatically positioning themselves as servants.
Today, the warship was still filled to the brim.

There were the “veterans” that had survived the last few battles, as well as the rookies that had just joined, and the rookies still did not know the cruelties of battle. They were discussing excitedly over there.
“Rookies, don’t be too excited. When we get to the battlefield, you will realize just how cruel that place is,” an elder said.
The rookies were naturally unconvinced. They were hot-blooded, young, and full of confidence.
However, after hearing the seniors talk about the specific process of the few battles, these rookies were all moved. Some of them even revealed looks of fear.
After a few battles, out of four full ships of people, now, there were actually only fifty people left of the initial number.
Just how cruel was this?

“However, if you guys can learn the true essence of a certain person, to say nothing of surviving three battles, even three hundred or three thousand battles wouldn’t be a problem,” a veteran suddenly said slowly.
“What?” The rookies were all curious.
The veteran from before pointed at Ling Han, “There, this is the one.”
“Hahahaha!” All the veterans laughed loudly.
This was naturally a sarcastic remark. It was a mockery of Ling Han’s escape every time.
Liu Xing and the others were enraged. He actually dared to slander their Lord!
However, seeing Ling Han remain calm and collected, they forcefully suppressed their anger.
The rookies didn’t know, and a few of them were even asking Ling Han for guidance out of curiosity.
They had all come to obtain benefits and battle merits, so who would want to die?
Ling Han hadn’t even spoken yet, when a few veterans couldn’t help but laugh loudly, revealing the “truth”.
This instantly made the rookies feel ashamed.
F***, so he was a deserter. No wonder it was said that he could survive three hundred battles, or even three thousand battles.

The funny thing was that the level of people on this ship was too low, so there was not a single person that had Galaxy Network’s connection device. Otherwise, with Ling Han’s current level of popularity, there would definitely be people that would recognize him.
—That was suspected to be a Venerate, and you guys actually dare to mock him; are you tired of living?
Liu Xing finally couldn’t bear it any longer. He slammed a hand on the table and stood up. “All of you, shut up!”
“Hahaha!” The rookies were still laughing loudly. They didn’t recognize Liu Xing, so they were naturally unafraid.
However, a great many seniors recognized Liu Xing and the others, and they all shut their mouths.
These three people were not to be trifled with. All of them were in the Ultimate Dao Foundation.
“Try and laugh again!” Seeing that Ling Han didn’t object, Feng Xingwang and Gu Taihua both stood up and shouted at the rookies.
“We’re laughing, so what does it have to do with you guys?” A rookie was stubborn.
“Shh, they’re not to be trifled with!” A veteran kindly introduced Liu Xing and the others.
These three guys specialized in picking Foundation Building Tier cultivators to rob, yet nothing happened all this while. This was proof of strength.
After hearing about Liu Xing and the others’ “great achievements”, the rookies all cowered.
Perhaps there were some among them whose abilities were not inferior, but it was better to have less trouble, so what was the point of attracting trouble?
However, no one understood why Liu Xing and the others would stand up for Ling Han.
Could it be that this was their new underling?
However, what was the point of taking in such a deserter?
They did not speak on the way, and everyone was very silent.
It wasn’t long before the warship arrived at its designated location.
But right at this moment, something happened.
“Not good, a great yin soul is approaching us!”
“Fire! Fire!”
The terrified voices of the sailors were suddenly heard. Everyone rushed onto the deck, and what they saw caused their expressions to change.

There was a Yin soul that was as tall as three hundred meters charging towards them, and on the way, there was also a warship that had already been destroyed. It floated in space, corpses and wreckage everywhere, a ghastly sight.
“This is... Sect Master-level Yin soul!”
“Heavens, how did such a great monster get here?”
“We’re done for, we’re done for!”
Everyone’s expressions were ashen. It was said that Yin souls did not have strong battle prowess, but that was only relative.
If a Sect Master made a move, they would definitely be annihilated in an instant.
The warship that had been destroyed in the distance was clear proof of this. It must have been the doing of that great yin soul.
A great many rookies were crying. This was really dying before they had even gained any benefits.

Only Liu Xing and the others were slightly calmer. They all looked at Ling Han. This guy had earned more than 20 million battle merits, and who knows, he may be able to deal with a Sect Master-level Yin soul.
Ling Han was also a little surprised. Under the layers of defense, there were actually still some that slipped through the net?
In an instant, that great yin soul had already charged over, and shot out a punch.
They were done for!
Everyone closed their eyes. The Sect Master-level aura surged. This was a fatal blow.
Peng, there was a loud bang, but they didn’t feel the arrival of doomsday,?
They all opened their eyes, and then saw a scene that caused their scalps to go numb.
—This great yin soul had already been blasted into pieces, and there was presently a person that was slowly withdrawing his fist.
Ling Han!
Heavens!
At this moment, everyone didn’t know whether they should be excited, grateful, ashamed, or something else. They were all dumbfounded, and didn’t know how to react at all.
“You guys just wander around nearby,” Ling Han said to Liu Xing and the others.
“Yes, Lord Ling!” Seeing Ling Han move with their own eyes, Liu Xingxing and the others naturally worshipped Ling Han to the core. When they agreed, even their backs were straight.
When everyone saw this, they were all filled with extreme regret.

chapters.title: Chapter 4536: Crazy
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han leaped out of the warship and used the Imminent Skyline, which was extremely fast.
He was willing to give Liu Xing and the others a chance. That was because he hoped that everyone could do their best in the matter of fighting against the Yin souls.
Though the power of a mere few people was limited, if everyone in the world was willing to step out, so what need was there to worry about Yin souls being indestructible?
As usual, he charged into the innermost depths, and began to reap kills.
His abilities had advanced to another level, and even if there was no qualitative change, Ling Han’s battle prowess had still increased considerably. Killing Yin souls was even easier for him.

This was mainly because he had previously been stuck at the peak stage of Six Stars and didn’t break through. Thus, the rewards from heaven and earth had become a boost to his soul and physique. This was also a huge benefit.
For example, stimulating Regulations and high-level energy required Spiritual Power.
The stronger the Spiritual Power, the faster the Regulations would be stimulated, and the more high-level energy there would be, and the more destructive power it would have on Yin souls.

Ling Han had no qualms. The Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was used, and he shuttled through the Yin souls. His fiery wings fluttered with Destructive Energy, and Yin souls would die at the slightest touch. There was absolutely no doubt about it.
If a Saint didn’t appear, he was unstoppable.
So what if it was a Venerate Tier? They wouldn’t be able to catch up to him at all, and it was possible that he would counterattack and take advantage of the opening to kill them instead.

To say nothing of the fact that Ling Han had resolved the battle single-handedly, at least under the premise that the Yin Saint did not appear, he had really dealt with a great number of Sect Master-level Yin souls, and held back one third of the Venerate-level Yin souls.
It would not be an exaggeration to say that this kind of merit was great.
Unfortunately, no one knew.
Ling Han didn’t mind. He didn’t do this to make his name resound throughout the world, but rather because the invasion of the Yin souls would affect everyone, and he was duty-bound to do so.
His deeds, whether good or bad, would be left for future generations to judge. At present, he only wanted to live on, and live well.
This battle lasted for more than half a month.

Who would dare disrespect such an elite?
The hierarchy of cultivation was cast in iron.
Ling Han didn’t say anything. He simply walked to a corner and sat down, closing his eyes to rest.

No one would be ashamed of their moves to court favor. On the contrary, everyone was incredibly envious.
Being able to follow by the side of such an elite was a good thing that could not be obtained even if one begged.
In the future, as long as they talked about today’s battle, they would naturally have a share of glory as they had once followed behind a certain someone.
Ji Wuming!
Though he was nameless, it was destined that his name would spread throughout the world.
The warship returned, and the legend about Ji Wuming began to spread like crazy. This made Ji Wuming, who had just arrived, feel very stifled.

It must be Ling Han!

Ling Han cracked a smile, “I am very famous now, am I not?”
Xu Jianshan couldn’t help but be taken aback. You are indeed very famous now, but there is no need for you to say it yourself, right?

I am an Imperial Son, and a Golden Generation at that. When my name was known all over the world, who knew which corner you were playing with mud in.

F***, was there any way to praise oneself like this?

Xu Jianshan faltered upon hearing this, and the corners of his mouth involuntarily twitched.

“Brother Ji, isn’t it a little inappropriate for you to pretend to be stupid like this?” he asked in displeasure.
“Yi, it was you who didn’t answer my question first, so why are you saying that I’m inappropriate?” Ling Han countered.
Xu Jianshan was instantly rendered speechless. That was indeed the case.
After being taken aback for a moment, he finally said, “Brother Ji’s great name does indeed make me feel slightly honored.”
“Is your heart—”
“Brother Ji!”
Seeing that Ling Han was still entangled in this problem, Xu Jianshan couldn’t help but call out loudly, feeling an indescribable madness.
Why did he feel a great desire to hit someone?
“Oh.” Ling Han shook his head, his expression filled with disappointment. “So you’re not excited at all. Sigh, this really makes me sad.”
Don’t make it sound so misleading!
Xu Jianshan clenched his fists tightly. He really wanted to give this guy a beating first.

However, the Imperial Clans had already reached a consensus. Due to the huge commotion caused by the previous incident, nothing could happen to Ling Han. From a certain aspect, he was even a banner that stabilized the morale of the army.
Thus, Xu Jianshan could only tolerate it.
“Not interested,” Ling Han said again.
Xu Jianshan was at a loss. What was he uninterested in?
Then, realization dawned on him. Ling Han had said that he was not interested, because he did not intend to join the Xu Clan.
‘So, you were joking with me just then, weren’t you?’
“Brother Ji, are you not going to consider for a little longer?” His words were very polite, but his tone had become cold and menacing.
The Imperial Clans have never accepted “no”; no one would dare!
Meanwhile, Ling Han’s expression was filled with curiosity, and he continued to ask, “You really don’t feel like your heart is beating wildly?”
‘Holy f*ck!’
Xu Jianshan was about to go crazy.

chapters.title: Chapter 4537: Stray shots have no eyes
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Xu Jianshan looked coldly at Ling Han, killing intent flickering in his eyes.
‘Are you toying with me, a dignified Golden Generation, like a monkey?’
“Brother Ji, do you know how most people die?” He quickly suppressed his anger, and asked Ling Han calmly.
“Died of stupidity?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“No, he couldn’t control his mouth, and died due to his own vulgarity,” Xu Jianshan said balefully.
Ling Han nodded, “Then you must control your mouth. At such a young age, don’t risk your life.”
This!
Xu Jianshan couldn’t help the veins on his neck popping. F*ck, that was an insult to you, all right?
How could Ling Han be so stupid that he couldn’t even tell?
Impossible, he could cultivate to the level of Sect Master, and even Venerate Tier, so how could he be such an idiot?
Thus, the other party was still teasing him.

Xu Jianshan suppressed the urge to forcefully make a move. Nothing could happen to Ling Han now. Countless pairs of eyes were watching. To say nothing of the fact that the Imperial Clans could not make a move, even if someone wanted to make a move on Ling Han, they would have to turn around to protect him.
Why?
Because once something happened to Ling Han, everyone would think that it was the doing of the Imperial Clans. Then, the hearts and morale that had been painstakingly gathered would disperse.

“Brother Ji, you have to know that in a battle with Yin souls, the slightest mistake could result in death.” Xu Jianshan said slowly, “Furthermore, stray attacks have no eyes on the battlefield. If they hit Brother Ji, hoho, that would not be good.”

This was a blatant threat. Though he did not say a single word, his meaning was very clear. If you do not concede or cooperate, then when you go to the battlefield one day to fight a bloody battle with Yin souls, you may be “accidentally wounded” by your own people and die.
Ling Han looked coldly at Xu Jianshan. He definitely would not accept threats!
So what if they were Imperial Clans? How many Imperial Sons had he killed?
“Hehe, then you have to be careful as well. Stray shots have no eyes, and it is possible that anyone could be hit.” Ling Han smiled.
It was clear that they could no longer continue this conversation.
With a cold wave of his sleeve, Xu Jianshan strode off.
Ling Han didn’t stop him. Since the other party threatened to find a chance to kill him on the battlefield, he would return the favor.
Did he think that he wouldn’t kill him?
Time passed quietly, and another ten days later, the Yin soul army made a comeback.
Ling Han boarded the warship, but the moment he boarded, he discovered that the atmosphere was a little strange.
With a sweep of his gaze, he immediately discovered the reason.
—Xu Jianshan. He was shockingly here as well.
This was the Imperial Son of the Golden Generation, and his cultivation level was at Sect Master-level. Thus, who wouldn’t be stunned by his appearance here?
Ling Han turned his gaze to the four elders behind Xu Jianshan.

These four people were expressionless, their expressions cold, as if they were carved from wood. However, Ling Han could tell from the vague aura exuding from them that these four old men were all Sect Master-level, and it was very possible that they were all Nine Stars.
Ha, this was too arrogant, wasn’t it? To publicly use five elites to besiege and kill him?

However, these people had absolutely no idea that his present battle prowess was enough to sweep aside all opposition at the level of Sect Master. To say nothing of five Sect Masters, even if there were fifty or five hundred of them, they would still be completely annihilated in front of him.
Xu Jianshan naturally saw him as well, and said calmly, “Brother Ji, you can still reconsider.”
Ling Han didn’t say anything. He simply cracked a smile, and killing intent appeared in his eyes.
Xu Jianshan shook his head, “Too bad!”

Ling Han had caused the Imperial Clans to suffer such a great humiliation. His only fate would definitely be death, but they could not publicly persecute him. Thus, if Ling Han were to die on the battlefield, they would be able to draw a clear dividing line between the Imperial Clans and his death, and at the same time, boost their morale. It could be claimed to be the best of both worlds.
Since Ling Han didn’t agree to join the Xu Clan, there was nothing more to say.
‘Die.’

The atmosphere on the ship was extremely tense. The Imperial Son had arrived, and though he did not say anything, even if this kind of existence was just standing there, it would still exert a great pressure on others.
Finally, after sailing for a while, they had arrived at the edge of the battlefield.
“Charge!”
Everyone rushed out and joined the battle.
Ling Han turned around to take a look. Xu Jianshan and the four elders were both standing there without moving.
“Brother Ji, please,” Xu Jianshan said very politely. “The Imperial Clans owe you a favor, so the five of us will protect Brother Ji from the Yin souls.”
Tsk.
Ling Han didn’t pay any heed to this. He strode forward.
Xu Jianshan immediately followed, and behind him, four elders followed like shadows.
It wasn’t long before Ling Han arrived at the Sect Master-level battlefield. However, he didn’t stop, and he continued to advance.
This caused Xu Jianshan and the others to be stunned.
Yi, why haven’t you stopped yet?

If they continued onwards, that would be the battlefield for Venerate Tier-level. Even if they went forwards, and were accidentally hit by stray attacks, they could still possibly be severely wounded.
That’s right.

Realization immediately dawned on them. Ling Han must have been afraid of being ganged up on by them, so he took the risk, wanting to use this kind of method to make them retreat in the face of difficulties.
“Chase!” Xu Jianshan only hesitated for a moment, then immediately waved his hand.
As long as they were careful, they would definitely be fine.
The five of them advanced cautiously. Waves of Venerate Tier-level fluctuations of power would occasionally spread over, making them feel on edge.
Dangerous, too dangerous.

Meanwhile, Ling Han was extremely relaxed. He had already walked this path many times. Furthermore, with his strength, even if he was really swept by a Venerate Tier-level shockwave, he was completely capable of dispersing it.
After a while, he walked out of this area.
Behind him, Xu Jianshan and the others all breathed a long sigh of relief, feeling that their backs were wet. As it turned out, unknowingly, they had broken out in a great amount of cold sweat.
But after an instant, they became nervous again.
Because this place was too deep into the territory of Yin souls, there were a great many Venerate Tier and Sect Master-level Yin souls. Staying here for even a second was extremely dangerous.
However, Ling Han didn’t give them any time to hesitate as he strode forward.
Damn it!
“Give chase! We definitely can’t let him return alive!” Xu Jianshan said through gritted teeth.
Killing Ling Han was a mission that had been assigned to the Xu Clan. As a member of the Imperial Clan, how humiliating would it be if he couldn’t even kill a minor character?
Moreover, wasn’t Ling Han in front? If there was a powerful Yin soul, he would be the first to encounter it.
Once they confirmed Ling Han’s death, they could immediately turn around and flee.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Yin souls barraged him, Ling Han was already brandishing his fists in battle, and the speed of his advance immediately slowed.
“Catch up to him and end the battle as soon as possible,” Xu Jianshan said.
He could no longer delay, or it was really possible that he would be in danger.
The four old men all nodded. The five of them sped up, and set off in rapid pursuit of Ling Han.
At this moment, Ling Han didn’t advance any further. Instead, he turned around and looked coldly at Xu Jianshan and the others.

“I have to say, your courage is truly amazing. In order to throw us off your tail, you actually dared to come here,” Xu Jianshan stated calmly. At the same time, the four elders had already dispersed, surrounding Ling Han.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Why can’t it be that I wanted to kill you guys, so I deliberately led you guys here?”

He could no longer delay, or it was really possible that he would be in danger.
The four old men all nodded.
The five of them sped up, and set off in rapid pursuit of Ling Han.
At this moment, Ling Han didn’t advance any further.
Instead, he turned around and looked coldly at Xu Jianshan and the others.
“I have to say, your courage is truly amazing.
In order to throw us off your tail, you actually dared to come here,” Xu Jianshan stated calmly.
At the same time, the four elders had already dispersed, surrounding Ling Han.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Why can’t it be that I wanted to kill you guys, so I deliberately led you guys here?”

chapters.title: Chapter 4538: Counterattack
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Xu Jianshan faltered for a moment before roaring with laughter.
He shook his head, “Who do you think you are?”
Are you a Venerate?
If you weren’t a Venerate, what right do you have to be so arrogant?

There were five of them, and all of them were Nine Star Sect Masters. Furthermore, he was a Golden Generation. It could be said that with him as the leader, and the support of the four great Sect Masters, this kind of battle prowess would definitely surpass Sect Master-level. If he was alone, who could compare to him?
Ling Han led them into a trap?
What a joke. Even if a sheep led a lion into a trap, how could it be a match for a lion?
“Die!” he shouted loudly, and charged towards Ling Han.
He was afraid that something would happen if he stayed too long. After all, there were too many Yin souls here.
The four old Sect Masters naturally wouldn’t hesitate either. They immediately followed after him.
“As a dignified Golden Generation, do you still need to bully me with numbers?” Ling Han said with a smile as he retreated backward.
“Humph, who would have the time to waste on you?” Xu Jianshan smirked coldly, not falling for Ling Han’s provocation.

However, with Ling Han’s retreat, countless Yin souls instantly enveloped them, causing Xu Jianshan and the others to be heavily surrounded. Of course, Ling Han was the same. The number of Yin souls he faced was even more.
“Scram!” Xu Jianshan shouted loudly. He shot out punch after punch, and brilliance shot into the skies, lighting up this dark universe.
As expected of the Golden Generation. He used Regulations, and not a single Yin soul could withstand a single blow from him.
If Venerates didn’t appear, who could rival him?
He continued to charge forward, rapidly closing the distance between him and Ling Han.
“You want to use the Yin souls to impede us? Hehe, I have to say, you are very bold. However, in front of absolute strength, what meaning is there to it?”
Yin souls, could they stop him?
This was absolutely impossible!

On the other side, though the abilities of the four old Sect Masters were slightly inferior, they were still members of the Imperial Clan, after all. Their battle prowess far surpassed the average nine-star Sect Master, and they similarly charged over, continuing to maintain the position of encircling the two of them.
They gradually shrunk the encirclement, and watched as Ling Han was like a turtle in a jar.
“Ji Wuming, do you regret it now?” Xu Jianshan asked balefully.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “My name is not Ji Wuming.”
Xu Jianshan could also guess. After all, his name was Wuming. This was too deliberate.

“No matter who you are, you will not be able to escape death today!” He charged over, and delivered a palm strike straight at Ling Han’s face. Sixteen streaks of Regulations turned into sharp blades, interwoven with high-level energy, wanting to slice Ling Han in half with a single strike.
At the same time, the four old Sect Masters also launched fierce attacks, preventing Ling Han from breaking through from any angle.
However, did Ling Han want to break out of the siege?
He raised his fist, and in an instant, shot out four consecutive punches, heading towards the four old Sect Masters respectively.
Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng!
With every punch, an old Sect Master would explode, turning into a rain of blood that filled the skies. Huge amounts of energy exploded, annihilating the Yin souls in the surroundings.
‘F*ck!’
Xu Jianshan’s attack came to an abrupt stop, his eyes filled with terror. In fact, even his body was trembling slightly.
The four old Sect Masters had actually been obliterated with a single punch?
How was this possible!
He could barely believe his eyes. This was too much of a shock to his tolerance level.

If he moved, he would indeed be able to defeat those four old Sect Masters, but it was definitely not something that could be done in a single move, and it was even more impossible that he could insta-kill them.
Hiss, what kind of colossal gap in strength was this?
“You, who exactly are you?” If it was not for the fact that a Venerate had confirmed that Ling Han was Sect Master-level, he would have suspected that the latter was a Venerate.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “I thought you didn’t care?”
Xu Jianshan gritted his teeth, “With how strong you are, you are definitely not some nameless character!”
“See, see, see. Just now, I wanted to reveal my identity, yet you refused to know. Now, you’re asking me again. Tell me, aren’t you despicable?” Ling Han asked.
A thought flashed through Xu Jianshan’s mind, and he blurted out, “You are Ling Han!”
Putting aside abilities, there should be no one other than Ling Han who had such a toxic tongue.
Ling Han’s expression was filled with disappointment. Why was it so easy to guess his identity?

“Does this count as my character crumbling?” he murmured. Er, if it was only Xu Jianshan, then he would just kill him to keep the secret. He could still use Ji Wuming’s identity to continue killing Yin souls and earn battle merits.
“Ling Han, you are really outrageously bold!” Xu Jianshan said balefully, “The whole universe is looking for you, yet you are strutting around, and actually came all the way here on your own.”

Ling Han wagged his finger, and while he was at it, threw out a punch, destroying a great number of Yin souls that were attacking him, “Wrong, wrong, wrong. The only people who cannot tolerate me are only Imperial Clans like you all. You all... cannot represent the people of this world!”
Xu Jianshan also casually waved his hand, destroying a large number of Yin souls. His eyes flickered.
If they fought, he was definitely no match for Ling Han. Thus, he definitely couldn’t face him head-on.

However, in terms of speed, Ling Han had grasped Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and in a situation when their cultivation level was equal, how could he compete with the world’s number one movement technique in speed?
Moreover, the environment here was already half-Netherworld. He couldn’t contact the elites of his clan, so it was impossible for him to call for reinforcements.
Thus, he had to run back, running until he could send out a signal.
Once a Venerate arrived, it would be Ling Han’s turn to flee for his life.
He no longer hesitated, and immediately turned around, his heart filled with humiliation.
He was a Golden Generation, synonymous with being invincible among his peers. Only he could look down on others. When had he ever fled in such a panic?
However, a figure flashed, and another person appeared in front of him. Flames danced wildly, exuding a soaring fighting spirit and killing intent.
Ling Han.
Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, the world’s fastest speed.
Xu Jianshan humphed lightly, and hurriedly launched an attack at Ling Han.
He knew how difficult it was to escape this time, so he was also mentally prepared for a bloody battle. If necessary, he would not hesitate to pay a certain price.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and also threw a punch, blasting towards Xu Jianshan.
This punch was too fast.
Peng!
Xu Jianshan was instantly sent flying, and countless Yin souls took advantage of the opening to pounce over, wanting to snatch his physical body.
“Scram!” Xu Jianshan roared loudly. His whole body exuded a blazing Sword Ray, which instantly destroyed all the Yin souls that had pounced towards him.
Pu!
However, he was still throwing up blood madly, appearing very miserable.

It was mainly because Ling Han’s punch was too domineering, directly wounding his organs. This had already caused him great injury, and he still had to forcefully endure his injuries before launching another attack, which naturally caused his injuries to worsen.
Thankfully, he was a Golden Generation, and his physique was extremely tough. Otherwise, he would be ten times worse off now.
Without another word, Xu Jianshan immediately began to run again.
With a flash, a person appeared again in front of him.
Naturally, it was still Ling Han.
“Still running?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
Xu Jianshan gritted his teeth, his gaze slightly panicked.
He knew that Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was fast, but before personally experiencing it, he had not thought that it would be so fast to such an astonishing extent.
This was practically enough to make one lose all hope.
“Ling Han!” he said heavily, yet did not know what else to say.
Beg for mercy?
That was impossible. He had come to kill Ling Han, and hoped that Ling Han would repay evil with kindness? Didn’t he know that this guy would not blink an eye at killing Imperial Sons?
He didn’t want to die at all, but what should he do?

chapters.title: Chapter 4539: Saintly Bone
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Do you regret it?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“Humph, do you want me to beg for mercy?” Xu Jianshan smirked coldly, “Impossible. There are no cowards in the Imperial Clans!”
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “No need to be stubborn. Your eyes have already betrayed you.”
Xu Jianshan shouted loudly, and once again began to flee.
As long as he could flee to a place where there was a signal, he would be able to contact his family, and it would only take an instant for Venerates to rush over to help.
Thus, he definitely couldn’t give up. As long as he didn’t die, there was still hope.
But in front of Ling Han, no matter how much he struggled, it was all in vain.
Every time he broke out of the siege, Ling Han would always appear in front of him at the first instant. He would throw a punch, and send him backwards.
He charged dozens of times, yet shockingly discovered that he was actually just circling around in the same spot.
This!
At this moment, he finally lost all hope.
The gap in strength was too wide, and his speed was completely inferior. How could he escape?
Xu Jianshan roared in fury. Boom! Imperial Blood surged.
He was really going all out. Even if he had to die, he was going to die a vigorous death.
Ling Han nodded, and said, “Seeing as you’re so prepared, I’ll give you a quick death.”
Boom, he threw a punch, and Destructive Energy surged.
Without a doubt, Xu Jianshan was instantly sent flying, but to Ling Han’s surprise, Xu Jianshan didn’t turn into a shower of blood.
It was not that Ling Han was violent, but rather that the force of his punch was really too overbearing, and it was very difficult for him to reserve power.
But look at Xu Jianshan. Though his whole body was gushing with blood, he surprisingly did not die.
This was very shocking.
Under the influence of Destructive Energy, even Substitution Seal was ineffective. Moreover, Ling Han’s battle prowess was far above Xu Jianshan’s, so why hadn’t he died?
Yi?
Ling Han looked at Xu Jianshan’s chest. It was completely mangled, revealing his bones, but his 24 ribs were all exuding a faint silvery light, exuding an indescribable majesty.
“Saintly bones!” Realization dawned on him.
No wonder Xu Jianshan had not been killed by him. As it turned out, his bones had reached Saint Tier!

No, it was not that his bones had reached Saint-level, but rather that he possessed a sliver of Saint-level genes. However, because Saint-level was really too powerful, even a tiny bit was enough to save Xu Jianshan’s life.
When one reached the level of Venerate Tier, the Substitution Seal would be ineffective. Thus, the Imperial Clans had used other methods to strengthen their protection of the Imperial Son.
—Previously, he had not used it, because what person in this world would be so outrageously bold as to dare make a move on the Imperial Son?
Now that the Imperial Sons had died one after another, the Imperial Clans no longer dared to have any thoughts of getting lucky, and fully armed the Imperial Sons.
Xu Jianshan himself was also slightly surprised. He had not thought that he would actually survive this punch.
As it turned out, the trump card that the clan had laid out for him was actually so awesome!
Why hadn’t he been told earlier?
True, if he had been told earlier, he would have had a way out, and would not have the determination to die in battle.
And now, after a life-and-death struggle, Xu Jianshan could actually vaguely see his own path of cultivation.

All this while, the journey of the Imperial Sons had been too smooth-sailing. Their natural talent was astonishingly high, and their background was also frightening, so no one dared to trifle with rhem. There was also a good thing like the Substitution Seal, so there was absolutely no need for them to worry about any life-threatening danger.

But in truth, death was also an experience. Without experiencing the spiritual test of a moment of life and death, how could one possibly develop an indestructible willpower, and how could one possibly walk on his own path of cultivation?
Thus, even though it was only for an instant, Xu Jianshan could vaguely see a completely new path.
This was his path of martial arts, and it may not be possible to walk it, but there was still a path to walk after all.
He could feel that the barrier to his cultivation level had loosened, and breaking through to the Fourth Extreme was close at hand.
“Hahaha!” He couldn’t help but laugh loudly. This was really a double blessing. Not only had he glimpsed the path of cultivation, he had also pushed aside the barrier to break through.
“Ling Han, I really have to thank you!” he said, but his tone was incredibly baleful.
After advancing into Venerate Tier, the first thing he had to do was kill Ling Han.
“Hehe, you had best give up!” Ling Han shook his head, and continued to attack.

He had only glimpsed a sliver of hope for a breakthrough, but he was still a million miles away from a true breakthrough. Even if he was to go into seclusion now, he wouldn’t be able to achieve it without at least a year and a half.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The Destructive Energy bombarded Xu Jianshan repeatedly, causing the flesh and blood on his body to fall off layer by layer.
Ling Han saw that Xu Jianshan’s backbone was like a great dragon, thick and sturdy.
Looking closely, this backbone was actually formed from the overlapping of two bones.
Realization dawned on him, “So you have implanted a Saint-level backbone! Hehe, what great power!”

The bones of Saints were naturally made of Saintly Material. In that case, how could Xu Jianshan’s bones not be tough when he implanted the Saintly bones into his body and slowly absorbed the Saintly Particles within them to strengthen his own bones?
This was easy to say, but in actual practice, it was incredibly difficult.
That was because if it had the word ‘Saint’ in its name, it was too powerful.
If a Sect Master ate the Saintly medicine, not only would he not get any benefits, it was even more likely that he would burst from the overwhelming power.
It was the same for Saint Bones.
If it was implanted into one’s body, the saintly might would be activated, and the latter would only die immediately.

Unless... this Saintly bone had the same bloodline as the one that it had been implanted in. Then, through fusing the bloodline together, there was indeed a chance that the Saintly bone would hibernate, and one could slowly absorb the Saintly Particles.
In other words, these Saintly bones could only come from elites of the clan.
Just this fact alone was enough to eliminate how many forces?

More importantly, the backbone was a great dragon in the human body. It supported the main trunk of the body, and possessed an incredibly important position. Even if Saints could regrow their severed limbs, how many years would it take for them to recover after plucking out this great dragon in the human body?
Thus, what Saint would be willing to hand over their spine?
Even if it was the Imperial Clan, they could only use it on the Golden Generation. After all, this price was too great, too great.
“Ling Han, you can’t kill me! And once I break through to Venerate Tier, it will be the time of your death!” Xu Jianshan declared coldly.
Ling Han shook his head, “I forgot to tell you. I was the one who killed Lin Xuan.”
What!
Xu Jianshan was instantly shocked. Lin Xuan’s cultivation level was Venerate Tier-level, and the height of his natural talent could be ranked in the top three even among Golden Generations.
He had actually been killed by Ling Han?
However, after a moment of distraction, Xu Jianshan regained his composure, and exclaimed, “I don’t believe it!”
“What does it have to do with me whether you believe it or not?” Ling Han said with a smile. He brandished his fists and charged forward, saying, “I’m simply telling you a fact.”
Under the heavy punches, Xu Lianshan retreated continuously.

His body had already absorbed a portion of the Saint-level particles, so his bones were incredibly sturdy. Even Ling Han was unable to break through them. However, the Destructive Energy was not to be trifled with either. It still managed to cause great damage to Xu Jianshan through his bones.
Originally, this would have been resolved with a single punch, but now? It had become a blunt blade that was slowly damaging him.
At this rate, Xu Jianshan would still be unable to escape death, but before he died, he could hold on for a period of time, and in this period of time, he would be tortured even more.
And it just so happened that he himself was the one who had caused it.

He had only glimpsed a sliver of hope for a breakthrough, but he was still a million miles away from a true breakthrough.
Even if he was to go into seclusion now, he wouldn’t be able to achieve it without at least a year and a half.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The Destructive Energy bombarded Xu Jianshan repeatedly, causing the flesh and blood on his body to fall off layer by layer.
Ling Han saw that Xu Jianshan’s backbone was like a great dragon, thick and sturdy.
Looking closely, this backbone was actually formed from the overlapping of two bones.
Realization dawned on him, “So you have implanted a Saint-level backbone!
Hehe, what great power!”
The bones of Saints were naturally made of Saintly Material.
In that case, how could Xu Jianshan’s bones not be tough when he implanted the Saintly bones into his body and slowly absorbed the Saintly Particles within them to strengthen his own bones?
This was easy to say, but in actual practice, it was incredibly difficult.
That was because if it had the word ‘Saint’ in its name, it was too powerful.
If a Sect Master ate the Saintly medicine, not only would he not get any benefits, it was even more likely that he would burst from the overwhelming power.
It was the same for Saint Bones.
If it was implanted into one’s body, the saintly might would be activated, and the latter would only die immediately.
Unless... this Saintly bone had the same bloodline as the one that it had been implanted in.
Then, through fusing the bloodline together, there was indeed a chance that the Saintly bone would hibernate, and one could slowly absorb the Saintly Particles.
In other words, these Saintly bones could only come from elites of the clan.
Just this fact alone was enough to eliminate how many forces?
More importantly, the backbone was a great dragon in the human body.
It supported the main trunk of the body, and possessed an incredibly important position.
Even if Saints could regrow their severed limbs, how many years would it take for them to recover after plucking out this great dragon in the human body?
Thus, what Saint would be willing to hand over their spine?
Even if it was the Imperial Clan, they could only use it on the Golden Generation.
After all, this price was too great, too great.
“Ling Han, you can’t kill me!
And once I break through to Venerate Tier, it will be the time of your death!” Xu Jianshan declared coldly.
Ling Han shook his head, “I forgot to tell you.
I was the one who killed Lin Xuan.”
What!
Xu Jianshan was instantly shocked.
Lin Xuan’s cultivation level was Venerate Tier-level, and the height of his natural talent could be ranked in the top three even among Golden Generations.
He had actually been killed by Ling Han?
However, after a moment of distraction, Xu Jianshan regained his composure, and exclaimed, “I don’t believe it!”
“What does it have to do with me whether you believe it or not?” Ling Han said with a smile.
He brandished his fists and charged forward, saying, “I’m simply telling you a fact.”
Under the heavy punches, Xu Lianshan retreated continuously.
His body had already absorbed a portion of the Saint-level particles, so his bones were incredibly sturdy.
Even Ling Han was unable to break through them.
However, the Destructive Energy was not to be trifled with either.
It still managed to cause great damage to Xu Jianshan through his bones.
Originally, this would have been resolved with a single punch, but now?
It had become a blunt blade that was slowly damaging him.
At this rate, Xu Jianshan would still be unable to escape death, but before he died, he could hold on for a period of time, and in this period of time, he would be tortured even more.
And it just so happened that he himself was the one who had caused it.

chapters.title: Chapter 4540: Nine Star Sect Master
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The more Xu Jianshan fought, the more flustered he became. His injuries were becoming more and more severe, and had already reached a point where it was difficult for him to recover.
The reason why he was still persisting was because he was really too defiant.
The pride of the Imperial Son and the pride of the Golden Generation made him grit his teeth and persist, determined to fight to the last moment.
Thus, he had also suffered greatly. He was beaten up for a whole half an hour, and only then was he slowly worn to death.
When he died, he didn’t even look human anymore.
Ling Han was speechless. He indeed didn’t want to torture Xu Jianshan, but who asked him to be too difficult to kill?
“These people from the Imperial Clans really have a lot of tricks up their sleeve.”

Ling Han felt rueful. Seven great stars had been refined into Di Wuji’s body, and once they exploded, his power would directly soar to three stars, or even five stars Venerate Tier-level, and in Xu Jianshan’s case, Saintly bones had been implanted into his body.

The example of Di Wuji might be more special, because it was very possible that this kind of technique was the doing of a Great Emperor, but there was no Great Emperor in this world now, so this kind of technique could not be replicated.
But something like Xu Jianshan should not be rare.
In other words, it would be extremely difficult to kill those Imperial Sons in the future.
“Sigh!” Ling Han shook his head. Unless he could advance into Saint Tier, this would definitely have some effect on him.
“Why are you always causing trouble for me?”
Ling Han studied Xu Jianshan’s corpse for a while. He had a feeling that there was a vague terrifying fluctuation in that Saintly bone inside Xu Jianshan’s body.
“Strange, I seem to have sensed this kind of fluctuation somewhere.”
“Oh, that’s right!”
Ling Han took out the broken sword. Occasionally, there would be an obscure fluctuation emanating from within, which was exactly the same as the Saintly bones.
“It’s not as simple as the aura of a Saint.”
“As for the details, I still have to ask the old man.”
Ling Han wanted to take away Xu Jianshan’s Saintly bones, but discovered that he could not.
This Saintly bone was like a sharp Divine Sword. If he touched it, the only result would be that he would be riddled with wounds.
This was not the Saintly medicine. Though the grade of the Saintly medicine was high, it did not have any destructive power, but this was different. It was showing off its full strength.
Sigh!
Ling Han sighed, unable to take it away.
So be it if he couldn’t retrieve it. In any case, he didn’t like bloody bones either.
Ling Han shook his head, and continued to battle with the Yin souls.
Right until the Yin soul army retreated, did he return to the warship.
Seeing that only Ling Han had returned, everyone was incredibly stunned.
Where was the Imperial Son?
Could it be...
None of them dared to think further. That was really too terrifying.
But did Ling Han really dare?
They did not know, and did not want to know either. The waters here were really too deep. Even if they knew just the slightest bit, it would bring a fatal calamity to them.

The warship safely returned to the Purple Gauze Planet. At present, it was still very calm. However, very soon, the matter of Xu Jianshan’s disappearance would spread out, and then his death would be discovered. Naturally, the culprit would have to be found.

Ling Han was definitely the first suspect. Xu Jianshan and the others had gone to hunt him down, and now that he had returned, Xu Jianshan and the others had died. If they didn’t suspect Ling Han, who would they suspect?
“I really want to see just how shameless the Imperial Clans can be.”
At present, he was a flag that everyone was staring at. If he collapsed, everyone would guess that it was the doing of the Imperial Clans.

Thus, it was absolutely impossible for the Imperial Clans to make a move on him in public. No matter how much they suspected that he was the culprit who had killed Xu Jianshan, they could only investigate in secret. They could either use the Yin souls to kill him, or create the illusion that he had been killed by the Yin souls.

As expected, the news of the deaths of Xu Jianshan and the others quickly spread out, but the Xu Clan was extraordinarily calm. In fact, they did not even send anyone over to question Ling Han, and acted as if nothing had happened.
Several days later, the Yin souls once again began their attack.
Ling Han still went to battle, reaping the rewards of heaven and earth, and while he was at it, after he had saved up 15 million merit points, he immediately went to redeem Eight Stars Celestial Qi.
His cultivation level was soaring madly.
He was at the middle stage of Seven Stars, at the late stage, then at the peak stage. Then, he began to break through.
Eight-star Sect Master!

In a short few months, he had soared from a six-star Sect Master to an eight-star Sect Master. Ling Han had to admit that though it was possible that the yin souls barraging the Living Realm would have extremely far-reaching effects, for the moment, he had really profited, and it was a great profit at that.
In terms of ability to kill Yin souls, no one was stronger than him. Even Venerates couldn’t compare.
—Even if they could be compared, how many rewards of heaven and earth would a Venerate need to take a step forward? It would definitely be 10 times or even 100 times more than him, right?
As the Yin souls continued to invade, Ling Han’s cultivation level continued to advance rapidly.
He broke through to the middle stage of Eight Stars, the late stage, and the peak stage.
Nine-star Sect Master!
Ling Han was very pleased. He had finally arrived at the end of the Minor Advanced Tier.
Now, he only had to kill a few more Yin souls, and advance his cultivation level to peak stage Nine Stars. Then, he would be able to break through to the Fourth Extreme and become a Venerate.
If he became a Venerate, what need would he have to fear everyone in the world?
So what if a Saint moved? If he was no match, he could completely flee.
He was filled with anticipation. He only had to advance another step further, and he would truly possess the preliminary qualifications to directly oppose the Imperial Clans.

Of course, if the Imperial Clans sent out Saints, or even the Imperial Weapon, he would definitely have no option but to flee. However, unlike now, there was no need for him to change his identity anymore. He could walk around the world with his original appearance.
Subsequently, he was extremely expectant of every battle, and was getting closer and closer to the Venerate Tier.
Nine Stars middle stage, late stage, peak stage!
That was enough.
Ling Han planned to immediately break through to Venerate Tier. If he became a Venerate, the efficiency of killing Yin souls would increase by who knew how many times.
However, he shockingly discovered that he... could not break through.
Why?
He hadn’t even begun, so how could he have concluded that it was impossible?
The reason was because of those chains on the fruit of cultivation.

If he wanted to become a Venerate, he would have to let the fruit of cultivation transform into the Fourth Extreme. However, the problem was that his fruit of cultivation was now tightly bound, so how could it transform into the Fourth Extreme?
Ling Han kept trying, wanting to break through these shackles.
However, he hadn’t been able to do so when he had been a One Star or Two Star Sect Master. Now that he was a Nine Star Sect Master... he couldn’t do so either.
These were the shackles that the heaven and earth had placed on him. As punishment for the Destructive Energy that he had cultivated to a complete state, they could not be broken at all!

Ling Han used his Spiritual Power to take human form, attempting to tear off one of the links. As long as he could tear off one, he would naturally be able to tear off the second, the third, and so on.
However, it was useless even if he exhausted his Spiritual Power.
It could not be severed!

He tried to use Destructive Energy. This thing could destroy everything, but the shackles were firmly embedded in his fruit of cultivation. Without waiting for the shackles to shatter, his fruit of cultivation would be destroyed first.
Without the fruit of cultivation, then what was the point of breaking through to Venerate Tier? His cultivation level would drop to Spiritual Transformation Tier.
After several attempts, Ling Han had no choice but to admit that he was really helpless against these chains.
Could it be that he would be stuck at the level of a nine-star Sect Master for the rest of his life?
True, he was definitely the strongest Sect Master in history, but what was the use?
Was he qualified to contest for the imperial throne?
There was no need for a Saint. Even if a One Star Venerate made a move, if he were to face them head-on, he would only be able to ensure his survival, at most.
No, there was always a way out. There would definitely be a way out!

chapters.title: Chapter 4541: Trapped
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han sat quietly, a myriad of thoughts running through his mind.
He knew that the punishment of the Heavenly Dao would be a trap, but he had never imagined that it would be a trap to this extent.
Not allowing him to break through?
No, there was always a way out. Furthermore, Heavenly Dao had always been the fairest, and would definitely not set up a complete dead end.
Even if there was only a slim chance, or even an extremely slim chance, there would definitely be a sliver of hope for a way out.
After pondering for a day, Ling Han finally made a decision.
‘Since you won’t allow me to break through, I’ll continue to improve my cultivation!’
At first glance, this was very contradictory.
He was already stuck at the level of Nine Star Sect Master, so how was he supposed to improve his cultivation level?
That’s right. The fruit of cultivation was restricted, and could not evolve into the Fourth Extreme, but what if his Nine Stars cultivation level was raised to Ten Stars?
There was no need for him to evolve the fruit of cultivation, as he could skip over the difficult problem of being trapped by the black chains.
And with his present Spiritual Power, he could not tear open the chains. Then, when he advanced into Ten Stars, or even Eleven or Twelve Stars?
One day, his strength would reach the level of severing these shackles.

As for the problem of how to break through into Ten Stars when Nine Stars was already the peak stage of Sect Master-level, Ling Han temporarily did not consider the problem. He firmly believed that there would be a limit to break through whichever cultivation level he was at. How could it be that he could not break through to Ten Stars of Sect Master-level?
He definitely could.
“Alright, since I can’t break through to the Venerate Tier, I’ll aim for Ten Stars!”
Ling Han changed his mind, and attempted to break through to Ten Stars.
However, in terms of breaking through, it was actually more difficult to reach Ten Stars.
That was because there was no precedent for this at all. In fact, he did not even know if it would work.

What if Ling Han couldn’t reach such a height even if he was beaten to death? Then, if Ling Han forcefully attempted to break through, wouldn’t he be asking for trouble? In fact, wouldn’t he even cause himself to go mad?
However, the Fourth Extreme was locked to him, so was there any other way?
Ling Han was definitely unwilling to be stuck at the level of Sect Master for the rest of his life — even if there were actually not many people in this world whose strength was superior to him.
He wanted to become the strongest, and only then would he be able to sweep aside all opposition from the Imperial Clans.
Forgiving? Hehe.
He would avenge himself, and this was his true belief.
Ling Han cultivated in seclusion for seven days, yet he couldn’t make heads or tails of the situation.
“Continue to kill Yin souls.”
“My path walked out through battle, and it can only be perfected through battle.”
Ling Han entered into space and began to battle Yin souls.
Right now, the only thing that could exert pressure on him was a Venerate Tier-level great yin soul.
He had his eye on this kind of existence.
Just like before, he ventured deep into the territory of the Yin souls, and then began a massacre.
Very quickly, a Venerate Tier Yin soul charged over, and delivered a palm strike towards Ling Han.
“Good timing!” Ling Han shouted loudly, and charged forwards fearlessly.
Peng!
With a single strike, Ling Han was instantly sent flying.
So what if he was a Nine Stars Sect Master? In front of a Venerate, he was still no match, even if it was a weak Venerate like a Yin soul.
But so what? A Venerate Tier would crush a Sect Master, without any additional conditions.
Unless!
“I can break through to Ten Stars!”

Ling Han’s eyes were burning. At present, he could deliver 22 six-star Regulations with a single strike. Though he was still no match for Venerate Tier, he had a feeling that as long as there were a little more Regulations, he could completely compensate for the qualitative gap with quantity.

That was because he had tried. 22 flashes of Six Star Regulations were already capable of contending against a sliver of Seven Star Regulations, and when he accumulated enough power and shot out 25 flashes of Six Star Regulations, he would be able to defeat that sliver of Seven Star Regulations.
Thus, theoretically speaking, as long as he grasped enough Six Star Regulations, he would indeed be able to stand against Venerates, but this number... would be astonishingly great.
It might have to be thirty, forty, or even more.
Ling Han didn’t know how many six-star Regulations he could unleash with a single strike if he could break through to Ten Stars. However, no matter what, he had to continue on this path.
Fight, fight, fight!
Gritting his teeth, he suppressed the boiling sensation in his chest, and immediately charged back, clashing head-on with that great yin soul.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
With every blow, Ling Han was undoubtedly sent flying. In fact, he spluttered out blood, and it was as if all the bones in his body were about to break. It was indescribably painful.
However, he immediately channeled the Ten Cultivation Technique, and after recovering for a short while, he charged back again.
The other Yin souls weren’t idle, and they also took advantage of the opening to attack, wanting to seize his body and replace him!

“An!” Ling Han called out the Six Characters Bright King Curse. His powerful spiritual power turned into an incredibly terrifying offensive power through this Buddhist Sect secret technique, and masses of Yin souls collapsed like snow meeting boiling water, instantly turning into dust.

He battled fiercely, fought bloody battles, and fought hard, forcing himself onto the line between life and death. If there was even the slightest mistake, and he would be consigned to eternal damnation.
Under such circumstances, he didn’t even consider using Purple Calamity Grains, so he could force out his potential.
Limits were broken at the moment of life and death.
However, even when the Yin souls withdrew their troops, Ling Han still had no gains.
He couldn’t see any opportunity to break through at all.
Ling Han didn’t give up. Breaking through to Ten Stars was the only path he had thought of at this moment. No matter how difficult it was, he was determined to continue on.
He did not return, and directly hid himself in the Void. As he meditated and cultivated, he waited for the next wave of attacks from the Yin souls.
Fight! Fight again!

Time and time again, Ling Han stood at the front lines, killing who knew how many Yin souls. He kept collecting rewards from heaven and earth. In fact, one day, heaven and earth suddenly stopped rewarding him.
He was startled. As it turned out, his physical body and soul had both reached perfection, and his cultivation level had also been stuck at nine stars, and could not possibly increase any further.
Thus, the heaven and earth didn’t know how to reward him either.
Er, how many Yin souls had he killed?

Ling Han didn’t know, but he would occasionally check the scoring device. The number on the scoring device stopped at 99 billion and a series of nines — it had reached the extreme of the scoring device, and was no longer taken into account.
In just a short while, Ling Han put this problem aside, and continued to battle.
With his personality of not turning back even if he ran into a wall, and since this was his only choice, then no matter what, he had to persevere to the end.
‘Come! Come! Come!’
Ling Han battled madly. He didn’t even use Destructive Energy anymore, and simply used his own path of martial arts to kill Yin souls.
Half a year, a year?
Ling Han didn’t know how much time had passed, but on a certain day, his eyes suddenly lit up, as good fortune befell his soul.
So... that was the case!
He was filled with pleasant surprise, because he had finally found inspiration to break through to Ten Stars.
Weng!
Right at this moment, a terrifying might swept over.
F***, it was Saint-level.
A large hand stretched out, covering heaven and earth. Endless dark veined patterns flickered, grabbing out at Ling Han.
The Yin Saint made his move.
Ling Han didn’t hesitate at all. He immediately channeled Purple Calamity Grains to form a protective shield, then spread Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to speed up.
Peng!

He sustained an attack from the Yin Saint, and the protective barrier formed by the Purple Calamity Grains immediately shattered. A powerful blast pushed him forwards, causing him to continue speeding up.
The power of a Saint was too terrifying. It actually caused Ling Han to accelerate inconceivably even at such a high speed.
However, the attack from the Yin Saint was also neutralized by Ling Han, and in the case of Purple Calamity Grains... it had completely lost its vitality.
After blocking the Saint’s attacks several times, it had finally reached its limit.
