How could it be that he could not break through to Ten Stars of Sect Master-level?
He definitely could.
“Alright, since I can’t break through to the Venerate Tier, I’ll aim for Ten Stars!”
Ling Han changed his mind, and attempted to break through to Ten Stars.
However, in terms of breaking through, it was actually more difficult to reach Ten Stars.
That was because there was no precedent for this at all.
In fact, he did not even know if it would work.
What if Ling Han couldn’t reach such a height even if he was beaten to death?
Then, if Ling Han forcefully attempted to break through, wouldn’t he be asking for trouble?
In fact, wouldn’t he even cause himself to go mad?
However, the Fourth Extreme was locked to him, so was there any other way?
Ling Han was definitely unwilling to be stuck at the level of Sect Master for the rest of his life — even if there were actually not many people in this world whose strength was superior to him.
He wanted to become the strongest, and only then would he be able to sweep aside all opposition from the Imperial Clans.
Forgiving?
Hehe.
He would avenge himself, and this was his true belief.
Ling Han cultivated in seclusion for seven days, yet he couldn’t make heads or tails of the situation.
“Continue to kill Yin souls.”
“My path walked out through battle, and it can only be perfected through battle.”
Ling Han entered into space and began to battle Yin souls.
Right now, the only thing that could exert pressure on him was a Venerate Tier-level great yin soul.
He had his eye on this kind of existence.
Just like before, he ventured deep into the territory of the Yin souls, and then began a massacre.
Very quickly, a Venerate Tier Yin soul charged over, and delivered a palm strike towards Ling Han.
“Good timing!” Ling Han shouted loudly, and charged forwards fearlessly.
Peng!
With a single strike, Ling Han was instantly sent flying.
So what if he was a Nine Stars Sect Master?
In front of a Venerate, he was still no match, even if it was a weak Venerate like a Yin soul.
But so what?
A Venerate Tier would crush a Sect Master, without any additional conditions.
Unless!
“I can break through to Ten Stars!”
Ling Han’s eyes were burning.
At present, he could deliver 22 six-star Regulations with a single strike.
Though he was still no match for Venerate Tier, he had a feeling that as long as there were a little more Regulations, he could completely compensate for the qualitative gap with quantity.
That was because he had tried.

22 flashes of Six Star Regulations were already capable of contending against a sliver of Seven Star Regulations, and when he accumulated enough power and shot out 25 flashes of Six Star Regulations, he would be able to defeat that sliver of Seven Star Regulations.
Thus, theoretically speaking, as long as he grasped enough Six Star Regulations, he would indeed be able to stand against Venerates, but this number... would be astonishingly great.
It might have to be thirty, forty, or even more.
Ling Han didn’t know how many six-star Regulations he could unleash with a single strike if he could break through to Ten Stars.
However, no matter what, he had to continue on this path.
Fight, fight, fight!
Gritting his teeth, he suppressed the boiling sensation in his chest, and immediately charged back, clashing head-on with that great yin soul.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
With every blow, Ling Han was undoubtedly sent flying.
In fact, he spluttered out blood, and it was as if all the bones in his body were about to break.
It was indescribably painful.
However, he immediately channeled the Ten Cultivation Technique, and after recovering for a short while, he charged back again.
The other Yin souls weren’t idle, and they also took advantage of the opening to attack, wanting to seize his body and replace him!
“An!” Ling Han called out the Six Characters Bright King Curse.

His powerful spiritual power turned into an incredibly terrifying offensive power through this Buddhist Sect secret technique, and masses of Yin souls collapsed like snow meeting boiling water, instantly turning into dust.
He battled fiercely, fought bloody battles, and fought hard, forcing himself onto the line between life and death.
If there was even the slightest mistake, and he would be consigned to eternal damnation.
Under such circumstances, he didn’t even consider using Purple Calamity Grains, so he could force out his potential.
Limits were broken at the moment of life and death.
However, even when the Yin souls withdrew their troops, Ling Han still had no gains.
He couldn’t see any opportunity to break through at all.
Ling Han didn’t give up.
Breaking through to Ten Stars was the only path he had thought of at this moment.
No matter how difficult it was, he was determined to continue on.
He did not return, and directly hid himself in the Void.
As he meditated and cultivated, he waited for the next wave of attacks from the Yin souls.
Fight!
Fight again!
Time and time again, Ling Han stood at the front lines, killing who knew how many Yin souls.
He kept collecting rewards from heaven and earth.
In fact, one day, heaven and earth suddenly stopped rewarding him.
He was startled.
As it turned out, his physical body and soul had both reached perfection, and his cultivation level had also been stuck at nine stars, and could not possibly increase any further.
Thus, the heaven and earth didn’t know how to reward him either.
Er, how many Yin souls had he killed?
Ling Han didn’t know, but he would occasionally check the scoring device.
The number on the scoring device stopped at 99 billion and a series of nines — it had reached the extreme of the scoring device, and was no longer taken into account.
In just a short while, Ling Han put this problem aside, and continued to battle.
With his personality of not turning back even if he ran into a wall, and since this was his only choice, then no matter what, he had to persevere to the end.
‘Come!
Come!
Come!’
Ling Han battled madly.
He didn’t even use Destructive Energy anymore, and simply used his own path of martial arts to kill Yin souls.
Half a year, a year?
Ling Han didn’t know how much time had passed, but on a certain day, his eyes suddenly lit up, as good fortune befell his soul.
So... that was the case!
He was filled with pleasant surprise, because he had finally found inspiration to break through to Ten Stars.
Weng!
Right at this moment, a terrifying might swept over.
F***, it was Saint-level.
A large hand stretched out, covering heaven and earth.
Endless dark veined patterns flickered, grabbing out at Ling Han.
The Yin Saint made his move.
Ling Han didn’t hesitate at all.
He immediately channeled Purple Calamity Grains to form a protective shield, then spread Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to speed up.
Peng!
He sustained an attack from the Yin Saint, and the protective barrier formed by the Purple Calamity Grains immediately shattered.
A powerful blast pushed him forwards, causing him to continue speeding up.
The power of a Saint was too terrifying.
It actually caused Ling Han to accelerate inconceivably even at such a high speed.
However, the attack from the Yin Saint was also neutralized by Ling Han, and in the case of Purple Calamity Grains... it had completely lost its vitality.
After blocking the Saint’s attacks several times, it had finally reached its limit.

chapters.title: Chapter 4542: Inspiration
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Why had the Yin Saint suddenly moved?
Could it be that because he had killed too many Yin souls, even the Yin Saint and the Saint could no longer bear it?
Or... could it be that the battle had escalated, and it was the turn of the Saint-level power to make a move?
Ling Han merely sprinted quickly. No matter what the reason was, in the face of Saint-level power, his only option was to flee.

Thankfully, the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was already very fast in the first place, and added with the fact that he had been struck by the Saint, his speed had increased even further. There was absolutely no need for him to worry about the Yin Saint catching up to him.
Ahead of him, the Venerate Tier-level battle area was already close at hand.

This time, Ling Han did not have the time to bother about his identity being revealed. With a flap of his fiery wings, he did not have the slightest intention of slowing down or concealing himself. Instead, he communicated through divine sense, “Run, the Yin Saint has moved!”
Though there were Venerates from the Imperial Clans here, aside from them, there were also Venerates from a great many other forces.
Thus, Ling Han could ignore the life or death of the Venerates from the Imperial Clans, but he couldn’t allow the other Venerates to die with them.
“Ling Han!”
“Yi!”
Seeing Ling Han flit past like a wild horse that had escaped its reins, everyone was extremely shocked. They had not thought that Ling Han would actually appear here.
However, they all shuddered upon hearing this.
The Yin Saint had moved?
Hiss, not good, a major event!
They hurriedly ran after him. At this moment, they all chose to believe Ling Han.
On this kind of matter, they were sure that Ling Han would not speak carelessly.

Immediately, large swathes of Venerates fled as well. At the same time, the members of the Imperial Clans also contacted their own Saints. At this time, they naturally had to ask Saints to come out and suppress the situation.
After Ling Han delivered the news, he immediately tore a rip into space and left.
He could not continue staying here.
When the Saints arrived, he wouldn’t be able to leave.
Would the Imperial Clans spare him?
Hehe, wasn’t this just a joke?
He had to flee now that the Saints hadn’t arrived!
He entered into the Void and continued to use Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to increase his speed.
Half a day later, he finally came out of the Void. Then, he adjusted his position, and descended towards the planet closest to him.
He hurriedly went to investigate the situation.

Sure enough, a large number of Yin Saints entered the battlefield, escalating the scale of this battle. With the powerful push of these Yin Saints, the territories occupied by the Netherworld rapidly expanded. The areas around the Mountain Sea Heaven, such as Purple Gauze Planet and others, had all fallen.

The majority retreated, continuing to build a line of defense, while a great many did not manage to retreat in time. Naturally, they were killed by the Yin souls — even if they were not killed, their physical bodies would be taken, and it would be no different from death.
Ling Han hurriedly made contact with the large black dog and the others. Thankfully, they had not lost any members. Only a few of them had been slightly injured, but it was no big deal.
He breathed a sigh of relief. As long as they were still alive, everything was fine.
Ling Han didn’t return at the first instant. Instead, he hurriedly went into seclusion.
He had grasped a sliver of inspiration for his breakthrough, so he naturally could not miss it. Otherwise, who knew when he would be able to grasp it again.
Seven days later, he exited seclusion.
He had not broken through to Ten Stars, yet could clearly see a path ahead of him.
Ling Han returned to meet up with the empress and the others.
When everyone saw each other, they all felt fortunate that they had survived a calamity.

“How’s the situation now?” Ling Han asked. He had only used the connection device when he had contacted the large black dog and the others. Usually, he would not be using the Galaxy Network, so he was naturally unable to grasp the latest situation.
“The various Imperial Clans and Holy Lands have all mobilized Saints. Even the Imperial Weapons have been moved over, temporarily suppressing the situation.”
“Buddha Doga did not appear on our side. However, the Netherworld also didn’t send out the Lord of the Blood Sea and the others.”
“Thus, we were caught off guard by the Netherworld’s concentrated troops. However, now that the Netherworld’s battle line has spread out, we also have to face a situation of shortage of manpower.”
Everyone was talking at once.

Under the wave of attacks from the Yin Saint’s concentrated power, the defensive line of the Living Realm was instantly torn apart, but now, the Netherworld army’s advance was also stopped. After all, if the Yin Saint directly entered into the Living Realm, even the Yin Saint’s strength would fall drastically.

The Netherworld had to wait, and allow the Yin Qi to expand outwards, so that the Living Realm would continuously transform into the Netherworld. At least, it had to be half-way open, and only then would they be able to proceed to the next step.
Similarly, the Living Realm also had to race against time. Otherwise, starting a battle in a place that was half-Netherworld and half-Living Realm would also be disadvantageous to them.
Thus, one wanted to transform the environment into the Netherworld, while the other wanted to transform it into the Living Realm. This had become the focus of contention.
For the moment, one side would not be able to push the other side out, and the other side would not be able to chase the other side back, so they were stuck in a stalemate.
If there was no stronger power intervening, it was obvious that this stalemate would continue for a very long time.

Ling Han nodded. The situation was temporarily stable. As for how things would develop afterwards, it was actually not up to them to worry. It would depend on how the Master of Yin River and the others would play their cards.
“Yi, your cultivation levels are all improving so quickly!”

Ling Han was slightly surprised. This was because the empress, Hu Niu, and the others had all advanced to the level of Sect Master. Meanwhile, the large black dog, the little azure dragon, and the perverted pig had all reached the level of Nine Stars. They had already caught up to his cultivation level.
Not only that, but even though Ji Wuming and the others had started later and progressed slower, they had all advanced into the True Self Tier by now. Their speed was astonishingly fast.
“Hold on, just how long have I been battling with Yin souls for?”
He only found out after asking for a while. As it turned out, he had actually battled Venerate Tier-level great yin souls for a whole twenty-three years!
Heavens, it had actually taken so long!
Ling Han couldn’t help but grit his teeth. After battling for a whole twenty-three years, he finally grasped a sliver of inspiration to break through to Ten Stars.

In terms of absolute lifespan, 23 years wasn’t a long time. However, in these 23 years, Ling Han was always hovering on the border between life and death. If he had made a mistake at any step, he would be consigned to eternal damnation.
If it was another person, to say nothing of 23 years, they would not be able to last even 23 days.
—Just let any Sect Master try to withstand Venerate Tier-level attack, and they could become ghosts at any time!
Most importantly, even in such a state, Ling Han had only managed to grasp a sliver of inspiration.
From this, it could be seen just how difficult it was to break through to Ten Stars.
“Since it’s all in the past, all of this isn’t important anymore. What’s important is that I have a chance of breaking through to Ten Stars!”
Ling Han decided to continue his seclusion, to charge up to Ten Stars in a single stroke.
“Little Han, you’re actually a Nine Stars Sect Master?” The large black dog and the others found this inconceivable.
With how freakish Ling Han was, he should have long since broken through to Venerate Tier.
Ling Han nodded, anddidn’t deny it.

“This isn’t good!” the little azure dragon said. “The current Golden Generation has all advanced into the Venerate Tier, and those like Ding Shu and Origin have all broken through to the Venerate Tier. Their battle prowess is extremely terrifying.”
Ling Han, whose battle prowess had once reigned supreme among the younger generation, couldn’t even squeeze into the top ten now, what more leading the masses. How could this not make people sigh?
Ling Han explained. The fruit of cultivation was trapped by the shackles of heaven and earth, so he was unable to break through to the Fourth Extreme.
This caused everyone to frown. What could they do? What could they do now?

“It’s fine,” Ling Han said with a smile. “I already have some confidence that I can break through toTen Stars. Worse come to worst, I’ll charge up to Twelve Stars, or even Fifteen Stars. One day, I’ll be able to break through these shackles!”
Seeing how confident Ling Han was, everyone could only believe him and nod.

chapters.title: Chapter 4543: Ten Stars!
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The only benefit brought by the invasion of the Yin souls was that the rate of cultivation of the Living Realm cultivators increased to another level.

Originally, it would have taken a few hundred years, or even several thousand, or even tens of thousands of years to reach this level, but now, with the rewards from the heaven and earth, they had reached this level in just over twenty years.
And the well-known figures of the younger generation would take advantage of this opportunity to once again widen the gap between them and the others.

The stronger one’s strength, the more Yin souls one could kill, and the stronger one would become. From there, it would stimulate the rapid increase of one’s cultivation level, and widen the gap between them and others.
Elites would become stronger.
Those like the Golden Generation, Ding Shu and Origin all became Venerates, only inferior to Saint Tier, and could be claimed to have boundless glory.
However, Ling Han, who had once been the most outstanding, had fallen behind.
—Because Ling Han had previously escaped to report the news, and was witnessed by a great many Venerates, everyone was clearly aware of Ling Han’s present cultivation level.
Sect Master, a Nine Star Sect Master.
What, it had already been more than twenty years since the invasion of the Yin souls, and the top prodigies had all become Venerates, but Ling Han was actually only Sect Master-level?
He had fallen behind, he had seriously fallen behind!
What was going on here?

No one knew, but the Golden Generation elites all smirked coldly. They had announced that while those without true background could laugh for a while, it was ultimately impossible for them to laugh for the rest of their life.
See, when one had reached this level, their true colours would be revealed.
Ding Shu, Origin and the others were also surprised. Logically speaking, how could the barrier of the Fourth Extreme be able to stop Ling Han?
In terms of comprehension ability, they were all masters of Genesis World, so they should be equally matched.
However, they had all broken through, and only Ling Han was left behind. What was going on here?

Now, the well-known figures of the Golden Generation, such as Imperial Son Ming and Imperial Son Tian, had all become Seven Star Venerates. Their cultivation level progressed frighteningly quickly, and in the case of Ding Shu and the others, they had already advanced into Three Stars.
Thus, even if Ling Han had now broken through to Venerate Tier, there was already a considerable gap between him and the top young prodigies.
Faced with the clamoring of the Imperial Sons, the large black dog couldn’t help but reveal the “truth”.
“Little Han’s freakish talent has attracted the jealousy of the heavens. The fruit of cultivation is trapped by the shackles of heaven and earth, unable to manifest the Fourth Extreme!

It reported its misfortunes, but not its good news. It was clear that Ling Han had already begun to cultivate in seclusion again, attempting to break through to Ten Stars This was a deliberate smoke bomb. As the saying goes, in times of danger, one’s true nature would be revealed. Whoever treated you well and who treated you badly could be clearly seen at this time.
“Sigh, what a pity!”
“So Ling Han’s strength has attracted the jealousy of the heavens!”

“That’s right. Previously, Ling Han had indeed displayed his fruit of cultivation. There were black patterns like chains on it, and I had initially thought that it was because he had cultivated some secret technique. I had not thought that it was actually the shackles of heaven and earth.”
“It’s over. Being punished by the heaven and earth, he’s definitely done for.”
“Sigh, such a prodigy is originally the king tier of king tiers, yet now he’s actually going to be eternally trapped at the level of Sect Master?”
“This time, the Golden Generation elites are going to be happy. They’ve finally lost a powerful enemy!”
This caused heated discussions, and Ling Han’s fruit of cultivation bearing the shackles of heaven and earth had indeed been witnessed by others, but no one had discovered what it was at the time.
Now that the truth was revealed, everyone naturally believed it. This indeed explained the problem of Ling Han being unable to break through to the Venerate Tier. After all, it was too illogical.
The heaven and earth was punishing him, so no matter how freakish you were, so what?
Once this kind of conclusion was reached, the Imperial Clans finally felt completely at ease.
Ling Han was done for. It was impossible for him to continue contending for the throne.
Thus, there was no need to rush to kill Ling Han now. They could completely have the Golden Generation elites personally kill him, and reclaim the glory that they had lost.
“Now, it is only up to Ding Shu, Origin and the others.”
“A new Emperor will definitely be born among the Golden Generation, Ding Shu and the others.”
“I wonder who it is.”
“No matter who it is, I only hope that a new Emperor will be born soon, and raze the Netherworld to the ground.”
“Yes, yes, yes!”
Because the situation had temporarily stabilized, the Imperial Sons began to play tricks again, issuing invitations to Ding Shu, Origin, and the others, to have a competition of prodigies.
In fact, they had even sent out an invitation to Ling Han.
Why had they invited Ling Han?
When the news spread, everyone was in an uproar.
It was clear that the Imperial Clans were humiliating Ling Han.
Weren’t you very awesome? Weren’t you once the strongest prodigy?
What is it? You can’t do it now?
‘Are you coming or not?’
If he didn’t come, that would be admitting defeat, and a slap to his own face! But if he came, then a sparring match would still be a slap to his face.
“Ling Han has already been crippled, so why are the Imperial Sons still clinging onto him?”
“He, why don’t you think about it? Merely in the open, just how many Imperial Sons have died by Ling Han’s hand? Added with the fact that there are still a great many that we don’t know about?”
“Thus, it can be said that the Imperial Sons hate Ling Han to the core!”
“I’ve also heard that at this gathering, the Donglin Imperial Clan will also choose a good husband for their Imperial Daughter, Chi Menghan.”
“Hiss, isn’t Chi Menghan Ling Han’s lover?”
“Precisely so, and that is why it is even more humiliating.”
“That’s right. His cultivation level has been eternally locked at the level of Sect Master, and his lover is going to marry someone else. Who wouldn’t go crazy in his place?”
“It can’t be helped. Who asked that Ling Han to be too brilliant in the early stages? Once he falls off the pedestal, there would definitely be countless people wanting to step on him.”
“Let’s take a look. When will the banquet be held?”
“Oh, because all the Imperial Sons have their own matters, it is scheduled to be held a year and a half later.”
“Where will it be held?”
“Xuanwu Planet.”
“Let’s go, let’s go, let’s quickly go there. When the time comes, we definitely have to witness this kind of gathering with our own eyes.”
Though it was still early, there were already a great many people that had set out on their way, fearing that they would miss out on the excitement.
And as the person involved, Ling Han was completely focused on breaking through to Ten Stars.

His accumulation of power was actually already enough. After battling bloody battles with Yin souls for 23 years, and even to the extent that the heaven and earth couldn’t reward him, just how much was this accumulation?
When he grasped a sliver of inspiration, the door to a new world had actually opened up to him.
He sat as still as a rock, but spiritual light flickered endlessly.
Right, right.
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face, his expression filled with confidence.
That was enough.
Beginning to break through to Ten Stars!

Once, twice, thrice. Continuous failures did not discourage Ling Han. It should be known that previously, he had fought bloody battles for 23 years without a clue. Thus, what were these few failures worth?
A year’s time quickly passed.
Ling Han’s comprehension bloomed like a flower, blooming endlessly.
Kuang!
Thunder suddenly boomed in the heaven and earth, and endless dark clouds began to intertwine, as if doomsday had descended.
The heaven’s calamity had arrived!
On Ling Han’s fruit of cultivation, the tenth golden streak was faintly discernible.

Now that the heaven’s calamity had descended, he definitely had to survive this. If he did, he would become the unprecedented Ten Stars Sect Master, and if he failed, it was unknown if he would still have the chance to charge up again.
After all, this was a life-or-death charge in his strongest state. It was hard to say whether he would be able to reach this kind of state in future.
Xiu, the heaven’s calamity transformed into human form and appeared in Ling Han’s mind.
“Scram!” Ling Han’s divine sense also took human form, charging towards the heaven’s calamity without hesitation.
F***, it had restricted his fruit of cultivation, and now it still wanted to ruin his plans?
He will kill it!

Originally, it would have taken a few hundred years, or even several thousand, or even tens of thousands of years to reach this level, but now, with the rewards from the heaven and earth, they had reached this level in just over twenty years.
And the well-known figures of the younger generation would take advantage of this opportunity to once again widen the gap between them and the others.
The stronger one’s strength, the more Yin souls one could kill, and the stronger one would become.
From there, it would stimulate the rapid increase of one’s cultivation level, and widen the gap between them and others.
Elites would become stronger.
Those like the Golden Generation, Ding Shu and Origin all became Venerates, only inferior to Saint Tier, and could be claimed to have boundless glory.
However, Ling Han, who had once been the most outstanding, had fallen behind.

Sect Master, a Nine Star Sect Master.
What, it had already been more than twenty years since the invasion of the Yin souls, and the top prodigies had all become Venerates, but Ling Han was actually only Sect Master-level?
He had fallen behind, he had seriously fallen behind!
What was going on here?
No one knew, but the Golden Generation elites all smirked coldly.
They had announced that while those without true background could laugh for a while, it was ultimately impossible for them to laugh for the rest of their life.
See, when one had reached this level, their true colours would be revealed.
Ding Shu, Origin and the others were also surprised.
Logically speaking, how could the barrier of the Fourth Extreme be able to stop Ling Han?
In terms of comprehension ability, they were all masters of Genesis World, so they should be equally matched.
However, they had all broken through, and only Ling Han was left behind.
What was going on here?

“Little Han’s freakish talent has attracted the jealousy of the heavens.

“That’s right.

“This time, the Golden Generation elites are going to be happy.

chapters.title: Chapter 4544: Sparring
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
It was as if Ling Han had gone mad, and the human figure formed by his divine sense attacked endlessly.
Peng, peng, peng! The punches landed on the heaven’s calamity figure, rendering it completely unqualified to attack. It could only take a beating.
Ling Han hadn’t broken through to the Venerate Tier, so the heaven and earth tribulation had to be restricted to the level of Sect Master.
At this level, was there anyone that could match Ling Han?
Hence, he was the only one who could make a move.
In a short while, the heaven’s calamity figure was completely dispersed by him, turning into a Celestial Qi that nourished Ling Han’s fruit of cultivation.
Yi?
Ling Han discovered that the amount of Celestial Qi was a little shocking, causing his tenth golden thread to rapidly deepen.

He had just stepped onto Ten Stars yet he had suddenly arrived at the middle stage of Ten Stars. Then, he advanced into the late stage like a hot knife through butter. In fact, he was even close to reaching the peak stage.
He had only destroyed the heaven’s calamity once, so how could the benefits be so great?
Just how difficult was this heaven’s calamity?

Ling Han faltered for a moment before coming to a sudden realization. This was because he had killed far too many Yin souls previously. However, heaven and earth had no rewards for him, so the rewards could only be accumulated as a debt to him.

—The heaven and earth would be heartless, and the fairest. You are too strong. The heaven and earth would impose shackles on you, and also leave you with a sliver of hope, and whatever is owed to you, it would definitely repay.
Peak stage of Ten Stars!
In a mere ten days, Ling Han had advanced from breaking through to Ten Stars to peak stage. This speed was chillingly fast.
Ling Han tried to sever his shackles again, but he still couldn’t.
Fine then, he would break through again!
Ling Han did not hesitate in the slightest, and began to charge towards Eleven Stars.
He refused to believe this.

The difficulty lay in Ten Stars. This was a level that no one had ever set foot on before. In fact, if it was not for the existence of the shackles of heaven and earth, Ling Han would not have thought of breaking through to Ten Stars either.
In fact, even if he wanted to break through his limits, he probably didn’t have such strong tenacity, to still refuse to give up after failing so many times.
Thus, one’s potential really had to be forced out sometimes.

The most difficult part had already passed. It was as if he had stepped onto the position of Venerate Tier, and now, from the position of One Star Venerate to breaking through to Two Stars, how difficult would that be?
In just three days, he had completed his breakthrough.
This time, the divine lightning of heaven and earth didn’t descend.
However, there was a mysterious energy surging in Ling Han’s body, helping him increase his cultivation level.
Ling Han knew very well that this was still the reward from heaven and earth. It had not been used up yet!
Another ten days passed, and he had reached the peak stage of Eleven Stars.
He once again attempted to sever the shackles, and discovered that they were slightly loosened.
Fine, you won’t open it, right?
‘I’ll continue to break through!’
Another four days passed, and Ling Han successfully advanced into Twelve Stars. Then, the rewards from heaven and earth were still continuing, helping him reach the middle stage of Twelve Stars.
This time, the rewards from heaven and earth had finally been used up.
Ling Han’s eyes suddenly snapped open. Boom! A terrifying aura surged out, causing even the Void to tremble.
“How... strong am I now?”
He was extremely curious. Theoretically speaking, reaching Ten Stars was equivalent to breaking through to the Venerate Tier. In that case, he was now equivalent to a three-star Venerate.
But the problem was, could such an analogy be used?
Ling Han spread open his hand, and with a light wave, 90 streaks of Regulations instantly appeared, intertwining with each other in an indescribable sequence.
“90 flashes!”
Even Ling Han himself was stunned. After crossing over the threshold of Ten Stars, his grasp of Regulations had actually increased exponentially.
“Furthermore, with Regulations intertwining, it seems to have increased my battle prowess further.”
Ling Han murmured to himself.

Previously, when the attack was delivered, the Regulations were only effective in terms of numbers. If there were too many, the attack would be strong, and if there were too few, the attack would be weak. There was nothing else.

But now, the 90 flashes of Regulations were intertwined in some indescribable manner, causing Ling Han to instinctively feel that the might of this was stronger than merely compounding the 90 flashes of Regulations, and it was not just by a little bit either.
“I’m really curious. Who should I find to spar with?”
Ling Han came out of seclusion. When the news came out, the empress, Hu Niu, the large black dog and the others all came over.
“Little Han, you’ve finally come out of seclusion!” the large black dog said smugly. “Look, Grandpa Dog is already a Venerate!”

Oh, indeed, it was not only the large black dog that had advanced into Venerate Tier. The little azure dragon and perverted pig had also advanced into Venerate Tier, and continued to maintain their lead in Ling Han’s group.
“How is it?” the little azure dragon asked.
Ling Han nodded, “I’ve surpassed Nine Stars!”
Hearing these words, everyone was instantly excited, joy on their faces.
Although Ling Han hadn’t reached the Venerate Tier yet, breaking through to Ten Stars was already a magnificent feat.
— Throughout the ages, how many Venerates were there in this world? But Ten Star Sect Master... was there one?
“Little Han, come, come, let Grandpa Dragon test out your current strength,” the little azure dragon said, its eyes extremely bright.
He had always been inferior to Ling Han, and now that he had finally gotten the chance, he naturally had to take advantage of the opportunity to trample on Ling Han.
Of course, their friendship would definitely not be shaken because of this.
Ling Han smiled, “Sure!”

“Don’t worry, Grandpa Dragon will use my power carefully,” the little azure dragon said casually, expressing that it would be more careful. It wouldn’t go to the extent of hurting or even killing Ling Han.
The two of them shot into the sky, and the others followed, watching the battle from afar.
“Father!” Ling Xi crossed her arms over her chest, revealing a worried expression.
After all, a Sect Master was battling against a Venerate. Even if Ling Han was freakish and broke through to Ten Stars, he was still a major tier away from the Venerate Tier, after all.
“Don’t worry, Master definitely won’t lose!” Fu Tianxing said with absolute certainty.
In his heart, Ling Han was an invincible god of war.
“Mhm!” Ling Xi nodded in agreement.
“Ling Han will win!” the empress interjected with absolute certainty.
This was an even firmer belief. Not only would he not lose, he would win!
“Niu’s Ling Han will definitely win!” Hu Niu nodded as well.
The little azure dragon heard them clearly, and couldn’t help but cry out loudly, “Little Han, Grandpa Dragon originally only wanted to defeat you, but now, I’ve decided to give you a beating.”
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Then you would have to have that kind of strength.”
“Take this!” the little azure dragon roared. It launched an attack, and energy surged. 30 six-star Regulations appeared at the same time, attacking Ling Han.

He knew that Ling Han had already been able to use 22 Regulations when he was still a Nine Star Sect Master. Thus, now that he had broken through to Ten Stars, his battle prowess would definitely explode greatly. He directly used 30 Regulations.
—He was a Venerate Tier, so it was naturally no issue for him to deliver 30 six-star Regulations with a single strike.
Boom, the terrifying energy turned into a massive dragon claw, interwoven with Regulations, that blasted towards Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled, and similarly shot out a punch. 30 flashes of Regulations also intertwined.
However, upon a closer look, the Regulations of the little azure dragon were only plain and unchanged, but Ling Han’s Regulations were intertwined with some kind of rhythm.
Peng!
The dragon claw immediately shattered, and a massive fist continued to smash towards the little azure dragon.
“F*ck!” the little azure dragon immediately exclaimed in astonishment.
How was this possible?
The others were also stunned. It was clear that the number of Regulations on both sides was the same, so why was it Ling Han that had the upper hand now?
This gap was not just a little bit.
The little azure dragon merely launched another attack. This time, he directly used the power of Venerate Tier, which naturally dispersed Ling Han’s attack with ease.

chapters.title: Chapter 4545: Strong to the point of heaven-defying
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Again!” The little azure dragon was unconvinced.

He thought that the reason why he was no match for Ling Han when the Regulations were the same in number was because Ling Han had becomea Ten Stars Sect Master. This had broken through the limits of Sect Master-level. Thus, in the use of the six-star Regulations, Ling Han definitely had an advantage.
Thus, he could only invest more Regulations into battle.
Boom! He unleashed another attack, which similarly transformed into a dragon claw. However, this time, it was entwined with 40 Six Star Regulations.
F***, forty flashes should be enough to crush you, right?
Ling Han, on the other hand, did not increase the number of Regulations. He still greeted this with 30 Regulations.
He wanted to know just how great a boost his Regulations would be when they intertwined.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow. This time, the Regulations clashed, and both attacks were destroyed.
They were evenly matched!
What!
Everyone was stunned. This, this, this, in a situation when there was a whole gap of ten Regulations, it was actually still a tie?
It should be known that the difference of a single star was the difference of a single Regulation, so the gap in battle prowess was incredibly obvious.
Now that there was a gap of ten flashes, it was actually a draw?
What kind of joke was this!
“You freak!” the little azure dragon said through gritted teeth.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “How about it? Your uncle is still your uncle, right?”
“I don’t yield!” The little azure dragon unleashed its third attack. This time, the number of Regulations on its claws increased to as many as fifty.
Ling Han was unafraid, and increased the number of Regulations to forty.
Peng! With a single strike, all the manifestations of Regulations were once again destroyed.
“You monster!” the little azure dragon cursed again, and then increased the number of Regulations to 60.
Ling Han greeted it with fifty flashes, dispersing it once more.
The little azure dragon increased the number by 70, and Ling Han dispersed the attack with 60. He increased it to 80, and Ling Han resolved the strike with 70.
Again?
There was no more. Even if the little azure dragon was a Venerate Tier, and was so freakish, it was only a One Star. The limit of his attack was 80 Six Star Regulations.
It was a tie!
Everyone was once again stunned. On the level of Six Star Regulations, Ling Han was actually not inferior to Venerate Tier.
This was practically... indescribably awesome.
“Brat, do you really have the battle prowess of a Venerate?” The little azure dragon was stunned. It charged out, and this time, it used the Seven Star Regulations.
There was only one.
Ling Han had also only used ten flashes of Six Star Regulations, but they were interwoven together, exuding an indescribable charm.

It had really been resolved.
Everyone’s eyes were dumbfounded, as if they had been struck dumb.

This was completely unrealistic!

Thus, Ling Han was practically a monster!

Two Seven Star Regulations, three, four... eight!
The little azure dragon was already going all out. Eight streaks of Seven Star Regulations were his limit, but even so, Ling Han was still able to move with ease, maintaining a tie all this while.
“I’m done fighting! I’m done fighting!” the little azure dragon said gloomily.
A One Star Venerate Tier was actually unable to defeat a Sect Master in a head-on confrontation. No matter what the reason was, this was incredibly humiliating.

“Freak!”

Everyone said, but all of them bore expressions of delight.
Ling Han, the king tier had returned!
So what if he hadn’t broken through to Venerate Tier? His battle prowess was on the level of Venerate Tier!
And when Ling Han broke through to Venerate Tier, just how strong would he be?

Twenty flashes of Regulations was the limit!
Are you f planning to break through 100?

Charging up to Ten Stars was done for the first time in history, but Ling Han, on the other hand, directly broke the limits of Eleven Stars and Twelve Stars

Thus, merely for this reason, he had to go to this appointment, what more when he also had to slap the Imperial Clans in the face while he was at it.

Meanwhile, the perverted pig retreated. Lord Pig didn’t want to go at all. You guys had best forget the existence of Lord Pig.
However, Ling Han stretched out a hand and picked it up.
B@stard, b@stard.

Ling Han did not have the empress and the others follow him. This time, he was going to slap their faces. Though the Imperial Clans guaranteed that they would be absolutely safe when attending the banquet, but what about afterwards?
He still had to be careful.

Now, the little azure dragon, the large black dog, and the perverted pig were all Venerates. The speed at which they tore open space was far faster than the speed at which they traveled through the Transfer Formation, and in Ling Han’s case, he was at a disadvantage because his cultivation level hadn’t increased, and he couldn’t use the Seven Star Regulations. Thus, in terms of crossing the Void, he was no match for the large black dog and the others.
It didn’t matter. The large black dog and the others would bring him along.

chapters.title: Chapter 4546: The feast begins
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The four “people” traversed through the universe, heading towards Xuanwu Planet.
With their speed, it only took them eleven days to reach this planet.
How lively!

This was the first impression that the four of them had. Most of the people here were young people, and their cultivation levels varied. There were cultivation levels ranging from Foundation Building Tier to Spiritual Transformation Tier, but there was a lack of Sect Masters. After all, those who could cultivate to Sect Master-level at such a young age naturally belonged to the category of the strongest prodigies of the current generation.
Were they all here to watch the excitement?
Ling Han gritted his teeth. These people were really too idle, weren’t they?
“Little Han, looks like you’re very popular. So many people have come to see you,” the large black dog said.
“To see you make a fool of yourself,” the little azure dragon added.
“Hu, hu!” The pervert pig laughed.
A vicious expression appeared on Ling Han’s face, and he said, “Are the three of you asking for a beating?”
In the whole world, only he would dare to say such words to Venerates, and only he would have that kind of strength and confidence.
The large black dog and the others all covered their mouths and laughed. It was really rare to see Ling Han suffer.
There were still about three months’ time until the grand feast hosted by the Imperial Clans.
Alright, they could only wait.
“Where’s Brother Monkey?” Ling Han asked.
“Brother Monkey went to a dangerous place to find natural treasures, hoping that they can help you break through the restrictions of heaven and earth,” the large black dog said seriously.
Brother Monkey!

Ling Han felt a warmth in his heart. Even though this world was realistic, materialistic, and in such a chaotic state, there were still sincere people like Brother Monkey, who brought him a sliver of sunshine and some warmth.
“What cultivation level is Brother Monkey at now?” he asked again.
“Eight-star Venerate Tier.” The little azure dragon pondered for a moment, then said, “In any case, Grandpa Dragon can’t beat him.”
Brother Monkey’s aptitude was also at the level of the Golden Generation. It would be strange if the little azure dragon could defeat him.
However, though an eight-star Venerate was practically the strongest below Saint Tier, Brother Monkey had gone to a desolate land of this universe. Who knew what kind of dangers he would encounter.

“I hope Brother Monkey can return safely,” Ling Han said. In truth, he was already confident that he could break through to Venerate Tier. There was absolutely no need for Brother Monkey to take such a risk.

The four of them discussed cultivation. Though Ling Han’s cultivation level was slightly inferior, he had long since formed his own path. Not only was he qualified to discuss dao with the large black dog and the others, he could even turn around to guide them.
This Sect Master was probably the only one in the world who could guide Venerates.

The little azure dragon already saw its own path, so it wouldn’t be difficult for it to walk it out. However, the large black dog and the perverted pig were slightly inferior. At least, they were still at a loss.
Day after day passed, and the four of them improved.
Finally, three months had passed, and the day for the Imperial Clan banquet was already close at hand.
At this moment, a large number of Imperial Sons arrived.

It was not just the Golden Generation, but also the Silver Generation and the ordinary Imperial Sons. Though Ling Han had killed batch after batch, the number of Imperial Clan elites was still considerable, so there were naturally even more that were alive than dead.
Now, these Imperial Sons were all in high spirits.

Yin souls invaded, and though it caused great damage to normal people, those like the Imperial Sons belonged to the category of benefiting from the invasion. Every single one of their cultivation levels had improved greatly.

Right now, the Golden Generation elites had all advanced to the Venerate Tier. Meanwhile, the Silver Generation elites were all standing at the same level as the high-ranking Sect Masters. In fact, even the ordinary Imperial Sons had quite a number that had successfully attained Sect Master-level.

By now, it was already the younger generation that would be taking the lead. As long as anyone could advance into Saint Tier, it would mean the full beginning of the replacement of the older generation with the younger generation.
Ding Shu, Origin, Myriad Dao and the others had also received invitations, and had all come here.

What made them luckier than Ling Han was the fact that they all had the backing of an Imperial Clan, which caused the Imperial Sons to clearly be envious and have killing intent, yet they did not dare to use their powerful background to snipe Ding Shu and the others.

If Ling Han wanted to, he could have married Chi Menghan many years ago. In that way, he would have the backing of the Donglin Imperial Clan. The other Imperial Sons would only be able to battle him in the open.
However, if he were to marry Chi Menghan under such circumstances, it would be equivalent to asking for help from the Donglin Imperial Clan. He would definitely have to pay a price.
How could Ling Han be living under someone else’s roof?
To him, the purpose of cultivation was freedom. How could he possibly give up a portion of his freedom for the sake of survival in exchange for the help of the Imperial Clan?
Now, it was indeed slightly more difficult for him, but wasn’t his growth better than anyone else’s?
Only after experiencing hardship and cold could plum fragrance be tempered1.
Another few days later, the banquet of the Imperial Clans began.

This wasn’t a one-day event. Instead, it would be held continuously for half a month. During this time, there would be martial arts competitions and spars, and the climax was when the Donglin Imperial Clan chose a husband for Chi Menghan.
For an Imperial Daughter like Chi Menghan, who possessed aptitude that was comparable to the Golden Generation, there would definitely be a queue of Imperial Sons who wanted to marry her.

The Donglin Imperial Clan was powerful enough by itself, so they definitely didn’t want to simply form an alliance through marriage with another Imperial Clan. Instead, they needed the person that would form a matrimonial alliance with Chi Menghan to be someone who could become Emperor!
Now that there were so many prodigies, it seemed like many people had hopes of becoming Emperor. Thus, the Donglin Imperial Clan needed to carefully consider and observe.

This banquet did not set up any barriers for those who came. Anyone could attend, but if they did so, they would only be able to stand in the outer circle. If they wanted to watch the sparring match from a close distance, or if they wanted to become acquainted with the Imperial Sons, they would first have to prove their own strength.
Otherwise, if just anyone could enter into the inner circle, the grade of this banquet would be endlessly dragged down.
Ling Han and the others arrived at the outer circle first.

The banquet was held in a valley. It was surrounded by mountains on all sides, and there was only one path through which one could enter. Anyone could stand at the top of the mountain and look down into the valley. As long as one had stepped onto the Celestial Path, this bit of distance was naturally no problem.
If one wanted to enter the valley and participate, they would at least have to have the cultivation level of Sect Master.
...The hierarchy of martial arts was the strictest. If a group of Sect Masters and Venerates spar with each other, would Spirit Transformation Tiers and True Self Tiers be qualified to participate?

Thus, most people were watching from the top of the mountain. In any case, there was no obstruction to their vision. Furthermore, the Sect Master and Venerate Tier-level battles usually took place in the skies, and they were actually closer.
On the first day, the atmosphere was harmonious. The Imperial Sons were all very polite, and no one made a move. On the second day, one spar after another officially began.

Actually, it was not just the Donglin Imperial Clan. There were also a few Imperial Clans that wanted to choose a husband for their Imperial Daughter. Thus, the Imperial Sons all worked hard to perform. Putting aside whether they were willing or not in the end, being able to gain the notice of other Imperial Clans was equivalent to a massive affirmation.
When one had reached heights like they had, they naturally were all aiming for the position of Emperor, and if one wanted to become Emperor, natural talent and luck were both necessary.
Affirmation from others had a boost to luck, and would mysteriously have an effect on it.
At first, everyone only watched the battle quietly, and then discussed who was stronger, but by the fifth day, the topic of conversation had changed to Ling Han.
“Yi, why hasn’t Ling Han appeared yet?”
“That’s right. Does he really not dare to come?”
“Hehe, who would be so stupid? He clearly knows that he would be embarrassing himself, yet still came here to make a fool of himself?”

chapters.title: Chapter 4547: Ling Han appears
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Everyone discussed spiritedly. On one hand, they hoped that Ling Han would appear, but on the other, they felt that it was impossible for him to appear.
“Little Han, shouldn’t it be time for you to take the field?” the large black dog asked.

“That’s right. You should take the field now; it’s time to show off and slap people’s faces,” the little azure dragon clicked its tongue. He loved to show off the most, but unfortunately, he couldn’t become the main character in the end.
“Heng, heng.” The lecherous pig was laidback. It only wanted to quietly look at the beauties, and when it was in the mood, it would go and tease the girls.
As for battle or whatnot, it was completely uninterested.
Ling Han smiled and said, “As the main character, I’m naturally going to be the climax. You guys go first.”
“All right. Grandpa Dragon is going.” The little azure dragon’s eyes shone brightly. Being in the limelight in front of everyone was his greatest hobby.
Xiu, he immediately leaped out, and headed towards the valley.

“Tsk, it’s another person who doesn’t recognize his own abilities at all.” Seeing the young man that the little azure dragon transformed into heading into the valley, a considerable number of people shook their heads.

There was a formation set up in the valley, and there was a layer of energy that could not be seen with the naked eye that formed a barrier. At least, only someone with the strength of Sect Master could pass through.

And those “VIPs” that were supposed to go to the valley had naturally arrived long ago. Those who were now charging towards that energy barrier were all people who were blindly confident in themselves, so they naturally would be looked down upon by others.
However, the little azure dragon was like a hot knife through butter, and the energy barrier couldn’t stop him at all.
That was because he was a Venerate.
“Yi!” “En?” “Ah!”
Everyone exclaimed in shock. They didn’t expect the little azure dragon to be so powerful.
F***, you clearly could have entered into the valley to attend the main banquet, so why did you have to stay here for five days?
Show off!
Peng! The little azure dragon landed on the ground, purposefully creating an extremely heavy sound of impact, instantly drawing everyone’s attention.
He enjoyed this kind of scene of being the center of attention very much. He bared his teeth in a grin, “Weren’t you guys waiting for Little Han? Grandpa Dragon is here!”

“So it’s you, Four-Legged Snake!” A Golden Generation sneered. The Imperial Clans had naturally investigated all the people by Ling Han’s side, and knew that the dog and snake by his side were very powerful. As for Brother Monkey, there was even less need to mention him.
“Pei, I’m a dragon, a True Dragon!” The little azure dragon immediately jumped up. “You country bumpkins are all blind!”

These words successfully caused the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters to reveal expressions of killing intent. In terms of ability to attract animosity, the little azure dragon was actually not much inferior to Ling Han.
“Where’s Ling Han? Why doesn’t he dare to show himself?” the Golden Generation asked. What was the point of tangling with the azure dragon?

The little azure dragon crossed its arms over its chest, appearing to be very detestable. “He has some matters to attend to, so he’ll come later. So, Grandpa Dragon will first beat the crap out of you guys, and then it’ll be Little Han’s turn.”
The Golden Generation laughed loudly, and said, “Merely a Four-Legged Snake, you are truly boastful!”
Do you think you are Ling Han, Ding Shu, Yang Yihuan and the others?
Moreover, Ling Han had already been crippled. He was eternally trapped at Sect Master-level, and had already withdrawn from the battle for the throne.
The little azure dragon roared and charged at the Golden Generation. “Watch how Grandpa Dragon smashes your stinky mouth!”
The corners of everyone’s mouths twitched. ‘If we’re talking about bad mouths, it seems like you’re the one more fitting for that label.’
The Golden Generation was unafraid. With a leap, he passed through the energy barrier and stood proudly in the air.
It was naturally impossible for him to battle with the little azure dragon in the valley. If he did, it would cause chaos below.
The little azure dragon didn’t say another word. Flapping its fiery wings, it set off in hot pursuit of the Golden Generation.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
The two of them battled fiercely. Frightening power reverberated, and the collision of the Seven Star Regulations created a brilliance that filled the skies.
That Golden Generation was also a One Star Venerate. As he delivered a strike, he could also deliver eight Seven Star Regulations, which was equal to the little azure dragon.
Since the Regulations were equal in level, then it would depend on whose power was stronger, and who had mastered the celestial technique better and was more agile in its use.
The little azure dragon had the advantage.
Who was he?
Young Son of the True Dragon, cultivated the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique, whose power far surpassed an Imperial Son!
And in terms of the celestial technique, the Imperial Techniques that he had mastered were not few in number. It was completely not inferior to the Imperial Son.
The moment the little azure dragon gained the upper hand, it immediately became smug and began to mock his opponent.
“Brat, you are too inferior.”
“No, no, not even 30% of Grandpa Dragon’s strength has been forced out.”
“Sigh, just hurry back and eat milk for a few more years before coming back.”
One after another, words of mockery came, and the Golden Generation’s face flushed bright red.
When had he ever seen such an opponent?
Just because you have the upper hand, so be it. What was the point of being so smug?
Moreover, you still haven’t won yet.
The little azure dragon didn’t care. His philosophy was not only to defeat you physically, but also to attack you spiritually.

The two of them battled fiercely. Though the Golden Generation kept unleashing his ultimate moves, the little azure dragon was not inferior either. It parried every move, and maintained its advantage firmly all this while, forcing the Golden Generation to admit defeat.

“Hahaha, too weak, really too weak.” The little azure dragon waved its hand, and said, “Is there anyone stronger? In a battle of equal cultivation levels, Grandpa Dragon will definitely beat the crap out of him!”
Everyone was extremely speechless.
You did not gain a crushing victory, so what need is there for you to be so proud? If it was really a life-and-death battle, it was not certain who would emerge victorious.
However, though the little azure dragon was arrogant, it was also incredibly cunning.
—A battle of equal cultivation levels!
He emphasized this point, and definitely had not been overwhelmed by victory.
He was a One Star Venerate, so if a Two Star or above Venerate were to defeat him, that would be an unjust victory.
They had never seen such a despicable person. He had said everything there was to say, and he had taken all kinds of advantages.
“Humph, this is a sparring match. It’s fine as long as the major tier is equivalent. How can you be so picky!” Another Golden Generation stepped out. He was Han Yun, from the Jade Drop Imperial Clan.
“If you can’t afford to play, then scram!” He moved directly, his large hand spreading out, turning into a monstrous demonic hand.
Three Star Venerate!
The little azure dragon didn’t dare to face him head-on, so it hurriedly used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to flee.

Against such an opponent, whether it was on the level of Regulations or power, the little azure dragon was at a clear disadvantage, and its opponent was the Golden Generation, so how rich was his battle experience?
The little azure dragon had no choice but to withdraw from the battle.
With a gap of two minor levels of cultivation level, he had really tried his best.
A hint of pride appeared on Han Yun’s face. This was the territory of the Imperial Clans. Was this a place where you could come and cause trouble?
“Alright, let’s continue.” He turned around and said to everyone with a smile.
Everyone chuckled as if they didn’t care about the little azure dragon.

On the mountain, the little azure dragon’s figure descended, and said angrily to Ling Han, “No, no, Grandpa Dragon wants to immediately return and cultivate in seclusion. I must catch up in cultivation level! If my cultivation level is the same, then that b@stard wouldn’t be qualified to act smug in front of Grandpa Dragon.”
He wasn’t exaggerating. In a battle at the same cultivation level, the Golden Generation was truly no match for him.
Ling Han nodded and said, “I’ll avenge you.”
“Go on!” The large black dog said, “Grandpa Dog will support you spiritually.”
“We have to snatch your wife back!”
“Charge!”
The large black dog and the others all egged him on.
Ling Han shook his head. These bad friends.
He smiled, and leaped towards the valley.

chapters.title: Chapter 4548: Sent flying with a smack
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Another guy that is going to seek his own humiliation.”
“There are too many such people, there is no need to pay attention to them.”
“Yi!”
Seeing Ling Han leap down, many people thought that he would immediately be sent flying back. However, Ling Han didn’t seem to encounter any obstruction at all, and directly landed in the valley.
“F***, another show-off.” Someone was indignant.
“No, he doesn’t need to show off,” the person beside him said slowly.
“Why?”
“Because he is Ling Han!”
When the news spread out, everyone looked pleasantly surprised and expectant.
Wasn’t the reason why so many people had come here just to see Ling Han?
This was the publicly acknowledged number one prodigy of the past. Even the Golden Generation could only gape behind him.
However, this kind of young king tier had actually attracted the jealousy of the heavens, and was eternally trapped at the level of Sect Master. How could they not sigh in pity?
A great many people still did not believe that this was real, and wanted to witness it with their own eyes.
Was Ling Han still the Ling Han of the past?
“I never thought that he would really dare to come!”
“Just this courage alone is worthy of his title as the strongest king tier.”
Everyone was filled with anticipation. Would they be witnessing the fall of the king tier, or the return of the king tier?
“Ling Han, though you will forever withdraw from the stage of history, I have to say, you do have some courage,” an Imperial Son said.
Niu Zhengyang of the Demon Ox Imperial Clan, Silver Generation.
Since when did even the Silver Generation dare to shout in front of him?

Ling Han couldn’t help but chuckle. His cultivation level had only been temporarily restricted to the level of Sect Master, and his cultivation level hadn’t dropped. So, why did the Silver Generation think that they could act superior in front of him?
To say nothing of the fact that you are only Sect Master-level, even if you had advanced into Venerate Tier, Ling Han was confident that he would be able to defeat a large number of them.
“Scram!” Ling Han said calmly. There was not a sliver of anger in his voice, only indifference.
The Silver Generation didn’t even have the right to anger him now. If they found him annoying, he could just crush them to death. There was no need to waste time.
“You!” Niu Zhengyang pointed at Ling Han, veins popping on his face.
He, an Imperial Son, a Silver Generation elite, was actually berated and ignored like a wild dog!
“You are already a cripple, and you still dare to be arrogant?” he shouted loudly, and charged towards Ling Han.

It should be known that ever since Ling Han, Ding Shu, Yang Yihuan, and the others had beaten the Golden Generations to the grouns, the Imperial Clans had begun to rearm their Imperial Sons. The old Saints of their clan did not hesitate to sacrifice themselves, extracting the great dragon of their backbone for their descendants to refine.
Not only did the Golden Generation enjoy such a good thing, but even the Silver Generation enjoyed it.
Thus, he also possessed the backbone of a Saint. He would absorb Saintly Particles every day, strengthening his bones and greatly improving his defenses.

This was only the first step. If it took a little longer, when all the bones in his body were filled with Saintly Material, his blood and flesh would also absorb these particles, and further increase his strength.
This strike was imbued with saintly might, so who could block it?
For Imperial Sons like them, the appearance of Ling Han, Yang Yihuan and the others was actually a good thing, forcing the clan to spare no expense to nurture them.
Thus, he didn’t take Ling Han seriously now. Firstly, he was strong, and secondly, Ling Han was crippled, so he naturally looked down on him.
Boom! With a single strike, he completely ignored the massive damage that his attack would cause.
It was fine. Ling Han had already appeared, and the next step would be battle.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “I told you to scram, yet you didn’t. You’re truly asking for a beating!”
Carelessly, he sent out a palm strike.
Everyone could clearly see that the attacks that Niu Zhengyang and Ling Han delivered each carried fourteen flashes of Regulations. In terms of Regulations, they were completely equal.
En, now it would depend on whose power was stronger.
“It must be Ling Han.”
“That’s right. He has cultivated Body Art as well. Furthermore, he is incredibly strong, far surpassing Imperial Son!”
Everyone nodded, thinking that since the Regulations were equal in number, then it must be Ling Han who would win.
Peng!
Their attacks collided, and as expected, Ling Han’s attack was like a hot knife through butter.
However, everyone was stunned. A great many people directly stood up.
How was this possible?
Ling Han indeed should be stronger, but in a situation when Regulations were equal, how could his advantage be so great?
With a single strike, Niu Zhengyang’s attack was crushed. This gap in strength was really too wide, wasn’t it?
The attack arrived at an incredibly fast speed.
Niu Zhengyang was instantly sent flying. Like a rolling gourd, he rolled several hundred meters on the ground before finally coming to a stop after crashing into a rock.
His body was riddled with wounds.
If it was not for the fact that a Saint Bone had been implanted into his body, he would definitely have died by now.
However, it was precisely because Ling Han had guessed that these Imperial Sons were presently implanting Saintly bones in their bodies, that he had been so heavy-handed.
He wanted to play slowly. How was he supposed to play if he scared them off all of a sudden?
Everyone was extremely confused.
How was this possible?
In a situation when Regulations were equal, even if Ling Han’s power had an absolute advantage, he shouldn’t have suppressed him so completely.
You see, Niu Zhengyang’s attack had been completely crushed, including the fifteen flashes of Regulations that he had shot out.
They were all six-star Regulations, and their numbers were also equal. How could such a one-sided situation possibly happen?
On the other side, Niu Zhengyang stood up with great difficulty. His face was filled with disbelief.
They were both Nine Star Sect Masters, yet he was actually no match for Ling Han?
He was a Silver Generation!
Were they still going to fight?

His heart was beating like a drum. If he chose to continue the battle, he had no confidence, but if he chose not to, previously, he had spoken so confidently, and now that he was afraid to fight, it was equivalent to slapping himself in the face.
After thinking for a long time, he still decided to battle.

Because Saintly bones had been implanted in his body, and because of Saintly Particles, from a certain aspect, he could release a sliver of saintly might. Thus, this was where his hopes of victory lay.
“Ling Han!” he shouted loudly, making a comeback.
Boom, another fourteen flashes of Regulations surged out.
Ling Han smiled, and flicked out a finger. This time, he had only shot out a mere ten Regulations.
However, the intertwining of his Regulations was like a tight rope.
Peng!
It was only a single strike, and Niu Zhengyang’s attack was broken through. The backlash from the attack exploded on his chest, cutting out a deep wound, revealing even the white of his bones.
There was complete silence!
This was too inconceivable.
10 Six Star Regulations had destroyed 14?
‘Are you joking?’
Everyone was dumbfounded, feeling that Ling Han’s freakishness had surpassed the truth of cultivation.
Even Ding Shu, Origin and the others were gaping widely, appearing to be in extreme disbelief.
This was completely unacceptable to them.
Something that was absolutely impossible had actually happened right in front of their eyes.
In history, there had indeed been weaker prodigies who had defeated stronger prodigies. However, it had never been heard that fewer Regulations could defeat more Regulations.
The heaven and earth were just. As long as they were of the same level, the higher number of Regulations would definitely be the victor. There was no doubt about it.
‘Why? Why?’

Niu Zhengyang trembled in fear. With the protection of his Saintly bones, he was temporarily safe from any danger to his life. However, faced with Ling Han’s inconceivable battle prowess, he was truly terrified. He couldn’t muster up the slightest bit of fighting spirit.
C

In a situation when Regulations were equal, even if Ling Han’s power had an absolute advantage, he shouldn’t have suppressed him so completely.
You see, Niu Zhengyang’s attack had been completely crushed, including the fifteen flashes of Regulations that he had shot out.
They were all six-star Regulations, and their numbers were also equal.
How could such a one-sided situation possibly happen?
On the other side, Niu Zhengyang stood up with great difficulty.
His face was filled with disbelief.
They were both Nine Star Sect Masters, yet he was actually no match for Ling Han?
He was a Silver Generation!
Were they still going to fight?
His heart was beating like a drum.

If he chose to continue the battle, he had no confidence, but if he chose not to, previously, he had spoken so confidently, and now that he was afraid to fight, it was equivalent to slapping himself in the face.
After thinking for a long time, he still decided to battle.
Because Saintly bones had been implanted in his body, and because of Saintly Particles, from a certain aspect, he could release a sliver of saintly might.
Thus, this was where his hopes of victory lay.
“Ling Han!” he shouted loudly, making a comeback.
Boom, another fourteen flashes of Regulations surged out.
Ling Han smiled, and flicked out a finger.
This time, he had only shot out a mere ten Regulations.
However, the intertwining of his Regulations was like a tight rope.
Peng!
It was only a single strike, and Niu Zhengyang’s attack was broken through.
The backlash from the attack exploded on his chest, cutting out a deep wound, revealing even the white of his bones.
There was complete silence!
This was too inconceivable.
10 Six Star Regulations had destroyed 14?
‘Are you joking?’
Everyone was dumbfounded, feeling that Ling Han’s freakishness had surpassed the truth of cultivation.
Even Ding Shu, Origin and the others were gaping widely, appearing to be in extreme disbelief.
This was completely unacceptable to them.
Something that was absolutely impossible had actually happened right in front of their eyes.
In history, there had indeed been weaker prodigies who had defeated stronger prodigies.
However, it had never been heard that fewer Regulations could defeat more Regulations.
The heaven and earth were just.
As long as they were of the same level, the higher number of Regulations would definitely be the victor.
There was no doubt about it.
‘Why?
Why?’
Niu Zhengyang trembled in fear.
With the protection of his Saintly bones, he was temporarily safe from any danger to his life.
However, faced with Ling Han’s inconceivable battle prowess, he was truly terrified.
He couldn’t muster up the slightest bit of fighting spirit.
