chapters.title: Chapter 4549: A mere Sect Master
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han smiled faintly, “What is it? Not fighting anymore?”
Niu Zhengyang gritted his teeth, but still said, “I forfeit!”
He had no choice but to admit defeat. This opponent was too freakish.
He had lost!

Everyone sighed internally. Though Ling Han was going to be eternally trapped at the level of Sect Master, this person was really freakish. In battle prowess of the same cultivation level, Ling Han was definitely invincible. In fact, even if a Great Emperor came back to life, he may not be a match for him in a battle of equal cultivation levels.
This was because they had never heard of anyone being freakish enough to have their cultivation level sealed by heaven and earth, unable to advance any further.

However, this was a deliberate misdirection from the large black dog. Ling Han hadn’t been sealed by heaven and earth because he was freakish. Instead, it was because he had obtained the Destructive Energy.
“Humph!” A Golden Generation sneered, “Ling Han, don’t think that we don’t know that you have already cultivated a sliver of Seven Star Regulations!”
What!
Hearing these words, everyone was stunned.
Ling Han had actually cultivated a sliver of Seven Star Regulations?
It should be known that when there was a gap of a level between Regulations, that was an absolutely one-sided suppression.
Thus, even if Ling Han had only cultivated a sliver of the Seven Star Regulations, he was still able to crush the Six Star Regulations. It was unreasonable.
No wonder Niu Zhengyang had been horribly defeated just now. So that was the case.
Everyone came to a “sudden realization”. Actually, the logic was very simple.

No wonder Ling Han was envied by the heaven and earth. As it turned out, he had cultivated the Seven Star Regulations when he was only at the level of Sect Master. Who else would be imprisoned if not you?

Yet they were very wrong. The reason why Ling Han had cultivated a sliver of the Seven Star Regulations was because he had obtained enough Imperial Origin, allowing him to see even higher level Regulations in advance.
Ling Han looked towards this Golden Generation, and asked with a smile, “Do you want a battle?”
This Golden Generation was Yi Taishu of the Blood Flame Imperial Clan, a One Star Venerate.
His expression was filled with pride, “Do you know that I am a Venerate?”
“So what?” Ling Han was completely unconcerned.
“Haha!” Everyone laughed loudly.
So what?
Venerate Tier could crush Sect Master; this was the truth of martial arts.
No matter how freakish you were, so what if you had cultivated a sliver of Seven Star Regulations? He had cultivated the true Seven Star Regulations, and it was not just one.
Hence, this gap was indescribably wide.
In a head-on confrontation, Ling Han would definitely be killed with a single strike.
“You’re only being stubborn because you’ve mastered the True Phoenix’s movement technique,” Yi Taishu said calmly. “If you face my attack head-on, hoho, you’ll definitely die.”
Ling Han cracked a smile, “What if I don’t die?”
“Not die?” Yi Taishu shook his head resolutely, “Impossible!”
He wasn’t an ordinary Venerate, but rather a Golden Generation. His battle prowess was comparable to a seven or eight star ordinary Venerate. Just how overwhelming was this?
“Come, how about we make a bet?” Ling Han cracked a smile.

“As you wish.” Yi Taishu wasn’t in a rush to make a move. Ling Han had suppressed the Golden Generation too powerfully at that time, and had practically beaten the Golden Generation into a useless generation. Thus, he also wanted Ling Han to embarrass himself enough.
You want to make a bet, and you want to make a big deal out of it? Fine, go ahead.
“If I take a blow from you, you have to give me a portion of Eight Star Celestial Qi,” Ling Han said.
“Then what if you can’t withstand it?” Yi Taishu asked balefully.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Then I’m going to die. If I die, everything on me will be yours.”
“All right,” Yi Taishu nodded.
“Wait.” Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, “I haven’t finished yet. If I win, you only lose a streak of Celestial Qi. If I lose, I lose my life. This is unfair!”
“What are you going to do?” Yi Taishu asked patiently.
“Every time I parry a blow from you, you will lose to me a portion of Eight Star Celestial Qi,” Ling Han said with a smile. How could he miss out on such a good opportunity to screw others over?
Hehe, you’ve gone crazy from wanting Celestial Qi, haven’t you?
But do you have the life to take it?
“Agreed,” Yi Taishu agreed. It didn’t matter. Even if he couldn’t kill Ling Han with a single strike, Ling Han would definitely die with two more strikes.
A dead man, so what if he was given Celestial Qi?
Could the battle begin now?
“Wait!” However, right at this moment, another person spoke up.
Imperial Son Ming!

This was the most powerful Golden Generation. Years ago, he had been on the same level as Imperial Son Xuan and Imperial Son Tian. Now that Lin Xuan had died, it had become him and Imperial Son Tian that were the most outstanding. He was already a seven-star Venerate.
Hence, once he spoke, even Yi Taishu had to give him face, and looked towards him.

“Let’s add some more stakes,” Imperial Son Ming said. “Isn’t the Donglin Imperial Clan looking for a son-in-law? Let’s start from this battle. The victor... has the chance to become the son-in-law of the Donglin Imperial Clan.”

He didn’t dare to force an Imperial Clan to submit to him. Thus, even if one of them won, he would only have a chance. However, this was already enough, and it could give Ling Han immense pressure and humiliation.
If you lose, you will lose your beloved forever!
“Agreed.” An old Venerate from the Donglin Imperial Clan nodded in agreement.
“I disagree!” Chi Mengshan immediately shouted. “I only have one brother-in-law, and that is Ling Han!”
However, the moment these words left her mouth, she was suppressed, and could only moan in pain.
Chi Menghan, meanwhile, was sitting upright, completely expressionless.
“Since that’s the case, let’s begin,” Imperial Son Ming said.
Ding Shu, Origin and the others were all paying close attention. They knew Ling Han very well, and knew that since this guy had appeared, he must have a trump card up his sleeve.
But what exactly was it?
What kind of trump card could allow him to fill the gap in cultivation level of a major tier?
“Ling Han, do you have any last words?” Yi Taishu asked balefully. Boom! The Venerate Tier aura was completely unleashed, solidifying into waves that undulated in waves.
Ling Han smiled, and raised his hand, “Rise!”
Boom, an Earth Dragon instantly appeared out of thin air.
At this, everyone “understood”.
Ling Han was also a Formation Master, and a grandmaster at that.
However, was this really possible?
“Ignorance!” Yi Taishu charged over in large strides, and shot out a punch. Peng, the Earth Dragon was instantly blasted into bits.
Ling Han raised his hand again, and another Earth Dragon appeared.
Peng! However, Yi Taishu had only struck once again, and the Earth Dragon crumbled once more.
“Two servings of Celestial Qi, thanks for the business,” Ling Han said with a smile.
Yi Taishu was completely unconcerned. So what if you earned 10,000 portions? In the end, you would still become a corpse.
Boom, boom, boom! One after another, Earth Dragons appeared, but they were also blasted apart by Yi Taishu.
At this moment, Yi Taishu was only 30 meters away from Ling Han.
“Die!” He moved. Boom, a massive palm appeared out of thin air, and struck out at Ling Han. Three Seven Star Regulations floated.
His limit was eight flashes, but if it was suppressing a Sect Master, wouldn’t three flashes be enough?
Ling Han smiled, “Rise! Rise! Rise!”
Boom, this time, eighty Earth Dragons directly appeared.
Just how powerful and perfect was his Spiritual Power?
The heaven and earth had already given him no further prizes, so it could be said that Ling Han had already reached the pinnacle of this cultivation level.
Thus, he summoned 80 Earth Dragons in one go, each of which had the strength of a peak stage Nine Star Sect Master.
‘Holy f*ck!’
A muscle involuntarily twitched in Yi Taishu’s cheek. Why were there so many Earth Dragons?
Even if there were 10, 20, or even 30 of them, he would be able to easily defeat them, but 80?
This was really a little too much.
It was not that he was no match, but rather that he needed to exert some effort.
This... was a mere Sect Master so difficult to kill?

chapters.title: Chapter 4550: Unsolvable
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
It was really difficult to kill him!

Yi Taishu unleashed his full power, launching a total of 11 attacks. Only then did he manage to eliminate all 80 Earth Dragons. However, with another wave of Ling Han’s hand, another 80 Earth Dragons appeared.
This... how was he supposed to play?

Yi Taishu attacked again, and the Earth Dragons rapidly decreased in number. However, it could not be helped that he was working very hard, but the moment Ling Han raised his hand, the Earth Dragons would regenerate, and it was really too easy for Ling Han.

The Venerate Tier-level power surged, causing massive damage to Xuanwu Planet. Even with Imperial Son Ming and the others protecting the area with all their might, this valley was soon razed to the ground.
It should be known that a Venerate Tier-level battle could destroy planets. If it was not for the fact that this place had been prepared beforehand, how could it have withstood such torment?
“70 portions of Celestial Qi, 80 portions of Celestial Qi.” Ling Han was still counting. His appearance was enough to make one vomit blood in fury.
Yi Taishu was extremely speechless.
Speaking of true battle prowess, he was a Venerate, so wouldn’t it be easy for him to kill a Sect Master?

However, it just so happened that Ling Han was actually a formations grandmaster, and his spiritual power was astonishingly strong. He could actually summon 80 Earth Dragons in one go, and even he had to expend some effort to kill them.
If this continued, how was he going to kill the enemy?
He had no choice but to consider a problem, and that was what if he really could not kill Ling Han?
Hiss, then how much Celestial Qi would he have to sacrifice? And it was Eight Star Celestial Qi at that!
This, even if it was only the number number, was enough to make the Blood Flame Imperial Clan go bankrupt, all right?

With this in mind, his attacks naturally became even more rapid. He wanted to defeat all the Earth Dragons as soon as possible, and deliver a fatal blow to Ling Han. However, when his attacks became faster, it was equivalent to speeding up the speed of delivering Celestial Qi to Ling Han.
“100 portions, 150 portions... Thank you, thank you.” Ling Han wore a sincere expression.
He was truly sincere. Who would be so insincere as to thank someone who had gifted them with over a hundred servings of Eight Star Celestial Qi?
There was none!

Yi Taishu roared loudly. His only chance of winning now was to exhaust Ling Han’s Spiritual Power, but looking at how Ling Han was moving with ease, it was very likely that his power would be exhausted first.

Formation Masters were pitifully few in number in the world, but once one had cultivated to Grandmaster-level, or even Saint-level, their battle prowess would also be astonishingly terrifying. One person was an army.
“Stop, stop, stop!” Ling Han shouted.
“The victor hasn’t been decided yet, so why did you call a halt?” Yi Taishu shouted. His expression was no longer as calm as before, and he was only flustered and exasperated.
Ling Han retorted, “Don’t you have any idea how many portions of Eight Star Celestial Qi you can take out?”
This!
Yi Taishu felt as if his chest had been ruthlessly stabbed. It hurt.

If this were a normal battle, it wouldn’t matter. They would just fight to the death. However, they still had a wager on this battle. Every time Ling Han blocked a move from him, he would have to pay a portion of Eight Star Celestial Qi as compensation.
If he counted the number now... it caused even his face to turn pale.
“You don’t dare to fight anymore?” Yi Taishu shouted.
Ling Han wagged his finger, “If you want a battle, fine, but please settle the tab first. My shop is small, so I can’t afford credit.”
Everyone’s expressions were strange. Did you f open a shop?
“I don’t have that much Celestial Qi!” Yi Taishu shouted.
To say nothing of him, even the whole Blood Flame Imperial Clan did not. In fact, even all the Imperial Clans added together didn’t.
Over a hundred portions of Eight Star Celestial Qi, not over a hundred portions of Celestial Qi.
Ling Han sighed and said, “If you’re poor, then don’t gamble. Why are you pretending to be rich?”
You!
Pu! Yi Taishu spluttered out a mouthful of blood. He had been angered to the point of spluttering.
“Brother-in-law is too awesome!” Chi Mengshan exclaimed excitedly, as she danced around.
Right, she was immediately suppressed again.
Chi Menghan, meanwhile, showed a smile. This was the man that she had her eye on!
“Ling Han, you’re relying on formations, so what ability do you have?” a Golden Generation shouted.
No one responded.
When facing an enemy, as long as they could win, what method could they not use? Was formations something to be ashamed of?
Of course not!
Thus, this was only him trying to twist the facts and cover up for the Golden Generation.
“Let me fight you!” A Venerate jumped out, but it was not a Golden Generation. In fact, he was not an Imperial Son, but rather a Dao Child that had just advanced into this level not too long ago.
Of course, he was much older, and had already exceeded 10,000 years old. However, among those at Venerate Tier, he could still be considered young.
Ling Han shook his head.
“What is it? Are you afraid?” This Venerate said. His name was Ma Bangye, and he was only a One Star Venerate.
Yi, though they were both One Star Venerates, how much stronger was the Golden Generation compared to the Dao Child?
Even Yi Taishu couldn’t deal with Ling Han, so what right did Ma Bangye have to jump out and challenge him?
“I’m only an ordinary One Star Venerate. What is it? You don’t even dare to battle me?” he said.
This was clearly belittling himself, and being able to make a Venerate do this, it was obvious that Ma Bangye was trying his best to curry the favor of the Imperial Clans.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “I already said that the shop is small, so I can’t afford credit. So, please pay off your debts first.”
F***, how could it possibly be cleared?
Over a hundred portions of Eight Star Celestial Qi!
But Ling Han looked like he wouldn’t start a fight unless the tab was settled, which made the Imperial Sons feel exasperated.
They had already announced to the whole world that as long as Ling Han dared to come, they would definitely give Ling Han a chance for a fair battle.
How could they go back on their word?

If they really broke their word, then the Imperial Clans would be completely humiliated. In fact, they would even be abandoned by the fortune of heaven and earth, and not a single Imperial Son would be able to become Emperor.
This was definitely not allowed.
But who asked them to be tricked by Ling Han? They were trapped in this kind of stalemate.
The Imperial Sons discussed for a while, and decided to collect funds together, gathering Celestial Qi for Ling Han.
With their command, a great many Imperial Clans channelled their power.
The members of the Golden Generation had all advanced to the Venerate Tier, and they were becoming more and more important in the clan. They were completely capable of making the clan work for them.
In just three days, a large amount of Celestial Qi was transported over.
“There are only 72 portions of Eight Star Celestial Qi. As for the rest, we’lll use the other grades of Celestial Qi to make up for it,” Imperial Son Ming said in a baleful voice.
It didn’t matter. Now, they would just have to let Ling Han feel proud. In any case, they would kill him when he returned, and they could still take back the Celestial Qi.
However, they couldn’t fall for this guy’s trick anymore. They couldn’t gamble with him anymore.
“Sure,” Ling Han said with a smile. He was extremely satisfied.
He had not expected that the trap that he had dug for Yi Taishu would actually allow him to reap such great rewards.
Not bad, not bad.
After collecting a large amount of Celestial Qi, Ling Han coughed, and said to Ma Bangye, “Now, you want to fight me?”
Everyone’s expressions were strange. Had Ling Han gotten addicted to swindling Celestial Qi? He still wanted to gamble?
Yet Ma Bangye smiled, “Sure.”
“Do you have Celestial Qi?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
Ma Bangye shook his head, “We won’t bet Celestial Qi... we bet our lives!”
They were betting their lives!
“If you win, my life will be yours. If you lose, your life will be mine!” Ma Bangye said balefully.

Everyone knew that Ma Bangye must have jumped out to curry the favour of the Imperial Clans, but the problem here was that you are only a One Star Venerate, so what right do you have to settle something that even Yi Taishu could not?
Ling Han smiled and said, “You’re a Venerate, yet you’re betting your life against a Sect Master like me?”
Was this fair?

This was practically a joke. The Venerate Tier could crush the Sect Master—of course, Ling Han was different. He was a Formations Grandmaster, and with the simultaneous appearance of 80 Earth Dragons, even Yi Taishu, who was a Golden Generation, couldn’t help but feel exasperated.
